text: The game and is honestly good. It's a turn based RPG battle game and it's genuinely great. The units are diverse, anything can be useful in the right context and the synergy is great. My main complaint is the absolute wall of in game transactions that hits you every few minutes. it's just a constant barrage of pop ups and it's real tedious. The offers are also incredibly bad value. There is also an insane amount of bloat but considering the age of the game, that's to be expected.

the game is great. time killer, team management is dope, the only thing I have a complaint about, is the challenges you do, remembers the team you used, but not the equipment you used in that battle. I wish there was something where you can save a layout of champion to gear and make it easier. Also, and this one is a big also, BRING A MERCY COUNTER! I'm tired of guessing man. I get way more rare pulls than anything on this game and I'm tired of it.

A game for downtime, can quickly get boring for that reason. The summoning is raw (you'll end up with so many useless commanders that are never worth anythingin the game, I'd say it's incredibly hard / time consuming to get anywhere in the game as a F2P. But even when spending it's very much gambling, except you lose a lot more often.

it's got a cool combat system and heros ECT ECT, haven't played much beyond a few campaign bosses because I'm just tired of the bombarding of promotions, deals and shop offers every fkn time I launch the game or return to main town. if I was interested in deals or buying stuff, I'd go to the store and look for it. I just wanted something different and casual. this is just annoying and spammy.

I deleted the game a while ago but decided to start playing it again to see what changes had been made/wanting to play again. however, when I logged back in all my progress has been lost, even when I log in with their plarium account it starts me all over. lost countless hours of grinding. I guess I will never be playing this game again because of the countless hours I put into playing the game is gone. So do not believe their comeback feature, even when tech said they could help, they didn't...

Raid is really good at some things, they know how to get their hooks in and keep you playing, and this is a good game in many ways, just let down by extremely predatory monetization, ridiculous power creep, extreme pay to win, and some really frustrating game design decisions. Despite all that I still play the game but at this stage it feels like a dirty addition that I want to give up, so cannot recommend it.

The Pros :- I like the characters. Kudos to the artists behind those. Base storyline and voice acting is good. The Cons:- -HEAVILY pushed micro transactions on every menu. -Not new player friendly there's so much to absorb it burns you out in a few hours. -If you want to get anywhere or do anything at a reasonable pace be prepared to pay with everything you've got in the bank and take out some credit why you're at it. the cost of some things is absolutely mind blowing.

The game itself is amazing, the customer service is the reason for my rating. If you have any issue, without a screenshot they say nothing can be done, always take screenshots of everything you do in the game or else you will get ripped off edit- ticket ID 7074556 & 7151502 These are the 2 I am not happy with, if this can be resolved then I'll quickly change my review to the 5* that the gameplay deserves.

Very expensive game. Yes you can progress for free and reach end game content in approx 150 years. Even if you buy in-game items nothing is guaranteed. This is a whole new level of gambling. Even on x25 you wont get the desired champion. So basically give us all your money and we give you nothing in exchange based game. It takes too much time and money........

It's a good game for what it is. Been playing for 3 months now but with only Granut (my only Leg Summon), Ezio, Xeno and Mikey as my strongest I am not getting very far in PvP. I complete all the daily challenges and try to do as many events and challenges as I can. I don't see myself playing long, as even when I'm stronger than others I can't beat them with their paid champions (Like Shredder and Predator). It's a good game, but as a free player I don't think I will play for much longer.

Game is enjoyable. However, in app purchases are far too expensive for such slim odds of getting what you want/need. Also, DO NO REFER FRIENDS. I referred a friend and got nothing out of it. Plarium claim she already had the game installed prior which is not true, she'd never even heard of the game. I get the vibe that these are greedy developers and there's really no need.

excellent graphics and variety of powered characters. Getting the most from your characters by selecting armour and upgrades to suit their skills and then combining them in teams of 4 usually seeking a balance of speed, power and defence. Highly rewarding and addictive, the frequent adverts to encourage you to give them money for game progress are irritating. You also have to work hard and be very patient to progress

I avoided this game for years because of the non stop ads... I joined for Ezio and the Assassins, and I've actually really enjoyed it so far! Update, after the event finished, leaving me no other means to unlock any other assassins, the game has lost any sense of purpose and has become rather dull. hopefully in the next event there will be more f2p characters to build out a full squad instead of just 1 good character!

The individual characters designs are very impressive the fact that each character then comes a tiny backstory and individualised move sets is beyond impressive. It's a great game to play to blow off some steam with daily tasks with rewards. The reason it's not 5 star is the constant pushing of Micro Transactions and Promo Codes all being geared towards new players, which is fine they need more help but the compete lack for longtime players is like the game punishing you for continuing to play

its burning up my phone in less than 5 minutes, no other apps do this, & you have very little choice if u play for free & they make the game very confusing when they are talking about the enemy and other parts of the game, they make it extremely complicated for people who are older, it looked simple in the ads but its nothing like the ads & its so deceiving, uninstalled, 3rd time now I've tried it, but even when I stick with it 4 a while its too complicated and burns your battery out 😭🤦‍♂️😫

There is a growing problem with the game. Every few updates they add new heroes which is a good thing! however, The more heroes added to the game, the harder it'll be for you to get the character you want. This has been a problem for a while but it's getting worse. The game always demands specific characters but with no real way to focus champions (All of them). So the grind starts to get stale knowing that you may never get the character you want. This is something they need to change soon.

It's alright. I enjoy it, but the only thing I gave an issue with is that everything you do requires paying in-game currency but doesn't give you enough to compensate. At least to me, it's difficult to improve my characters or their gear. I should not have to pay in-game currency to un-equip or re-equip gear. Also difficult to get higher ranking characters outside of login rewards or events.

The foundations of the game are great. Trying to delete your account because you haven't played in years and want a fresh start is basically impossible, especially with the customer service and required information that the bot requires. Not to mention the absolutely insane amount of pop ups when in the main town. Its easily the most predatory monetization I've seen. Seriously guys, over 15 pop ups saying I need to buy all this junk? That makes me quit more than anything.

As a free player, it's not bad. Definitely gotta knock out the daily achievements to even have a chance at progress. I'm 100+ days in. starting during the American McGee's Alice in Wonderland event, and I've mostly enjoyed it. It certainly has more resources to manage than other games I've played, so I've certainly made some mistakes, but overall, it's a fun use of 45 to 180 minutes per day. It would be nice if pop-up ads for pay to win items didn't show up constantly every time, though.

Really rough if you are just starting out. The game doesn't seem to give you any upgrade material for your characters, and when you go to choose characters there is no screen that shows their skills which is extremely frustrating. The lack of blue or purple units in the beginning of the game make it really hard to progress farther, especially when it keeps getting tougher and you don't have materials to level your characters or better units.

In-app purchases for anything worthwhile is expensive, also it's not worth it because your odds of actually getting anything better than rare from your shard purchases is ridiculous. The game is free to play if you do want something to pass time and not pay for anything you can play this game, but if you plan on progressing, you'd rather wait for free events and characters. it's been years and I have yet to acquire a mythical character from a shard, finally uninstalling this game now.

Overall "free" account progress is locked behind PvP success. This means the company can continue to add more powerful champions, new rarity levels, and different types of gear that require credit cards which will literally halt your progress unless you get lucky or get paying. Power creep and corporate greed are squeezing this game and the players for every last penny, while Plarium sees nothing wrong. The game is in maintenance/whale farming mode

The game has way too many features and it's hard to keep up with everything going on. Needs hours and hours of study for the best game play options. From the level 25 takes ages to get to the following levels. Played it for two full months and despite being fun to play the action is a bit repetitive.

It's a good game as a PvE experience which thankfully is it's core. Levelling up champions and trying gear sets is fun and strategic. The PvP element leaves a lot to be desired. I've literally never won Live Arena being fairly new and get matched up against people with way more levels and with a greater pool of champions to choose from. The regular Arena also needs a massive overhaul as seems pretty unbalanced.

I've had this game for years and my thoughts have remained the same. The gap between pay to play players and non pay to play players is massive. incomparable. The prices for all the items and bundles in the shop are stupid egregious. I'm constantly facing players that obviously pay to play. this makes it impossible for PVP anything. I can't seem to get hardly any skill tomes of high rarity or other items to grow my team to keep up without paying. PVP anything, is discouraging as a result.

For starters, it is a good game and is fun. For almost everything it is a lot of grinding and the time it takes for energy to replenish and the gems. One of my most hated aspects is the upgrading, it takes so much silver just for a failed attempt. And summons, they suck. There's so many champions and you get so many repeats and none of the ones you actually want. Ive probably summoned the Hellhound at least 50 times at this point. Its a never ending game pretty much.

One of the few games I sunk a bunch of money into and felt no remorse about it. Between gear sets, characters, the difficulty building and acquiring them, there was a real sense of satisfaction when my toons were tuned how I liked them. Builds were very diverse and personal rather than you had to wear this gear or you're dumb, at least I thought so, and nobody is doing it better or even comes close imho. i lost my account though and interest with it, and will probably suicide bomb Google for it

This game has been a glitchy pay to play nightmare. The promo code system was "down" until after the time limit to enter new player promos. And the game force closes all the time once you hit a certain point in the campaign so that all of the new player buffs you get at the beginning are wasted and expire before you can use them. The game is a painful slog designed to force you to spend money. It's almost dystopian how many in-game sales popups there are. Support is non-responsive. Waste of time

excellent quality graphics and a simplistic play style that's engaging and the game is very generous with summons. However, you will notice most people have at least 2 legendary hero's by 30-35th level, however my first game went into the 40s without any. This has occurred with a few friends as well halting progression. I made a new account and had two legends before 20th level and a third with Skeletor. Many "first accounts" seem to be broken but making a new account seems to work sometimes.

The game is really good but," huge but" if you don't watch YouTube videos first, you are going to hate it!! Dev's won't let you restart, I tried 10 times, new emails and accounts.... so frustrating!!!! Now I'm stuck with a bunch of trashy champions and it's just plain disheartening. Everything is always about money 😭😭😭

Game is overall pretty fun and has a lot to offer even as free to play. You can play pretty much all aspects of the game without spending anything. Content creators like Ash and hell hades have great guides to follow. Hades has a f2p series he plays every year and has great strategies to follow. Above said, i do think it could be a little easier to get Blue summoning shards. And imo, I think it's time to make changing gear free. But the content is there. update: gear change is free!

gave it another shot after all these years cause I still get tons of ads for it. it is still incredibly disappointing. there is not a single thing that makes me want to keep playing. the story? forgettable. the units? also forgettable. the art style? I mean it is a 10 year old game but it really shows. the gameplay? its a slogfest of grinding for everything. very little quality of lifes and if you do the missions make sure you do them one at a time cause you cant complete them "retroactively"

Pretty much any other game in this genre is better than this. Its dry, heavily monetized, extremely pay to win, almost no decent daily rewards or bonuses. Balance is a mess, lackluster hero designs. Played a ton of games in this genre and this is almost the worst one I have ever played. Just no incentive to really play unless your a whale or have nothing else to do.

I would add the option to remove champions completely without having to use them as "food champions" to rank up other champions. Edit: After almost 3 months of playing I have barely made progress in the game. Shards rate are really bad and for free to play players you are essentially stuck in an incredible disadvantage against premium players : endless hours of grinding, live arena defeats . Free to play players should have more of a chance at enjoying the game as much as premium players

Always changing up everything in the name of "balance". For them it means destroying established teams and characters. Nerfing, not balancing. There's no way that my teams I used to beat certain aspects of the game now struggle and fail at levels what I completed with ease as a brand new account with less powerful characters and gear in half the time. Their mercy system is still a joke and a ripoff. Simply broken. After all these years they still don't even have an alphabetical sorting system.

Mostly a pay-to-win game. It takes long time to progress and the tracking isnt even accurate. For instance, There are numerous missions involving raids that dont quite get tracked unless you have unlocked up to that point, meanwhile other non-raid missions get tracked but you just don't receive the rewards until you make it to that mission progress level. The game is also very pushy about buying different pay-to-win packages by constantly popping up "sales". Pay or progress very slowly...

​While this is easily one of the best games in its genre, it is also the most expensive I have encountered. Progression requires an incredibly intense grind, and the in-game store packages—often ranging from $30 to $50—are overpriced compared to the $2 to $20 options seen in competing titles. Furthermore, the constant stream of transaction pop-ups on the main menu is intrusive. A more restrained approach to store promotions would greatly improve the overall user experience.

It's a good game, but the in-game shop is expensive. Like RIDICULOUSLY expensive. The game constantly bombards you with flash deal pop-ups worded like it's such a great deal, but when you actually look at what you get for the price they charge, it's like no way am I paying that much for that. I've seen pop-ups shilling something that gives you like a 1% chance of getting something semi-decent going for the price of an entire AAA game. Nope.

I'm new to Raid and decided to download it because of the free Skeletor and He-Man characters. However, the game has an excessive amount of ads and pop-up offers. I spend more time closing obnoxious promotions for items I don't understand or I am still learning than actually playing the game. As a new player who's still learning the basics, it's overwhelming and takes away from the overall experience. Hopefully it gets fixed soon I am unaware for how long this has been an issue for.

The game is okay. But, it is probably one of the most expensive games you will play. Some games have packs for a few dollars. The packs on this game are usually $29, $39 or $50. Very expensive. Plus, the micro transaction pop up windows are constant. it is very annoying that the push to buy is beyond the norm. You can play for free, but you will never be able to compete at a high level without a multi year long grind for resources or upgrades.

it's fun the first week or two then you run out of all the resources they throw at you the first week, you find out you can't play without energy and very little is able to be farmed early. There's so many modes locked behind level restrictions, the main modes to farm energy. The game gets boring pretty quick unless you're willing to purchase resources with real money.

Updated app on Android tab. App would never reload. Deleted and reinstalled multiple times with same results. I was able to load once. App froze after 30 minutes. App won't load. Have played many years and have spent thousands of $$$. Deleted, currently playing a competitor's game with no issues on same device. Thanks plarium. I hope others don't have the same experience.

When i started playing i loved the game. as I progressed energy runs out extremely fast because of the high cost. Because its high cost I believe it would suit players to have extra free options to get energy. It doesn't makes sense that I have to spend money to play the game and the the champs cost as well this game right now is a money guzzler. its not sustainable to free to play players. very good design 👌🏽 I enjoy until my energy is sucked dry and I gotta wait 8 hours for it to refill.

free play is possible but barely. pop up ads are frequent & annoying. but updates and storage requirements for the game are too frequent & too multiple Gigs. up until now my device could only run it by moving storage from internal to SD on my devices. but latest update is so big my system can't handle it. crashes a lot. seriously stop making it harder to play with every update & now unable to play on at least one of my devices with latest update.

Played the game, used the RAID7 new player code, linked my account to my email which reset the game, which was fine, but then wouldn't let me claim the promo gut on the account they reset FOR LINKING MY EMAIL! I sent a trouble ticket, and it magically disappeared with no solution. Send another one, gave up and deleted the app. Really wanted to play, but thats so riduciouls. Edit: Reached out, Maryna responded that was a copy and paste from the help section. Wasn't anything to do with my issue.

One of the worse games I ever played if you like legitimate games with legitimate mechanics. only true things is it's a hero collector game with no real way to get what you want. everything is rng even leveling skills. you'll waste a year just trying to get one champs gear fully maxed and level. this is a game that intentionally hinders player progression. do not recommend if you want a relaxing with little problems. pvp is also filled with hackers and they refuse to address it.

Edit: My statement about the free stuff is whack in comparison to what the big spenders get is 100% real. Yes, the free stuff is nice. Let's be honest here though, big spenders get Legendary characters, the ability to level them up without grinding, same with armor, etc. The Whales dominate this game. I understand economics but as a casual player with real world responsibilities it cheapens my playing experience. I play most days still and do love the game.

heavy advertisement of in-game products. the game is nice and fun. what is the cost that is really undesirable. video of some bonus features like little freebies here and there, about to get anything nice you got to spend real world money to acquire better characters and even after spending 50 bucks for 40 shards the chances of getting a legendary is slim to none, unless you get 10 legendary crystals and use them at the same time. your chances go up but it's still not guaranteed.

suprisingly fun and addictive for sure. wanted to comment about some small issues I have first it is kinda hard to get silver (high amounts) second why can you only use codes once a day? (genuinely why tho.) beside that the game is amazing good quality nice strategies and mostly balanced. I really like some of the character design (mostly because they(male) got some "features" that is nice to look at. although the drop rates on certain stuff is kinda low(the good ones anyway) 4 stars forme

Fantastic game with a really awesome community. There is a bit of a learning curve, but you can always find help on their website or YouTube. A lot of the best aspects are behind a pay wall, but if you willing to put in the hours grinding it out; you can still enjoy the game. I normally don't go for P2W games but I spend what I can to support the development of this wonderful game. Even if you dont spend a dime there are plenty of ways to keep things entertaining. The champions look amazing 👏

Palarium has to be one of the greediest gaming companies. Every time you change screens there's at least one (most times 2 or 3) pop-ups trying to get more money. So annoying. And I just played a whole days worth of energy[2 bottles + 450 more,(that's insane!)] to complete one of their tasks. Something (get 10 Greater Arcane Potions from stage 7 or higher)that shouldn't have taken but one bottle! And I'm not being unfair at all in my judgement. because I just read that they're #2 grossing RPG!!!

This game is nothing but a cash grab. I've tried to like it, but after 2 years and never once drawing anything more than a 4 star hero out of the summons, it's pretty clear to me. they want you to spend money on every aspect of this game. if yall want something that's the exact same concept, but is actually good to their f2p players, check out Jujutsu shibuya incident. They hook their players up. obviously they still have their cash grab but the game is way more accessible to f2p players.

I love the fact that as long as u log in daily and/or do certain things u receive free characters.The only reason I can't give the game 5 stars & I want to, is (I understand people have to make money from a game they made,took alot of time), but I wish u could earn all the items u have to pay for, even if it means making it extremely hard to achieve & put a time limit on it, but make it accessible to everyone. Poor people want the same experience as someone not poor lol.

The last time I played this game was 3 years ago, since I started anew I haven't been able to stop playing for two weeks straight, I literally can't play any other game, the magic, the atmosphere and majesty of the fantastical world. Though I have some suggestions for character models, I hope that you guys could add scabbards hanging from the left side of sword-wielding characters' waists, I also wish the knights wearing surcoats had an indentation of a cuirass or brigantine under them.

I've played this garbage years ago! it's nice to see your greediness is catching up to you.🙂 I Speak for multitudes when I say we paid you hundreds, if not thousands of dollars to advance in this money pit just to NEVER receive the legendary characters you advertise, your items that you sold did the absolute bare minimum amount just to keep us paying! for over 6 years we've paid and played with NO progress! your time has come to hang it up! sincerely, former Gamer

I've been playing this game since 2021 there's been a lot of ups and Downs, but it is a pay 2 win game when you find a player, that level 45 in arena live gold. And has nothing but mythic champions really I don't pay to play this. it's impossible almost to reach tag. Team silver 3, even if you have the points. As if there's too many people there, you're not allowed to go in. But they want you to invite your friends to play. But they don't have room for advancement pop ups are my biggest complain

I used to play this game 2 years ago and I stopped it because you cannot make real progress without buying their "promotions" as they call it which they are expensive to say the least, so I came back to 3 days ago to see if something changed but I see is still the same, dont get me wrong the game is really good but I guess the team is very greedy especially if your warriors are high leveled your progress will be very slow.

Just reinstalled, now you have to click through at least one ad for a purchase every time you do anything! I'm leaving it installed so I don't have to see their ads in better games. 2019: Whale paradise. Don't bother playing unless you want to spend on this game. Heroes are ttl unbalanced.

Progression too slow. Rewards not satisfying at all. Been trying to get new champions and it's nearly impossible. The access to higer rank champions is locked behind hours of meaningless grinding or a paywall. And speaking of paywalls, the insane prices for any pack in the shop is borderline outrageous. Not to mention the inhuman amounts of pop-ups or how convoluted navigating the menu feels. It is appreciated that there are no ads tho. Appealing concept, too slow in terms of progression.

I absolutely hate when a game CONSTANTLY pops up its own sales offers. I would rather watch an ad. this game is horrible in that regard. can't really enjoy the game with all of their own pop-ups. if I want to buy a pass or top up, I will go to the market on my own

Decent game but turns into endless, repetitive grinding and massive paywall. Yes, it's free to play but if you want to compete, gain high quality characters and gear, be prepared to shell out thousands of dollars.

it's been fun playing and getting different champions as well. I have been playing for a while now and this game is the greatest game so many different things to do and get and to lvl up as well. also sadly I stopped playing my switch games just to play this game it has so much more to it than I could get from my switch games and the graphics are great as well and the story as well. I can't wait to see what is nexts to come in the coming months. thank u raid for this game. happy raidingeveryone

I dont disagree with that. I 100% believe you guys should make money and be paid handsomely for good work. it's a great game. I dont want to take away from it. I want to make it better for all. The game comes off as an unbeatable pay to play for newcomers who dont usually spend a whale amount on games. They won't play cause of that. It's hard not to think it seeing the game environment. I have made good on f2p, but not everyone knows how. Your recent qol updates reflect you are aware.

game is to greedy, needing to much just to keep up. downloaded it for a money making app FreeCash, and completed several challenges, but the raid denied my progress and completion, and refused to pay for the challenges I complete...if you see this game in a app for rewards, ignore it

Back end or mostly server run game hence does not require strong and continuous network connection👍 Graphics are unbelievable and unrealistic👍 Strategic and mind blowing game👏 Daily free gift, promo codes, log in program and occasional free eventual gifts👍👏 But to complete some events or tournaments need lot more purchases or you will miss many things👎 Also required lot of patience and skills of understanding to play long and deep🧐

the game itself is ok. not great, but ok. its a gotcha resource management game. not special in any meaningful way. the biggest downside is plariums predatory PtW practices. they have non stop pop up ads, "lightning deals" that tell you "if you close this window, its gone forever". the way they balance the game is by releasing stronger PtW/limited time champs to counter the last PtW/limited time champs. i have played since 2021 and at no point would i have recommended anyone to play.
My only complaint is the prices in the shop are insane. I feel like a 15 dollar a month battle pass would be sufficient. the constant pop ups with purchase suggestions distracts from a fun game.

Fun game so far although I'm not able to leave a clan. I joined an open clan not knowing they were all inactive players. It automatically made me the clan leader and when I attempt to make someone else the leader so I can leave it doesn't work. it "says" it made them the leader but it just keeps defaulting back to me being the leader of a dead clan.

2 years playing and my take away is. The graphics, community, and events are great, but the late-game loop is frustrating. The 130 stamina cap and gear dungeons are outdated, requiring thousands of energy for a few usable pieces. Progressive banners lack a true safety net, and there’s no in-game mercy tracker. Once PvE is clear, you hit a wall in Live Arena where intense power creep and RNG force a repetitive loop designed to pressure you into spending. Needs better catch-up mechanics.

Games fun and all, but its clearly pay to play. not nearly enough energy to play, level up or even participate in any sort of tournament/event. Basically if you enjoy this game be prepared to open your wallet. Games just a cash grab. Also good luck in Arena, most players have the cheesiest champions in their line up. RE: You understand? No you don't and no there isn't. Arena is a joke, my team of 215k power shouldn't be getting slept by 140k power. MAKE IT MAKE SENSE.

GOTCHA GAME like no other. Beautifully designed game to drain your time and money. The odds are always against your favor. The Game gives you a product but sells you the solution. Everything is a chance, a chance to pull reliable champions, upgrade artifacts, roll stats.. etc. etc. Boosted 2x events give you 2x trash. There is an internal calculator that tracks your draw luck. Good luck on figuring it out. Unequip/Equip costs resources. There is an event every week to bait you into spending. GTF

I finally did it !! after 2 years and thousands and thousands of dollars i finally canceled my monthly subscription and deleted this disgustingly greedy game. After I stopped spending and saved up a decent amount of shards for free I opened them and got nothing. Hell of a way to reward your consumer's. I struggled because I put so much money into it but i just cant deal with the greed and lack luster events and rewards. Keep the money scumbags but good riddance .. a lot of fake bot reviews lol

the game starts okay. there's a lot of pushes to buy stuff (it's kinda insane how much they push you to spend real money) but you get a lot of free stuff too. it's kinda okay gameplay but really it's quite shallow. got bored quickly and have no desire to play. last 10 or so times I opened the game it was just to collect daily free rewards. then I quickly couldn't even be bothered with that. I will say that the visuals and sound are great for a mobile game. great presentation. just boring

Just deleted it for the last time. i've deleted it and then downloaded it again several times over the years, hoping that it would get better.But it hasn't. this is a money sink. your bombarded constantly with ads and offers to cheat in the game.If you'll just give them anywhere from fifty to a hundred dollars. the character designs are really cool. And they wave it in front of your face, it's a train entice you to buy things that will not guarantee you actually get the characters that you want.

If I could review this game as a zero I would. I do play this game but it is not fun having to spend hours on hours in the game to complete everything. Money hungry company it's insane. I've been playing for a while, but it is about the grind. ONE OF MY BIGGEST PROBLEMS IS THERE IS NOT ENOUGH SILVER TO GO AROUND AND PRIMAL SHARDS HAS A HIGH CHANCE FOR RARE CHAMPIONS. Just gotta build the right characters, and there are so many events going on at the same time. Kinda overwhelming sometimes.

The game is definitely fun, but everything is overpriced. the newest champion was very difficult to get without spending real money and they had an offer for 30 shards out of 100 for $60. That's $60 for not even 1/3 the amound of shards needed to unlock the champion. The game constantly bombards with limited time "deals" that when you try to close say you might lose out acting like $40 is no big deal.

overall I like the game but to get food champions via shards and spending money is so expensive to only 1 void level and then just rare level champions after buying legendary, void, and primal shards. the chances of getting higher ranked champions is stacked so against the player when it comes to the shards those purchases dont seem worth it.

predatory game with progress reliant on expensive micro transactions edit; I've played for multiple years, spent 10s of thousands $. plarium doesn't look after its players.. meta is heavily powercrept behind 2 or 3 characters. too have any reasonable chance of pulling these characters cost 10s of thousands of dollars.

Makes it pretty impossible to get the heros you want the drop rates for characters to make it competitive is extremely underwhelming. kept seeing ads to come back and play but it is still obviously not going to change the massively low rates to get heros you want to use and the return gift was lackluster.

extremely expensive, endless advertising, super long uploading times.... absolutely no benefit for clan leaders, actually going to be extremely stressful for clan leaders trying to organise and get players cohesive.... MOST IMPORTANTLY, THE GAME IS A MONEY PIT!!!! Your not going to recieve fair value for your money .... this is outrageous

Get ready to close a half-dozen pop-ups asking for cash every time you boot up the game! Also the UI is pretty convoluted and it takes a while to find shortcuts. Beyond that, it's a pretty neat game with great graphics, some interesting tactical options, and a ton of heroes. Dont invest a lot in heroes with only 2 skills. The amount of grind needed to upgrade star levels is exponentially increasing, since it requires sacrificing more and more high-level heroes.

This game was made with ridiculous standards and stupidity. They asked for a review after I just started, this is the updated version. It's difficult to understand and is constantly trying to force ads on you. I'll improve my review when it doesn't feel like a ponsi-scheme.

The game is fun to play whether it's to pass time or something you seriously enjoy. However, my reasoning behind the rating is the amount of crashing that happens. Sure it can be frustrating when the game crashes, though when you lose resources like energy, or if you're in the middle of an auto fight it makes you not want to play. Once the crashes go down the rating goes up, other than that though the game is extremely detailed and smooth for anyone to easily play!

You can't change the settings until after the painfully long tutorial sequence, and all the reviews saying it's "console quality" are clearly fake. It still has the mechanics, in-game transactions, nonexistent "RPG elements", and real-time waiting periods of every mobile game. Also, you have to spend your in-game currency to UNEQUIP GEAR. This game is a joke, and it's not worth your time

Updating my review... Unfortunately. Now don't get me wrong, the game does seem to be improving slightly as time goes on, BUT, the in-gmame marketplace is REDICULOUS. The price of most PACKS are more than an ENTIRE GAME you would buy nowadays. Progression is ok... If you spend a load of money to kickstart you, otherwise it would take the average person at least a year to get a good setup. Even after spending a ton of money myself, it make you feel like you have to spend more just to have fun....

pros: it's easy to learn the mechanics. (so long as you pay attention), you get at least two epic sets of gear without spending real world money. and you get lots and lots of resources to keep playing. it's also visually very appealing. drawback: you have to deal with a huge amounts of ads asking you to spend 50+ dollars. if you're like me and don't want to spend that kind of money on a phone game, stay away from the pvp, and just keep hitting the little "x".

A once-great game, ruined by greed. The pricing of items in this game has always been absurd, but optional. over the past few weeks, they have been modifying the game to make it impossible to compete without spending money. We're not talking $5-10 here, either. We're talking upwards of $100. I still play because i haven't yet broken the addiction, but I've stopped caring about the game. Things are spiralling downward.

First of all it's an amazing game with good graphics, gameplay, and creativity. But there's a BIG problem this is a pay to win game. You can't do basically anything without spending. One way to fix that would be adding ways to get free packs just like the ones in the store but make where you have to complete tasks to win them. Another way would be daily, weekly, or even monthly rewards for the players who are totally free to play.

I think this game has a lot of potential. Graphics-wise I prefer it to other gacha games. But, the game is too heavily focused on montization, and the upcoming updates seem to show that they will be focused on more high tier (ie. pay to win) players. So unless you want to pay money to play, I would recommend downloading a different game of the same genre. .

The core of the game is interesting and fun. However, over time the game has gotten more and more pushy about spending money and the events have become very predatory.  Events has become harder to complete, resources have become more scarce, and real money packs are being pushed more and at higher prices. Two months ago I would have recommended the game. Now I recommend people stay far, far away.

this game has some major issues. The RNG factor and the randomness of the game is ridiculous, the timegating within Dungeons is stupid, and the "deals," that are constantly shoved in your face, are overpriced pieces of garbage. Even pvp has some problems, especially with the matchmaking. However, although these problems are prominent and NEED to be fixed, especially with the current traction the game is getting, I still had fun and can recommend it to anyone that likes turn-based games.

After 3 days of playing the game I gotta say I'm hooked. I dont really like turn based combat but it plays very smoothly and the combos can be very satisfying. Also, despite the fact that you can buy equipment and gems to make yourself better quicker, the game can still be played for free. The story is okay but the narration is very good. The worst part of the game is that you really need to set aside time to play if you expect to be any good. That said, a pretty good mobile game.

Constant failure in upgrading artifacts. Great job ruining the game. One man's balance is another man's trashing of the game. You expect me to be paying participant when you randomly rob me of a million silver when I am just trying to upgrade to level 12.

Updating review. I have been playing game off and on for several years and have spent money in game. I have just permanently uninstalled it. The challenges have gotten to the point where if you don't spend money they are worthless, and items are overpriced. Every time I open the game there are at least 4 nag screens to click through before you can play. I installed on my desktop and this past time there were over 10 screens to click through before I could get to the game. Very dissappointed

Well I got sick of seeing your ads so I thought I'd play the game. All the reward bonuses I'm supposed to receive when downloading the game seems it was a lie I got nothing. Console graphics? Its mobile graphics not even remotely close to console. Game is extremely boring and I have played many games just like this. This game is not worth anyone's time. Stop with all the ads. Can't wait to make it YouTube video about this. The truth will be known. A review without being told how to review it.

This game is fun; I've been playing for about 5 months. But the company behind is abysmal. Every decision they make just makes the players feel less and less valued. Even their downtime compensation is getting hilariously bad. 25 lesser potions of each affinity was just given (for context, it's about fifteen minutes worth of work to get that in-game) for the game being down for hours. Plarium has made it clear that they are only interested in new player acquisition. If you play, don't spend.

I can appreciate the storyline and characters considering it's a mobile game. However, I cannot continue playing this game anymore. Every sign-in I'm bombarded by around 10+ 'advertisements' for packs that the game is offering for sale. It's bothersome, to say the least, and freezes up my phone more often than not.

The game is graphically impressive, I enjoy the customisation with items, armor and Synergy with other characters and their abilities. But that's pretty much where it stops. You'll get shards throughout the game that allows you to get common, uncommon, epic and Legendary Heroes. It's a percentage on what Heroes you'll get, but unfortunately after playing this game for well over a year and at level 40 I've yet to receive a single legendary. Because of this I decided to delete my account.

This is a very fun, graphically-intense RPG with a ton of depth. There is, however, a huge paywall between you and fair progression and the price is STEEP. I like to support games, so I put 50 dollars into this one (almost the price of a new console game) and I noticed a very small bump in progression. With packages as steep as 95 bucks, I can't imagine how much a player has to pay to see rewarding progress. I dont mind working hard, but f2p is impossible. If you have no money, fly over this one

Great game plays as advertised, and it's really addicting. The down sides are the amount of deals when you open the game. There are a ton of deals whenever you open the game so be prepared to close out of them. Thankfully there isn't any ads during gameplay which is something they did right. If you aren't willing to pay a fortune on this game, you'll have to grind for the majority of the time on it. The campaign is a cool story line, and the game is fairly balanced. Has crashed multiple times.

Great experience! Amazing visuals, loads of content, granular and in-depth progression system. Until you reach end-game and are forced to play many, many hours a day and are expected to spend a fair sum to keep up with progression. Very buggy, crashes consistently regardless of the activity in question. Skip this, and the rest of the genre unless you feel like paying for someone else's child to go to college.

I think it's pretty neat! though I've had an issue where I can't even play the game due to not enough space despite it being on my SD card which has more than 80GB of free space... I would like to play the game and actually give a review past something like this, but unfortunately, unless that's fixed, I won't be able to give anything past 3 stars.

Its ok. Graphics are good, and it's a good concept but unless you have 200$ or more to sink into the game you won't progress for a long time. If you can't (pay to assist, because it won't make you win) then you will have to have about 3 to 5 hours a day to be able to grind everything available and then it's basically a rinse and repeat of endless grinding with little result and hundreds of "offers" (over time) that pop up every time you enter the town.

Jokes aside, this isn't a bad game per-se. The character models are actually pretty detailed and fun to collect, the problems i have with the game is the fact that it's just another idle game. there's no challenge, and no soul, it's just occasionally tap the screen and watch the characters do everything for you. that's not strategy, nor is it an rpg. it's an idle, or afk... boss fights are weak at best, story is non-existent. I didn't have to pay to play, and the heroes are cool, thus 3 stars.

Great graphics, and first week or two you are hooked. Then you realize how repetitive it is, and that it's all just one big money grab. I messaged support and 1 week later still no answer, and that's after having spent a decent amount of money on the game. Definitely regret downloading this one. Other games out there I've been playing for years and still love them, this one is one to stay away from.

Amazing graphics and game play with tons of variety. Lots of different events and challenges. On the down side the amount of time needed to progress is crazy. You could play over 4 hours per day and not complete all the daily challenges. Also there is lots of things to buy. It can be played for free, just will take forever to progress. The developer seems most interested in making money and not in improving the game.

The graphics are good considering it is a mobile game and while the gameplay is simple, it doesn't stop the game from being entertaining. Two reasons for 2 stars. The first is the constant barrage of pop-up sales you are hit with, which would be tolerable if they occurred once when launching the game, but unfortunately they keep occuring throughout. The 2nd is the fact that Arena is literally unplayable as there is no ranking system, meaning a lvl.12 gets matched against lvl. 40,50 players.

The game is very good. If you're looking for a fun, beautiful, long grind of a gear farming type game, look no farther. Last update addressed a lot of needs and issues. I would suggest to developers, How about an auction house to buy and sell gear? Fusion game is ridiculously hard and doesn't even make sense to lose so many good characters just to get one that is not even good., Clan boss gets old fast. should think of way to make that less of a chore., Purchasing in game prices r laughable.

I enjoyed the game for the first month or two and then realize it's the same content all the time. I understand that it's a business and the goal is to maximize profits. The game itself has so much potential, but it just seems to lack in so many other aspect. The ads are annoying, but the incremental increase in pricing when you purchase anything is what really irrate me. Ultimately since I'm no longer enjoying the game and and content I will uninstall, but these are just my opinions.

I enjoy the gameplay itself but I find more and more issues with it. They love RNG, the only things that aren't random are champion level progression and equipping gear (but removing gear they charge silver for). The most egregious usage of RNG in this game in my opinion is applying skill tomes. They are incredibly hard to come by once the initial supply runs out and the cheapest pack that includes several of them is currently going for $49.99, and they don't allow you to choose which skill of the selected Champion actually gets upgraded when you use one, it's random...  Their tooltips are also misleading. Many skill upgrades come in increments of 5%, however for damage it works like this (20% + 5% = 25%), whereas for healing and shields it's different (20% + 5% = 21%) and nowhere in the game is this explained.  Another problem I have is that one of my champions has a 105% crit rate and yet I see non-critical attacks. Another annoyance is two popup dialogues EVERY TIME you open the app to try to sell more packs for real money.

Money grubbing. You have to x out up to 5 pop-ups asking you to spend up to 99 dollars on different packs every time you start the game. The art is good, the heroes look great. The gameplay is ok, they hand out energy like candy in the beginning so youll be able to play for hours but the battle system could use some work. Standard turn based battles where different heroes have a couple of special attacks or buffs.

The graphics are amazing and characters are cool too, but it gets mind numbingly repetitive. Also, unless you spend an obscene amount of money it will take years of constant grinding to get anywhere close to doing the higher lvl content. I know this from experience. After 3 years me and a friend that started at the same time are nowhere near each other. I spent money and he didn't. He plays every day and is a higher lvl, but his power is barely a 1/4 mine and I only rarely play. Nice auto reply.

Good concept, decent storytelling. But that's all that's good. The game runs very slowly, and is monetized on a level that would make Activision and EA blush. There's no real way to get good champions unless you're stupid lucky. I work very hard for my money, and if I choose to support a f2p game it must already be good. I don't want to have to pay to enjoy the experience.

Well... 24hrs of playing and graphics are awesome, gameplay is nice, except for the fact that I can get past chapter 4. Already the enemies are too strong for me. I just spent .99 cents on it and was a waste so I know what yo expect... same as every other greedy mobile game. I can spend all my coins to upgrade gear and get maybe half the chapter through just to be stuck again or I can delete it right now and save me the headache... hmm...

The game could be better, but the constant in your face in-game money grab attempts are really depressing. Boot up the game and you are immediately bombarded with offers. I understand you need to make money to pay the bills, but there are better ways on how to go about this instead of pestering the player. It takes away the enjoyment of the game. Furthermore, this is a pay to win game. New players are at a high disadvantage and are unfairly matched up. Expect slow loading times. Good storyline.

Really liked this game when I first started playing. The graphics are great for a mobile app, but the gameplay is extremely repetitive. The only good thing that keeps you coming back for more is leveling up your champions and trying new combinations to progress further. This game is fine as far as free to play, but you will def flag behind others who choose to pay. The game is more geared to pay to win. And dont even bother trying to get to the late game unless you pay. Bad community engagement

Absolutely love the game... One problem however, we NEED a way to sell champions. It's really irritating when my inventory fills up and instead of selling all the ones that are no use to me and getting just a pinch of their value back I have to spend the silver i was saving up for my other quests, sending me back to square one. I don't care if it's just me throwing them away for nothing just please add it.

Played the game for a year or better, clan was ranked in top 10, game is full of overpriced "deals", random loot drawing and whales who spend thousands just to quit and waste their time and money. Half the game you don't even have to play the other half you'll download an auto clicker just to give you the illusion you're doing something. A complete waste of time and money Edit: after dev feedback - "make it better".. good one.

I have seen A LOT of ANNOYING ads about this game, so I had to try it. When it started i was amazed, great story, nice looking characters... But after 5-7 hours of gameplay I got bored. Most of game types haven't even got a tutorial, I have to wait a long time to get new heroes, lot ads about in-game offers and the story got messy and I stopped understanding (because am not native English speaker). So, long story short, I won't recommend to you this game and it's also very, Very VERY overrated.

The graphics are great, and the gameplay is good enough that I haven't deleted it yet. However, the sheer number of pop-up windows for daily and weekly "specials" (8 when I first opened it today) are really souring me on the game. Having to close eight windows before being able to play the game is uncalled for. I realize they have to make money, but I'm not going to drop 20, 50, 100 bucks on a mobile game. I would happily drop 5-10 if it meant I could turn off those obnoxious pop-ups though.

Mostly giving this app 1 star because of the five minutes of closing popups every time you open the game. After about a year of this game it still hasn't let up. Sick of it. Game's ok at best. Hot characters but no descriptions or backstory for any of them. Game has a campaign mode but who TF knows what it's actually about. Character building is a strong point, could be made better if you could power up the "rarity" of all characters, even if it was extremely time consuming.

Bottom line: Amazing potential that is being destroyed but the greedy developers. Pros - Amazing graphics, tons of content Cons - 1. The most pay-to-win game out there, nothing come even close to that. Also, the packages are overpriced 2. In addition, the developers are actually cheating the player by the 'mercy' system that is supposed to compensate the player who has bad luck, but it simply doesn't work, they just manipulate the player to a system that isn't exists from the first place

I tried this game and I hate it. The main story is so short you can literally complete it in a single session... Here's a unique feature I've never encountered before, You have to PAY every time you switch or remove a piece of armour which adds up very quickly. This game also has MORE ADS than YouTube without premium membership. To sum it up, a COMPLETE waste of time. That is of course unless you love the aforementioned, then go for gold.

These are my views of the game after playing for almost a day. I didnt make a single purchase but got a free champion and silver from a referral. Pros: Easy to learn the controls and layout of the game, nice story line, easy combat system, no lag, nice champion designs and gameplay. Cons: Every single time you log in you are bombarded with pop ads advertising "special" or "limited time" deals, once your champions hit level 30 it becomes a horrible grind, p2p is the best way to win this game.

This game has good graphics, but not all good games require this; if I wanted a good rpg, I'd play one without or with little microtransactions, because it ruins the competition of the game. The biggest gameplay problem is that the gameplay is not as complex as the character menu, there's a lot of options for every hero but there's barely any attacks compared to it. My biggest complaint is the sheer amount of all the unnecessary characters, there's too many. But I can't explain all cuz char lims

I really like this game for the artistic style, as it is pretty much the only game of its type on the app store without anime or cartoonish style art. Lately it has gotten stale though. My initial review was for 4 stars, simply because it was a good game that just pushed the monetization too much. Since then it has gone downhill. It came out that their new content pretty much only comes out when they aren't making enough money, and there has really not been any new content for quite a long time. I have been playing for about a year at this point, and I have three accounts.

The premise of the game seems to be for you to grind and get stuff to become more powerful. This is ok, not complaining. But, for the love of games, CAN YOU PROVIDE ME WITH PLACES TO GRIND AND RESOURCES FOR IT?!! Point 1: ENERGY,ENERGY, ENERGY!!!! A massive part of the game is repeatedly playing the same levels over and over, so why am I getting a total of 130 units to play levels that cost 16 units/run. Even if you complete all the quest for the day, you don't get enough. And a BOOK DUNGEON pls

So I found a bug thats no more then a minor inconvenience, but I still found one. If you stay in the market until it refreshes then your game, or at least mine, refused to accept anymore input from my touchscreen. The rest of my UI did, just not the game. I give it four stars because it just feels kinda stingy....40-50 shard packs of common and not a single rare? I get the droprate is supposed to be low, but less then 2%? That's a bit much, or rather, not enough. Besides all that. Good game.

I really don't understand why this game is so popular. The still pictures graphics are fine but looking at the human character faces at any point it looks like a 90s PC game. It's a standard gatcha game as far as character collection and energy use. Unlike some other energy use games you have to let the game run while it multi battles/grinds a level for you. You can't even close the game, just set it down and ignore it for a while. It's not a bad game it just has been done better elsewhere.

cool game. good graphics. good grindy turn based rpg that lets you make big numbers. complaint for the devs: it's really cool that there's such a big variety of gear to put on the heroes. this encourages me to play around and try different combos to see what's best. but it's super annoying that you have to pay silver to take your armor off. that system discourages playing around. its gonna take me 200k just to re-armor a dude. thats 20 stage runs. just to take my gat-dang clothes off. ridiculous

Visuals are good, game play could stand to be a touch more intuitive, and it occasionally freezes. Drop rates for champs are what you expect them to be, but it's not impossible to progress without epic or legendary champs. Definitely not pay to win, but money does give you some small advantages in terms of more rapid character advancement and slightly better odds at better champs due to higher tier summoning crystals. Game play game gets a touch grindy at times. Overall a good game.

This isn't a "bad game", but it is ran by bad staff, who create some really perverse mechanics. The PvP system is actually great..... but its hampered by a matchmaking system that makes sure only one out of every 10 fights is competitive. Its also hampered by speed being way too improtant, and making a super character available if you stick around long enough. You will get positively bombarded with ads for purchases in game. And not in the corner either, but taking up your entire screen. The mechanics are fun. There's some tactics to the pve. But a lot of the higher end game mechanics seem designed by entirely different people, and this makes really shut out a lot of people from getting to enjoy the bare bones mechanics which are pretty sound. Its fun but the fun has its limits.

Played for 3 months, low fun, high cost, pretty graphics. Its a collect em all style game similar to summoners war. The main problem is that to complete the larger quest lines like the recent foli fusion you need to drop a couple of hundred dollars and play the game like it is a full time job. Even then this game has very little in terms of fun, because of the cost in leveling, gearing and discovering new heroes. Few games in my life would I ask for my time back after playing, this is one.

Graphics look great, gameplay is good, story is meh. The problem is the constant barrage of ads to buy this or buy that. It is quite insane. There are times I have to dismiss 3 or 4 ads to get back to what I was doing. I understand that this is how they make money, but I have played a number of gacha games that had far fewer ads.

Beautiful game, but......complete cash grab. everytime you restart the game they throw multiple offers in your face. Progress is slow unless you pay to get better units that are otherwise extremely hard to obtain. The gameplay is already challenging, on top of there being a cost to use everything that's already challenging to obtain. It's a shame. the gem mine pays for itself in half a year's time with consistent harvesting.

Game is cool, the store is very expensive. The game is just fine playing naturally (don't play a lot to begin with, just something to kill time) but man they love to remind you about dat store lol. *edit- changed my review to 1 star. The game is constantly getting greedy. They changed log in rewards to make it harder to get champions for casual players and almost every event is just to see how much money the player can spend. Don't get the game. Not worth it

Can't even log into the game even though there's nothing wrong with my connection. Tried through Facebook and Platinum (no sign up option for Platinum in game either), both times it just wouldn't go through. When I tried downloading all the game's files without logging it, it gets stuck on authentication and then tells me I need to log in. edit: I came back to this game and faced the SAME problem. I went to support as I was told and then found out I would need to jump through hoops just to play

When you play it, you'll know why. I thought it was a 5 star, but it eventually just wasn't as good as it seemed. Fun though, but be aware that you will be looking at tons of pay walls, ridiculous grind, special offers, and over time, straight up boredom and lack of motivation to play the game unless your wallet is bottomless. Goodluck to those that stick with the game because I can't. Anthem seems like a better longterm investment

Awesome! I love it! (Edit: I don't love it anymore) Every time you open the game the game you get spammed with like 10 popup ads. The shard drops on good characters is really low. Every purchase I have made in game has left me really disappointed with huge buyers remorse. The only reason I kept playing is because of the time and money I had invested into it. But no longer, with all the ads it's clearly just a money grab game. It sucks and I quit. [Edit]: Response to developer. LOL that's funny!

Seems my review keeps getting deleted. This game is all good graphics and well designed characters on the surface. Under that, it is a complete money sink. You cannot grow or even compete without sinking a small fortune into it. You start out running but after a few chapters you are dead in the water and must pay out cash. This is made evident even by the constant in game purchase adds that are spammed every time you load a new screen.

Freaking way toooooo many ads to buy buy buy.... Takes so long just to get in the game. If I wanted to buy in game items I would go to the shop. I don't need it slammed in my face every time I log in.... I'm in installing this pay to win piece of junk They state that everything is free and you have access to everything... Ya if you play none stop every day. It's such a grind.... I couldnt get any worth while characters on their "extra chance" to get a rarer one events.., it's def a pay to win

Too repetitive, I don't appreciate all the pop-ups that show up when you log in for you to drop hundreds of dollars on useless items. This game is not worth the money. To Developer: time to time?? Almost every time I go to the main screen I have to click out of the ads. Don't try making it seem like it doesn't happen as it does. How about you just have an announcement screen that you can scroll through the deals of the day? I'd rather that then hitting the X 3-5 times, every time ads show.

Great, but the pop-ups.... I understand that you need to make your money, and I don't fault you for finding creative ways to implement them, but the pop-ups are egregious. On start up, I need to nix about eight pop-ups (maybe less, but feels like more). If I was not planning on spending anything, the pop-ups just make it annoying. If I was going to spend, the pop-ups look desperate.

It's a very fun game. Get new champions, level them, get them gear. Rinse, repeat. Unfortunately, like all the games of the FTP type, the long term game is influenced by how much you're willing to spend. You'll find that the best packages to give you champions to compete with are 50 bucks a pop, and that's not nearly scratching the surface of what you'll need. Still fun, but expect to hit a tough paywall.

This game is designed to trap people into spending money!! You cannot play with a since of enjoyment, because every aspect of this game makes you have to spend money! An example: If you want to build a void character expect to buy a shar. If you get very very very lucky and get a Lego or Epic you will need to buy books, Mastery scrolls, Leveling mugs, maybe gear and then the silver to level the gear. the 1 Legendary or Epic character could cost $200.00 US. The game has over 500 characters.

The ads are a real turn off and even after I turn them off in the options, as soon as I hop on again, I've found that the notifications have been turned on. The game itself ain't bad, but I've found myself getting bored. The heroes skills just aren't interesting and the heroes don't look like their avatars. Good log in rewards, but not enough to keep me playing.

It real fun when you first start out. All the trailers make it look like the best game ever. But... once you get a couple hours in and past all the "tutorial" missions you start to see all these different currencies and items to make your character stronger. Free to Pay games can be fun when you don't feel like you have to spend money to progress if you don't want to. This isn't one of those games. Unless they overhaul the entire game I wouldn't waste my time.

It was pretty fun, but the amount of in-app purchasing ads was ridiculous. Especially with some of them being $100. Watch out for this game if you are into f2p. EDIT: Yes, a ridiculous amount of time and effort. The silver it takes to buff up the equipment is ludicrous. Beyond that, the way you shove the in app purchasing down players' throats is straight up greedy, then to respond saying it is possible to do it free? Not okay, keep the ads to the shop.

Graphics is nice, Chapnions are fun. That's all the good things. Now the bad. Obviously I need to start with predatory P2W. Every few minutes you get not one, but FIVE "give me money" pop-ups. I don't mind spending money in games, but this is a turn off. In terms of gameplay, here's what ultimately made me quit in a first week. There are 27 item sets you can combine. Items have several ranks, stats and rarity. Here's the kicker. Everything about them is completely randomized. No, thank you.

I originally gave this game 5, then 4, then 3 stars. Now, it's down to 2 stars. I really enjoy the game, it's easy to play, there's no complicated tap moves needed, it's a simple concept. It's the game itself that needs MUCH improvement. There's WAY too much emphasis placed on the Arena. If the only goal in the game is to make Platinum Tier, then the game is not enjoyable. A game should not be only competing against other players who spend all their money on a game.

Though fun at first, it is heavily pay to win. The game gets old after a while. And if you ever lucky you'll draw a legendary character with free gems, But they're exceedingly rare to draw. the ones you get for free are just pitiful. And after this new update the game is both slow and sluggish. This game was once fun for me to play, but has become old and stagnant. If your looking for a fun game that's not pay to win. Look elsewhere. This game is a waste of time after a few months of playing

It is the very definition of a pay to win game. Everything in this game is costly, upgrading, and removing gear costs so much silver. You never get anything other than a common summoning for heroes, and they seriously want $30 for 1 single epic summoning and two rares. And their "gifts" won't help you progress at all. Their battle pass is pointless; all it does is start a battle automatically, still running through the battle at normal speed, and farming is boring, tedious.

Let me start off with it's a pretty fun game. Why my review is so low is due to constantly being bombarded with ads wanting me to spend money inside of the game... it's a free game and you can do just fine without spending money. Also if I was going to spend money in this game I wouldn't because everything they offer is ridiculously priced. I mean like way high.

This is a boring game that swiftly becomes repetitive, despite the abundance of champions present in the game you will probably never see anything above a 4 star, unless you pay a large amount of money, then we get to the part about switching artifacts, which burns through your silver faster then you can blink, over all this game is money-grubbing, boring, and a complete waste of time.

As many have said, the gameplay is good (auto and manual), graphics are nice, lots of things to do, so in that vein, not a bad block of time to spend. However, this game is one of the most blatant money grabs on the market. If you are focused on F2W, then forget this game...I have come a point where I literally CANNOT progress any further...gear drops suck, summoning blows, and I can't beat the bosses I need to get better gear to progress...so, well, goodbye n good riddance...

I like the game, but it is deceiving. I spent over $400 but I am still not progressing. so how much someone should pay to get somewhere. I can simply go play world of warcraft which will be more fun and much cheaper. My advice is dont spend money on this game because it is cleverly targeted to keep you pay. save your money and play something that gives you exactly what you pay for. I could have got a new play station if I paid a bit more. Moreover, dont expect any support

Good time killer for the first 20-30 levels then it slows down tremendously and it leans towards pay-to-play for better progress unless you have some top-notch RNG and pull some of the Legendaries during your trial. The odds are very low to pull one, much less more than one. Don't let that take away from the game but just be prepared to spend or crawl.

Personally I really like the game. Graphics are nice and in the beginning there is loads of stuff to do. That said, after about a month of playing new players will reallise a couple of things. 1, the game is incredibly P2W. Every aspect of the game seems designed to make it tedious for the playerbase and thus results in people spending money. 2, spending a reasonable amount money on this game seems pointless. Every thing is so expensive that there are only two choices. Spend hundreds or nothing.

Raid looks good, and that's it. If you came to the game through one of the many sponsorships on youtube, expecting free stuff, well, sorry but you've been lied to: you don't get any bonus silver or a free epic champion of your choice, only endless notifications asking you to buy overpriced stuff (most of the bundles are around 50 euros, which is enormous, for almost nothing). The rewards are awful, the gameplay repetitive, rng upgrading that costs silver, in short, you better have a bank account

Wouldn't give me Deathknight. Also, incredibly boring. Multi battle is lame. It should do it instantly seeing as you have to play the level first. Boring game. Graphics aren't even that good. Killed my phone 10% over 10 minutes and my phone is apparently meant for gaming. Trash game with too many micro transactions and pop ups trying to get you to spend money.

Of all the mobile games I have played, this is the most frustrating, and not in a good way. I like the core mechanics of the game itself. It's obvious that it's built by a gambling company but I don't mind that. That's part of the fun. At its core, this is a character building game. Learning all the different champions and the buffs and debuffs they have combined with attack mechanics and equipment makes it a lot of fun. What's horrible is how expensive it is. $28 for a "mini" pack isn't mini

The pop ups need to be fixed. There's way to many just to get in and play the game. It becomes obnoxious to just play casually. The gameplay is fun and graphics look good for mobile but some mechanics for bosses make it such a grind to proceed further to get any worthwhile characters. You get free shards but they mostly give you 1 star trash. Unless you have money to blow I wouldn't recommend this. I hope the balance does get fixed in the future.

Giving it a 1 star for its gross advertising Im level 33 and am enjoying the game, but when i come across ads on places like Instagram they are not accurate to the game. One in particular shows equiping or removing armor to show on the character, this is just not true. My absolute least favorite is when launching the game you have to exit out of at least 6 pop up screens trying to sell you in game items or packs. Game is fun otherwise.

I rarely rate games but when I do, it can only mean 1 thing: either I hate it or I love it. And honestly, it's the latter. The difficulty of the game isn't that much hard to the point that you have to spend real cash for upgrades (so far). The graphics are astounding. The story so far is good. Overall I love this game! I am not that much into this type of games but RAID: Shadow Legends is an exception for me!

It's a decent game, but I found it to be a bit too PvP focused, so I eventually uninstalled. Most things seem to be centered around improving to be able to be dominant in the PvP arena. Not much of a campaign really. A dozen levels and then just harder versions of the same ones. There are a number of repeat dungeons to play though, but again, for the purpose of improving for PvP reasons. If you're not into that, I would skip this game. *Btw, paying in-game currency to unequip an item is silly.

I want to like the game. But there is no reason to continue past 90 days. No real dailys. It's expensive as hell to get good champions. Pay to play is. Serious problem. There are just so many design, payment and marketing issues. It just becomes a versus game at some point but it's either grind for literal days of pay. The "deals" cost as much as a full game. Take a page out of AFK and other top mobile games make the dollar deals more appealing. It's more palatable than 40+

Edited: horrible business practices. Practically stealing. Game never improves, devs just shove more offer packs at you forever. fantastic game. awesome slew of monsters, artifacts are cool, the dungeons are engaging and the grind is fun. the only issue i have is that all of the events require a LOT of real money to complete. i dont mind throwing a little money at a great game, but they seem to want 100$ just to complete the main event each month. pure greed and needs to be addressed. I dont even care about occasional glitches and maintainance because they're good at compensating players for the missed time but the greed..

There are some pros but the cons make for some major gripes. Hence the mediocre score. Pros: game provides entertainment for a good while and has good graphics Cons: At a certain point in the game it just becomes boring and repetitive. All games have this issue to deal with, but Raid in the bottom half of games at tackling that issue. Also...we get it. You want to make money. Stop bombarding us with your offers and on login at that. We "clicked" (touched) yes or not once. We shouldn't have to repeated "click" it the same exact offers like 6x in 1 playthrough. It is HIGHLY annoying and is a easy way to cause people to not want to play your game anymore. I honestly I logged in less because of it and I highly doubt i'm the only one. Upgrading items is the worst. It just it. Imagine upgrading items in summoners war. Yeah, it is EXACTLY like that. Feels like the game is missing content to be something I want to feel comfortable sinking more time, energy, and/or money into (not a whale, but I am okay with putting UP TO $100 into a game if a spend enough time into it...think video game hours on console or even PC). Lastly, I hope you never have to change devices and re-install game. It makes you redo all of the starting stuff and tutorial all over again. WE DON'T WANT TO WASTE WHAT LITTLE FREE TIME ON DOING THIS AGAIN!!! Give us the option to log into our accounts of accounts of opening the app. Otherwise the device feels it is a new account and we are stuck to deal with it. This makes me not want to login because I don't want to waste my time. If you are logging on on computer you can bypass this, however, if I am at my computer I have so many other options of things to do that the game is competing with. So the game will 9/10 times lose the battle of getting my time/ attention. Whereas phone...I am probably wasting time in transit or trying to entertain myself between things of larger importance in my life. I highly doubt this only applies to me.

Both times I have been convinced to spend money, the event stopped recording my progress, and I was shafted a lot of rewards. It's 90% an ad to spend money. Every few minutes, you have to deal with a swarm of "deals. " They will charge a ridiculous amount of money for digital content that they just say "oops" when it doesn't work. They skew the math on some things without an explanation that doesn't require you to DIG through forums to find someone else who did the math and found it to be flawed

Not worth free money. I downloaded this game as part of a promo to pay & earn points toward a gift card. It had double earning of any other game. I still did not want to suffer through to figure this thing out. The game looks great, & if you like these type maybe it's a good one, but it didn't draw me in at all. Many things to see/do but the intro doesn't let you check anything out, it makes you click here & there for 2 rounds & then can click where you want. Didn't win over any new player here

Graphics are great, gameplay is Summoner Wars, UI is fine. But, and it is a huge but, you will progress slow as hell if you do not pay some serious $. Unlike similar games, the drop rate on items and champions are so excruciatingly low. You WILL spend hours farming, you WILL continue to farm getting every other item than you need. The RNG and F2P model of this game is horrendous and broken. Do not expect to keep up or have any competitive experience. Again, fine game, but it's a money sink.

I found the number of ads, and how intrusive they were, quite ridiculous. When logging in today there were 5 Ads to click through before I could interact with the game. And then as I navigate through to do my daily things, there are more popping up. You can have options to purchase that are ever-present and enticing without needing to interrupt your users (see: Hero Wars Mobile).

Opened the game, no tutorial, no explanation of anything. Figured I'd poke around and figure it out myself.
