Within 5min of trying to figure things out I got 3 pop ups trying to get me to buy in game items for $30, $30, and $10. That was enough for me to turn it off. Disappointing, great looking game and I do enjoy a good RPG but this game appears to be nothing more than a quick money grab.

pretty fun game, when you buy a pack with a legendary on it. The upper levels becomes more accessible, almost being impossible without high tier champions, thus needing a pack to play the game. Besides this need, and when you buy a pack, it becomes a pretty fun game. having spent hours on end playing this game, I bearly noticed, overall good game.

I used to enjoy this game. I had played it with a friend for years. Lately, there's been a lot of power creep and I haven't been able to keep up. Now they add a new rarity and the only way to get these new most powerful troops is with a special pull that costs a lot and only gives a .5% chance to get one.. yeah.. there's definitely no way I can keep up. I'm out

This game is FULL of pop-ups with offers so you can spend money on their in-game cash shop. Every few minutes, you are giving from 1 to 4-5 pop-ups with deals and offers. When you load the game, you can get close to 6 or 7 pop-ups with deals and other things. Basically, you are constantly closing these windows. It's beyond annoying. The second issue I have with this game, it's the drop rates.... HORRIBLE. I've gotten a few epic heroes but ZERO legendary. You need to spend real $ to have a chance

Love the game idea, graphics are amazing, and each character creation and idea is awesome. I like that I can play free. The other reviews are BS. But I have a really big problem with this game when I have to be online all day pretty much to farm any silver or do any events/tournaments. People have lives you know....I find it ridiculous that there is not some sort of daily limitation for everyone. It gets old and boring after being on here all day for auto or doing dungeons, makes me unistall

I've been playing for about an hour. Fun game. I definitely see the pay to win or even just play aspect already. I had barely started and was pushed a $30 starter pack. Ridiculous, but 4 stars for now just because it's fun, despite the monetary push. Update: Uninstalled. It gets tiresome fairly quickly if you don't buy packs or any of the seemingly myriad gimmicks you need to build your characters. Just repetitive and no real advancement. Be wary.

Edit: I sent an email to them and still nothing! Don't bother purchasing any items playing the mobile version of the game. You don't always get your items you bought but they'll take your money. I submitted 2 support tickets and received 2 generated responses in which neither gives me my items or option for refund. First ticket response says to wait a few days! What the heck. Few days later my $ was withdrawn and still didn't get what I purchased. Still waiting for this to get resolved.

THIS GAME IS A HERO COLLECTION GAME, NOT AN RPG!!! That being said, this is easily my favorite game if its type. it's definitely advertised very deceptively, but that is (almost) all that's wrong here. If you know what you're getting yourself into, then you shouldn't be disappointed. The hero artwork is great. (Tons of skin, so not for young kids IMO) And it has a lot to do. It shoves microtransactions at you, that's the other issue. If it weren't for these, it'd be a 4-star.

This games graphics are half decent, the character designs are actually amazing. But this game is money hungry. Which you may think all free mobile games are. But this game is a whole new level. The constant packages that get advertised to you on a daily basis is absurd. Of course you don't have to pay, but then you're in one of the worst grinds in any game I've seen. If this game wants to survive they NEED to change their practices, or it will die out real fast.

I will give this 3 stars. I really want to give it 4 but I really can't. Graphics are pretty decent, characters are great. Basics are simple and it does offer different play styles. Flaws, yeah it's pay to play. While yes you can get blue shards from the market for 200k add in the 20k to open it and you start raising costs to play. Energy wise I'm okay so far personally but I can see where without paying your not going to get far. Needs better ways to get characters for less

I enjoyed the game for the first 3 months. I love the visuals, the opening of shards and the strategy aspect and there is great community support from youtubers (e.g. hellhades). However, there are some big issues overall. The server is very unstable. The game is a massive time sink (e.g. upgrading items, grinding levels). The arena is super broken and prevents player progression. It is very pay to win game(I only have 2 fully booked legos) and super super expensive to buy things of low value.

I was disappointed by the depth of the game given how heavily it was advertised and how much money clearly went into its development. Visually very impressive but functions exactly like all the others of its genre. You get some heroes. They are on a rail through a set group of fights. There aren't many in-battle decisions you can make and those you can dont take much thought to optimize, most battles come down to "Is your level high enough? Yes? You win". Would say more but I'm at char limit.

I have come to love this game! The graphics are amazing! The competitive game play is awesome! Only I can't afford the subscriptions and or anything else in the app but I do just fine so far without having to. I did have a 10$ purchase that I just became aware of and it was done by mistake! I've requested a refund hope I'll receive it because that it way above my means to spend in any game..

I decided to give the game a chance, due to it being all over the place online, regardless of being told not to, and I have to say it visually looks like just about every other fantasy style out there, and as far as U.I and game play goes, it just feels like a carbon copy of other games similar to the genre, such as summoners war and cookie kingdom. It has great graphics, but I need more than a copy with better graphics to keep me interested. Overall, not for me but I get the appeal.

Recently downloaded this game a few weeks ago. So far no complaints. Update... so I've had the game for a few months and I love playing it dont get me wrong. But I wish it would be easier to earn rank 4 and 5 star chickens. Or at least be able to rank up to lever 6 star easier. I get bored with leveling up 5 new characters for each one I want to use them on to rank up

Started out great, but despite the claims of not being Pay to win, this game is geared towards the high spenders. I do not mind spending a few dollars but to get a Legendary you must pump hundreds for a very small chance. The events are almost uncompleteable without spending money on energy recharge. Plarium talks a good game about balance and being not pay to win but its all lip service. I can not recommend this to anyone, it is just another slot machine that doesn't put out. Bad investment!

Starts of alright, good graphics, good heroes, lots of energy, but in the later stages it makes it so you have so little energy, where they basically force you to spend money. When you open the app you get pop ups of sooo many ads, it's utterly annoying to deal with. The game is cool, fast paced just annoying with ads and how you basically have to go P2W to progress in the game

Was originally a 4 star review... I've been playing for over 2 years now. The game is still insanely grindy and the money grabs are the worst in any game I've played. I log in maybe once a month now to see if it gets any better and it hasn't. The drop rate for characters is pathetic, even on a a double promo of 2x with a 10x chance of a certain character you will get nothing of use and be disappointed. Then I stop playing for a month and do it all over again...Maybe someday I'll pick it back up.

Played it once. Got bored very quickly as I was progressing through the game. It gets very repetitive very quickly. Basically you just play a level, kill the boss, get items to make your character stronger and repeat. It's just a game that looks good but performed poorly when actually played for the first time. Don't waste your time by playing a repetitive game with boring action. Don't get hypnotised by the ad some YouTubers got sponsorship on.

The game runs smooth, and looks amazing. My biggest complaints are from the battles and characters you get. Unless youre able to buy better characters...then your chances of winning any battles past Chapter 1 of the story are slim to none. Its also quite annoying to see all these cool characters...and you never get to play as them. Unless you get really lucky or actually buy characters you want, then you are just out of luck. Ive had more fun and easier times with other games tbh.

Since you misunderstood my last review I will try again. I don't mind the drop system, and I love that you all give away heroes all the time (even if the event price can be a bit ridiculous) however my problem is this: You have over 300 champions in the game and brag about the variety on the store page, so why limit us to just 100? We should be allowed to collect and upgrade all the champions we want, otherwise giving champions away just feels redundant.

Great game! Only main complaint is that the drop rates for certain characters within the campaign are pretty non existent. Spending hours/days trying to farm for characters and maybe getting one after 15 days. Only other complaint is that the benefit to price ratio is severely low for the packs you can purchase, especially when comparing to other games. Bottom line is I do recommend this game. If you're 100% F2P you will enjoy the game, you'll just be grinding a lot lot lot lot lot.

It's like every other turned based game on mobile! Ever played Marvel Strike Force or GoddessKiss? If yes, then you've played this game. Like most mobile games that only look interesting in the ads, this game brings NOTHING new to the formula. The mechanics are a complete copy of other games, and just like them, you'll reach a point where you won't be able to advance unless you pay and or grind your *** for months. Different looks, but same exoskeleton! I'd rather waste my train time on UNO.

I've been playing for over 9 months. I hit the wall within the first few months of game play and spent about $20 for a boost. It helped while I learned more about the game and how to build heroes, but progression was extremely slow. The Battle Pass really helped my experience, but at the cost of $25. I consider myself a Free To Play player and is why I am so bored with the game. No way to keep up or progress without spending loads of $$$ every month. Currently looking for a new game to invest in

Honestly? This game isn't exactly good or bad, but it's mostly lied about by multiple youtubers 'beautiful graphics' if you look at specific spots in the game, you'd know thats a lie. 'Amazing battle mechanics' its as amazing as clicking on the auto attack button. among everything else, you're bombarded with ad after ad that are rediculously high in pricing. Edit: just because of the cheap response, I lowered the rating to 1 star. Enjoy :)

Plarium is 100% pay to win. But that's not what earns it a 1 star. If you have an issue where an error occurs and it doesn't make the server log, which has happened to me they WILL NOT make it right. They give you a snarky "you should be more careful" message.   SO THEY WILL TAKE YOUR MONEY AND WILL DO NOTHING TO HELP YOU WHATSOEVER. AVOID THIS LIKE THE PLAGUE.  Graphics looks good. I'm very concerned about getting my personal information off their servers though. I'm waiting to hear back about how to do that properly and how to confirm that they have done so. I' ll remove this section if they can satisfy that request.

Played for 2 years. Was in the top 2%, of players. Edited after response from devs. The changes were for money, and it can't be excused away. Dragon champions is a similar game that is no where near as greedy, easy to casual, and doesn't tie up nearly as much time, in addition to having more variety of play modes and less frustration with the gacha system. If you're considering a game with Raid's style of gameplay, check it out first. I'm not the one to try and convince. Fix your game.

Not a lot of thought put into longevity for this game. Reached level 25 and cant progress any further. With the few decent characters given this far, I cant complete any more campaigns or dungeons levels. All I can do is go back and keep playing the nodes I've already done. Characters are at max level too. Very boring!! No way of getting higher level characters to further progress. So where do I go from here? Uninstall is the only logical option.

Pretty fun. Very generous at first but then gets very grindy in order to encourage microtransaction purchases. This would be fine, because the game is free, however the in-app purchases are disgustingly expensive. Many are equal to a half or full price AAA PC or console game. Will bombard you with 10 or more in app purchase adverts every time you log in. Definitely aiming to get kids to spend money. Also the game freezes half the time on my brand new Pixel 4.

Second time I tried to play, I got a barrage of ads. After 5 minutes of telling the game I don't want to buy anything, it gave me one last ad. It was the last because I uninstalled the game after that. Game, hard to call it that when I don't get to play anything. *Edit* These were not notifications, these straight up, non-dismissable, in game ads. When I only have 5 minutes to waste, this is not the game to play.

Free to play is broken. To progress you need to put in a certain amount of time grinding. With limited energy that time is shortened significantly. Events that give you free energy dont last long enough to make it worth while. Getting good champions means very little without the good armor to back them up. More characters means more armor. To win competitive challenges to get decent armor you need to spend money. This is a business I get it you're only in it for the money. But just admit it.

I've enjoyed this game, but the real world cost of in game items is absurd. I have watched free in game items get replaced with items of less value multiple times, accessible areas of the game get adjusted so they are further out of reach, and other examples of negative changes. I've seen positive as well though. I'm just hoping for more positive down the road.

Updating this review. We are right back in the same boat. They made some changes to classic arena but they appear to have revoked them AGAIN. There is no distinction in difficulty from gold 1 to gold 4. They randomly throw together lists of fights. What is the point of the ranks if there isn't a clear progression? Other games do this just fine. Why is this impossible for you Plarium? Go watch one of the many videos of content creators noticing this. Once again, not playing until fixed. Boooring.

The Game is good and addictive for sure. They tell us it's free to play and all, but no way is it free to play it's rather disappointing as you keep progressing. Playing for almost 4 months now, it seem impossible for me to reach the silver arena even after having a few maxed good champions with me. More over the developers keep telling you can get good rewards from tournaments and events, but there's a catch you have to spend money or hold on to your Lego/void shards & energy to win them too.

This game is complete garbage, whoever thinks that charging a fee to remove an item is high out of their mind. Secondly, I can't play a single level without being shown an ad. I understand that they need money, but it's not cool at all. Furthermore the packs they give you are a total scam, spent almost 200 on this game and I feel ripped off. If your looking for a great game, then you have you haven't found it yet. I will say some of the ads they use to promote the game are pretty funny.

The game is okay. Graphics are okay, progression too. But Plarium is alwaysytoi greedy and annoying. There are too many ads for spending money, and even if you spend a few bucks, it is not enough for anything. Also, the game isnt f2p friendly at all. Which is a pitty, since I could go back, play more, and spend there, but they want to make the big whales happy.

Stop the ads man! The first thing that pops up every login, the same 10 offers asking you to buy their $30-$100+ "value packs"! I enjoyed it initially, but it is really just a money grabbing app. If you want to advance after level 30, just know you'll be buying your way up. Not worth it if you like strategy and team battle games...even after spending money, I do not believe the value was equivalent to price.

My account is gone. Lvl 60, many good champions, all gear and progress completely gone. 6 months of diligent work, never missing anything. Update: 9 days later and still no progress. I received a message when attempting to recover (through transaction receipts) that purchases were made from an entirely different account. Meaning they are, at best, clueless on where my account has gone. Do not play this game, they will steal from you!

Changed from 5 down to 2 stars. I like the battles and the mechanics, I play this mostly to pass time. The biggest downfall is the game doesn't reward you for the amount of time you put in. This game is the most rng grinding game I've played. There are far too many in game adds also, 6-10 ads sin the first 5 minutes if playing everytime you play. The time investment for the reward is meh at best. It's certainly a pay to win system.

Initially I enjoyed it, but if you're not willing to spend money, it just becomes a grind. The problem is that it's INCREDIBLY marketing heavy. I don't make in app purchases, and it's practically impossible to keep up without them. You simply can't compete against a team of legendary characters in the arena. Upgrades and events seem designed specifically for high dollar invested players. Even worse, the "packages" are extremely overpriced. Uninstalling.

So I have played this game actively for the past 2 weeks now, grinding it out for hours upon hours every day. The conclusion is that although it looks fantastic it needs a lot of work in terms of sound design, activities to do etc. but most importantly, it is a Pay to Win game, period. Even all of the major events that promise great prizes are mathematically impossible to achieve without pouring money into the game. Buyer beware, dont spend a dime on these sort of practices.

Overall the game is just average. I downloaded the game expecting "One of the most ambitious RPG games of 2019" and honestly...the game isnt much of an RPG. Sure, the characters level up and you can get equipment and such, but it doesn't feel like I can get immersed in the characters because I dont really have much of a say when it comes to their abilities and such. The combat is nice, but it feels more like a hero arena game than an RPG. Just change the ads to better show what the game IS lol.

The game itself has a great amount of potential, it's the developers that are extremely lacking. I've backed off from playing this game quite a bit due to the lack of content, the extreme lack of holding their end of the bargain to deliver said content, their piss poor excuse for customer service, which is basically non existent, & the constant bombardment of purchase packs upon logging into the game. Its disappointing to see a mobile game with so much potential go to waste due to the developers

One of the worst thing about this game is the farming system. Trying to farm for armor set artifacts, xp beer, and many other things in this game is such a slow and annoying process. It's such a chore and really ruins the game. The experience in this game is a chore. You have to go into a boring battle either manually or auto at least 30 times to get what you need. Since that is the case they should add a sim to simulate for your farming. If not then add in a ×5 speed button. Be considerate.

Pretty graphics but limited content. Also this game is pay to win hard-core and the developers seem only to care about the big spenders unfortunately. Unfortunately, there is no way to compete in the challenges and actually climb the ladder to earn top rewards or to complete the challenges. Hopefully the devs will change how they run the game. Very disappointing when you grind and grind but you still can't make it ahead without dropping money, money, money. P2W, such a waste.

Pretty good balance for a mobile game the battle pass is a good idea I would like to see it come back. Also the only downside to it is the constant pop ups for sales that are going on for ingame purchases cutdown on the frequency that those pop up and I'll give a 5 star. If you get it to where all promotions pop up only on initial login that would be great.

I lost all my progress when the game updated recently. Having already spent several months trying to pull ahead, I really don't want to start all over just because I didn't want to create a Plarium account the first time through. I never spent any money, just spent a good chunk of my days grinding my tail off trying to make use of all my excess energy on the arenas, dungeons, and campaign missions. Yes, the game is fun. When it works. But this glitch shouldn't affect anyone else in the long run.

Okay, I've had this game for almost a year now. I've grinded, farmed, and literally tried my absolute hardest to become a competent player in this game. I've got a decent collection of Epic and Rare Champions. I've fought through the Campaign, played through numerous other game modes as well. you'd think there would be atleast a guaranteed Legendary for spending SO MUCH time to this game, but you'd be wrong. Plarium, what is going on with your Dev team? this could be a great game. But it's not.

Endless bombardment with ads and cash shop items. Complete a level? Here's 2 things you can buy to speed up your game. 5 seconds later, they throw 5 more popups at you. Also, "disabling notifications" in BOTH my phone's settings AND in the game DOES ABSOLUTELY NOTHING TO STOP THE ENDLESS "BUY ME BUY ME BUY ME" pop-ups. And don't get me started on the utter worthlessness of 99% of the "mystery shard" summons: 3-star rare is the MINIMUM quality needed for end-game. This game exemplifies ALL the worst traits of Pay-To-Win games.

Pros: amazing depth of content and character development. I could see the potential here. Also, lots of free stuff when the game doesnt work from the devs. Cons: Game breaks so often that the devs are constantly giving away free stuff. I wanted this to be a 5 star game but the regular crashes, failed rewards claims, and complete lack of support are murder. Save yourself a bunch of time and skip this one.

The reason I gave the game three stars (although it's really nice) is because: there should be a way to get extra abilities on 1 star characters after you upgrade them to 2 or 3 stars, also ascension for these characters, because there are many different characters that are nice at 1 star. That is all from me. Keeping my original review as is, I'd like to add, this game is NOT an RPG. If you're looking for a game where you create and develop your own character, ie a real RPG, look elsewhere.

Horrid support, no desire to add content, spams you multiple times almost every time you got to the main screen to buy something. They pushed microtransactions to a new level. There are bugs that they take a long time to fix or refuse to fix. PVP portion is unplayable for new players as it is full of dead whale accounts that the company refuses to get rid of. The chances to get anything of value is horrid as well, thus just trying to drive you to purchase more packages. Just some honesty.

I have never left a review for a game before, but I have to for this one in hopes it saves someone from downloading this. This game is absolute garbage, add pop-ups every 2 seconds, its pay to win for sure, and prices are obnoxious anyways considering the pull rates. Leveling sucks. They have no skip feature, so the grind is horrendous. The event times are ridiculously short and expensive, so they are impossible to complete without spending money. I wouldn't recommend this game to anyone ever.

Game would be amazing if it didn't absolutely spam you with "Make this purchase" pop ups after every click you make. Holy hell, it's insane. You load the game up and immediately get bombarded with literally SEVEN pop ups to buy stuff before you can even play the game. This happens every time you start the game. Oh, and don't expect them to stop while you've been playing, because you get hit with ads almost nonstop. Have fun with this advertisement with a game hidden somewhere in it.

The game takes waaay too long to get any decent characters. I played for two months on two different accounts and didn't get a single 5 star character. Grinding for materials takes far too long and after a certain point I couldn't progress in the campaign because I didn't have 5 star characters. Plus throwing 6 ads at you every time you go back to town. There are much better versions of this game out there. Skip this one.

I was actually really enjoying the core gameplay at first. Overlooking how intrusive the sale pop-ups were. Got my heroes up to level 11. Pretty fun time. But then I reached a point where it dawned on me that in order to get these orange crystals you have to spend actual money. There's no way around it. You must spend real money with no end in sight to how much you'll actually be spending. So I decided to call it there. Sorry. This would be a good game if you guys weren't so greedy.

My rating originally started as a five. After a few weeks of playing its definitely "ONE STAR." They will try to shove as much product as they can, down your throat. The game is designed to not give you what you need to advance, so you can spend money instead. You would think gear, shards and potions would be random drop. It isn't. You have a better chance getting something you don't need for a hero you dont have.. The marketing is designed to sell you what you need instead. Over time its obvious

It's fun strategising teams to efficiently take down dungeons and bosses with the gear and champions available on your account. There are a few systemic issues with the game, mainly around spending money as some of the packs are a little predatory in nature. But it is however fun to pull shards when you get a cool new champion, so it's not all bad. There are heaps of communities on Youtube and discord, and the clans in game are a great place to meet like minded people.

I am not sure where to begin. First of all, the platform of this game is fun. You have multiple missions to explore. Good time waster. Second of all, WOW they blow your screen up with multiple adds to spend real money. Im talking about constant adds for $59, or even $100. Main problem is, if you want to do anything with this game, you have to spend anywhere from $500-$1,000 just to advance your guys and compete. Unless your rich, don't fall into this trap.

Game is super fun. I think that some of the rates should be upped though like if you do a higher end keep you should get more than 1 of the lesser potions for 10 or 12 energy. also the prices on some of the packs are a bit outlandish. I got a pretty good pack one time that I felt like was worth the price. everything else feels a bit over priced and I wish it was a bit lower. Sort of curbed me from spending anymore.

After seeing tons of ads Over the years I decided to give this game a go. If this was a stand alone game I might like this more, but every level or so and every log in you will get pop ups to spend anywhere from 10-50$$ I've seen at least 8 in the last 2 hours and it is all over the main menu UI. I have no problem spending money on games, but when the game shoves it in your face constantly... I am not inclined to continue playing. If the direction changes from endless pop ups I'll try it again.

Really fun game at first, especially when they are throwing at the new stuff at you. But it quickly devolves into pay to play; I can put in a couple hours each day (which feels like a lot for a phone game) for multiple weeks and still can't get any of my people past rank 5 at lvl 50. Like I said, fun game. Looks great and is very robust, but progress is so slow and painful unless you pay for it.

Still pay to win, get ready to spend over $300 and gain...nothing, I played this game for the past 2 years and all is done is lose my time and money. Very repetitive and boring, just good graphics. Free "units" doesn't exist, even with their events, you'll need to spend your money. The summon events are made for you to spend your money, even the "free" ones.

I do enjoy this game but it's WAY too focused on getting users to spend money. In game events happen frequently (such as fusions) and without saving for months in advance, they're extremely challenging to complete without buying basic resources such as energy. Also, 95% of the characters need books to level up their skills in order to be effective, yet there is no way to farm them in game, and they sell for between €10 - 30 in the store each. Also, the time they expect you to invest is ludicrous

Its a very nice game with cool items and heroes in it. The worst thing about this game is they want you to pay money. I just got out from the campaign and i got 6 pop ups with things to buy in the game with real money. And its not just 1 time, everytime you open up you'r game i get 4 pop ups with deals in the game. Like really ? Dont just shove them to me like that. If i want to buy something the simple thing will be to go to the "Deals" section (idk if there is one , im kinda new to the game).

I think the game is fun in general but there's some champions that are unkillable. You could have a full team with triple the strength of that single champion but it won't matter. I'm referring to Duchess Lilitu. There's also hackers who hack Ultimate Death-Night, making him unkillable when he's down to the last sliver of health. It's also annoying opening 30 Void shards and only getting one epic champion. This is to make sure you (invest) into the game. I could make a longer list if needed.

The devs have made it too easy for the top players to keep newer players out. It is impossible to get any of the op characters unless you have tons of $$, even then you still might not get the op guy. In addition to this, character balance is non-existant and you must have specific OP charaters to progress or you will be set back until you get them once you reach a certain point in the game. Other than this the game is good, and devs make sure to read what was written before you comment.

The game is both addicting and fun for a while. But if you are not comfortable with spending a lot of money, you are eventually gonna have a bad time. Too many ads, things like clan boss takes too much time, drop rates are horrible, upgrading gear is both expensive AND takes too much time. "playing" this game is just watching your phone for hours each day. Fun for a while, but don't spend any money on it. It is absolutely not worth it. Its like gambling and it shouldn't even be legal.

It was a good game for a while but here lately so many issues. In part of the campaign it requires you to start and finish with two champions. I've done this 3 different times in nightmare stage today alone and it gave me 2 stars. It's a small thing to some but energy costs and when rewards aren't given well that's a problem. Edit. Its July 19th, save yourself. Find something else to play. I was ripped off during the summons event so that ends it for me. Wish I could give no stars review

Obscene amount of pop-ups. I get it, you have to make money. There is no reason I should have to close ten windows all trying to get me to spend money just to play your game. Edit RESPONSE TO DEV: That's perfectly fine but if you're going to be considerate of one end of the spectrum you should also consider the opposite. Why not add a menu setting [Disable all real money transaction pop-ups] and have this option OFF by default. That way players see your offers unless they don't want to.

Pay to waste. Play for free or don't play at all. This game is very detailed. Tons of minutiae that makes it fun. But don't be tempted to waste money. You could literally spend $500 and see absolutely no benefit because there are so many parts that go into each champ. Also most champs are worthless, even the legendaries. Basically gotta get lucky to get the only few good ones. Algorithm is jacked. Even spending money you will get duplicates of worst champs.

Starts off as a game you can really get into. It has decent graphics, and a storyline that seems interesting, but soon gets very boring. After playing the exact same dungeon 50+ times because you have to get a specific artifact, only to have to do the same thing for the next quest, you soon lose intrest in the quests. And by that time youve already finished the storyline. Then there are the endless ingame purchase pop-ups, on average 10 every time you start the game. After 5 days im done!

Fantastic graphics and some really cool gameplay options. However, I uninstalled because it really isn't f2p friendly. I stuck with it for over a month to finally get a free epic or legendary hero... and I got a legendary who is not viable in any game mode. It would essentially take several months for another chance at a legendary character. Then I started noticing how difficult it is to level up your characters for mid-late tier gameplay. I cannot afford this game unfortunately.

This game was good when it first came out and for about 4 months after that. Its not the same anymore, every update makes the game more pay to win than its previous update. I really liked the game but if you try to start now, you're going to have a very hard time to catch up. You could play the campaign but with a game like this, the other modes are important. Id recommend playing Zombie Strike, Age of Magic, or Destiny Summoners. I uninstalled this and moved on.

If you are here because of an ad then let me tell you what this game really is. Is it an RPG? No, this game has no memorable characters or anything relating to an RPG style game. Does it have console grade graphics? Not really, maybe consoles from several generations ago. This game is massively expensive to play, with 6% chance to summon a legendary champion from a shard you can buy for somewhere around 10-20$ a piece. If you want to stay free expect to farm for up to several years

Fun game don't get me wrong, but like everyone else said, holy hell! Calm down on the ads, as soon as I open it up it's almost like I hit a pay wall. It's a fun game to pass the time and collect characters like pokemon, never saw a game quite like this, but if I want to buy some character packs I see where the store item is. Just let me play the damn game. Uninstalled.

Everytime you start the game you get 7-10 popups trying to get you to buy a pack-which are the most overpriced I've seen for any game. There is absolutely zero interaction with anyone else in this game-including your own guild members. No talks, ever. Creating an atmosphere that doesnt exactly make me want to keep playing. Beyond that, there are numerous level walls that take forever to get past, then once you do, a new one pops up not long after. Disappointing mobile game.

Their customer support is no good. I had an account which I had spent over 100$ on. It has been. A little over 3 years since I logged in and so according to their terms it was deleted. I received no compensation in the form of in game packages or content. I did ask and they denied any and all form of compensation. Even though we know giving me in game content wouldn't cost them a thing. DO NOT SPEND MONEY ON THIS GAME!

Edit: 1.13 seems to have broken the game. It's very p2w plus gambling, you can play free. But the wall is huge. It's just set up and let the game play itself, so the only thing you really do is gamble on if you get champions. But that's pretty stacked against you. Everything is really over priced. I can't figure out how some digital content on a phone app should be worth $40, $60 or $99 It's very pretty, but unless you have a ton of money to waste, you'll be pretty limited.

Super fun game, I've soaked about 132 hours into it, and had a blast. But the game is designed to help you, lift, you, and nudge you along until nightmare mode (story) and equivalent difficulty settings in dungeons, etc. At this point you simply can't get enough energy to play the way you usually do without spending money on the game. I spent $10 myself for the daily gem pack, and it helped for a bit, but not enough. Replying to Dev's Response: Already spent the time & effort 👍

Trash game, greedy developers. Constant notification spamming. In the game, popups are endless. Out of the game, the notifications don't stop. As for the game itself... It's just another, formulaic ”free” mobile game that's designed to keep you chasing nothing while always making you feel inadequately prepared and continuously frustrated so that you spend money. Nothing new, nothing good.

The game start out innocent enough but quickly expands into a push for in game money transactions. A ftp player will quickly fall behind in every way possible to the players who spend money. You can't keep up in the arenas. You can't keep up in any tournaments as you will be out spent and out scored by the time you get your first points in. Every aspect of the game is a little push for you to spend just a little bit to get ahead. You earned it plarium now own it!!

Constant ad bombardment, mediocre art quality (constantly reusing character models but changing colors), and almost non-existent lore. This game was a huge disappointment and free to play is a joke. If you want to play free be ready to build your entire day around the game. If you are wanting to spend money, be ready to drop at least 1K a month or it won't make a difference.

If I had done this review a few months ago it would have been 5/5. But that isn't the case anymore. The game constantly crashes now, usually wasting your resources. Support tickets go unanswered. In game events have gone from difficult but doable for free to play accounts to impossible without making $50 to $100 in app purchases. The developer seems more interested in squeezing every cent out of the remaining players than they are in actually making the game stable.

I was enjoying it at first. As a gatcha game it's ok. But when I saw the loot tables and all of the pay to win... It just became to much. For instance. Mythic and Void shards have the exact same drop table. It constantly pops up in game for purchaseable packs. Even with the notices turned off. Free to play but impossible to actually progress without buying into the system. And it has at best a 12% chance of giving you a top tier legend. Even with the legendary shard. UPDATE!... So the reply below is pretty stock. seen it in many other reviews. Going through the in game menus I found the drop rates for this game and it's shards. Still sitting at the exact same rates. Until that is addressed this game is fully play to win.

No new player welcome gifts to help catch up. seems like a small thing but it's the first game I've ever played without it as a way to say thank you for supporting us. over all, I like the realistic characters, but games like summoners war, and Dungeon Hunters Champions make you feel welcome with swag, and give gifts often for loyalty, so I'll just stick with them and give them my money when I choose to put a little $ into it.

I like the game overall but i am hoping they will continue adding to the options. They should have more social options to battle with friends and team up in battles with your clan. Clans seem to be very non active and pointless. The refferal system seems to not work and the support answers I got where generic. I love the battle portion and how you level up your character. I wish it gave you more pointers on the artifacts, hard to know what will help you. The ads that pop up are super annoying.

This game isn't even pay to win, it's basically pay to play. You gain champions at abysmally slow rates, you have no way to target farm specific champions/types in anyway. You quickly run into a point where you have to constantly refarm missions that you have already completed because getting gear is slow, much less trying to find decent/good gear. And to top it all off, the game will constantly bombard you with all of their real money purchase options.

A disappointment, the game looks great and controls fine, but that's where the goodness ends. Sales popups hit you each time you enter the main screen usually 3 to 5 at a time, which is a great indicator of the devs goals. High prices for random heroes is bad enough, but these guys charge you monthly to use auto battle a max of 100 times a day, otherwise you only get 30, making grinding for exp, money and loot torture. To make it worse, hero storage is meager and expensive to expand.

Major pay to win. Game is pretty but that's about it. Game also plays itself so you don't have too. Constant ads, drains batteries like no one's business, and after about 10 mins gets boring. There are a lot of heroes but most are just reskins. Only a handful of unique ones and they are very hard to get. If you want to play and have fun expect to spend tons of money, and you will still be bored. There are already many games like this on the market with a lot less annoying pop ups.

Over all, a fairly decent game for story and amount of time you can spend playing it. Unfortunately, you will be bombarded with ads EVERY TIME you go to the home screen. To the point that it gets VERY frustrating. NOTE TO EDITOR: From time to time should mean seldom or on occasion, i.e. when you first log in/ start up the game and once an hour. Highlight the shop to signify sales. Don't be so extreme!

Great start on a game with quite a bit of potential.... BUT this game is waaay too greedy. There is a premium pass but it costs more than most and doesn't pay out the correct currency to buy it again. You will also see numerous adds to pay for things that do provide advantages over other players. These are extremely expensive when compared to other similar games. If you can't figure out how to get rid of all of that money you're stuck with PLAY THIS GAME

The game has a bit of a learning curve but it sure has come a long way from what it was. One thing I've noticed in passed reviews and something I almost missed is the character progression is not explained very well. You can play this game free to play if you really want to I've done it its just grindy. To progress characters you have to level them then sacrifice other characters to further the level of the one you want to level in the tavern but trust me sacrifice uncommon and common champions

Good game, fun gameplay. They have gone offline to fix the servers that I know of, at least 4 times in the last 24 hours. Even if it was only for 15 or 20 minutes, that's ridiculous, you can patch your game in 1 longer maintenance period. Also the game isn't loading for me at all right now, doesn't matter if I'm on wifi or LTE. The Pay2Play is real and ridiculous. Have I paid for stuff? Yes. Most packs aren't even worth the price once you get to higher levels.

It is definitely a game that requires a lot of money to play. I always hit paywalls in the way of what I'd want to play or do. Even with the beginners kit they give you doesn't get you that far. And if you don't completely do every daily task, you can't complete weekly and monthly task. Those are one of the only ways you can get better shards to get better champions for free. Then every time you log on to the game ads pop up. Playing this is saying goodbye to your money and time(maybe both).

(it ruined my formatting so enjoy the wall of text) So I managed to go this long without trying out RSL. For one my phone was garbage and two it was just a meme to me. However, now that I have installed it I've been dumping way too much time into it. It is a very fun game albeit grindy. Since it is an autobattler I can forgive the grindiness. I would give it 5-stars but the cash shop and pay to win elements alone drop it down 3-stars. They literally sell armor in the cash shop. Full sets of epics that you normally have to grind out. On top of that they have a brain-dead market lead because they clearly went for the high price breakpoint instead of MICRO transactions. There are worthless $1 MTX and then there is the $100 macro transactions. I've spent about $20 in here but that was before I saw the breadth of the cash shop. I'm no longer spending money now. If they didn't sell armor sets and they dropped their pricing by a factor of 10 I'd probably spend money every month. I don't mind it if the cash shop is reasonable and I'm having fun. Hell I give Blizzard $15 a month and I don't play it or have as much fun as I do with RSL. I also don't know what they are doing with the multi-battle system. I understand that it is limited so that people want to buy more. However, I think they should either reduce the cost of each level when using it (by a flat rate or percent) or just allow everyone to use as many multi-battles as they want. It's just another indicator that these features are just to hook in more whales than they are to help out everyone. They also need to add a better way to farm out books. There are multiple sources but nothing like they have for mastery scrolls or any artifact. Maybe add 1 rare to the daily reward, 3 epics to the weekly, and 5 to the monthly. This would add a great incentive to the quests Instead of just shards. Speaking of shards, they greatly overvalue them. I think they need to double or triple the shards generated from questing. I do enjoy earning these things through questing and star completion via campaign and faction wars but I've been playing for 15 days and I only got one epic that wasn't through the cash shop. They definitely expect you to be playing for months and months on end to get a legendary if you are playing for free but, again, this game is aimed towards the whales and not the average player. This game is so close to being great. I really enjoy the animations, the champions, the multitude of campaign/dungeons/etc, the events, and the teambuilding elements. The egregious cash shop ruins it though. If they added value to the multi-battle system, increased the shard rewards (this would also solve the book issue and the large p2w power gap), and moved their decimal point to the left for everything in the cash shop this would be an easy 5-star game that I'd spend cash on every month.

I enjoy the game alot. The main problem for me is the RNG sucks. I have opened a good amount of blue shards (with the possibility of rare, epic, and legendary champions) and I have only ever gotten rare. Other than that solid gameplay and story. Lots of content and there is always an event. It is not pay to win it's more pay to save time.

I uninstalled. I am finally free. This game have been a study in how to scam people. It started out great with attainable goals and fun events. Unfortunately, ever since the Santa event the game have been on a steady run downhill. Just opening the game is a chore where you will spend several minutes just closing ads. The events are now just tedious and repetitive excuse to spend money on loot boxes. The amount you are asked to spend are egregious.

A lot of ppl talk about how much they push or how much money they spend. The news and ads for the game isn't what bothers me. Its the DAMN room it takes on the phone. Its just a huge file I've had to delete so much off my phone just to keep playing. Thats more of problem than the few ads that pop up when you first log in. I do like and enjoy the game. Its addictive. I have not once spent any money on the game and have been able to play everything on the game. Takes patience and strategy.

I didn't play for long, but was driven away pretty quickly. The main reason is because of the popups. The game, from what I saw, is very similar to summoners war, which I enjoyed, but the popups ruined my experience. They are extremely intrusive and every time I would go to the bastion, I would need to click out of 5 popups at least.

Game has a bad habit of freezing, things are expensive and the drop rates seem low. Somewhat counteracted by the rate of which you acquire stones for summoning units. The diversity in the campaign is decent, the voice acting is good, and there's almost always something to do. Actual rating would probably be 3.5 out of 4 and would go up if the energy you wasted on the game freezing would be refunded.

Why in the world would anyone make a super grind heavy game that requires hours upon hours to get decently rolled gear and then give you a limit to the amount of time you can spend in game every day?! Oh, wait. This game is a total money grab. I've never seen a developer as greedy as Plarium. If you dont mind shelling out actual dollars for a mobile game, then go for it. Otherwise you will get frustrated.

The game is fun, good graphics and lots of options, but I get extremely annoyed every time I open the game and have to close out 1 to 7 pop ups begging me to spend money, this also happens after you are ingame playing and exit the market, or tavern. I don't have a problem spending so.e money on a game if I am entertained, but constantly being bombarded with pop ups turns me off to the game, and i won't play it anymore. From time to time would be once a day or so, not everytime we enter the game

Wouldn't be as bad if you didn't get unlimited popups urging you to buy stuff all the time. Tried opening the tavern, got blocked 5 times in a row with "offers". Definitely a no from me. The long craft times don't help either, they really don't add anything to the game. The concept is not bad, but you constantly feel pressured to buy things, more so than any other game I've played so far, and I *have* played several P2W titles. Wouldn't recommend.

Raid is a fun game with some issues. Positive: The game is fun, there are loads of characters, levels to fight, and even a place to park characters to gain xp while they wait. It seems that character progression is well laid out, level character, ascend powers, evolve character to higher levels. Negatives: You have to observe every...single...fight you perform. There is a 15 multi-battle limit per day, but you still have to watch all of them play out. With similar games, you can auto-battle and step away, coming back later to see your progress. Raid does not allow this. This is the single, largest, negative aspect of this game and is what, ultimately, lead me to give it up. Otherwise, I think shard allowances (the ability to summon new characters) is incredibly low. I would like to see the ability to summon more characters, even if they are only 1* and 2*.

I really have enjoyed this game, except lately you get errors and can't log in and it's been like this for weeks. They said "we fixed it!"and it worked for 2 days and now back to logging in issues again. So irritating to play a game for so many months as a daily player, achieve levels, rewards etc and now it is to the point where I'm ready to uninstall it! Reminds me of W.O.W.. especially login failures!

This game gets really boring quickly. seeing the same landscapes and enemies over and over again gets repetitive and doesn't make me want to continue playing. This is made worse by the fact that you have to fight battles ONE AT A TIME. You cant simulate battles and fight more than one battle at a time. I have 2500 energy and I am not going to spend 8 hours straight playing and spending it all. The leveling up and ranking up of characters is painfully slow, and all done to get your money.

Game is your run of the mill hero collector game. Runs well on even on low end devices which it should get credit for. The game itself is solid & has an excellent marketing team. With that said, it gets a knock for constantly asking the player to spend money on packs. Including one that is thrown in your face right after the 10 or so minute tutorial. For that reason alone, it gets four stars instead of five.

They do not seem to listen to what the community wants for updates. The latest arena battle update feels like very little thought went into it. And the in game purchases are over priced. I cannot believe anyone is willing to drop over $20 on some items to speed up their progress. And some packs cost more than a triple a modern console game.

Littered with pop up in app purchases(IAP). That's the big part. Open the game and immediately be met by 5 or 6 pop up IAPs that slowly close for "buy this hot deal" "starter pack" etc. Also happens when going back to your kingdom occasionally. Otherwise, the game is actually pretty decent. Fun to play, easy to learn. Graphics are exceptional for a free mobile game, and the story telling takes a page from The Witcher console game. If the pop up IAPs could stop this would be a 5-star game.

Good game, would be 4 or 5 stars, but it freezes up on me a few times a day. This means loss of key items in game. I am running a note 10 plus, one of the most powerful phones on the market at this time. It is not a performance issue, it is a code issue. I was hoping with this big update it would be fixed. NOPE freezing is still a MAJOR problem. . Their response is play it on a pc. What is the point of a mobile game if I have to play it on a pc. I contacted support got nothing....

BUY BUY BUY! The amount of pop-ups that come up to purchase the packs.. it's pathetic. They beg for money over and over. Open the game, 9 pop-ups for packs. Play for about 10 minutes, another 3 pop-ups. every 15 minutes or so, another 3-4 pop-ups. Yes, they're going to respond with their standard reply of "we don't want anyone to miss out on the deals" but it's incredibly excessive. I've never seen it this bad in any game I've ever played. As far as the game play.. nice graphics, a fun game of grinding and you get plenty of options of characters to use. But you'll never get a Legendary without hundreds of dollars, and at this point in the game, if you're just starting out, don't ever expect to finish in the top 10 in any event. The top players are 2+years into building their teams and are beyond elite. Why does this matter? You'll never see them? Oh.. simple fool. Even at level 10 in the arena I was facing level 60+ players. Need to win a few matches? Hope you find that random person who doesn't set up a defense otherwise you're just waiting 15 minutes to refresh the list and hope you get matched with someone you MIGHT have a slim hope against. Algorithms for fair play and matching are broken, servers go down repeatedly, but the one thing you can count on is pop-ups saying "SPEND MORE MONEY!!"

I actually do like this game a lot. But they will spam your whole screen with at least 3 advertisements every other time you go back to your base. The prices are also OUTRAGEOUS in the pay to win side of the game. So expensive that out of spite I'm not going to spend a penny on this game. I'll play it, it is good, but they're crazy if they think I'll spend $20 for some set items and a lil bit of gold. Rethink your strategy.

This game actually has a pretty nice design to it. Very quick access general dungeon grinding RPG I enjoy it at times, however the way advertisements for in app purchases are pushed aggravate me so much that I don't feel like launching the game. Every single time the game is launched, you get spammed with in app purchases, roughly 5-7 screens of them at each login. I'd be more inclined to financially support the game if it didn't feel like it demanded it every time I launched it.

If you are willing to drop a few hundred dollars, this is a great game. Otherwise, this game is terribly unfair to free to play or low spenders as well as new players. Arena which is essential for character development and mission progress has become impossible for low spenders or new players. The game also focuses too much on grinding to level up characters, and even this is ridiculously slow without paying for double XP and energy.

I honestly believe that this is a good game, decent depth, beautiful graphics, lots of different champion combinations. The problem is that you cant play the game for more than 30 - 40 mins a day, you get 12 energy per hour x 24 hours + 200 or so from additional daily tasks. This results in 40 mins (max of game play) and then nothing to do but just watch the screen waiting to be able to do something. It gets VERY frustrating not being able to actually play the game without spending a lot of money. Unless you are willing to commit 10-20 dollars a day for energy/gems game is not playable

Well, really good graphics. But I played daily for 2.5 months and pretty much got nowhere. You can win characters everyday via random draws through shards, but I never got anything beyond middling toons. For instance, I just logged in for the first time in 2 weeks and used 3 of the 2nd highest shards and got the lowest possible option each time. I guess I could play for another 2.5 months praying for a Legendary, but I don't have it in me to add additional disappointment to my life.

I am able to play the game for about 5 minutes and then it will do 1 of 3 different things, it will either just completely freeze, force close itself, or say there is a connection error. it's not my phone and it's not my connection because it only does it to this game. I will give better ratings if you can fix this problem with your game. It is really annoying when i have to waste my energy or other things when I'm in the middle of a fight and get kicked out.

You earned this bad review plarium, now claim it! Stale content, terribly slow for bug fixes( we still have bugs that are 6 months old and still unpatched), and they use every opportunity to milk their player base. You have to close 10 ads every time you start the game up, and they're constantly pushing their "deals" down your throat. I'm disappointed how they choose to handle their game, because it is fun and has potential to be so much more.

This would be a better game if it didn't have 5+ pop ups advertising pay to win in this game. And in app purchases are VERY expensive. The cheapest that I've seen is $9.99. That is A LOT for basic items and I do not feel like you get your money's worth. Most of the shard chances are a rip-off. Even during events where you get 2x chance for epics and legendaries, I've made 10+ pulls at once and gotten nothing but rares and low tier epics. Very time consuming, very expensive, very much a gamble.

It looks and feels great. However, any good drops and characters are locked behind hours and hours of grinding or a pay wall. I don't mind spending a little for a game, but this is a tad bit ridiculous. Edit: I always do appreciate a concerned dev, and that was a quick reply. Three stars, as maybe it'll balance out more.

Random summoner type money grab. One of those types that you have to spend hundreds to have a chance to compete but that doesn't guarantee anything because it's all chance and you might not even get the best heroes. Add the 3-9 pop-up ads that take a second to show up every time you go to base, a second to close, then a second to wait while you see if another one loads. Then stack hours and hours of repetitive grind on top which needs constant attention and the game to be open.

The Game is fun to play, though too grindy and time consuming. Besides the annoying pop-up offers and ridiculous prices for too many Champs (=low possibility to get a REALLY good one), it also sucks away a lot of Data. I played it a couple days with my phone and no Wifi and it took 1,5GB of my Data. Way too much for a mobile Game! P.S. Those pop-ups would be useful if its no more than once a day! My brain is able to hold this information for a couple hours, thank you very much!

The game overall is decent. It's fun and there are plenty of things to do. The game looks pretty good for a mobile platform. Where it falls short for me is the constant in your face barrage of microtransactions and purchasable in game items. I mean, everytime I go back to the main player hub I get 3-5 screens of "Would you like to buy this? No? How about this? Still no? What about these several other things?" Also I cannot find a way to turn off the push notifications.

Disclaimer: I regularly spend hundreds per year on mobile games. I can't recommend this in good conscience. The tutorial is bulky and the UI is clunky. The gameplay lacks something it's competitors have. It's expensive. And I commonly spend $50 for single heroes on games like AFKArena. I wanted to love it after seeing a ton of ads for it, but I can't. Sorry dev team. <\3

Not only is this game boring and repetitive, but holy cow the amount of pop-ups you get trying to sell you packs. I've been logged in for over a minute and haven't been able to play yet because I have to keep closing boxes. this feels like a video game that was made 20 years ago and they've made it into a mobile game. Like the original final fantasy on play station.

Good graphics. Mechanics, and upgrade styles are not unique. There are multiple resources you have to manage which feels more like a grab for people to invest real money. Every time I boot this game up, I have to exit out of 3-5 pay-to-win "packs" that pop up and are way too expensive and its incredibly annoying. This game is owned by the whales, and its targeted for those who spend money on these types of games. When I finished leveling some gear and had to exit out of 6 packs, I was done.

Im not a person to spend in-game money to advance. And for this game its not a necessity yet. The constant "great deal" pop ups when you go to the bastion are bugging me a bit tho. My main problem is that I can't play it for more than 15 minutes because it starts lagging and freezing. I've dealt with small bits of that before but this amount of it hurts my soul. Im not sure if its a game problem, or on my side however. Still think it needs adressing. Other than that the game is pretty enjoyable.

The game has nice graphics, gameplay is alright. The thing that kills it is all the damn pop ups wanting you to spend money. It just shoves it in your face, you have to click out of 4-5 boxes everytime and not even once a day they seem to pop up all the time. It gets really annoying, if I want to spend money I will look for the store and spend money, this practice makes me never to want to spend a dime on this game. Each day I deal with it, the more I consider uninstalling it.

Too many popup ads Plain and simple. I know Plarium says they don't want their players to "miss out" on all their great opportunities... but come on?!? I know I don't spend money on this, I know you don't make money off of me, but I've been dealing with your popups for anyway two years now and I'm over it, especially for a game where once you finish all of the difficulty levels, all you do is farm and farm and farm. Nothing really new after that except more ways to upgrade what you have. Boring.

No matter what they say it's a purely paid to win game that targets anyone with the slightest gambling habit and exploits that as much as they can. The early levels are fun but the further you go it becomes more and more about the money. I wish I had been fortunate enough to learn this before spending about $500 on the game, but sometimes you need to pay for your lessons. Much like you need to pay to get the prizes you have "earned". Tldr either pay to play or die from frustration

Insufficient depth of strategy and gameplay. Pretty enough, but after investing significant time and acquiring a large roster of characters, most characters are pointless and synergy is limited, even compared to other games in this genre. Mechanics largely ripped from a game called Summoner's War. This one had way better style and graphics, but actually seems like a worse game to play.

It is a fun, well made game. It's honestly one of the best mobile games I've played. That being said, the developers are greedy. This game is absolutely pay-to-win. And they don't even pretend otherwise. As soon as you login you are bombarded with almost 10 popups trying to get you to buy this deal or that deal, and the stuff isn't cheap either! Playing this without paying is fine but it can be a slow grind. After playing constantly for almost 4 months I've found that this just gets boring.

The gameplay is a little bland and limited but customization is ok. The thing that is god awful. Is anytime you go on to the main screen or bastion. They bombard you with sales to buy stuff. It's not when you start the game this happens, it happens all the time and you're there hitting the x over and over and over again. They don't put this into notifications or an option where you can hide for 7 days like a lot of others. The little fun that is in the game is killed by their ads.

Decently fun, but the ads for in app purchases are way too aggressive. it is bad enough that I took a full star from what I would otherwise rate this game. the game quality goes down when you have to spend the first 30 seconds closing pop ups just to get to the game. Plus they told me to dismiss notifications if I didn't want them, but I haven't had notifications turned on in a long time, but it still happens.

I gave 4 stars only because there are a lot of in-app purchase ads that are incredibly annoying to close out each time I restart the game. Give me "show me this once a day" box to check and I'll change to 5 stars. Otherwise, if thise kind of game is your genre, then come join us! The community can be pretty quiet or brutal at times, but if you find a channel you like chatting on it can be enjoyable while grinding away.

At first, it's fun but the prices are absolutely outrageous and the devs don't really make the feedback process easy. Seems a little too much like a cash grab. One issue is the numerous pop ups, and another issue is the 100% rng basis for getting drops/rolls/etc. Both are super cash grabby. Also it's impossible to submit a support ticket in game. I accidentally deleted two level 15 artifacts trying to sell trash to get more silver so I could complete the two 15s I had, and there's no way to undo!! UPDATE: so, I played for about 140 days or so, which I think is plenty of time to get a sense for the game. Honestly, it's not good. The draw for the game is collecting heroes, of course, but for what purpose? Just to have them? There's really no content for the endgame, which almost all players on here agree is a shortfall for this game. Further, the energy system is terrible, and the rewards are too infrequent for low spenders. The game is just bad. I can clear all of the content without a problem, and I rank mid to high Gold 4 for arena without trying. I say that so you know this isn't coming from a disgruntled player who just can't progress. Rather, there's nothing to do except spend money and collect more champions, for literally no reason. That's a poor game design, and this game will be dead soon.

Update: New device, same issue. Guess the devs either don't care or can't figure it out. 08/05/2019 I cannot get past the first battle. Once I defeat everyone it says login issue. When I try to login again, it says it cannot connect to servers. I don't have a user name or ID yet and cannot contact support without apparently. I've cleared cache and reinstalled but nothing is working. The first battle is fun though since I've played it multiple times.

Typical Gatcha style game with good graphics. Drop rates for the summons are meh, and they encourage spending. Playing as a ftp, it's fun. But you definitely can see where you are encouraged to spend. Plus the popups for the new deals at boot dont hide it very well either. Decent time sink, fun to play, but the monetization scheme is super agressive.

It's just a cash grab now. I regret giving them any of my money. You now have to pay to get rid of stupid notifications with their new Battle Points or whatever system. You HAVE to buy into it to get the notifications removed in it. I'm done. Witt the whole game. It was a nice couple months, and I'm sad to see it go, but that was the line. If you're looking for a free game, or maybe spend a few bucks here and there, this is NOT it. They are asking for more $$ than an MMORPG was or is currently.

Its a fairly fun game with some pretty good graphics but you'll get to a point where it turns into a heavy grind. They will push all sorts of microtransactions in your face, by which i mean i have had at minimum 4-6 game ads shoved in my face, and have prices that rival console games for a battle pass. They said its periodic but thats false. I get offers every single time I open it. I dont like how expensive most of the in game purchases are, however it is a pretty fun game regardless.

The ads asking you to buy things are very frequent, ranging between 4 to 6 or more in a row, very annoying. Freebies are frequent, but low value. At the end of battles when champions are found, we should have the option to sell, favorite or drop them. An option to add them to vault or use them to level up other characters would also be nice. The game freezes twice a day, regardless if I am on 4g, 5g or wifi. I send report, no response from devs. Happens every day. Needs major fixing.

Was a fun pass time but becoming a strictly pay to play game now... making it harder and harder to win anything all the time, as you progress, they tweak the rules to make things unattainable. The more packs you buy to advance, the higher your price gets for the next one. If you're thinking of starting out, run away! It's a money pit!

Overhyped, misleading, and bland. With the oversaturation of ads, it's no wonder this game is considered a joke. Its mechanics are no different from your usual gacha game, and the visuals touted to be great are decent at best, especially with the cookie cutter character designs. While the campaign has voice acting, this is nowhere near the fully-voiced game that was advertised. Not that you'd find yourself playing this for long because of how much a grind it is, unless you pay to win.

The game is mostly fun, but the shop has just become entirely too predatory. Nothing is worth buying and progression is slowest I've seen without it. They stretch "deals" over a week so that you miss events that you need the materials for when you do buy them. Prices have gone up and up and content has gotten harder to scale into with spending If you're thinking about starting, it's already too late unless you're ready to spend.

Gambling app, pure and simple. I don't mind spending on a game if there is value but in Raid you can spend hundreds of dollars and get absolutely nothing in return because every single aspect is like a slot machine and randomly generated. In addition, the pricing changes based on spending habits, so if you really enjoy the game and are willing to spend money, you will also have to pay more for everything. As much as I enjoy the gameplay, it is absolutely not worth the time & money invested.

Game mechanics are good and it's generous with the rewards. The one thing that really made me give a 1 star is the constant pop-ups of purchase packs. The moment you log in you are bombarded with all of these packs that you can buy and some are great deals if you're into that but I'm not. I brusehd it off for a few days but now its "buy this, buy that". It's sooo annoying, all I want to do is play the game without being interrupted.

Would love for better deals to come out of the purchased material once a month or so. It seems like you've cut back the amount of items we get lately or how good the deal really is. 35$ for 6 artifacts and some coins is kinda steep considering the gear you get is never actually good besides 1 piece. I've dropped well over 1000$ on this game over my time playing so it's a great game, just would love for some better deals to pop up than the repeated "great deals" we get every other day.

Could be a really good mobile game. The issue the game has is that it is one of the most expensive mobile games I think I've ever seen. The sheer amount of pop-ups is a joke, what's more a joke is the cost of these things. Yeah the game is free, but even if you wanted to get 1 thing that is worthwhile, prepare to pay. The summoning system that gets you your characters is the biggest scam I've seen in a game. Wouldn't recommend to anyone, especially people with impulse control issues.

Overall, it's what I expect from a Gacha game. it has some pretty neat mechanics and the customization of gear and units can keep the game refreshing. My biggest complaint is the same for any other Free-to-Play arena/energy style games. They do have an energy style system, but it isn't near as limiting as other games. People who will play short sessions periodically it will have more than enough to do what they want. One thing I would change is the big spam boxes selling items when I log in.

From a gameplay perspective, this game is fine. Not amazing, but not bad and can be enjoyable in a weird grind-y kind of way. But. This game is sooo desparate to get your money. Almost every time you return to the main menu it'll advertise some limited time offer and not just one, but a few of them. If you can put up with the very "in your face" marketing the game does then it's fine. A solid 7/10.

Joyless cash-grab game after the first month of play. Exciting characters both visually and with their skills, but beyond that, there is NOTHING to do in this game. The storyline is cool but takes about 2 days to complete and is easy, then it's just repeat and repeat. Farm gear (with THE LOWEST DROP RATES I've ever seen in a game) and then use it to farm experience. With your higher level champions you can, guess what, farm higher level gear. Fun for a month, DONT WASTE YOUR MONEY though.

Started out 5 stars and now down to 1 star. The 10-15 pop ups at the beginning every single time I login is absolutely horrendous and annoying. You have a "shop" for this. Sometimes I just need to login for a moment to lvl up my characters in the sparring pit. If there was a way to turn these off I would continue to play but until then, I will move on to similar games without these persistent and annoying pop ups.

At first,game play,cinematics,and story line are great. Then you beat the rudimentary levels,and it become a cash trap. Switching out armor is too expensive,levelling up armour is too expensive,you litterally have to spend hours a day just to create mediocre characters. Its nearly impossible to get legendary characters,even after spending money in game. It had great potential,at some point,but the money spent on advertising,should have been spent on game play,and story line enhancments.

If you have a gap in your recreation time and you want to fill it with a traditional mobile game, then this is a fine selection. It has all the usual tricks, from timed incentives that train you to open it regularly to layers of fake currencies that make it less clear exactly how much money you're being asked to dump into the game's store. The gameplay is simple but passable. Still, you're guaranteed to hit a progression wall at which point the only winning strategy is "pay for bigger numbers"

For the most part, a fun and enjoyable game with some depth to it. The paywall isn't as solid as other games, but the grind is just as intense. I havnt found it bad, I also have spend $ when I see a decent deal (definitely not a whale) and I'm enjoying the grind for now. Just sticking to logging in every day for 2 weeks gets you decent high end heros with decent gear. These two will get you through most the early game easily and can still be used in the mid game.

You can't justify in game pop ups with the deals being temporary, because they're not. The deals cycle. I'll see the same deal a day or two after the previous one expires. I like the game, it's pretty good other than the fact I have to spend coin to unequip gear. You gotta get players to spend money somehow I suppose. The best deal I see in game is $3 which I've bought multiple times. Other than that nothing in in the game is really worth purchasing. Seems like a bit of a money grab. 6 out of 10

Do not let this 1 star be completely discouraging. It is a fun game with great graphics and story line. I gave it 1 start because unless you want to spend A LOT of money or have the patience of Job you're not going to progress. Be prepared to play the same levels over and over and over and over and over again. In response: Yes you can get items from game play, but like I stated in my initial review it is only after playing the same levels over and over again. The progression is VERY slow!!!

Way too expensive, super tight game on giving anything decent. I have no idea how this game is rated so highly. Even when I did make purchases I felt like I got cheated. It tells you the possible things you can get but you ALWAYS get the least valuable stuff. Constant pop ups every single time you go back to the main area to make expensive purchases. I mean I get it, great graphics, decent game, you guys deserve to make money on your work but the reward for the effort put in just isn't there.

Three stars. I've played 30 days as of this review, with 4 champions to level 50. I will keep playing for now. The PROS are good graphics and gameplay. the updates are frequent and there's always some kind of event going on. this game has massive potential in my opinion but the CONS: Too grindy. Encourages you to spend money in the store which is GROSSLY overpriced. feels very greedy. if I didn't have the 60$ to blow on extra ingame loot that I've spent already, I would have quit awhile ago.

Ads are OVERWHELMING with no way to disable them. This is not a game, but a legal way to scam people out of money. Were it a "game" the ads could be disabled. You can jump on Steam and buy a fully fleshed out game for less than the cost of some of the "packs" which contain items you can only get in that pack and not just buy playing the game. This game is a modern day claw machine, cost way more to play than any "prize" is worth.

They keep promising to deliver new content but it never arrives. The stuff that does get released doesn't actually add anything new to the game. The "deals" they offer used to just pop up once a day when you first logged in and new offers would pop up once. Now I get the same "deals" thrown at me over and over Everytime I log in, and the worst, in the middle of playing if I go back to the main screen they will show me all the "deals" I just saw 10 minutes ago when I logged in.

Would be nice to interact with other online players more. At least be able to show inventory and champion set ups. Some kind of trading maybe. Monthly subscription should come with a few free artifact removal/replacement per month. I feel like i have a lot of good ideas but thats only my opinion. The game is definitely on the right track with plenty of potential!!!

Horribly grindy, you can barely progress if you don't purchase items with real money, and they let you know that.
