Every time I log in there are multiple prompts of things they want you to buy and "deals". Literally more than 10 sometimes, before it let's you even play the game. Gameplay is basic as heck. Not even that fun. Do yourself a favour and don't even waste your time on this.

I've played probably a thousand hours. The updates are like every six months and just create more issues. Same content pretty much for over a year. No new dungeons etc. Still waiting on battlepass 2. Unless they actually start trying to fix and develop the game. Your better off finding a different game. It's just a time sink. And over priced items with beyond terrible chances to get anything good.

Edited my review after one day of playing. While the mechanics of the game play are cool, don't bother playing unless you plan on spending money. The game does not give you enough energy to play, leveling the heroes is a huge grind, skill up books are few and FAR between, and the drop rates on epic and legendary heroes is a joke. I hope that the developer makes changes, but greed is a funny thing. This whole game is a trap to get you to spend money.

I played this game religiously not too long after it came out. It at first was fantastic until it was acquired by a new company. Now its riddled with bloat messages trying to get you to spend money on the game. Its predatory and annoying to have to deal with all of those messages. The game is now too overly complicated and is EXTREMELY pay to win. If that's your thing that's cool but its not for me especially seeing how poorly monetized the game is

Decent game, good community, plentiful updates, decent models, two problems, the sheer amount of "Hey, hey! Buy this thing! It'll get you along faster", and the most recent update made it nigh impossible to play on some phones because there's too much for data storage to keep, thus making "Not enough space to play" pop up anytime I try to log in

The game is fun, but the monetization is pretty aggressive. Multiple pop-ups that have to be closed out, lots of freebies early on so that progression is quick, then when it get's grindy you're more likely to spend money to get the same satisfaction. I've played about 30 hours and bought a $5 pack because I am having fun and think the Devs deserve some money, if I stick with it I'll pony up a little more down the road. Just be aware of the psychological warfare that's being employed and be smart.

Raid depicts itself as being different and more enjoyable than other games of its like. Long story short: it isn't, and I don't recommend this game to anyone who values their time or money. Gameplay is bland and incredibly repetitive, characters are generic and uninteresting, decent characters require a grind like no other to obtain (unless you're willing to part with lots of your money), "story" is lackluster and forgettable, and the game suffers from highly aggressive advertising. Not great 👎

The game is a pretty good rpg, but after everything I did, it had a flood of "deals" telling me about stuff I could buy. I get it, you want to make money, but making me click through 7 or 8 in app purchase options before I can play isn't how to go about it. I would rather pay for the game up front than deal with your parasitic micro transaction bs. I had high hopes for this game and you left me disappointed.

I have been playing raid since almost the beginning and have reached the end game wall. The game is great to begin with, there is lots to do and so many obstacles to over come. BUT!!!! The game currently has a definite lifespan I have completed everything the game has to offer and have thrown lots of real money to do so. Unfortunately new content being released is not stimulating for end game players. If something is not changed soon I will be uninstalling like many others in my situation have.

Really want to like it more. The game mechanically and visually are top notch, I love so many of the character designs. However, the grind is real in this game, and personally I feel that the in game purchases do not match the value monetarily. And the game does lack in variety, things feel very same. The arena needs some balancing of some sort as it's disheartening to try to progress only to run into opponents that all run the same dude, with the same build that means they'll solo your dudes.

The game is hacked....I will not spend any additional money on this game until it is fixed. In arena, I used to consistently finish mid gold 4. Now, I'm struggling to remain in gold 3. The game is fun and I've invested quite a bit of cash and time, but will leave if Plarium doesn't fix their consistent issues. The hacking has pushed me to the edge.

The number of pop up ads when you open the game is annoying then they added those same ads for when you come back from doing a bunch of dungeons or levels. Being punished for playing the game was the last straw for me. I have so many duplicates and the only legendary I have, I paid for. The drop rates are abysmal, the gameplay is meh, the graphics are nice though, and some of the challenges are fun. Overall, the game feels like a Sisyphian task

I've played the game for over 6 months mostly daily. But they are pushing less and less new content out changing the looks a little bit and calling it "new" don't waste your time downloading and putting so much time in for the most pay to win game that only caters to people who spend loads of money. Get you a game that will care about all the player base and push out new content on a regular basis. If you don't believe me just search "raid road map" on yt2see how bad they are at dropping content

Despite the game being very grind-heavy and the frustrating algorithms for the RNG rate, it's a pretty admittedly addictive game. I turned my partner onto it and we've pulled some nice characters so far. We're not F2P by any means but we do pay for content sparingly and are pretty responsible. As far as GACHA games though, this is decent. It's not great, but it is decent and the marketing department does a great job of advertising this game. It's an okay time waster. But don't expect in depth.

The game is alright for about a week, but then it hits the same exact problem every free to play game does and becomes tedious. Unless you buy one of the 10 bundles that pop up one after another every. Single. Time. You. Do. Anything. Otherwise you will not be able to progress without hours of grinding. Not really worth your time.

Animations are entertaining. You are the overseer of your minions. Not bad on upgrades of weapons and skills, however, to really advance it's necessary for pay-to-play, and even beginners packages are way to expensive like $99 dollars and lesser expense packs don't give you much for your hard earned money. Don't pay! Nag screens are about as much as any other game...trying to get you to purchase with real money. Pretty good game for this genre.

This game isn't as bad as most say it is but that does not mean it's good, the ads can get annoying, the female characters are over-sexual, but that is pretty par for the course for mobile games and video games as a whole, and you can get by as f2p, I got two 4 stars in not that many rolls, what I drive issue with is that you can't get a summon easily and that the game just isn't fun, it doesn't innovate on anything in the RPG genre, it's just the same pick a move and go you see in mobile games.

I am very impressed with how smooth this game runs on my phone for being of such high quality graphics. The only thing that i wish this game had was better multiplayer capabilities. For example, there is no general Duel option or Trade functionality. And an option to customize your bastion with defences that you could eventually upgrade would be sick! Spontaneous attacks from real time players and NPCs. maybe even guild wars!! I hope the developers will take all inquiries into consideration!

Could be a great game, but the decisions made by Plarium keep getting worse and worse. Constant server issues, a predatory microtransation system that becomes more expensive the more you buy, and a plethora of questionable policies favoring certain accounts all add into the hot mess that it is now. I'll change my review when these issues are resolved.

While the gameplay is sound. The over argression on its monetization practices killed any desire to keep playing. Between the heavily hounded ad campaign to an onslaught of shop ads when you start the app. Plus the prices they ask are garbage. Not to mention presentation is lacking. Outside of numbers, nothing else feels satisfying including attack strikes. Overall, it feels like it is overselling itself as more than it is.

HORRIBLE customer service I have played this game for months now. most who embark on this type of journey with a new game spend some money regularly (several hundred almost thousand dollars) or don't at all. Apparently they don't care. I contacted them about 5 items that I purchased that expired because THEIR game was unable to be accessed for hours and so they told me "that's unfortunate but I should have claimed them during the time frame". They lost a loyal customer and any of my friends.

First of all, the game wasn't the game for me (not a fan of these types of games), but I won't leave a bad review because of it. The graphics are great for mobile game, and the gameplay is your typical try and summon one to five star characters and send them in the dungeons to get materials for upgrading units. My only real complaint is that there are a lot of in-game ads for real cash currency and items. To the point where you have to click out of sometimes three or four pop ups in a row.

Its not thats its not fun. It's just not very fun. At first I enjoyed it, but content gets really repetitive. Plus doesn't take long to get most of the characters which you won't have space for anyways or use. The legendaries are so difficult to get and when you do get one it wont be a good one. The prices are insane and the pop ups are worse then a late 90s pirate site without an ad block. It's clear most of money on this game is spent in advertising and not making the game better.

* I think I figured out what I wanted from this game. Hero Collection and Strategy, I enjoyed more in Heathstone, and Hero Customization, what I was looking for is more like Paladins (obviously very different than mobile). * The most basic thing that this game doesn't do for me is involving way too much grinding for too little payoff. If making money was something the creators were looking for to begin with, they have the typical flashy-but-actually-useless packages, and got their $10 out of me.

Cool game generally, obviously if you spend money you'll get farther and win more. Developers figured out if you separate a game and sell it piece by piece then people will pay way more in the long run. Before you would get that whole game for the base price. funny how after you answered me you added more to make it even worse. Yes it is possible, but the time frame would be outrageous to even get two players up to level six and have some fives, four's. U would have to play all day everyday.

It has good value for a while, but then you realize that the "unique" characters are recycled, the gameplay is too repeatative and the grind is far too slow. I also get very annoyed with the game always trying to sell me on gambling packs every single time i open the game. If other games offer in-game currency for playing this game, go for it. There definitely better mobile games to play and focus than this.

The game is alright, nothing special, but enjoyable. Worst thing are the 28 pop ups they throw in your face before you can start playing. It's because of the pop ups that I can't be bothered to start the game. Also, bad faces. Most of the characters just look ugly. It's alright for the monsters, but hard to look at for the human characters.

Graphics look good and the voice acting is decent, but it's one of those games with a tutorial that makes the game the world's easiest PnC adventure, and has an auto play button. Basically if you like click the cow but want microtransactions, this game is for you. If you want an actual game, well this is allegedly the best mobile had to offer, which is why it's hard to take mobile seriously. Maybe my expectations were too high so take this with a grain of salt. I just want a real game.

The graphics are good. The gameplay is mindless and while there's a decent core idea... It doesn't go beyond basic. I know this is a F2P game, but the amount of money it wants you to spend would be hilarious if it wasn't predatory. 500 characters is not enough space to go into all the issues with this game and just how medicore it is once you get past the graphics. No thanks.

I have played this game for over a year and spent some money on it. It is a great game at the start and you would like to progress but the game is rigged to keep your characters as weak as possable and the only way to improve them is to buy very expensive packs. I have started playing another online game and it is much more fun because it is not a pay-to-win format. Really think twice before investing time in this, it WILL lead to frustration!

I had to close 8 different in-game pop-up ads for microtransactions before I could play at all. Some of these microtransactions were 30 bucks or more; i could buy a full game for the price of an "Epic Hero and rewards." Also, there are money sinks to make sure you have to buy silver at some point. For example it costs $20,000 silver in some cases to equip a different weapon. This game was designed with greed in mind.

So I've been trying to avoid this game for a long time . I've had numerous YouTubers I follow pitch for it and thought if they weren't being paid to play it they would never mention it. I'm not so sure now. . So now that I find myself with an extended stay in the hospital I'd give it a whirl and I'm glad I did. Pros turn based , wide variety of heroes lots of advancement. It actually has a story . Cons 1 I could not find where to enter a referral so no free epic champ for me 2 2 gigs+ memory

I thought it was a 5+ star game at first. Till I got pretty far into game then it felt like pay to play. Which I also did. I don't mind spending 25$ a week. But here lies the issue. I would spend them on these Xtra rare summons.. or at least I thought. The extra rare also included everything below that tier so you have to get more. I was very disappointed it all the money I spent and nothing to show you. So I quit. It's such a shame because I enjoyed it.

The game was fun at first and I can tell there's a TON of strategy that goes into this. That excited me, because sometimes I do just want to chill and play a game for an hour or two on my tablet, but I have two MAJOR bones to pick with this game. 1. Ads for microtransactions CANNOT BE SILENCED after you see them once. They pop up every time you go to the main hub. Most mobile games have a checkbox saying "don't show again today" and it keeps that offer from reappearing for 24hrs or the next server day ticks over. This game does NOT offer that, and it feels like it's being a very pushy salesman. I understand you want people to know what's available but there's a line and this game long jumps over it. 2. I've received multiple push notifications for the same thing. I look at my phone wondering why it's blowing up with notifications to find it's none other than RAID just spamming me about something. It's very pushy, and I don't like that at all. At least I can mute the notifications, but it's still annoying. I bet they do that on purpose to make you look sooner for the same reasons I did, to see why I was getting 2-3 beeps at once. It's quite underhanded if intentional, and sloppy if it isn't. I would highly recommend Dragon Village M over this. If you don't mind the cutesy anime style over the gritty, realistic art style and don't mind a story that isn't even written well in English, go for that. I don't want to be entirely negative, so I will end on a good note. I like the lore. The story that goes on as you progress through the areas of the game made me interested in the world and whoever that writer is, make sure you give them a thumbs-up from me. I'm pretty picky about my plot in games and this one felt decent, which is impressive for the type of game it is. Narration is also on par, give him a thumbs-up too. It was fun, but after my first week, I won't be coming back. Good luck, guys.

This company has decided to put all its good graphics, character and story development into advertisements instead of the actual game. The game itself is just endless, boring dungeon grinding for tiny incremental stat increases over long periods of time. If I wanted to push the same button over and over forever I'd go to a casino--a gambling addiction is less expensive. Just save time, money, and infinite frustration. Watch the damn ads, because the ads are literally the best part of the game.

So, this game is not terrible. However, aside from the random freezing crashes, my absolute biggest gripe is that this game is very much a pay-to-win game. And it's not just a matter of paying a few bucks; any competitive package costs about as much as retail games, if not far more. Things would be much better if you could buy everything with gems, and gems themselves continue to be gotten both through gameplay and cash purchases. Having done both QA and game design, I see this as unacceptable.

A little too aggressive with the spend money ads. I get that you need to do it, but having to click away 3+ ads when i open the game is a bit much and tells the consumer a lot about the experience they are in for. The game is really good at making you feel like you're progressing slowly and need to spend money on summons since the game doesn't give you anything above 2nd tier out of 4 to start the game. Most gacha style at least give you one special unit to hook you, this is no hook all work.

Add a way to disable pop-ups for the market. We all know where it is at; maybe allow a pop-up the first time you get to the base screen. I am enjoying the game but almost fed up with the 50+ pop-up sales I see a day (because it's a lot of grinding if you don't want to spend money). Just tone it down. Show me the sales when I first log in; then let me grind in peace.

Addictive in a manipulative, you'll have to eventually spend money if you want a team good enough to compete with other players and complete the challenges. Don't do it to yourself and play something that isn't going to rob you. RESPONSE TO DEVELOPER. If you want to play for more than an hour you'll have to buy energy, the game looks great and I was addicted to it, I put probably close to 1000 hours into it but I also spent close to $300 on packs that included stuff like 1000 energy or gems.

Edit: the referral links are buggy and support team is non-existent, so that's frustrating. The game has a lot of potential in terms of being a solid strategy based game. That said your animated drawings shouldn't be sold at 40-90 dollars for almost every pack, crazy high prices, but also it's basically gambling with very low odds of getting a useable character. I've played for around 4 months and I enjoy the game, but y'all are greedy, but I guess the people willing to pay are to blame.

Edit: Bull..and explore? What? The same stuff every day? The game is made to make you spend money to see any progress. It's not that you can't progress, you will, in a week or a few months. Save your time. Save your money. There are other games by other companies who see themselves as providing an enjoyable experience to their players. All this company see's is money. If you like being bombarded every time you log-in or do anything by ads selling $49.99 package deals, this is your game.

Game is designed for you to spend a lot of money if you want to progress and the prices of their in-game packs are ridiculously expensive and aggressive. They would say that purchases are optional but you can't get anywhere if you don't spend. This game only favors big spenders who spend thousands and you don't get value for your purchases. Since the game is full of big spenders it's so hard if not impossible to advance as you are no match to their gear. This game only leads to disappointment.

Been playing for more than half a year now, the game has the potential to be one greatest games on the app store. Sadly the lack of interest from developers towards their player base and the greed of the company is getting in the way.... Latest patch with "new content" is just a remake of existing content. Actual new content which is coded into the game is not being released, any many many more issues. Plarium you are f-ing up this great game.

I can admire the attempt to push how good the graphics are, because they are, but mostly nothing else is like they say in the ads. The game got boring for me very quickly and many characters feel too similar to boast about +400 characters. It's grindy, repetitive, and unenjoyable unless you spend money, and that's something they should work on. There's room for improvement, but even as an rpg fan, this game just isn't for me.

Pretty Solid so far. A few gripes, mainly how much microtransactions get shoved in your face. There is also no way to check a box to opt out for a day or w/e. So that's consistently annoying. Acquiring Gems (in-game currency) is tedious as all hell, and you dont get many. So use them sparingly. Highest rarity just like in all games, purely based on luck. You either get one, or a hundred. Or you get none forever. The Events are also an absolute pain to acquire pts. Aside from that The game is Fun

I have submitted a request for refunds for the past 90 days of purchases, and have spoken to Google Play to help submit this case. I have also emailed Plarium directly. I look forward to hearing from Plarium in the mandated 3-business day turn around time set by Google Play T&Cs. I am quitting the game because of the emphasis the company places on pushing in-game purchases, despite the amount of issues present in the game. They seem to not care about addressing the games technical issues, or flawed game mechanics in lieu of trying to cash out on people's hype for pulling shards. Please understand that I enjoy the game at its core. But it has become too much of a hassle to play any further.

Do not spend your money on this game. The odds of getting a really valuable champion for the amount of money they charge is not fair at all. A full deluxe or special edition game on PS5 or Xbox is usually around 100$. Spend 100 dollars here and u will still not have a truly valuable character that can get you into a sweet spot for grinding. Im am not pleased with the results after all the money I have spent to keep getting the same characters I already have in the second lowest tier(rare). Smh.

Just another pay to win and no enjoyable end game content. They are a corporation so it is expected that they aim to make money, which sadly translates into their own in-game advertisements that blast you 5-8 at a time for packs to purchase. The events are pointless and only aim to get you to buy resources, only to end up with mediocre rewards. After having played for quite some time, the game just becomes a grind and I cannot recommend this game.

I downloaded and played this "game" a few months ago. To unequip or swap to better weapons and armor you had to pay in-game currency. To upgrade your champions, you had to gamble, with terrible odds, with in-game currency. To play past the time gate they set up, you had to spend in-game currency. The whole time you had to dodge relentless "special offers" trying desperately to separate you from your wallet. Ads run amok. I could abide this, if the gameplay was rewarding. It is not.

Behind a very creative pay wall. They let you beat the game the first run through, and get pretty far, and then stuff scales up insanely high and you're not getting any further till you farm/buy a better team. Game becomes unbarably boring. They try to bait you in just long enough to think it won't be one of those games and then screws you. I see they say they tried to make some balance between paid and free to play. I think it's a 1 star free to play. Grinding for weeks is not any fun at all

I played this game for hundreds of hours %100 F2P. The game is designed to get you to pay money for progression. Yes it's a "gotcha" but it's heavily weighted so you get bogged down by resources and character pulls. Even after endless hours of grinding if you can't pull the right champs then you will be stuck. The only way to consistently pull new champs is to pay $$$. And omg the amount of adds is oppressive.

Meh, The graphics are good and all, but the gameplay is so dull and boring. You tap the same move every game, with 1 or 2 that you can use once every 5 turns. I see Youtubers saying "Join now and get a free epic character". Yet I still only get the default stuff that you normally get. Not to mention the game basically screams "Give us your money". I dont recommend.

I tried this game several. Made multiple accounts trying all of the different starter heroes. It was fun for a little while. I believe I lost interest when I felt that this was truly more of a money grab game than a game that was made for the casual mobile gamer such as myself. Haven't done a video on my channel, not really worth the editing and time. Tons of other reviewers out there though and good on them. The game could have been more appealing if the cash shop wasn't so aggressive.

Just another Pay To Win! Sure you could play for free, you wouldn't get anywhere in any reasonable time. Just don't bother, you can do better things with your life. Don't believe their efforts to make the game easier to play for free, in order to meet the requirements to get the new elite characters, you need to make purchases. I would love to see how much credit card fraud is involved in the higher ranking players of this game. I finally uninstalled this game after seeing their efforts........

After seeing the massive campaign for this game via twitch youtube and all over the internet i decided to see it for myself. The game is playable on auto. Meaning you dont actually play the game. Just press auto and characters are either strong enough to do it or not. Its not much of a game if thats the main gameplay cycle. Its more of a time sink. This is where the cash shop comes in. Before level 15, which took 1 hour, I was bombarded to spend over 100 usd. Dont play this its a cash grab.

I've thoroughly enjoyed playing this game. I'm getting tired of it though. I've been playing for a few months now, level 35, I have yet to get a legendary. I'm constantly grinding for artifacts, potions, brews, leveling up champions, and when I've just about hit my wits end and give in to purchasing something the prices always pull me back. Right now there is a deal for 1 sacred shard and 100 gems FOR $30. That's way too expensive for so little! Until prices go down I'm not buying anything.

Ive invested several hours over the last few days in this game already. Being that I haven't put a penny into the game I'd say I've progressed quite nicely, but i am quickly seeing where I'm going to hit a wall where progression is going to slow if money isn't invested into the game, i can understand developers have to get paid somehow. Looking thou its not going to take much to spend a chunk of change on this game in a hurry. also would love to see a friends list and be able to battle friends..

I have been grinding out dungeons for over 4 months now and still don't have any end game gear. (Lvl 20 -25 dungeons) The amount of resources you need to meet requirements in events anymore is insane,and the rewards are extremely lackluster. For a company that hit the billion dollar mark.... do better, be better. All I ever see from content creators is how bad and greedy the game is. And I can agree, pretty graphics don't mean anything. 100 dollar offers for the same offer that used to be 60.

This game has a lot of potential but not enough content. The in-game ad barrage when you log in is infuriating. I appreciate that notice of limited time offers is made but my suggestion would be to limit the pop ups to 1 with a link in the pop up that directs you to a tab that houses only the limited time offers. You could draw a player's attention to the offers but not make it a struggle to get to the game for players who are not interested in them or may have already taken advantage of them.

This is a pure and simple gacha game at its core. They add a lot of "mechanics", more than most games. All they really result in is more grind and more chances to spend money. Speaking of that... Everytime you log in to this game be prepared to be bombarded by ads and offers trying to get you to spend money. The only good thing about the game are the graphics. The story is mundane and washed out.

It just gets stagnant after awhile. I've dumped some dollars into this, as I felt it polished enough to pay the devs for their hard work. Even so, after not "maintaining" my account for a couple weeks, I've fallen behind the curve and don't see the need to drop more money to catch up- I've spent more than I do on console games that offer 10x the content. Devs your game is slowly declining in status as most of the recent reviews have shown. BTW your auto-replys to the reviews makes me laugh.

Used to really enjoy the game and then life happened and I lost a lot of financial means so the game became less fun. To top it off the "pace" of the game is entirely too slow. Everything depends on what heroes you have and their skill levels. The 2x game speed is a joke you're looking at hours of nothing to achieve very little. The game has great art, amazing content but without a lot of independent research and a lot of luck you aren't going very far.

the game visually is impressive. but it's boring. it's just endless busy work unless you fork over your bank account. character kits are boring except for some of the most expensive characters. every guild i saw was riddled with people who had quit and I'm no different. The character models are cool, but pointless because most of them are just fodder to get 1 star up in your character, so why get invested or attached to any!? And the cash shop is expensive! They can't even be called micro

The game itself seems to be exceptionally well put together, however I still see many flaws in it. The actual in-game currencies have little to no worth and instead most of the things in the shop need to be bought with actual money. I see no point in actually having an in-game currency if there is 1 tab to buy a few things and 7 other tabs to spend actual money. Other than the cash-grab attempt at a shop, the story is well thought out and the characters are interesting. Still, I don't recommend.

I've played since first quarter 2019. The game was fun and had potential. Over the course of my time playing I have gotten two legendaries from draws, the rest in my collection are all from events. I have spent money both unintentionally and intentionally. The popup ads are worse than browsing unsafe web. (Getting a refund for a pocket-buy was an unexpected hassle. Don't use Paypal.) If you are willing to pay for a game where prices for gatcha items are reasonable, this isn't the game for you.

The game has high potential to be a great game. The only MAJOR issue is that every time you log in, and I mean every time, they bombard you with a minimal of 5+ "buy this pack" pop ups. It dont matter if you're logged out for just a few minutes the moment you log back in, BOOM pop up "buy me". I hate that. They should show them one time and not again. Or put it in the shop tab and let players go see the packs for themselves if they want to!!

This game will waste your time and money. The drop rates are extremely low, they will give you multiples of stuff you already have, the pop-ups and are intrusive and predatory to get you to pay more, and to top it off the progression is a snails pace. I tried to play this game and like it, but after a while of grinding missions and story to get lottery shards and then waiting for high drop chance events, hoping to get something that is not utter trash, the game spits in your face. Save your 💰.

Was a great game to play. But after logging in for 260 days straight, they give you exp points, so when I ran out of exp, it cost me twice as much stamina to do events. So for me to continue playing I would have to purchase stamina. A big trap and very disappointing. I have stopped playing and uninstalled this money grabbing game. Very sad to find out after so long that they use underhanded tactics like this.

This game is super broke. My brother and one of my friends got me into this game, and I stuck it out for a while, but I can't handle the brokenness and bugs anymore. So, here is my honest review. The character designs are awesome. The animations are great, but...The game mode you play to the rewards you get are totally broken. I've gotten a lot of horrible rewards repeatedly from beginning to end of matliple game modes. You'll have to pay to get decent gear, so it's not worth the time to play.

A lot of work went into developing this game and it shows. Its a polished game with more content coming and you dont run out of things to really do in it..just energy. It can be p2w, don't expect to be one of the top players without time and money. Would be nice if they stopped bombarding me with "Buy this pack for 14.99" messages when I log on. You'll get like 5 of those messages in your face and then it'll finally stop. Also gacha. funny how I keep drawing the same characters over again at 2%.

Well seeing as I already wrote a review of this game and somehow it is now gone I will write it again. This game used to be a lot of fun. But since they started their predatory monetization practices in their Ahabesque drive to hunt whales, this game has gone down hill at speed. Every time the game updates you have to fight with the ingame download to get anything done. Often waiting minutes at a time in order to even get into a campaign battle. Not to mention the dozens of offer popups.

Events cannot be regularly completed without spending cash. HEAVY p2w game. QOL features are non-existent. No quality sorting of monster box. Not enough storage for equipment. Can't emphasize enough how this developer just wants your money. Don't fall for their "We want everyone to see ads so they don't miss them". If you want to spend money, all you have to do is go to store. Don't fall for their "You will eventually get something good or rares can be made great". Money rules this game

Beautiful game, with its flawless graphics, it's easy to get roped into the limited time events where you'd be able to receive opportunities to receive better character for a better gameplay experience. Unfortunately, Free-to-Play does not allow room for advancement. In short, you'd have a lot of money (or luck) to blow on this game in order to get anywhere in this game. Similar MMOs (Darkness Rises, Black Desert, etc) have a wider fan base while making it more attainable for both F2P and P2P.

It was a lot of fun at first - different champs, farming stats, free gifts/rewards. Then I realized how much farming you actually have to do to get your champ to certain rank/level... It's so grindy and tedious once all the free energy they give you is used up. If you're inclined to spend money... luckily they ALWAYS shove at least 5 of their deals in your face at login, which is SO EXTREMELY ANNOYING. So many types of "currency" that feels like a giant money grab. Just play on auto mode...

Played for 5 months. The game started out great. I enjoyed the graphics and different characters. It wasn't until later while grinding for 1 specific 4 star green item over 100 times that I realized you will go no where in this game without spending $$. I won't say this game isn't for everyone. Play and decide on your own. I just don't have 8 hours a day to grind for gear or silver. BTW, all the cons that are listed in the low star reviews are accurate.

Updated review. This game is really bad, just blatantly a scam. They not only double downed on the pay to win aspect but triple downed on it with another arena mode. If you wanna "play" this "game" don't expect to get far unless you pay a lot of money. I recommend not giving them any money or downloading the game in general. Oh also the ads in the game are horrendous. You get thrown an offer every second with no way to disable it.

I've heard raid is grindy and p2w so I gave it a try to challenge myself. Honestly, most of the content in this game is doable f2p if you learn the mechanics and invest a lot of time, and I really mean A LOT of time. They show you some annoying offers for money, but not too often and the game doesn't show any ads. The graphics are pretty good and I like the game so far. The only issues I have are: a rather dull early game and the arena missions that aren't in touch with the rest of the missions.

I like the potential for this game, limited what I can say on post. First is the ads, ok we get it, there is deals and special offers, that's what looking at the store is for. I have never played a game on pc or moba (and I have played thousands) that has this many in one session. It's also a click bait, as soon as you think your done with the ads you click on the tavern or training hall and an ad magically pops up the same time to take you to the store. Just 1 or 2 ads please, not 5, 6, or 7.

Played for 5 or so months, bought packs. Was fun at first, but quickly felt more like work. It's very pretty. That's it for the positives. Opening the game bombards you with pop up ads, multiple times a day you'll have to smash closed 2-5 "deal offers". They keep promising upgrades, and fail to deliver new content. Expensive compared to similar games. Even as a paying customer, support is nil. They have major issues they refuse to fix, cheating, broken pvp.

Everytime you login you get bombarded with sales and pop ups. Im on day three and ive been sent over a hundred promotions to buy your in game products. The worst part is they could have made this game fun.( EDIT: i tried to "turn off your notifications" it not only turned them all back on when i logged out, it also, did not work once it left the dismiss on. It still did pop ups.)This game should be removed from the market. Anyone that greedy shouldnt be allowed to make anything.

They still have no support. No inventory to store your energy for when you can use it. And their server issue is never fixed. And the sad thing is this is the only way I can get a response for support. It could be a great game if they cared about the players. But they only care about your credit card. Now you can only complete your weekly quest by buying with real money. It''ll end up costing you like $30 a week. And they still never make the game any better. Look at all their other games.

The most predatory game on the app store. Plarium bombards you with ad after ad, and the packages are crazy expensive! Everything in this game is geared towards making you spend bigger and more often. Buyer beware. The characters are cool sure, but after you have seen the same character reskinned and sold for a higher price the third or fourth time, it gets old. The same animations and skeletons are used for a lot of characters, and the ever growing pool of characters to account for the typical gacha power creep means it is becoming more and more difficult to get the characters you want every time a new character is released. There is no way to farm characters you actually want short of buying shards, which is a completely chance based gamble.

I have been a long standing player in the game. I stopped playing for a while, restored the game, but cannot log into my account. The game keeps popping up with errors about the game having some issues. So I cannot restore my saved game, cannot log into my Plarium account, I can log into Amazon Prime, but when trying to claim the ingame rewards, same error about game having issues. Developer, do you really care about your customers, or is this just another easy way to get money? Fix the game

I've been playing this game for a little while. There is 2 issues really pushing me away from this game. The game will constantly freeze up after a battle and the major issue is every time you log in, you have 5-10 pop ups suggesting you to buy this set of armor, gems and etc before you can even play the game. That seriously gets old real quick every time I'm trying to play and makes this game feel like money hungry. If they fixed, I'd rate this game higher but as of right now, it's average.

The game has great potential. I immediately uninstalled the game after being bombarded with ads. Tip to devs, if you want app users to buy something, tone down the "temporary deals" spam. Nothing more annoying than ads 24/7 in your face. I wanted to like the game, would have considered spending money, loved the gameplay, but the ads... I'm a fan of a lot of gacha strategy games, but none of them come close to how much this game begs for money.

Gosh, really great animations and I could see from my little time that there were some well thought our mechanics. But, I uninstalled after the game blasted me with a banner ad every single time I came back to the home screen. Put in a "do not show me this" button, or just stop begging for money when I'm in the first 5 minutes and I have no idea what the things I'm being sold really do.

Seems like it would be fun, and I liked the first hour or two. But after logging in the next day to 7 or 8 ads popping up in a row begging me to buy stuff, i had less fun. The second day of the same thing, an it's uninstalled. 2 stars because it looks like a good game, but seriously, if I said no to 2 ads, take a frickin' hint! UPDATE: I understand wanting to show deals, but 8 in a row each new one popping up as you close another is not "from time to time". It's harrassment!

This game isn't too bad as far as gameplay or graphics.... the issue is getting to that gameplay past all the walls of ads to buy in game bonuses. EVERY time you open the app or go to your home town it will open at least 5 ads in your face. Honestly went beyond my tolerance. Also I picked it up for the so called great story I had heard about from some reviewers. I don't know about other people, but good story is not always synonymous with long story.

The game is awesome, but as soon as you open up the game, the first thing you'll be doing is closing deals after deals after deals so forth and so on to the point that it ruins the gaming experience. The fact that it has a store is irrelevant since they want to sell you bundles that costs from $4.99 up to (if not more than) $49.99. This game has the potential for a perfect 5 star, but the multiple micro transaction being shoved down our throats ruins it open opening the game.

Lowered to 1 star due to them blatantly lying within their response. There are legendary, and higher up, items you do not get for free. You can only purchase them, and they're ridiculously expensive. Don't waste your paycheck on this game. Pay to play game. Gets boring very fast unless you spend money. There are many games like this that are less expensive and more fun. Super slow game, constant ads and spam. They waste your rss then pop up an ad to sell you stuff. Garbage

If you want to be competitive at all, or finish campaigns/dungeons, you need to pay a lot of money. The graphics are good, the gameplay is good, and there's plenty to do, but after a while it's just maintenance to get shards to summon new characters but the rates are so low that you won't get anything of use from them. Bummer. I'd have spent money if it wasn't ~$30 for a 1% chance at a good character.

Played for 7 days. I can see the apeel of the game and I did enjoy the expirence during that time. Biggest downside for me was the constant reminder that it's sorta pay to win. I'm not personally a huge fan of games that you can buy items that make the game much easier. It takes away from the game expirence. I'm all for the developers making money, but make the micro transactions a little less game expience impactful and more fun or creative. Just my 2 cents.

Dont spend money on it. Even if you pay to get an epic or legendary shard, more than likely you'll end up with a rare character. Not only that, the pop-up items are extremely annoying. I understand they want people more inclined to buy more shards in order to get those legendary characters. But spending money and not getting an epic or legendary is kinda of a bad deal. It's a fun game but will be uninstalling due to this issues.

I read a lot of comments of how this have is a money cow. Simply not true, after playing similar games there comes a point when you hit a wall. When you hit that wall you can either grind and continue to play, buy some things and continue to play, or quit because you think you need to buy things to play. As the game progresses it should get harder, not easier. Love the game and give it my full support. Might even steam it.

Overall , it's a good game but there are something in the game that the most of the players feels is wrong.1st. Unequipping weapons from a character cost silvers , the high tier it is the more pricey it is. Maybe you can lower it by a 50 to 70 percent or better remove it hehe.2nd. Can you put more detailed number of the ingame downloads. This latest update just shock me cause it have eaten a lot of my data plan just saying.3rd. Can you put a 3x or 4x speed.That's all for now. Hope you read this.

I would rate higher(probably a 4)as the game is fun. But there are way way too many pop-ups trying to get you to spend money. When I open the game I'm hit with like 5 different pop-ups. I am not a heavy spender on mobile games but I will on occasion spend 5-10 bucks on a game I enjoy. I however will not spend on a game that tries this hard it's very off putting and due to this fact I haven't played it as much as I would have otherwise.

The initial grind feels aggressively tuned to make you want to spend money, more so than other mobile games I've encountered (mainly FEH and Langrisser). If you're confused on how to spend said money, there is an unending barrage of popups to show you the way. Otherwise, it looks as pretty as advertised but gameplay felt lacking beyond a shiny wrapper. Overall, no thank you.

It's a mobile game so I really shouldn't be surprised on how I feel about it. The story seems rather uninspired. Every time you open the app you are hounded to purchase bundles that seem way over priced. Loot boxes in the form of "shards" that encourage you to destroy what you get out of them to feed other champions. Unless you like wasting your time with these sorts of games, I wouldn't bother.

I only have 1 game in my phone, and it is this. It was really fun and worthwhile at first, avoiding the pitfalls that make most games irrelevant and irritating, but have no fear: it's now among those other titles that overswell themselves with "new ways to play" 400 different kinds of in game currency and a huuuuge roster (a good and bad thing) of characters... Bad enough the champion gathering is a roll of the dice, but the time expected to earn any of these currencies is ridiculous

This was fun for the first day, after the hype of the graphics wore off I realized this was another cash wall game and what a wall at that. You log on and get greeted by ad after ad after ad (you have to close like five or six ads in a row everytime you boot up). After I got the initial tutorial done and threw a few of the zones, free progression comes to a halt. BUT dont worry you want a new random legendary or epic hero?! Just gotta drop like $25-30 bucks, hope your kid doesn't mis click!

Very bad customer service, in fact one of the worst in the industry. Game developers do no support the player base and their valuable customers. Tells you to drop an e-mail if you have issues but once you drop a query, they can't be bothered to solve it and jusifies it with BS. Jacks up prices for in game purchases like you've never seen before in mobile games. Too expensive. Game itself is a slow grind to hell. Not recommended. Just another greedy enterprise. Stay away at all cost!!

I have played this game for a year and a half now. It was fun and had a lot of potential, but end game just ends up being a daily chore. Add in that Plarium does the opposite of what the community asks for, they constantly are releasing money-grab features, and the constant maintenance down-time.... this game has turned into a 1 star. Plarium has steered me away entirely from thinking this game is enjoyable in any way.

Generally, I wait a few months before leaving a review, and so far, I've been playing since December last year. This is honestly a very good F2P game, and of course, there's the P2W side of things. I've spent a little money here and there, but it made no difference to me as the drop rate of heroes, gear, etc, is all rng based, you either get something good or you don't. All that aside, I've loved playing the game as it's got an awesome pace, and I've thoroughly enjoyed playing.

Great game! Unfortunately, they have suppressed the amount of stuff they give out for free compared to last year which is incredibly sad. The price of in game items are astronomical to make the "deals" seem like an amazing price. This company walks a fine line of greed vs consumer retention. Time is money and they want both from you, whether you pay up front or not. This game is not Free to play friendly so be careful with your wallet.

Been playing this game for 5-years, it's very addictive (I don't mean that in a good way). The game is heavily monetized, the packs are over priced, (basically it's a gambling app disguised as a game) progress is very slow, time in game every day is excessively long (usually 8hrs) just to do all daily activities. higher staged areas of the game are paywalled. This game is very pay to win. Save your time and money and play something else.

Used to love this game but have got to the point that i can't recommend it at all ..zero new content in the almost year I've been playing.. after thousands of dollars spent nothing new to do... yet I still have to deal with many many many in-game adds for the "deals" in the in-game store.. no way to get books without spending real money... I'm done ..dont waste your time or money on this game

The prices for in app purchases are disgustingly expensive. Some offers are $60 right up to over $100. No in app purchase is worth the same price you would pay for a full AAA game. The grind is long, you only get 15 auto battles(unless you pay) making the grind HUGE! Events are also set up to be nearly unbeatable unless you spend money, and I would spend money, if they weren't so greedy. (Edit: thanks for the reply, and ya I know, you're a casino with a videogame built around it.)

Underwhelmingly average game. Now, what I mean by underwhelmingly average is that this game has been advertised throughout youtube for a couple of months now through sponsorships with quite a few youtubers, but the game itself is average at best. Sure, it looks nice, but I generally play games for gameplay and not graphics and the gameplay isn't anything new in the mobile genre. Now that alone wouldn't warrant the two-star rating. The ton of pushy popups to buy stuff to "enhance my game experience" does that. And those things are not cheap, either: For 60 bucks I can easily buy a AAA title with more features and better graphics. Yes, the game is free to play, but I don't want to have to click through 5 popups to get to the actual gameplay.

Been playing for about a month now. The game is really fun and runs smoothly. Gems are a bit harsh to come by without paying after a while. But my biggest gripe with the game right now is the aggressive ads pushing you to the shop. One ad at startup would be enough, but 6 damn popups? That's overdoing it. Other than that, good game. Keep it up.

Do you like pop-ups? Like clicking the X on continuous game "hot deals" and "limited offers"? Then this is the game for you. Every screen change, end of battle, or just waiting a few minutes will give you an endless stream of in-game ads and offers to say no to. This game would be at least enjoyable if they would lay off the begging for money.

I love this game but the customer service is hands down the worst of any game I've ever played! Don't expect any help from plarium or replies either for issues, however, the game itself is really great and probably one of the best mobile RPGs currently out. Can be f2p but like most other games, progress can be sped up with gems. Customer service and ridiculous shop deals prevented me from giving 5 stars, but the game itself is fun.

Played this game for a few months. At first I was enthralled with it. I got through the story, strived to beat enemies in the arena, collected countless shards hoping for legendaries. Spent about $50 on the game as well. Over time I realized the entire game is just a money pit. They dont care about players whatsoever. Your reward for leveling up is being able to spend $50-$100 at once in the hopes of getting better characters to run the same quests countless times with new teams.

The paywall is MASSIVE. Even if you sink a few hundred dollars into the game you're not guaranteed much. Might as well just buy a game console instead. I have at least a hundred hours and a considerable amount of money spent but not 1 single legendary hero. There is really only 1 viable character upgrade route (Giant Slayer )which slightly changes if you're going for PVP(which is stagnant). Game looks great but content is basically there to collect all of your money in exchange for possibly nada

The problem with this game is that the gameplay and strategizing is fun, but the grinding and drop rates are downright awful. To give you an idea, they regularly charge $30 for a 6% chance of getting a legendary champion. That means that on average, you would have to spend $510 to get a single legendary. If that isn't predatory, I don't know what is. The game would be better if the monetization wasn't horrendous. There is quite literally nothing worth buying, everything is overpriced by x50.

The game itself is fine, except for when it lags, loses your silver, and stops running in the middle of multi -battles. The support team does not help. I have had numerous problems , they tell me we're working on it, we already know about the situation. It doesn't matter how many screenshots you have showing the amount of silver in your account before the incident, and the amount of civil you hang account afterwards, plus the missing gear, they will not help.

Its an okay game. You can tell theirs alot of work and money put into it. Its just not necessarily fun. They've been getting alot of attention lately by youtubers and ads, I just don't think its justified. Other then the one "free" epic hero you get at the beginning of the game, you don't really get any good heros without spending money of watching ads. You can tell their desperation for the game to succeed more, because their always advertising it. Overall, bad game. Don't give it a chance.

This is a very fun game, but the grind becomes astronomical as you advance. Unless you pay serious cash (and I'm not FTP) it takes a huge number of campaign/dungeon runs to level up a character and gear. On top of that is the RNG of which characters and gear you unlock. Without specific characters, or easier-to-get characters with amazing gear, some game modes are incredibly hard to beat (looking at you, spider). I enjoyed it for about 200 days, then the grind and RNG became too much.

WAAAAAAAYYY too many pop-ups trying to get you to spend money. It's aggravating to have to click through 5+ offers for starter bundles, etc., every time you log into the game before you can play. Other than that, the game looks nice. More fun than most games of this genre. Update: Response to the dev response. No, your pop-ups don't go away when you dismiss them. They come back every time you launch the game, whether or not you dismiss them the previous session. Minus one star. Thx.

this game is fun to get the new characters, that's it. the main thing I'm upset about is the shards. EVERY SINGLE TIME, when I go to get the primal (red) and Void shard ( purple ) i am only receiving the rare ( blue). This has been happening ever since I first downloaded this 5 years ago. no wonder why i keep deleting it. my advice for the developers = 2 word ..... Do Better

I have been playing for over 3 months. The main isssue I had came with the release of the dwarves and the faction wars. The hero limit stayed the same, forcing you to do more with less. Someone in charge of balancing game mechanics drop the ball. You want a unique game, Kill the energy mechanic and make money off the rest. If play is going to be grindy, do away with auto combat limits. You can't be dynamic, if you are a genre clone. Try some disruptive management and be a game changer.

Brutal pay to win. More of an AfK game than anything else. Too bad, cool character design is being wasted in this game. I'm a moderate spender in most games I invest my time in, but this game is clearly only accessible to the biggest spenders. UI is a mess, systems are wretchedly explained. Combat had no nuance or depth (especially when compared to a game like Strike Force). Don't waste your time and certainly don't waste your money.

The game is very good in technical and visual areas. My 1 star is due to the costs to play. F2P users can only play for short periods of time after they get their daily rations. While some manage to get farther along, most do not unless they play for long periods of time. Also, if you are a P2P user, if you purchase items from the store and for some reason do not get them, don't bother with entering support tickets. Even if you give them the proof that you paid, they wont care.......

Devs are scum pressing heavy microtransactions to entrap and encourage paying obscene amounts of cash for basic items. This is one of the only gamss I've seen LIMIT how many times you can buy something per day / month because they know players would get away with a better deal if it was infinite. This explains the advertising money. Overall, this game is ok. However, without paying for anything, it's dreadful and dull. Don't listen to the garbage dev response below it's a lie :)

Upon complain of receiving compensation, as opposed to fixing the problem I was encouraged by the review board to make purchases to obtain compensation. What a scam. Want me to spend time and money on your game but you can not even correct simple issues with your game cause it would cost them a possible purchase. They want more than the average game system game to make any decent purchases.and go get barely anything. Customer service is non existant. Any other game you purchase characters on,

Fun so far. Lots of spam for microstransactions. Good graphics and art. Formulaic Gacha game done well. Edit: The "spam for microstransactions" refers to ingame popups at the Bastion, home base, where 2 - 4 promotional offers will pop up at a time. the ingame options to turn off notifications do not remove these. A few days later and I'm continuing to enjoy the game.

The game would make EA proud with the amount of in your face microtransactions. While the game may technically be free to play, in reality it's more pay to advance. After well over 100 near 200 rolls of the free shards that the game provides as drops or the occasional buy, you will find that all you get is 1 and 2 star units. To get the better units who have the ability to clear campaign lines missions, you will have to spend money. Above all that, the game constantly spams their "sales# at you.

I played this game for almost 2 years and finally had enough of the money grubbing tactics. I tend to spend on games I enjoy but it is never enough in this game. They will also increase the amount of money for packs that you tend to buy to try to squeeze out as much money they can.Their tactics are preditory. When I finally got a clan boss team for ultra nightmare they seem to decrease the drop rate for the most important resource...Books! But here is some for $50 want it?Want it? U know you do!

So overall I really like this game. As far as comparable games, it's much more difficult to acquire and level up high tier champs. My biggest issue however is that it freezes ALL THE TIME!!! I have voiced my concern to the in game support and the discord and guess what? They've done nothing. They tell me to play on a computer, which I cant do. How about they make a MOBILE GAME that actually works on a new phone.

PREDATORY BUSINESS. It's pay to gamble to MAYBE win. The game IS fun. It has a lot to offer and potential for many hours of time, but the chances of getting higher tier heroes and gear is slim to none. You will exhaust your resources quickly if you are a free to play, and the game will strangle you until you finally spend cash on something. Again, there is great potential here: the actual core gameplay is great though questionably balanced, and the graphics are top tier for mobile.

Over $150 spent, and I don't have a single legendary, or any of the better characters that are necessary for later in the game. I can't imagine how tedious this is for non-paying players. The offers in-game also are very predatory, i bought a pack for 25$, and immediately after they showed me a "chain offer" that cost 15$ for twice as much stuff. I understand the game needs to make money, but these tactics ontop of gambling mechanics are horrible. I wont be spending a single dime again.

Now that I've had more experience I can say that RAID: Shadow Legends is nothing special. It will harass you daily for money, and it will give you nothing of value in return--though it's not all bad. The visuals and gameplay are quite solid, and the diversity of characters in both departments is very nice. It's not significantly better (or worse) than any of its competitors in any way. It is looking to fleece you of as much of your money as it can before you swear off Plarium games forever.

had to change my rating. I liked the game, though the characters was cool, and there was a lot to do, but was slapped in the face with another cash grab reality. the create events to make it look like you'll get cool bonuses, but make it impossible for you to meet the stipulations, so to get what you want you have to pay for it. and if you're not willing to pay, you'll never be able to get anything more then mediocre characters. unistalled!

The game forces players to buy expensive items. Summoning powerful championship is luck based and pay based. Also their is a bug in the challenges for f2p. I've submitted a ticket, and they haven't fixed the bug for a last week. The game will also give an option of buying a skin for a championship for $15. The game is expensive and impossible to progress in the game.

Don't do it! This game is dead. They are trying to pull as much money as quickly as they can, from the small base of players left. If spending all your money is fun for you, ignore this review. Every in game event is copy pasted, sure they add different titles, but you grind the exact things exactly the same way. Also if you want the rewards that are worth while, they are locked by insane point requirements that scale exponentially, requiring you to spend resources, aka real money, to reach.

Aside from the good-for-mobile graphics, this game is a disaster. Server crashes daily, and super buggy. To even start playing you have to click through several popup ads for various things to buy and this repeats all the time. I'm all for devs of good games getting paid for their products, but this game is excessive p2w, and given their inability to even keep the servers up for 24 hours you should be very wary of having payment card info or usernames/passwords go through them.

Below average turn-based RPG, with 8+ ads flying in your face every time you load up the game. Aside from the first 2 minutes, the story contains none of the humor and quality of the ubiquitous commercials. Many events only reward the top paying players, leaving almost nothing to do for non-whales. The equipment is full of generic, procedurally generated numbers that provide a near-infinite but soulless grind. This "game" is a perfect case study in microtransaction exploitation.

It's just an advanced version of like idle heroes. Don't believe any of the ads for this game btw it's just the in-game cinematics and you just tap through it. Turn based combat system same as any other game like this. It's not a hack and slash like you want. I guess it's a good game for mobile, but then again you can just get KOTOR or Call of Duty. Both are better games. PS. I hope this last couple of wasted hours means I don't have to see these ads ever again.

The developers don't seem to care about fixing the actual issues that the players have with the game and instead focus on milking people for every dollar they can get. I'm addicted to this game and have spent way more money than I'm comfortable sharing, and even I am very close to walking away. I strongly advise new players to try another game. The game is fun for the first few months, but then it drops fast and isn't worth investing in.

Fun game, ruined by a bombardment of in-game ads. You literally have to close 3-5 ads as soon as you enter the game, and periodically must close 3-5 more as you browse menus. Unacceptable. And there's no way to "justify" it because they "want us to know what they have for sale". If I wanted to know that, I can easily just check out the store page. Duh. Greedy cash-grab. A pretty cash-grab, but a cash-grab nonetheless. Just play SWGOH.

Plays well. First time playing game like this so take my review for what it's worth. Update: This is a gatcha game so you can find out what you can expect from a game like this. What sets Raid apart, and not for good reasons, is that everything is heavily monetized--almost every item that's worthwhile has become harder to earn in game with no alternative but to buy, and no content updates. The company has no interest in retention but uses a revolving door strategy of marketing to new players.

Company is known to pay for fake positive reviews and to delete negative ones, so I don't expect this will stay up long, but this is not a game. It's a digital storefront for people with gambling addictions to suffer through. Don't get me wrong, I didn't buy anything, but the game is constantly bombarding you with ads for "essential" items and gear and encouraging huge purchases in a very predatory fashion.

Only 3 stars because the graphics are cool and the story isn't bad. But seriously, the MOST money grubbing game I've ever seen! $30 for a single (that's 1!!) 'Epic' summon that has a chance to give you a rare summon. Especially when you run an 'event' where your odds of getting a specified legendary from epic shards is maxed to 5%. I get you need to make money from the game, but that's ridiculous. $30 for 10 summons is more acceptable. Especially when you can only hold xx amount of troops >.>

Game is fun for a while, but things have been made significantly harder to try and coax absurdly overpriced purchases. Game is heavily pay to advance / pay to win. Constant ad assults begging for you to spend more on fake "deals". Also, there is still no way to see the status of the "mercy system". Typical mobile game tactics: The company wants you to spend a large amount of cash on a game that's bland and uninspired.

I'm giving this two only because the graphics are some of the best I've seen in an app game. Otherwise this game is tedious and quite boring after you get to a certain point. The campaign is over too quickly and the other dungeons require specific types of champions that you may or may not ever acquire causing your progress to halt in its tracks. Loot drops are 80% of the time hot garbage as well as the champion summons. I don't have enough space to write about every gripe I have.

I enjoy the game a lot. It is filled with expensive microtransactions and be prepaired to spend some if you want to keep up. That said, you can do everything the game has to offer without spending at all. Edit They actually keep adding stuff and content. Still playing every day. Almost 4 years now. I'm editing my review to a more positive rating as they have proven they care. It's not perfect but the devs try. Keep it up.

I want to give this game a better rating but I can't get over its faults. As nice as the character models, animation, and strategy are, the game devs are far too aggressive with their microtransaction advertisements. When you open the game, you need to close a barrage of at least 4 ads in a row. Then after playing for 20 minutes you get slapped with 3 more. Palarium, you need to reconsider these marketing strategies if you want to keep new players.

Update: You did not address the unequiping items costing silver, which makes no sense. Also, in order to get any powerful characters you have to spend a lot of Real money just to get a .3% chance of getting a legendary, and if it doesn't have a name, it is a basic legendary character that is not much better than an epic character. DON'T WASTE YOUR TIME OR MONEY ON THIS GAME!!!!!!!!!!

After playing this game for over a few weeks, I have come to the conclusion that this game is a serious grinder. What I mean by that is this, to get any items you have to sit there and just click and wait to get very little back in game currency and items. Some itmes that help with masteries are very little and far between. That is something, inmho, needs to be reworked. Don't get me wrong, the game is fun however, the over grinding to get items is overwelhming.

Started December. Spent enough money in this game that I could even buy the whole Total War franchise games and all Blizzard games and I would have made more fun. This game has nothing to offer but dopamine, every now and then, just to keep you in the game while they bombard you with constant sale pop ups. Some mechanics are broken, technical calculations like damage are not given to us because "where is the fun in that?".

Awful. There is virtually no difference between playing this game and watching a youtube video of someone else playing it. The only difference is that you will save hundreds of dollars and hundreds of hours of your life. The game is expensive, repetitive, time consuming, and heavily luck based. There is virtually no multiplayer component at all and your only interaction with other players is with a chat box. The game doesn't run well on mobile devices either. Trust me and stay away!

Okay first this game isn't this new "great" game. It's the same type of phone game you've seen before with HEAVY pay walls put in at specific points forcing you to buy something to progress. The heros are rng, so you're most likely not getting something good unless you pay for it. The game is a typical turn based combat. The arenas or worlds or levels you fight in are basically "here fight in the same place with the same enemies five times." Honestly, not great. Don't download.

Got the chance to play this from Beta and in glad I got the opportunity. I've been looking for a game for quite some time and this one checks all the boxes. A little confusing at the start but then takes off once you understand the basics. You must also be willing to spend money This game took a nose dive fast. All I keep hearing is Faction Wars coming soon and it's still been months.

A blatant cash grab that applies virtually everything addictive discovered in gaming over the last 20 years and monetizes on it heavily. There is little to no skill involved. Rather, your ability to be successful with the game is benched in how much time you have available for grinding and how much money you've spent. The story is probably written by an algorithm and the "hundreds of heroes" are mostly uninteresting. The best thing about the game is the graphics. Don't waste your time or money.

I have held back playing this game for so long and playing it for the past week, I get remember why. Gameplay is fun and fast like any other turn-based, gatcha-card mobile game. However, it's FILLED with in-app "Give Us Money" advertising. Signing in, is 2-3min of pop-ups asking for you to spend money. When you go back to the "Main Menu", you're hit with another money grab ad, EVERYIME. The game would be better without all of the begging. The character choices is overwhelming. Not f2p friendly

Raid is an absolutely beautiful game compared to most other games on mobile, but unfortunately that's where the compliments stop. The game is chock-full of microtransactions, to the point that you have to go through at least 3, but usually 5 screens asking you to buy something with real money each time you start up (not daily, EVERY time). they need to dial back the greed before this game can earn a higher rating, which i would be happy to reevaluate should that come to pass.

This game is long established and is exactly what you would expect. It has one of the most unforgiving gacha pull systems. I gave the game 2, weeks of full effort during the anniversary event. It became quite clear where you plataue and content drives to a halt. If you are not paying (quite a lot) then everything falls to snail speed. You won't see enough new units to keep you intrigued and this game has a massive roster, this makes it feel even worse.

The graphics are stunning for a mobile game. The summoning portal (gacha, because that's what it is) needs work. Its not the most unfair I've seen but it just serves to tempt you to make ridiculously priced purchases for next to no worth. If you want a gacha game to sink money into that badly, there are plenty others out there with more substance.

As a new player, this is probably the most painfully slow and dull of all the gachas I've played. Progression is tedious and needlessly complicated (with full completion of all levels requiring you to only use 2 units despite teams consisting of 4), resources are few and far between, and pull rates are abysmally low. It's basically "pay to progress at all." The links from YouTube ads never work, and the "new player" codes you can enter don't work if you've played through any of the game already.

I've gotten lots of legendary champs since my last review and the game has come a long way. So I'm bumping up my review to 4* from 3*. One thing that I'm hoping for right now is a book fix. About the only way to get books is buying them. I'm a light spender but your deals don't make sense. I'll give 5* if there's a way to get books easier, or make the deals cheaper. I'm a light spender and for some reason not a single deal is under $20 for me. My f2p account there all under $10.. why?

This is NOT an RPG. I like that you don't have to come deep out of pocket (still have to come out of pocket). But I hate that every single action boils down to a micro transaction, (even unequipping gear?)... That's BS. I have items that I don't even know what they do. This game is DESIGNED to keep you grinding. This is a fighting STRATEGY game. One request... Don't let players Advent characters with no Ascension about that really wastes resources. UPDATE: Your reply to my review is irrelevant

No ads. They make they're money in microtransactions. But it's not unplayable without your wallet. Bear in mind it will be a grind and not very invovled. You will make use of the auto run and X2 features to farm. But if you enjoy a turned based rpg combat with polished features and artwork this will be a fine free game. As I write this I have around 40 hours in the game and feel like there is still plenty there. Enjoy.

While this game is very fun and high quality, I have two big problems with it. First and foremost, the sensualization is REALLY unnecessary, and probably offensive. Secondly, this game is very in your face pay-to-play. I havent had the game for 24 hours yet and when I opened the app I had to close at least 10 pop-up store offers. That all being said, the game seems rather fair to new players in some respects, like having decent chances to get better rewards from small shards. Could be improved.

Ok you keep asking me to review so I will. Now what I have to say is obviously just my opinion , I don't expect changes on my behalf. So first thing is I like the look of the characters , what I don't like is that when you upgrade it doesn't change their appearance. Now this is a phone game so I imagine the graphics engine is limited. The other thing that I would like to see is for the character animation during combat to have variety & not be so stiff. Again a phone game🤗

In every other game, when you spend 100 dollars, you at least feel satisfied, not here, tho here that gets you the chance at 4 legends who's percentages are abysmally low. When I first saw the game, I thought it was that you spend silver to summon, and if you have a shard, it is free. In my opinion, that's how it should go mind bump up the prices on the silver for summons to whatever amount you think is right. It latest makes the game feel less like a pay to win.

I'm a long term player and a med-low spender at the "end-game" stage. I have enjoyed this game in the past, but have seen a shift I do not like. The events and challenges have heavily shifted towards spending being a requirement, despite careful resource management. The game lacks many standard features other games in this genre has. The recent "FTP" mechanics are countered and overshadowed by an increase in required resource consumption. Most importantly I do not feel my time is respected.

This game is bad. Constantly spams you with overpriced "deals". They let you choose 4 characters when you start and one is way better than the other three so if you didn't pick him you are boned. You need to constantly manage your roster but the tools they give you are terrible. The UI is awful for managing all the stuff they want you to do. Most of the characters are extremely generic and it's hard to tell who is worth it or not without reading a guide.

I enjoy this game, I really do, but there are far too many popup ads within the game for some deal or other. I get it. You have a limited time deal. But honestly, how many people are going to react to these popup windows when you're annoying the heck of out them? I don't mind 1-2, but you assault players with 5-6 every time they click on Bastion! We can check the fricking shop if we want a 'deal'!

This game has so much potential. Graphics are amazing and the amount of content (campaign, dungeons) at the beginning seems like a lot, but over time you are literally playing the same thing over and over again. The arena is the WORST thing about this game, especially for new players. You're pitted against players that have stronger units with better gear, which makes it extremely hard to progress. The events are also hard to complete without spending cash. This game is NOT F2P friendly.

it was fun at first but now it's becoming a grind. Once you reach level 40, its damn near impossible to progress quickly without spending money.
