The drop rate is terrible, you always get low level monsters. You can collect all the shards you want but the strongest one you'll get is a "rare" type and Epic monsters are far and few in between. Don't bother with legendary monsters. I got a legendary shard and all I got was a "rare" monster I already had. It is pay to win all the way through.

After 3 years and this game is still full of push-ads to try to get my money. Every time you load up the game, the first thing it asks is your money.... the sad thing is this game looks great n story is amazing. The money grab was not so nice, and the drop rate is horrible. Unless you got $$ to spend on a game, if not, find some other game to play, this is not worth the time.

If I could rate the game lower, I would. Even with spending money and grinding for materials, it's nearly impossible to gather in time. And to remove the champions that have those fusions requirements after you spent money and time grinding is insane. Maybe once the events are over leave it with that but keep the option to fuse the character that you have. I would write more to explain but I'm limited to only 500 words. So don't waste your money on anything. It's soso if you play free!!!

The developers dont like to hear how much of money hungry pigs they are. They charge ungodly amounts to make decent progress in the game unless you want to be playing for a year before it starts getting interesting. If you want to get ads constantly, if you want to spend hundreds on a free game, or if you dont mind being screwed over on drop rates of gear and shards just to have the developers tell you the games about strategy, play this game. (My last review disappeared so thats interesting.)

Very predatory and aggressive when it comes to their microtransactions. I get it, you gotta make a living; However judging by their TV and yt ads that are very common, I doubt they are hurting for money to the point they need to throw 3 pop-ups displaying a different microtransaction they are selling everytime you return to the main screen. I'd get it if it was when you'd log into the game, but they're throwing these pop ups even after leaving the store. Like you didn't just browse them. Lol..

This game is fun and well made. BUT, the blatant pay to win mentality that they are moving towards is disheartening. the ad barrage when opening the app is frustrating, and obviously geared towards those who have thousands of dollars to spend on an app. most of the offers are between $40 and $100, for what amounts to not much in the long run. I could go on, to keep it simple, the game is really fun, but the company behind it is killing it to make money from from those with money to spend on it.

Game is decent but the biggest problem is the time sink to remain relevant. Daily Rewards are locked behind a time gate which you need a minimum of three hours of game time to obtain all of them. Not only that, once you obtain all Daily Rewards, you need to spend additional time to utilize all the resources like Energy, Entry Tokens for content etc properly. You're looking at spending 4 to 5 hours minimum PER DAY to be on the right track for this game, on a daily basis. Too much..

THEY WILL STEAL YOUR MONEY FOR A BROKEN GAME. I was enjoying this game a lot. I invested a fair chunk of money because I liked the game. I had purchased a special item set for a character and really liked the combo it created. After about a week the game started kicking me locking me out of my account. I wasn't able to access the game for a week. They found that the set I had purchased was the causing a bug and won't refund or give adequate support. Typical not caring about customers or ethics.

The game is a cash grab. They over value their product. If you are free to play, enjoy playing for 10 minutes, 2-3 times a day. You never have energy unless you want to buy one of their extremely overpriced packages. The Plarium player Support ignores you and does nothing to refund your lost items. Overall, it is a horrible game. If you love these gotcha type games, there are better ones.

It's a boring money suck. I played it for way too long and spent to much. By no means is this "free". You will need to spend money to get heroes and other boosters in order to progress. After a few days of play you will have an idea of what the entire game is. Mindless, boring, time, and money suck. Pvp feels entirely based on your luck pulling heroes and gear. You will see the same team comps over and over because those work. Waste your time doing anything else.

The game is fine and has some level of strategy to it, However there is a lot of grind to the game, Grinding levels for your champions, And grinding materials to love them up, And the grinding is restricted to an insane degree, You can only Do certain dungeons on specific days of the week, So the only real way to make decent progress is by spending real money which is how the game gets you. The game is fun but underhanded. Wouldn't support this.

Game looks ok.... at best but what a boring mess!! Just not fun at all for me! It is no different then any other game of its type!! And like all other reviews say the pop ups and amount of money they want you to spend is just a joke!! Yeah you may not need to spend money but you will spend way to much time playing/grindding to get anywhere! Good try I guess but just the same game with a different skin on it.

Fun auto RPG. Cool champs and abilities, even though the majority of the champs are mostly useless in the later stage of the game. Free to play is fun and playable, just limited. If they lowered the price of the ancient shards, (which apart from a few exceptions is the only way to get the strongest legendary champs in the game), I would be willing to spend money on RAID. 30 US dollars is a ridiculous price to ask for one ancient shard. Insane prices are the only reason I cant give 5 stars

Newest update caused major issues. I can't log in anymore, constantly greeted with a message to restart the game or re-log in. I've missed a few days of rewards at this point and clan activity. Edit: I contacted support only to be told "this is a known issue" and time has come and gone and nothing seems to have been fixed. No update, no nothing. At this rate, by the time I get back in I'll have suffered clan loss, not to mention at least a months worth of rewards.

Extremely aggressive money hunting game. RIGHT out of the gate, they hit you with the oldest most worn out marketing strategies they can muster. Not to mention, it's a month behind on my game so I can't even get the latest free stuff (of which there is much, but it's locked behind a 24+ hour wait wall). Gonna play it until it becomes unplayable, then going to delete.

While this game starts out free, to get any kind of progression towards the end game you'll need to shell out a lot of money. This would be a fun game if the monitization wasn't so heavy handed. Upon logging in, you'll get at least 5 pop up ads asking you to pay money and they pop up everytime you log in. If they spent more time on the game rather than monitization, this would have been a great game.

One of the worst games I have ever tried. Everything is so limited, locked 24 hour promotional codes for putting in one code, stuck on only green summon shards only unless paying with money for better ones, unclear events or ones that cannot be a part of, automatic farming is limited, and cannot advance because of units of weak quality. And the worst thing, everything is directed of "pay this" to just have anything decent. This game insults Everything to what a good game should be or feel.

Very good game. Great graphics. Great game play. Don't even mind the grind. My only complaint is the drop rates. I've opened numerous sacred and void shards and have repeatedly been disappointed. I know it rng but drop rates for legendaries seem to be a bit too low. Because of this I'm also hesitant to purchase anything with real money. packs are way to expensive.

Good, until you reach the point I'm at, where i can't progress without spending money. A week of grinding the same 6 missions all for nothing. I won't spend a dollar on a game like this. I'd rather use my money as toilet paper then give it to these greedy developers. Find a different game unless your willing to spend lots of money. Edit: just needed to fix a few typos.

Overall gameplay feels good, however the cost of packs/bundles in game, and what I imagine the company believes to be a fair price for progression, is in fact quite hard to swallow. Stamina is a huge gate for those that don't want to/can't afford to pay, this should be doubled, at minimum, more stamina, means more play time, should mean player retention. Epic and legendary skill books, as well as 4 and 5 star chickens for upgrading seem far to hard to acquire.

This is a fun game at first. Seems like there are good rewards when you're new. The more you play the more greedy the game gets. There's not much chance to get new champs, lack of shards. When you do get new champs you'll most often be disappointed with duplicates. The game is set up like a lot of others, spend more money to win or even be slightly satisfied. Usually the items you buy will leave you disappointed also. I played for about 2 years just hoping it would get better. I'm done

Pay to Win, pay to play and pay for everything. You want to continue playing? Pay 50 euro a week. It's a never ending grind and you may either spend a year of your life or thousands of euro to reach the goal of having collected more than the others. "Games" like these should be 18+ as it tricks minors into spending way too much money than a mobile game is worth. Edit: It's not about getting everything for free. It's about how much you have to spend to not run into arbitrary limitations (energy)

The amount of product pushing they put on you is unlike anything over ever seen. every single time you log in, or finish a fight and go to town... it's an add to buy an insanely expensive item. this game is a cash grab plain and simple. there isn't much real content, the creators of this game should be ashamed. but I'm sure they are not. scum usually isn't ashamed, do not play this game. it's not worth it

Everything you hear about this game is true. It's just a massive cash grab. They shove 5 ads to buy their meny forms of currency in you face every time you log in without fail. The odds of getting a decent champion in this game are .5% with most shards. Forcing you to waist hundreds of dollars in hopes of summoning something decent, .5%???????? Honestly That's insane. Fortunately they didn't get me and I have never spent a dime on the game.

Not recommended. I enjoy the game, but they are too focused on monetisation with true progression locked behind large pay walls. For example, based on current prices and without a 2x event, you are looking at spending around $500 USD for a guarenteed legendary hero (0.5% chance) or playing exhaustively for months on end to save up the 200 shards. Also, instead of a "Hey we have new deals !!" prompt on login, you are force fed 4-5 different prompts of sales before you can even play the game.

The referral program doesn't work, the person I invited NEVER HAD THE GAME BEFORE and reached the top reward level and neither of us received any of the rewards and if you write support about it, they tell you that there's nothing they can do because it's automated. The prices are way too high for in game items, the pop up packs are outright scams, you can find a better price in the shop. The events are designed to where you have to pay exorbitant amounts of money to complete them! 3712972

6/25/2019 The probability of getting a crappy champion and repetitive champion is beyond acceptable. Higher level dungeons should no longer give items that you can obtain from lower levels. But overall the game provides little by little to its players, and devs listen to the community, little by little. Hope in the future it would be fixed and mechanics improved. This game is brilliant, so we keep playing. Atleast even until now. Edit: 6/25/2020. One year after my review, it only got worse.

I've had the game for less than a day so I can't score based on gameplay experience (although, what I have played was fun) but I gotta say that the pop-up deal-ads are nuts. I just had 7 login ads and 6 were for micro transactions, although I think the average was $30 so "micro" isn't appropriate I guess. I understand you guys have some truly epic promos to pay for but an option to turn off the cash solicitation for those that don't partake or for our kids accounts would be appreciated.

I read the reviews, I get an idea of the kind of game this is and I've played it as well. It has potential but I agree with a lot of the reviews. You shouldn't have to pay to remove or equip a better item that you own. And the spamming of loot and promotions thrown in your face when you log in. I've read the responses from the dev's and I understand that these are temporary deals but your not listening to your customers when they say they dont like that. Do you like getting junk mail? Same thing

Been playing over a year...spent way more on the game than I should have. Continue to play in the hopes of quality new content, but it seems clear all of the millions in monthly revenue that Plarium makes is just going into marketing instead of content creation. I'm holding out hope, as are thousands of other end-game high spending players, that eventually things will get better. But as of right now, it's not looking great.

The game is good. Their support is lacking. I've had an open ticket with them for four days now. I e recieved 1 reply a day. It seems they only respond once every 24 hours. I lost my game profile when trying to link my account to Plarium. They list it as a simple fix yet we are going into day 5. On a game where daily progress is important this is really disappointing. Over 10 days now and still not resolved.

It's actually a really fun game, The huge marketing push threw me off for a few so I didn't start playing until recently but I'm pleasantly surprised by how good the story is. I just wish that it didn't give such a crazy advantage to those who pay more while having such high prices for everything. I know obviously there's gotta be good rewards for those who pay so I can deal with the first part but I'm broke as hell, so the prices, come on, throw us broke players a bone here. 😜

The graphics are amazing, the best I've seen for mobile and it has a lot of varied factions each with a lot of characters to pick. Unfortunately the game is a p2w nightmare, if you try to f2p this game you will be on a constant treadmill hell never being able to catch a wiff of whales let alone catch up to them. Summon odds are also quite unfair from my experience, probably in an attempt to get you to spend. A real shame considering how cool the characters are.

This is a great game in a lot of ways; it's got great graphics, it's fun gameplay and it's a great time killer and collection RPG. However, anybody prone to spending money on phone games BEWARE! The developers of this game are the greediest I've encountered. The in-game offers are never ending, and they pop up after everything you do. Summoning shards are very scarce and have low drop rates, so offers seem more appealing to buy so you can get better units. It's a slow grind for F2P players.

You guys really need to fix a bunch of things in this game. 1. Paying silver to swap out gear is honestly ridiculous & shouldn't even be a thing 2. Paying for stuff should feel rewarding, I've bought 2 gear packs for $50 each, and it honestly didn't feel like it helped at all get further. If I'm buying something, especially if it's $50, I want to feel rewarded, and it's going to help a lot. 3. The summon rates and mercy system are HORRIBLE

Ok, so this is my second review I've left for this game. I am currently lvl 70 in the game so I think it's time to update my view on the game. The game from day one has struggled with dupe system, silver, and epic and legendary books, they have yet to fix this issue and it's been over 2 years. They do not listen to the community and feels like they only care about the bottom line. They do not attempt to keep long term players. The game is fun early but pays walls become a thing mid game. Beware

This game is completely unbalanced and tilted toward pay to play. I am constantly put up against high level and Legendary level players, which must be bought. Thus I am continually slaughtered in the Arena (PvP); which conveniently, you must play daily in order to have the one in a million chance of landing a more powerful player without buying it. Just like every other mobile game I've played that skews the game in order to push you to spend money!

It's your typical mobile game. Tons of artificial grind to try and force you to pay money. Horrible pvp with zero balance for the same reason. Tons of price gouging. With some crashing whenever I open the Events tab. If you're looking for a game to kill time. It's enjoyable enough. But don't expect anything you haven't already experienced with other mobile games. One spot I will give credit to it though, is the champion art is really stunning.

I've spent money on the game and don't regret it, even though I should. Those who don't wanna spend money to level up will spend a lot of time instead. It is what it is. What I don't like is the incessant popups to buy packs. Those who wanna spend will go to the store, those who don't will x out. Developers: knock it off with the popups. It turns people off. Just let people play.

Okay look... I understand you want to promote your "Deals" but having them relentlessly bombarding me as soon as I log in is old. It so old at this point it should have already died. Second of all what good is the colored gems if they can't even reward you with the color champion of their color. I'm tired of cashing in these little nuggets of disappointment. I used to really like this game but I can't find a reason to bother with it anymore. Uninstalled and I'm out. PEACE!

Game would be great if it didn't limit my play time and character progression through its energy mechanic. Energy is required to play levels. It SLOWLY regenerates (and you might get lucky and find a potion or gems to use?), which means that after a few minutes of playing you have to wait until it fills to continue. I feel like this is a common pitfall of games using this. How is it beneficial to lose players who get tired of having to wait to play, while knowing that the game wants you to ptp?

Really enjoying the game. I'm a month in or so. I'm using the 'monthly' challenge as my marker. The challenge is not timed in any way so you are guaranteed the sacred shard if you play, unlike many other games. I read a lot of reviews today that suggest it's heavy p2w. That does seem to be my experience. I defeated a team of level maxed legendaries with a better geared all rare team. So there is plenty of strategy to keep me in this one for the foreseeable future. 30+days $0.

Tried to get back into the game, but the sheer amount of impulse buy shenanigans has stopped me from playing anymore. If you want to be on top in moat events you have e to be constantly on and tends to be a who paid the most money in terms of both units and equipment. I've even bought the fifteen dollar beginners pack to see how it would go. A ancient and epic stone, five blue stones.......only received one four star and getting the later tier stones requires a full month of being on constantly.

I been playing this game for about a few weeks now, good game, i even got a starter pack to rank up a lil faster. It's good for my down time at work. At signing in you get alot of popups for coins, jams etc. Back to back which is annoying but then after that no more pop ups. I got a game update yesterday........I'm still waiting, it wont update so now I'm stuck with no downtime game, I'll give it till this evening and if not I'll just delete n look for another game. I feel cheated out of $9.99.

As far as free games go, this one is pretty decent. There is a pay wall but if you can be patient, and don't mind a grind, then you can easily play this game for hours each day without having to spend a cent. Top notch game, one of my favourites, good graphics, gameplay and rewarding progression. If you like turn-based fantasy games this one is made for you! p.s. works great on PC with BlueStacks!

Last patch keeps crashing game. Plarium is now owned by a company that basically makes slot machines. Reached level 36 without paying for anything and it's a non-stop, rewardless grind. Get hit up with 4-6 "promo" offers almost every time I launch the game. Drop rates from shards are absolutely atrocious. I have to pay to remove equipped items from my heroes? They say it's a balanced game, but all that means is that it's worse than P2W. You'll end up spending thousands just to reach P2W levels.

Replayed the game after a long time away. I was immediately spammed with multiple in app purchases I had to click out of. They still offer no real way to advance in this game without paying a steep price and that's disappointing. Still wouldn't recommend this game to anyone. There are many similar games that are more open to players and aren't trying to force you into paying as much as this game is.

For all the hype, I expected more than another entrant into the Summoners War space. Many of the base game mechanics are the same: Five-star summon system, elemental strength / weakness, runes/artifacts, campaign, dungeons. I do like a few of the improvements they've made, though. Hero upgrades don't require max-level fodder, ascension can be done in stages, and the scroll system / minotaur rewards (forget what it's called, adds permanent stat increases) are a few that I recall. It's unfortunately offset by the fact that every time I log in, I'm presented with no less than FIVE TO SEVEN spam ads for packages, which I must clear to play. It also shares SW's main downfall: To play this game, even in moderate capacity, takes HOURS of your time each day, even if you're just running dungeons; it's a constant distraction from whatever else you're doing. Also as with SW, while there are PVE components, the real endgame is PVP... so if that's not your cup of tea, might want to try elsewhere.

O.K., not a bad game, but it has some glaring flaws. The first, with it being a free to play game, I don't mind the ads, buy this, etc. that games show you. The problem with this game is it gives you about five before you can even play the game. The worst, is it is a huge ponzi scheme. On average, you collect 2-star heroes. To make one 6-star hero would require you to level up 2,520 2-star heroes. This doesn't mention that it takes a long time to level these.

Graphics and story line are pretty rad. The game mechanics are almost identical to the game "summoners war". So if you liked that game you will like this game too. Only complaint is that the micro transactions requests pop up a little too much. I understand the need to show time limited deals, however at times it seems a bit excessive. Otherwise it's an amazing game and I see myself playing it for a while.

Easy to see how this game is designed by a gambling company. The game is constantly shoving different in game purchases down your throat. You'll quickly run into a content wall when you realize that your characters are simply not good enough to progress. To continue playing the game you'll need to endlessly grind for "shards" which HOPEFULLY get you better characters. That's only if you havent been annoyed or enticed enough by the grind to spend money on the game already.

Update from previous review: I trudged through and enjoyed the beginnings of this game, it had promise. At this point there is literally nothing to do in game. The updates have been pointless. The in game pop-ups for incredibly overpriced "deals" are never ending. The developers have made it clear that they only care about bringing in new wallets, not about the game itself. And until I see some drastic changes (which I don't think will happen) I plan on staying away. You should too.

Bombarded with pop-ups of them begging us to buy their "package" nearly every single time we click on a menu... they don't even give you time to determine if you like the game before throwing "$14.99" in your face several times. now, I did play it for a few days, and it's pretty much Star wars Galaxy of heroes, but with extremely annoying and frequent pop-ups. ... the only thing good about this game, are the commercials it inspired.

It's okay. I've played on and off for years but progression is so slow and grindy I feel like it's a part time job just playing the game and doing all the events. a game I wish I could play consistently but get burnt out on way too quickly due to repetition and very slow progression. Acquiring characters though is the worst part of the game. the endless grind for shards just to be disappointed when half the legendary (and most of the epics) characters are useless in most game modes.

This game's pretty fun. There's lots of champions to collect and plenty of game modes to play. But my lord do they want you to spend money. Every time you open the app the game thrust several bundles, daily deals, and limited time offers. If you understand that the game is 'pay-to-win' you'll have a great time. I would rate 5 stars if yall stopped pushing paid options on the players.

The gameplay is suitable for a child, the graphics shown in the advertisements is nowhere in the game, the characters look like animations from a children's cartoon, the actual controls and interactions in the game are minimal. The sole reason I rated the game as highly as I did is the fact that I can actually play the game for an hour or what have you without being suffocated by ads for Fishdom or Gardenscape🤮

I don't understand how people enjoy this "game". It's basically an afk fighter, but requires more grinding and has you jump through more hoops for the same type of thrill. How much the rarety affects stats and actual usability of heroes slants the battleground heavily in the favor of whales. The games pay to win, simple as that. Sure you get free stuff, but I've been playing for over a week and only have 1 epic. After account lvl 30, it gets really grindy and dull.

Well I would say it's a good game if you are looking for something to play, though the sense of accomplishment in this game is pretty lacking, especially when you reach the end game part. Not to mention the reward for event is pretty much not worth the time and effort to attend them. And even from the advertisement saying there are many unqiue hero, if you have the correct hero for the specific dungeon, you are pretty much stuck there. Heavily luck dependent game, and of course pay 2 win game.

Update: since they responded I shall respond in turn. Played for roughly 6 months, and I was stupid enough to spend money on these greedy grubbers. Plarium is nothing but a greed monster. They just want your money. Very hard to get further in the game without purchasing packs, and you could (if you're an idiot) easily spend hundreds to thousands (as some players do!) On in game purchases just for the small chance of getting something decent.

I've played this game for quite a while now. I recommend it. It gets frustrating after a while due to the constant grind that seems to get you nowhere. Spending money helps with this. Another thing that i notice happening is in the arena. My best group of 4 has 172k power. Often I'll go against a team with around 40k to 50k power and get completely destroyed. Must be something im missing in the game or players are hacking there accounts. Surely they are not. Happens way to often though.

Don't waste your time. Game developers are targeting whales. No decent rewards for even the above average gamers ($150 invested over the course of 60 plus days). This is a pay to progress game, I get it. But if you want to sustain a customer base of enthusiast gamers (think folks like me playing and spending cash for three, four, or even many more years), you should really should reconsider your Champion drop algorithms. One "bone" and I would of been good for a couple more months.

Hot garbage. From a glance, this game looks shallow and lacking. When you play it, it's that and filled with greed. You are constantly bombarded with ads offering packages for cash, everything (including equipping and unequipping items) costs in game money. They make the claim that you have many characters to choose from but they are all just re-skins on top of re-skins. It's quite clear that the bare minimum was done to qualify as a game but really it's just a money grab.

Pay 2 win, with constant expensive offers to buy different "packs" that are "limited time only" but the same offers comes the next day if you didn't buy it. You can buy anything for money in this game and the drop rates from grinding are horrible, the drop rates in their "hero summons" are low, trying to force you into buying until you get what you want. Do yourself a favor and skip this one. It's not worth it. The Dev answered to this review is a lie, you can not play this game for free, p2w..

It's a fun game with a great art style and I particularly like how you can build up even common units with the mastery system, but I just got burnt out having to see ad after ad for whatever they want you to think is a deal. Having seen videos on how psychologically manipulative these kinds of systems are recently, I think I might be done with this gacha inspired genre and its many different flavors. If you feel you have the self discipline to not go overboard or have money to burn, have fun.

Not going to lie; I had suspisions that this game would be overrated and or just not what was advertised as seen on the various ads on youtube or my facebook feed. The game can be strat based or a mind dull, if you want it to. The story also seems a bit dry, however I view this game close to just a champion collector and it is what it is. But as a collector in a game I enjoy that aspect personally. All I can say is for what it is as a free game, its worth an hour of gameplay to get into.

The amount of grinding needed to get even close to mediocre is absolutely insane. The RNG is absolutely rediculous if you wish to get a good character. There are so many characters that you don't know what to level up unless you do a ton of research. Prepare to pay an absolute kings ransom if you wish to progress in any substantial way as the price for characters is ludicrous. It is a surprisingly fun play however as soon as you get out of the tutorial phase you are hit by a massive grind wall.

New players beware. PLARIUM (devs) are the greediest bunch I have ever seen. This game is designed for people with gambling addictions and the folks behind the scene are smart and they get you hooked on spending. This is how your experience will go: you start game tons of free stuff, everything is exciting and hard and you slowly progress, so you realize that to progress anywhere you will need to spend. $10 here 20 there... next thing you know you spent hundreds of dollars on and no real rewards

Gave it a few hours to give it a chance and I feel like I wasted my time. The game adamantly forces you to look at offers to make a purchase. At first it was ok, but it gets old fast. I'm going in 5 hours with the same lame 5 characters in the beginning with no explanation on how to summon "good" units without taking out the wallet or having to outsource to get informed. The units you do get to summon in the first 5 hours that it took from me were generic from a poor selection of a limited pool.

Same story, different review. Seems like a great game at first especially if you have some luck, then it just becomes awful. This game will only be worth your time if Plarium decides to focus on the games content and experience rather than its marketing playing off people's gambling addictions. The game is basically a casino with nice art work. Palarium, let us know when the game has made changes(Increse legendary and epic shards/books, have events that are possible for a free to play crowd etc)

Probably the greediest "game" I've ever played. None of the content is meaningful, just like the story line. Characters look cool, and that is literally the only redeeming factor. Every time you go to the home screen, you get BOMBARDED with ads begging you to spend money. There is nothing of any value that can be earned through playing. If you DO decide to spend money, the packages are STUPIDLY overpriced, and summoning rates are the worst over ever seen in any gacha game. Avoid this app.

No wonder they have such a "high rating" on the app store. They deleted my review. Great job Palerium. I said it before, I'll say it again. This game has a low return rate on "rewards" you play for hours, grind for longer, doing missions over 1000 times with no exaggeration only to try and say "the experience is worth the time. Not pulling rare units" cause when you try, you will never get anything you actually want. Was fun for a time but I'm happier now that I finally uninstalled it.

Shards have the worst odds, buying packs is a waste of money, the events only favor the people who spend hundreds on the game, mythical shards are a scam your free champions do little to no damage in later stages of the game, the game doesn't hesitate to let you know there's packs available for purchase. Legendary and mythical have less than a 6% chance of you pulling them and costs upwards of $40 just for a couple shards. There's no other viable way of getting them for free.

Great graphics (finally not Manga) and animations. Highly addictive and fun. On the downside, very limited to FTP players, and if you really want to get involved, 1000 USD is gone in a sec. Gatcha game if there is any, heavy PTW, but still fun. With some minor changes could be great. Plarium, please listen to the community.

Cometely bombarded by 59.99, 99.99, 1.99, etc "deals". This is game is flat out advertising their free to play yet attack you with "deals". If I'm gonna spend 99 dollars on something it's going to be an actual game not a pack to do 10 single summons. Their going in the right direction. This game is so out of touch and flat out greed has taken over them completely. I saw more ads then gameplay. O and there is no way turn off money deal notifications, nice try trying to look good money grubbers

Hate the constant overboard on ads. Yes the sure will let everyone and their mommas know the deals they have. Seriously not everyone is a whale. Please just add a "tone the ad harassement down a bit," or just put it on the loading screen. This game really takes a long time even if you spend spend a lot. Even the gurantee champions cost a lot of in-game currency/shards. Overall you can enjoy the game if you ignore the insantity of ads. They are not going to fix it by the way folks. Just saying.

Good game with a few bugs, so far both times I completed challenges to get 3x epic skill tomes I didnt receive the reward, they seem to be dodging the questions on the forums too. I'd be happy with even a "We're looking into it" but radio silence seems to be their strategy. Getting bombarded with ads for gem packs everytime I open the game is a bit annoying too. Takes about 15 to 30 seconds to close them on a bad day.

This game is literally designed to do one thing and one thing only - take your money. Literally EVERYTHING requires credits, almost everything you do uses "energy," which once depleted, you have to either wait for it to recharge or PAY to get more. Not to mention you CONSTANTLY get bombarded with pop ups encouraging you to buy stuff. The gameplay is as basic as it could possibly be. In fact, the game can literally play itself for you. It's just not fun. Waste of time and money.

I have been playing almost 2 months now and I cant take the pop-ups every single time I open the game, its predatory to purchase something and wont stop. Its constantly annoying you and Im certain I am far from the only person who is disappointed to put it nicely. Now the game overall is good not great but good and gives enough with Amazon Prime so that you arent spending "Years" getting what you could get in minutes with $250.

The game was fun when I wasn't being bombarded with ads and micro transaction offers, I liked playing the game but I couldn't continue to play it, because everytime you open it theres approximately 6-10 "special offers" that you have to close out before you can do anything else. My recommendation stop throwing all that in the players faces, just keep the notification over the store icon and don't force the players to look at it.

So, this WAS a 3 star review, until Plarium tried whitewashing this review by adding some B.S. explanation about how a pop-up that comes up over 20 times in the 1st 5 minutes of gameplay EVERY time I log in is just "keeping players informed" about their special offers... PFFFT! However, I DO love playing the game. Also, ever since the 1st of the year, the game now freezes while loading battles quite a lot, forcing you to close the app and resopen it...

The game is good but there is a complete and utter lack of updates that will help the players. From an inside perspective it seems that Plarium (the people in charge of Raid) spends most of their budgets on marketing and advertisment and zero on actual content. There is no reason why you should consider playing this game right now. Wait for meaningful updates first.

Tried this game again. It's an identity thiefs dream. Not sure what it costs per day to be competitive, but it definitely isn't cheap. After a few months progress is down to a crawl. Plenty of ads to spend $4.99 here, and $49.99 there to immediately progress. If you aren't stealing credit card numbers or don't have a massive disposable income don't waist your time on this game.

I was directed here from another app. 'Get free gold in ours, if you finish the tutorial In raid..." cheap trick!! There is nothing that states where the tutorial is, it only pops up as you find new items, and I'm sure it won't be finished until I have unlocked ALL the areas...some at level 50. Now that would be fine, except it says I have 21 days to finish the tutorial. Sooo....as hard as this is to play for free...guess what chance I have of getting those rewards??

I have been playing for close to a couple years. While I enjoy the game play and graphics... I have major issues with the lack of Legendary champions I have received. Falling for the in-game shard pack deals, I have paid for shards many times, and even during the "optimal summoning events" I have pulled none in the last 6 months. Clan members that have played longer seem to have a better % rate. That being said, I'm playing this game for what it is and will not spend another dollar on it.

Make sure you look at the character reviews and see which artifact sets are recommended when you first start, cause it can cost you a pretty penny to remove and replace them later. Ads aren't too in your face although I do think the packages are a bit pricey. Save gems and get the gem mine if you think you'll keep playing for awhile. The character art is awesome but can get a little repetitive in some factions. Using common cards to level up is like using pennies to buy a Cadillac.

The best way to get off an addiction is to not start it. Plarium uses psychological tricks to get you hooked. I just tried to buy a 99.99 pack for 3 sacred shards because it was "hot", and there's an event going on, with limited time, to get a new champion. The event can not be completed by FTP accounts. Don't install this game. Free to play progression is horrible. P.S. it took plarium screwing up 2 of my purchases (didn't get the items right away) to snap me out of it.

Fun game! Just be aware of how you spend money in the game. I played for a few years, but took a break. I just went back to play and as it turns out, it is their policy to delete accounts without notice if you take a break of longer than 3 years. I contacted them showing them my Google Play purchases and they said it was their policy not to restore purchases. I spent over $50 on in-game purchases. For them to delete my account without even an email to warn me, it just feels like stealing.

The game was pretty and once I was playing I had fun, but I hated opening the game because of all the ads. Let me be clear to the developers. Telling me about deals on in game items, champions, and currency is an advertisement. And having ten of them as soon as I open the game makes me not want to play. If I wanted to give you money, I would find out how.

Easy to navigate, awesome gameplay and addicting. So much to do in the game to keep you engaged. However there is little quality of life in the game. Once you get past the intro into mid game you hot a money wall. Everything you need to improve is based on spending. The latest event they have for a guaranteed legendary champions will cost a minimum $300 to get buy pulling 150 shards. This game is overly focused on how much it can squeeze out rather than player retention.

Impossible to even play on my note 8, the game just refuses to download the new update. Game-wise there's nothing new to see or experience it's another gacha p2w fiasco. Everything requires money to do (even changing equipment on heroes) and the summoning rates seem pretty awful. Overall pretty package with generic everything else. Maybe use your brains for some fun events or something instead of creating 1000 different bundles you can buy.

Initially the game is fun, and has great graphics, but after a time it becomes very grindy. You basically start farming resources, to upgrade, to be able to farm quicker. Then the game just stops being fun. The prices are fairly steep, and the longer you play the more you see diminishing returns on your money. A lack of new content, and lack of care for the playerbase by the company eventually caused me to quit.

This can be entertaining except if you don't pay outrageous prices for bundles, you can't advance. I've put at least a couple hundred dollars into bundles try to advance further and it is very marginal. I would have been better off buying a full video game system that is mine to keep for alot less money for one game. Go play Call of Duty mobile instead. It's totally free. These people must really think highly of themselves or something. Insane prices. Not good.

I downloaded and installed the game because it seemed interesting and that I could also get the Alice character for free. Well, nobody told me about using the promo code to get her, and by the time I found out about it, it was too late. I'm rather heartbroken and frustrated of losing the opportunity just cause I didn't know, so now there's really no point except to uninstall. I am ok thought since I waited to spend any money til I found out about getting her. Don't make the same mistakes I did.

Fun at first with a sense of progression- then you hit the pay wall and things slow to a crawl unless you open up your bank account. I put the game down for a month after the numerous 'deals' the game bombards you with got too annoying. When I returned I found that my account had been deleted, which pissed me off since I'd spent about $50 on that account. Tried to start over, but it's just not worth it. This game is super predatory. If you have deep pockets, give it a whirl.

There isn't a game in existence that wants you to whale as badly as this game does. Seriously, every time you close a menu, you get a pop-up asking you to spend $5, $10, $20 or more. Half the time they're the same exact pop-up you closed when you exited the last menu. It makes me wonder how much money has been spent, and by how many players, to keep this game from dying.

My review got deleted within 2 days after developer replied. In summary, game has 2* ratings on controls, graphics, and gameplay, yet a 4.1 overall. That's weird to me. You will be shown about 40 ads within an hour of gameplay. Saying it's to ensure new members dont miss limited time sales is ridiculous. You can have a tab with all offers in in that glows red or something so people check it out. Be wary of any game that undergoes an extensive advertising campaign while still claiming to be free.

This is my updated review after few months: I wish there was a 0 star. If you are looking for a peaceful game to enjoy and have a good time, NEVER EVER try this game. The game is fun when it's working properly, but that is about 20% of the time. Constant frustration, server issues, poor management, countless bugs, in game crashes, and now massive banned accounts because of "technical issues". I don't mind the amount you have to pay (which is a lot), again it's a fun game when it is working.

I've noticed a lot of replies from the developers saying purchases are up to the player to make, but the game has such an blatantly slow progression that they kinda force your hand to make a purchase. This, " well it's the players choice to make a purchase," falls flat, when it takes hours of grinding to get 1 character, and even then that character may be utterly terrible. so is it really our choice if the game itself takes forever to get anywhere without these purchases?

The game is beautiful and made with love. But this is hands down the most expensive pay-to-win game that I have ever seen, and nearly every mechanism in the game is designed to dissolve your resources. I understand that this game was probably very expensive to develop, but jeez, this is daylight robbery. I'll pass on the pay-to-win aspect, and see how far, or long I can enjoy this game for. In-game popups trying to get your money is like spam. I just got 7 or 8 consecutive popups.

I've completed all missions and it's not rewarding at the end. You get one of the best characters but at that point you can already beat the hardest levels. For the price of transactions they dont release many updates or any new features of any kind. Remonitize old content, add heroes which makes it harder to get good ones, giving characters to content creators. I bought in, but I'm not feeling the love from plarium.

If you have a child or nephew playing this game hide your Credit cards. They can amass 1000+ dollars in charges very quickly. When you turn the game on it forces all its " offers " on you. It is 100% a p2w game, I also have an account and once you hit a certain point you get stuck. You have to spend months to get anywhere. Out of all the legendary Crystal's I got from the game free, not one of them gave me a legendary character. Just the rare, and you can get those with the green Crystal's.

The champs are very well designed and the game runs very smoothly on a phone. However i found it very time consuming to level up (ascend) the champions. The only alternative is paying for it. And if gaming is not your day job and this game isn't bringing you bread then i can't recommend investing real money in this. Try it out for a week and tell me if the gameplay isn't designed solely to get players to spend money in-game. Sorry devs, you did a good job but the numbers guy ruined it.

The basic loop of the game is enjoyable, but there are bottlenecks beyond your average paywall. This is a gacha game, I know what I signed up for. I expect to be bombarded with offers. Closing multiple popups does not bother me. Bad luck on getting champions doesn't bother me. What bothers me are the fundamental problems facing low level players, such as the infamous "Silver I Arena" quest. It's a problem not due to monetizing, but poor balancing. Gameplay does not seem to be a focus, here.

They think their items are worth $30 for a starter pack. You're wrong. I won't spend the price of an entire PC game for some items. But that not why I Uninstalled. They limit how much you can play with energy. Those types of games died long ago. When you limit how much ppl can play, they just stop playing. I dnt need a parent for a dev deciding when I can and can't play. So for these reasons 1 star and an uninstall.

I would like to be able to give you a better rating for your game, but the single biggest pet hate I have is companies who spam adds to spend money even before I have had the chance to even play your game. Give players a chance to experience your game for what it is before you try and pry money out if them. *EDIT* I'm not saying "do not grow your game", I'm saying.. allow someone to play your game to see how it works before putting popups to spend 79.99AUD every time I navigate somewhere on a game I have no idea about. Why would i spend that at level 1 when i have no idea how good you game is? I got sick of the ads after equipping 2 units and doing 5 fights, so i uninstalled. If that's what you call gaming then good luck and i won't be back.

I've played for almost 3 months straight, spent around $30. Not a single legendary, not a huge deal, you don't need a legendary to progress, it would be nice to have at least one though. Now they offer a legendary for logging in for 7 days, but this legendary they give you barely meets the requirements of being a legendary. Plarium puts a lot into their advertising but the gameplay is a little bland. Also the popups to buy stuff are quite excessive. I know you need to make money but dam.

So I changed my rating on this app. So far I've been enjoying it and moving from one level to the other. Just that getting resources to upgrade champions and weapons is so difficult. And if you think of buying anything on the app, you just can't. Because everything is damn expensive. I've played other games in the past. Compared to raid, raid is just too expensive to purchase anything on. Come on you are asking someone to spend his/her full month salary on a game? Be reasonable.

You need a solid bank account, a lot of free time and some luck to be able to get strong characters. Some packages cost $99 (if you want to power up the most powerful characters and you will need 5-6 of them per character) when most are around $25-$50. So stay away from this game and go buy a game on steam, more fun for a more cheaper price. If package were around $10 this game will more enjoyable but it is far to be the case after spending more than $1,000 on it....

The cash incentive is high and the prices are ridiculous! But free to play is possible and it feels rewarding although slow. Response to devs: I'm not sure I understand your argument.. I started 3 free to play accounts at the same time as my main, with minimal purchases my main account soared past all the other accounts both in levels and in progress. Please explain how that was not both easier and faster?!?

Only good thing is graphics. The game will pop up ads to buy stuff with real money several times in a row and everytime you change screens. The 'micro' transactions are more like macro transactions. Costing more than triple A titles on console. The battles are all the same too, nothing to make it fun. There is much better mobile mmorpg games to play that are free or cheap with a lot of features.

The game is basically enjoyable with certain large problems. It's card game style combat mechanics. I think Phone Destroyer did it better. Unfortunately there's several rather large pay walls. Top end heros can only be purchased, not earned. Also, the game doesnt appear to honor affiliate links, so regardless of how good the offer looks, you aren't getting it.

It is SO STUPID that there is a chance to fail at upgrading equipment. Losing 100k just to get a piece of armor to level 12 is the dumbest thing I've ever experienced in my 30 years of gaming. Congratulations on making a potential great game into a giant POS! Response to the editors comment: Thanks for providing your justification. It's still dumb like you. Investments are only good when they turn a profit, which this game does not. I'll invest elsewhere I think.

Game fun but pop ups ruin it. When logging in, there are between 2 and 5 purchase pack 'opportunities' which delay my log in. I have played games where I spent hundreds. I will not spend a penny on this game and part of the reason is it is like a telemarketer calling 5 times in a row. I won't buy anything out of principle. Fix that and this game is pretty fun. Just let people shop for the packs like most games. Or have a notification on the 'SHOP' tab. Don't be annoying about it.

I'm Lvl 30 (5 weeks) This game is a GRINDER!!!! You grind for everything!!! Due to the ridiculously low possibilities of getting good characters, and required parts to advance, it's hands down one of thee MOST repetitive games out there, because all you'll be doing is grinding for minuscule improvements In chat, a lvl 42 player said the game can become more enjoyable after 4 months......Ummmm I'll pass and hope to find something possibly more enjoyable now, since I've already wasted 5 weeks.

Great game with tons of Champions and in-game features to keep you busy for a long time and then some. Drop rates for Legend seem wickedly low, especially due to the fact that without purchases the Void and Sacred shards are extremely difficult to obtain, same with the tomes. Overall love it and would like to see more events and slightly improved odds on rewards, summons and drops.

They use scummy tactics to get you into the game. The graphics are decent for a mobile game, it is NOT on par with PC or Console games by a long shot. I would rather spend money to play darkest dungeon on my phone than play this game for free. Sure DD has more simple graphics, but the gameplay alone is infinitely better. I played it for over a week to get the "free first week of rewards" and at no point did I feel involved. I'm amazed the game has this many good reviews

I have been playing for about 9 months now. The events nowdays require more points to complete than 6 months ago. The "offers" contain fewer goods for the same price than 4 months ago. No new content has been added to the game since the summer of 2019. Developers will say otherwise, but in my opinion adding another difficulty level to a dungeon is not new content. The game is made to take all your money and give nothing in return.

First, the raids take way too long on higher levels. with only a 2x speed up avaliablility, it really sucks to wait 45 mins to win or die in the raid. In-app purchases are too expensive for hardly any rewards. The only reason I'm giving this game 2* is because of the graphics. you really need to make an option where you can speed up the game 4times or have an optional skip. That way, you can just get to the end of raid and lower the prices on the in-app purchases

The only good thing I can say about this game, are the character models, which are detailed enough even though they are low-poly. Everything else is your run of the mill hero collector and incredibly mediocre. Nothing really makes the game interesting or better than similar clone variants, aside from the interesting character designs/factions. One thing I didn't mention, is that the grind is egregious. Building a character takes forever and you will be hitting paywalls after paywalls.

Only good thing about this game is their ads with the cgi characters but not the other ads with poeple praising this game saying that this game is "ambitious". I don't see anything new about this game. Ever since the early games there are a lot of turn based/strategy/rpg. And don't brag about the graphics. If you don't have that graphics at this point in time it's either your content is made to have a comic/retro look or there's just something wrong with your graphic designers.

I originally played this game years ago. I found the constant pop ups and asking for money very aggressive and annoying. The content was overly difficult and pay to win. I decided to try it again this year. While the game is slightly more user friendly, at it's core not much has changed. The QoL updates people have been asking for for years still haven't been implemented. The game is still pay to win. But hey there's a million new heroes that you can't pronounce. Time to move on for good.

Great graphics and fun gameplay. It is more than a bit of a grind and luck (RNG) plays a big part in the game. There are in game transactions which are way overpriced in my opinion, especially since due to the RNG factor, you may spend $60 and not really get anything worthwhile. The developers do seem to be releasing frequent updates, but despite this there are still a lot of connection and crashing issues. All in all, it is a fun game if you don't mind dealing with the constand grind and RNG.

Awesome idle game BUT it's got some serious drawbacks. After a few days, improvement is really only possible through purchases, and the literal 20 pop-ups each bootup will let you know how. And, it struggles with the same problems all idle games do: the community. You'd think a game where the progress is tied to being better than other players would welcome new players as fresh meat, but that's just not a part of the culture of idle game communities. Excellent graphics though and a fun concept.

This game is a virus on social media, if only the money spent on advertising the game was funneled into developing the actual game so that it actually played as advertised would have been better. Add the too frequent pop ups or overpriced "limited time deals" for you to accidentally or unintentionally click on just to watch the sprites on auto play is infuriating. Just be aware that if you haven't played games like this before... don't expect anything from the many ads presented.

For all the money they spend on advertising you figure the game would be better. They throw pop-ups at you after pretty much everything you do. Everything costs money including changing equipment on your characters. The summon rate for decent characters is absolutely horrid(and don't say every hero is good, most are not). They give such a small amount of character slots you are forced into buying more. Im going to play a little longer to see if it gets better but I wouldn't recommend this game

The game is not bad for what it is (turn-based series of battles jrpg style). Graphics is nice, sound is good and satisfying, gatcha is relatively generous. What I abhor is an in-your-face barrage of shop advertisements every time I log in. Do away with them an I'll gladly rise a score. In most other f2p games you only have events or server maintenance reminders doing this, but not blatant shop ads.

The mechanics are smooth and there is plenty to do in the game. But you run out of energy to fast as almost everything requires a type of energy so you only play for about 4 or 5 hours a day which makes progress super slow unless you spend money. When you do spend money it's such an unreasonable amount for such a small reward. Such as spending over 50 bucks for a few shards that almost never gives you a character above rare. I'd rate higher if prices were cheaper or rewards were higher for shop.

20ish unique characters and several hundred reskins? You got it. Boring AF gameplay that can just be automated? You got it Completely average graphics? You got it. Overhype and bribing people in hope of getting players and good reviews? You sure as hell got it! I work in a paint factory. Watching paint dry for 10 hours everyday. This game makes me focus more on my work. The paint at least dries in weird and interesting ways once in a while.

Made a purchase in game that never appeared in my account. After the investigation they found no issues and, of course, never provided the purchase. The pop-ups are annoying, the check-in every few hours are annoying, when you earn things you still have to go through a number of clicks to get the stuff. Why can't it appear in your stock automatically?! I've spent about a grand on this game over few years and I'm about to delete it forever because of the dumb way it's setup. Last drop.

This game is not free to play friendly. It gives you just enough free daily energy to keep you interested for maybe an hour. There are free login rewards that were recently extended to 90 days but after that it's just a few quest rewards and barely any gems (in game currency) which can be used to buy more energy to continue gameplay. Quickly losing interest because I use up the free energy too quickly and go play other games.

It's a very good game at the start but once the extra energy they give you is used up I know you will have to wait hours in between play sessions. But at the same time I seem to be able to constantly buildup energy over the limit unlike other games where they stop you once hit the limit. The game is simple and they give you directions as you go for how to do something.

PLEASE STAY AWAY IF YOU HAVE GAMBLING PROBLEMS OR IF IT'S HARD TO RESIST IMPULSIVE BUYING. This game is pay to win and the odds of you getting rare characters is super slim without having to pay THOUSANDS of $$$ to get all the champions. This is a shady practice in some parts of the gaming industry, so if I can save 1 person from financial turmoil then my work here is completed. Don't buy into the trouble, you will waste money that could be used for thousands of different reasons.

JUST A CASH GRAB! Requested a refund only to be ignored and sent automated email replies! Plarium does not care about its player base, i spent a lot of money on things i was assuming id be able to use but its so unplayable studdering, crashing, log in issues, maintenance downtime 3 times a day. Plus they dont tell you that there are huge pay walls everywhere, and only cater to those willing to pay thousands of dollars to progress! Only free to play part is hitting the login button

Honestly. The layout, menus and gameplay and pretty good, and I've had fun playing for a while. I've played many gachas and I have to say as addictive as Raid can be, Raid is by far the most greedy gacha I've played. Compared to others it has a much higher price point on items and a lower %rate on rolling higher ranking champs. Can be really fun but once you reach end game you become stagnant unless you pay loads of money to be able to get the 5* champs necessary to participate in endgame.

Another "free" game that bombards you with opportunities to buy your way to wins. You get no less than 7-9 pop-up screens from the store EVERY time you log in! If I wanted to buy something I'd go to the store. They are nice enough to let you spend ONLY $1500 per month though. Best part of this game is the graphics. There needs to be a free to play section where only non money players compete. The people who pay to play spend more than enough to fund non paying players.

Terrible P2W mechanics, prices are unbearably high (at least in my country) - I can buy myself any AAA PC game for money this game demands from me for one of its "featured packs", grind is everywhere, many in-game features work quite poorly and game sometimes crashes. Haven't been playing mobile games for quite some time. Now I remember why. Ah, yes, graphics are nice and females are good looking, if you know what I mean.

Purely a cash grab. They spam you with ads everytime you do anything, force you to spend money to buy items necessary for upgrades, or play certain modes and hope you can get a high enough score for them to "award" you with some which you can only do if you spend a ton of money prior to playing it, makes progress insanely slow if you don't plan on giving them a bunch of your money. Terribly greedy company! DO NOT DOWNLOAD THIS GAME!!!!!!!

Changed my rating from 5 to 1 star. Game was fun at the start but thats all they want you to believe. Amazing graphics and a huge list of champions you have a CHANCE to unlock to build the perfect team! But then all the broken game mechanics (looking at you arena), malicious summon rates and predatory P2W structure started to surface. Everything is stacked against you to make you spend money for scraps. Avoid this game at all costs. DO NOT GET SUCKERED IN LIKE THE REST OF US!

If you're a player like me, I do spend money on a well designed game, which this one is. However, the random generator for characters is absolutely trash! It's fully focused on you being someone willing to gamble, which I feel like prays upon someone like myself. I'll gamble a little, at least until I know I'm being screwed. This game is flashy, fast, and easy to play, but it's also incredibly predatoy. If I hadn't spent at least 500, I'd get rid of this game right now!!!

DO NOT SPEND REAL MONEY. Read all the 1 and 2 star reviews and you'll see why. Game can be fun, but the packs are WAY too expensive, and unless you buy these constantly, it takes forever to build up any sort of decent power to progress through the missions and challenges even if you do buy the packs. Game is a full on cash grab game as the packs are extremely expensive yet yield worthless items every single time. Edit:. Even after Plariums response, the packs are expensive for what you get.

So, you'll never get a 5* review from me BUT here you go and for those thinking of installing this... Visually, the game is great. There is an entire storyline you can follow as well. However, Arena log is broke as of 3 weeks now. The req's for events to get items is incredibly high (also broken; not counting) and the amount of microtrans is terrible (popups). Drop rates are low for everything but mystery shards and dungeon cost is insane. Playing for now but eh, might change soon. No VIP also.

Good graphics and animation, way too grindy and not enough content. Needs better pacing and execution. Already bored of this game and it's only my fourth day. Early mid level dungeons and any campaign mode after normal, which you will reach fast, require much stronger characters. You can't get them unless you grind for a very long time or are lucky enough to pull them. I have 3 epic at level 40 and 1 rare at level 40. That' max level for four stars, good luck and have fun getting to 5.

Its ok, kinda. If you want to hop on something and just kill a few guys, you'll have fun. But, Twice now my notifications have said my day 3 log in bonus is ready and when I go to collect it won't let me. It feels like bait to get me back Into the game. Another is I thought you'd be able to just buy cool champions. I don't mind spending money. But 39.99 for a CHANCE of a legendary hero is retarded. The rest of the review dev responses are trying to justify a 50 dollar battle pass system . 2 star

It's a awesome game !!!but it's pay to win in the worst way , and the tech support sucks big time ....I was blocked from changing my email address of the account that I have spent thousands of dollars on and was then falsely accused of buying an account ..save your money , save your time and delete the app !!!! My money is on nobody reaching out to me on this matter 💯

Initially I had rated this game with 5 stars, but I should have waited until I had played it for a bit longer. I've readjusted my rating, because even though the game is good, I've played games that had better rewards and even better return on the money you'd spend. Unfortunately it seems the developers have missed the fact that if they gave even a little more, it might encourage players to spend more. Hope there's some improvement in the future.

Beautiful game. Low rating because of the aggressive money grabbing schemes. You open the game to get (and I don't exaggerate about this) 8 pop-ups where they try to sell you bundles. Gets to a point where I don't even am interested anymore. Game looks beautiful but it's your average free to play pay to win game where focus is on selling rather than gameplay. Not recommended.

I've played the game up to level 37 and I've played alot of games. But this game is by far the most broke when it comes to drop rates, and the jump from 3 stars to 4 and even 5. Like towards the stuff you know we need. Like its frustrating for a player to need in game whatever. But not everyone wants to drop 50 here and there for a little bit of nothing. I waited just for you guys to have double drop rates and spent 100 dollars in one night for 3 purples.. you guys say be patient but its a lie..

Just keep getting disappointed. Rpg aspects are great. Graphics are great. Character design is fun. A lot of different things to complete. BUT! Expect to spend money, at least some, to enjoy all the game offers. Expect to spend a lot if you dare compete. Better be able to drop thousands to succeed. No joke. Maybe, my rating will go up with time, but for now... 2 stars, 1 for the graphics and 1for rpg aspects. Building champions, gearing them, tweaking stats, and testing team comps.

The gane is good. But please make the prices reasonable. Getting so little for the price compared to other games. Do not take too much from players. Learn to give back to them by offering goods at a reasonable. Price is okay but the the good you are getting from it is too little. Learn the traffic of money. Check evony the kings return... You have same price as them but we tend to buy because the items they offer is good. So the flow of money to the developer is fast.

I wouldn't recommend this, this game straight lies ever step of the way and every login throws about 10 advertisements for you to pay for gems. I got 535 gems and never unlocked the mine, because it kept changing the requirements when I met them. When I got 100 it changed to 200, then 300, 500, now 1000. Everyone has the same units despite having hundreds possible, it at best a time waster with no real pay off through and through.

The game is very decent. The main problems come from the heavy rng aspects of the game. Upgrading artifacts over 10 and up takes up to much silver, silver that can be used to upgrade units and buying items in the market. Sacred shards on the other hand are hard to come by and there are only two packs that I know of that sells only one shard. If I want one I have to buy a 30 or 50$ pack just to get a 6% chance of getting a legendary unit??? yikes.

Graphics are good. But the problem is the model for this game is too pay to win.... You can only enter codes once a day. There is a ban on restarting accounts which is designed so people will always have to pay... Im guessing the mechanics are there so that players will be playing for a long time except theres little to no incentive to do so...

I understood when I got this, it was going to be pay to win. I knew that going in. What I didn't expect was to be forced to X out 9 ads for things they are trying to sell everytime I log in. Edit to reply to plarium support: Make each new ad only pop up once. You'll still get your impulse purchases, and people like me can check the store if we decide to spend a few bucks.

This game is actually very fun. However two problems. One is the prices on the store are insane...but this isnt an issue, it's actually helped me not buy anything. The main reason for my rating is toyr insistence I spend money. Not by game design, but I get 5+ pop ups every time I sign in. You shove so many "deals" in the consumers face they likely grow numb to it and tune the offers out like I do.

not bad. its addictive obviously great graphics. but once you get past the campaign you just do it on a harder difficulty. pvp is actually a team you set up when you're offline that's controlled by the game that'll defend you that's it. it's more of you attacking with a game controlled set of characters. still pve. clans aren't really that active. every time you get on they bombard you with ads to buy in-game packs, many for 99.99$

I remembered why I stopped playing after a week. Poor summon rates compared to other gacha games. Combat, animations, screen transitions, just the entire game is too slow, even on x2 speed. Do not waste your time or money on this game, it has not improved at all since it launched. Worst part is logging in and having 10+ pop ups trying to get you to spend money on the game.

The game looks ok, and some of the heros look nice; most look awful. If you want cool looking units prepare to shell out some cash, but don't worry they'll push plenty of cash grabs at you every chance they get. The gameplay is ok, it's nothing innovative. Turn based team building. If you play this game free to play you will get nowhere, and with rates this horrible if you spend a little you get nothing. You absolutely have to spend big on this game. 0/5 absolutely trash.

Ad Simulator with some afk "gameplay" This game is pretty bad. As an avid RPG, ARPG gamer, this is neither, and advertised like it is. the gameplay itself is dull and can literally be automated by an in-game option. Not to mention that you have to wade through hundreds of ads, buy this hero! Buy that item! Special offer, limited time, etc etc. I deleted this game for three key reasons: bad gameplay design, barrages of messages and push notifications asking me to pay, and bad advertising all over

My review was removed! A money hungry game. Great graphics great story. Just too many ads and prompts to buy stuff. Advertising isn't cheap. They have to make back their money somehow. Just remember if you have tons of money to spend then this game is right for you. If you don't have any money. Don't play can't progress without money at a certain point.

Biggest cash grab on the market. Every action in the game takes resources, all of which are in short supply. I'm talking right down to equipping gear: if you want to remove it, that'll cost in game coin, which runs out quickly. But you're reminded you can purchase more! Over and over and over in the form of popups, which are needlessly annoying. Leveling, ranking up, increasing skills take forever unless you want to spend $40-99 a pop. A shame bc this game is actually fun. Not F2P friendly.

This is exactly Summoner's war. The combat to the gear to how you get awakening materials. It's the same thing, just some tweeks to not look the same. I stopped playing for a couple months and came back. Their updates are just adding mechanics that are already added to S'war. How are they not getting sued for this. Not to mention there are so many ads to buy summoning packs and gear packs, Its ridiculous. This supposedly isn't p2w, but if you're not spending money it takes so much more grinding.

Since the last update, I can't log in for more than a few minutes before a message pops up saying maintenance is about to happen. For the last two days, people have been erroneously banned, purchased items (including battle passes) hav disappeared from people's accounts and the servers have been unstable. They gave us a chicken (food used to level champions) and a void shard that gives you a super low chance of getting an OK champion (I got a trash rare from the pull) as compensation for this.

It's hard to put into words how I feel about Raid. On the one hand, it has fantastic graphics and the potential (keyword) to be an incredibly rich, complex game. On the other hand, I cannot think of another company (gaming or otherwise) that treats its customer base so poorly. Raid demands either insane amounts of time or insane amounts of money to progress. While I still play Raid out of habit, I cannot in good faith recommend it to anyone as a good game - much better options exist elsewhere.

Edit: Even though you can say it's fine to choose not to buy and "go at your own pace" it doesn't make it less annoying to get so many pop ups, not even gonna talk about the prices for these packs going far beyond laughable at 60 cad dollars. And if you didn't guess, your own pace is also sluggish as the normal crystals always give 1 star heroes, with some small exceptions for 2 stars. Way too slow to progress on a f2p style.

First I'll say, yes, I've spent my actual money in this game. Pretty cool game so far. Having said that, here's my beef. Soon as you log in it's just a consist barrage of buy this, buy that ads. Insult to injury is they will do it over and over again with any slightly significant time away from bastion. I already know where to find stuff if I want to buy more. Stop destroying a decent game by shoving purchases down our throats.

Enjoyable, for First 2 months or so. Then, you're still having fun, but a few options to buy shards and gems to help you progress pop up. You don't think anything about it, buy some shards, move on. And then, the same situations just keep happening. Again. And again. And again. Please save your money. This game is fun, slightly addictive, and an absolute money pit. BUT. If you've got the money, by all means🤷🏻‍♂️😂 Just putting a PSA out there

Buyer Beware: The fact that this is the most expensive game I've ever played wouldn't be so bad if you got what you payed for... I've already lost an embarassing amount of money and have very little to show for it (even while supposedly having "double odds" for higher level champions this weekend). Too bad. It really would be a fun game if the designers weren't so f***ing greedy.

After having played the game for long enough, it lost the draw. You can only ever see the campaign once( im referring to the actual story you see when beatingthe 12 areas), and quickly becomes a grindy collect-a-thon due to the stupidly high rarity of the higher level summons from the mid tier loot boxes and the same rarity for the higher tier loot boxes. Glad to say that I will not be spending any more time or money on this.

I see this game a lot so i thought i give it a try and i was very disappointed because for a beginner they like dont give you anything good unlike other games not even a good beginner pack and all packs have things that are not worth the price and the prices are so high, i mean we are talking about a video game and this is a idle game so you are not doing much. Game has lots of characters but it takes just so much to get even one good character. Chinese games are much better than these traps.

I was a bit obessed with this game but unless you are prepared to spend *a lot* of money to get characters to level 60 you aren't going to succeed at the higher tasks. Just go in knowing that - it isn't "top grossing" for no reason. Also, despite the training bits, a huge amount of critical information is terribly explained, or not at all.

This isn't an RPG. It's a gacha game with a fantasy combat theme. RPGs have storylines built into gameplay, and the minimal storytelling here is in many ways disjoined from gameplay. RPGs also generally allow you to change your characters' gear freely, while you need to pay an obscene amount to do that here. Plarium will also suddenly change the rules of gameplay if they decide players are moving through the game too efficiently. If you don't pay money, the game is stacked against you.

I go back and forth on this game. I've been playing for years, and I have my gripes. I can take off for a few months and it doesn't feel like I'm missing anything. It's fun for a while, and then it gets boring. It is the same grind, time and time again. Once you finally get Legendaries like Martyr, get her booked, get her masteries, get her in your best gear, oh look, she's power crept. Some newly released champion starts off better. But it's very pretty! And Zargala is the QUEEN!!!

The idea that everything can be gotten for free (f2p) is more than misleading. The game utilizes several psychological principles to separate you from your hard-earned money.
