F2P players are consistently WAY behind with a minimal array of solid champions compared to those that spend. The salt in the wound is the fact that you can only play so much each day before you have to spend money to get more play time... every day. It's addictive, but not in a good way... more like drugs or alcohol.

Decided to delete this game and no longer play or support it. While I truly do enjoy the game and the grind, the recent updates to player rewards and clan activities/structures are atrocious. It's clear plarium isn't actually interested in listening to player feedback and improving the game. Their real goal seems to be making the game increasingly harder to play without spending money. I would advise anyone looking for a new game to find one that actually respects it's player base.

Do you like closing pop ups? If so, this is the game for you. Each time you log in you will get to spend time closing pop ups for WAY overpriced in game purchases. The game could be entertaining but then you get to close ads. In response to the developer comment. Each time I log in I have to close 10 pop up. That is 10 times i have to close the pop up before I can play. Advertising in game purchases from $4.99 to $99.99.

Let's start with the good: Awesome graphics and loads of content. Now for the bad: The game is geared for spenders and if your not this will make progression difficult, especially in the arena where you have to fight the spenders. My advice is get on YouTube watch Hellhades and Deadwood Jedi before progressing to far into the game. They were very helpful for me because the good resources to advance in the game are difficult to get unless you spend. This is why I only gave it a 1 star.

It was fun for a month but it is developing into a cash grab really fast. The "Summoning Events" are only to bait in pay to play players wallets and to buy insane amounts of items to try to complete the limited time events. If you attempt to complete a summoning event using free to play it is impossible, even if you saved up for it for weeks. Gonna put this one in the same category as Summoners War, fun at first but only to get you invested enough to use your wallet, which of course I fell for.

honestly, not very unique of a game. It is part of the current fad of games where there are a billion menu items, red dots everywhere on the home screen to click, five or more popups when you login and that is just the user interface. the UI is the most confusing and frustrating part of this game. The game itself is extremely repetitive. Every game is the same. You pick a few characters to run up a stage to defeat three ways of enemies. After a while, you feel like a repetitive robot.

Haven't played much of this game yet, but what I have played so far has been disappointing. Looks to be another cash grab from some app developers. Plus I'm playing on a Galaxy Note 10 Plus (one of the newest phones on the market) and still have terrible lag and slow loading, while playing on wifi mind you. But I can already see how after a few level grinds it will take months to advance or pay money. Will update after more gameplay.

They may call a game like this a 'gacha', but I usually refer to this particular one as a 'gatchya!' meaning 'Hah! I got your money and am giving you rubbish in return!' This game is definitely pay to win. Yes, you can beat this game without spending a dime, many have (and should - after being banned for spending $500 on this game.... I don't recommend giving them anything) but to get the 'best' Champions, you'll have to find a way to get the better shards. Good luck to you if you want to find a way to get shards that are better than 'ok'. And even if you *do* get good shards to summon your champions, good luck to you in summoning something good. The RNG in this game is terrible for a lot of people, and even with 'good' shards, the odds are not in your favor. Moving on, to the storyline. Having completed it (more than once) I have to sit back with a cigarette to process it. Not because that it had a particularly emotional impact, but because I was trying to figure out what the hell was actually going on - then I discovered there wasn't really a storyline. At least not one that I cared about. Which brings me to caring about this game. The characters in this game inspire zero emotional rapport with me. Voice acting is something that would help. Oh, this game DOES have voice acting, but nothing to write home about. Trust me. The characters have zero personality, even the four mains. You know nothing about them, and it's absolutely no surprise that there aren't many guides about this game. Also, this game isn't very generous in terms of premium features. It's not easy to acquire gems, and they expect you to spend an arm and a leg acquiring them in order to open a Gem Mine that gives you 125 gems a month. Max. Trust me when I say that isn't a lot. At all. Having found a vastly-superior game, Epic 7, I only play this game out of extreme boredom. If you want a generous gacha game that has superior voice acting, memorable characters, and beautiful cutscenes with personality, try Epic 7, not this game.

Was alright at first. Unfortunately this game strongly leans on the pay to play perspective. Each time you log in you are bombarded by different "deals" that you can neither skip nor opt our of seeing (to the best of my knowledge exploring the different features). Not free to play friendly and after the first week you will be hit hard by a progression wall.

At first the game was good and fun, but after 25 mins it got boring. Not to mention the paywall it gets locked behind after the first few missions. The combat gets boring very fast and it gets even more boring if you use a mode that literally fights for you, imagine spending money on items in this game and then you just dont play it. Overall 1 star

I have already left a review and it seems as though it was deleted... The game can be fun and entertaining, however, the prices for a lot of their transactional offers is obscenely expensive, especially in regards to the ridiculously low summon ratings. They also inundate your screen with multiple offers that sometimes can reach up to 5 or 6 offers, one right after the other. If they reduced the cost for their offers, gave more in the transactions, or increased summon rates I would rate higher.

Graphics and gameplay are great but the rng is setup to force you to buy the ridiculously expensive bundles. I know it doesn't matter how many times people say this, they'll never change it bc everyone else is doing it and people keep buying the bundles. At this point you should just expect any mobile game you play to be pay to win. Reply to Plarium Global Ltd: I will continue to play the game and revise my review at a later date based on my experience.

Game won't stop asking me to review it no matter how many times I click a low rating, so here, have a 1 star rating. Also cause you can't even log into the game without having several pack offers popping out, regardless if you just saw the same ones 2 minutes ago and reopened the game just now. Even if for some reason I was interested in buying any, they are overpriced. The game itself is ok, too much information missing and you are just guessing that what you're doing is ok until it's too late

This is the highest grossing game out there, it's also the worst game of it's kind out there. The rng does not seem truly random, and as a developer of gambling machines they know this. The ads are predatory. I'm on day three again, because my account was hacked and I have a new one. I already am not progressing. I can't get more characters without USD. There is a form of currency for every event, shop, and gotcha in game, making doing anything extremely slow. Pick any other similar game please.

I honestly love the game but hate it more. Off course this won't be one of the ratings that pops up when people check out the game but in the small small chance that it is, don't fall into the money trap. This game will draw you in with its excellent gameplay but will cost you a small fortune if you want to progress beyond mid game. I can't make the review long enough to warn people of it because of limitations, but please don't fall into the trap. It is very dissapointing after 6 solid months!

This is the most pay to play game I've come across yet. Combat is sub par in comparison to other games I've played, though the visuals are better than others. I wouldn't suggest playing Raid unless you have boat loads of disposable income. I spent over $200 just to find that it was a drop in the bucket when compared to others near my lvl, after playing for an hour.

Short version: this game has immense potential but it's lust for cash squanders that potential.🙁 Cons: ⚫pay-to-win ⚫freemium content such as: the energy point system which limits playing time (unless you buy more energy points) ⚫Upon game start, you are bombarded with pop-ups promoting freemium. Don't bother playing unless you have a lot of disposable income.

The game is good, I really enjoy playing it and summoning new champions. The problem is that if you don't spend money frequently you won't manage especially during events and tournaments. The fact that you have to pay for energy in order to play is just too much. If at least it allowed you to play as much as you want and not have to wait for the energy to fill up again after a few games would be already way better. Love the game but gave it 3* for this reason.

Graphics are the only redeeming quality of this game anymore. I first played four years ago, and the game has always been disassociated with the players. Recently, my account was hacked and I had to deal with Plarium. I have been waiting over 3 months now for any response from Plarium. This company and game seem to not care about the players, don't waste your time on a game that ignores its players. Especially when hacking and selling accounts is extremely common.

Your response indicates you didn't understand my complaint. It shouldn't . . . and didn't used to cost nearly 4 million to go from 15th to 16th level. Latest updates make the game even worse! Instant artifact upgrade asks for money over and over, constantly raising the price to ridiculous levels. The longer you play the game the more you are punished with lower success rates. Does not live up to the hype. When game glitches, tech support is just an excuse squad.

Do not waste your time. There are glitches in the game. You spend a ton of time getting the good stuff (such as void shards) and then because of the glitches, you can't even use it (characters don't show up). Their support team is a joke and don't care to address or help with the issues. Update: -1 star. They comment on negative reviews to make it look like they care. Sent it in and ”Nevertheless, we have provided you with all the available information on this."

The game itself is decent, but the high number of in-game offers that popup in your face are a constant source of annoyance, especially when they are repeats of offers already shown during the session. This shows that the devs are money hungry, constantly pushing for players to spend money on their game. I get you want/need funds, but outright badgering the players to get it makes playing (or even launching) this game far less enjoyable.

After trying a handful of Gacha games, this honestly doesn't really give me any reason to play it with how stingy most of the content is. Too much content is prioritized with money in mind, even stuff like auto play, passive leveling, and etc require premium cash to unlock their full potential or it's just too limited. You'll at least get a change of pace from the usual anime style at least, but it's very meh in the sea of Gacha games.

The game was fun for awhile. In the dungeons I would win levels as far as my character strength would take me, mostly on auto. However, replaying that level on auto with the same characters would regularly result in defeat, even if tried multiple times. That is garbage gameplay. Make the game fair and fun and I'll likely spend a little money. Try to cheat me into spending money and I uninstall.

At first I gave this game 5 stars but after playing it for almost a year. The shard you use to get characters is ridiculous. There's hundreds of characters and you will get the same ones over and over. It's really hard to get the right characters and gear. Not to mention you need books to level up skills. Which are impossible to get without spending money. Getting higher level shards to get the best characters are impossible to get too. If you want to advance in the game you HAVE to spend money

I've been playing over a month now. I have fun with it, even considering how grindy it can be. always remains challenging. my only problem with it is that most in game offers as well as pre set packs are not worth the price. the packs help but considering how much investing in each character there is, it can mean very little unless you are lucky enough to acquire legendary heros. the RNG in this game can be brutal at times. it can make you feel punished for simply playing as intended.

I enjoyed this game for a while after it came out, and I've been relatively free to play. the character designs are great, but when it comes to events it's a huge drain on any resources you have. at a point, it becomes very clear that it is pay to win. the free legendaries are great, but you can only do so much with them unless you save resources to level them up and your artifacts. silver and energy brain consistently, and even if you build up for an event, it is not likely that you will finish

Has too many pop ups to buy stuff. Like we get it... You can buy stuff, anyone who has played for more than a couple knows you have stuff to buy! Everytime I go back to main thing you hit me with promo after promo and its annoying. Takes you out of the game and slows players from getting to the action. Will play still, just very annoyed at the in-your-faceness.

Game was good in the beginning, now you have to buy everything and it's constantly cutting out, you constantly have to re-log in... I left a comment about this before and the developers are all "Oh we compensated players for the trouble... who cares about the compensation when you can barely even play the damn game cuz you have to restart over and over. it does it on all my devices and on other wifi so it is NOT an issue w my devices. Game has potential BUT.....If you truly want to enjoy it you need to pay extreme prices. Everything is revolved around money, and there isn't any new content to enjoy. They just keep feeding you more ways to spend money. Like I said it has potential to be great, BUT the people running it are ruining it. I've been playing for about the time of launch and it's def behind in terms of content. In short play something else that will be worth the time.

Fun game, but... At start up they force you to wade through as many as 10 pop up windows where they try to sell you everything under the sun. Its annoying to the point that if I just have a few minutes to play and want to perhaps check progress on something I cannot. I wind up skipping it and doing something else. Just a hint to the devs... I'll never, ever pay for anything related to this app because of you cramming it down my throat that way.

Game just wants your money. Not worth playing unless you're a whale. The spammed "offers" whenever you log in or return to the main game screen are super annoying as well. Your reply is BS. It would be easy to have one pop up saying special time sensitive offers that leads to the page with offers, where a player could then browse, but no, you have to spam each offer separately and not just once but several times during game play. It's so annoying it makes me not want to play the game

The gameplay is alright but some of the selling points in their ads couldn't be farther from the truth. Story is meh, not all champions have unique art(infact several are just retextures or recolors), arena is FAR from balanced when it comes to matchmaking, champion customization is limited to abilities and equipment and offers from other games to play this one are busted and don't work. Not a game worth investing in if you ask me, there are better options out there.

This game is good. Actually the moment to moment gameplay and upgrading your heroes is all a lot of fun. But this game suffers from what most of the mobile gaming industry suffers from, it is designed to make you pay. I don't mind shelling out for good games, so after I enjoyed my first hours I bought the $10 beginner pack. This made the early stages of the game awesome. But as you progress, you hit a wall. Everyone I asked online said the same thing: you gotta buy champions! It's dissapointing.

Very fun, but very grindy. Can easily be free to play and still advance. *Update* If you spend as much time in the gym (or things to better yourself) as I do logged in, you'll be way better off. You would probably be super successful. Instead I wasted a bunch of time going nowhere in real life and only did mildy okay at this game. Huge waste of time. They need to find a way to speed this game up so people spend less time logged on. Auto battle isn't the fix. I'd still be logged on 24/7.

Just starting out around level 10 and this game has so many pop ups and "great offers" to spend money on items, gems, levels, champions and who knows what else that it's driving me nuts. Seems like an okay gacha game otherwise. I'm sure they make plenty of money off this game, chill out devs and take a breath. I shouldn't have to close 5 to 6 offers in a row to get to the screen I want.

The game is fun, but the constant bombardment of in-game pop-up ads detracts from enjoying it. Prices are ridiculous for the majority of their packs as well. Other than these, it has very nice visuals, even on PC, and gameplay. Could use more story, however. PvP balancing needs a lot of work!

This is the worst game ever made of all time. First of all, the game play is hardly engaging. They just give you an idle button and that's it. Secondly, it is filled with heavy microtransactions, which sums up every typical mobile game. I'm not surprised that it was mentioned from heavy sponsorship. Edit: that's not a great response. Can you please balance out the game's mechanics instead of adding more limits and pay content? I don't like how there's not much improvement in general.

Just another energy based game that largely works off of lottory or gambling to progress. The game isn't innovative or embassies it's a style we have all seen before. You might get a few minutes of progress before pop-up after pop-up trying to get you to buy something so the game doesn't slow to a crawl or just can't play at all. Like so many "free" games you end up having to pay $100s a month to play a meh game you set to auto play anyways. Is this how you want to spend your money?

At first I liked the wide variety skills and characters that you could link to make interesting teams, but as you go deeper into content you realize that there is only a handful of useful characters. By that point it's pure cash grab. If you get lucky to get a good character you most likely won't be able to level all of their skills without spending money.

the game would be better if they weren't so stingy with their rewards. seriously you use less energy on stage 1 of a battle but if you go to stage 8 and use more energy, they give you the same reward (as stage 1) if not less. Greedy! and the pop-ups are annoying to yes I get you're trying to show me a deal but you don't need to show me 20 times in 10 minutes... Unfortunately I already put money into this game.. oops! uninstalling.

As of right now, the second mission (the 2nd mission after the prologue) will not fully load in for me, the game is stuck at loading under the a in the "and the more..." tip. I dont know if this is a problem with my device (Samsung Galaxy S10+) or if this is being caused for other reasons, I first downloaded via a link through a sponsor, deleted it and redownload it through the app store. I hope there is a fix for this so I can get back in and get those prizes for the special launch tournament.

True definition of pay to win! While this game is fun, if you expect to progress at a rate that is faster than glaciers moving, you're gonna be paying a LOT of money. Every time you log in, you're bombarded with ads to buy stuff for the game (usually 3-5 pop-ups) before you can play. Don't waste your money on soul gems unless you're filthy rich, the odds of getting the highest tier soul from the highest tier gem is 6%. You're better off buying XP boostsand gems.

I am having an issue in game with the multi battle feature. One or both of my carry Heroes is *always* dropped out of my lineup before the battle begins. I have tried to find a way to talk to customer support, but i can't find anything except this review feature to comment on. I guess I will try the Raid Reddit next. I was subscribing to a battle pass because I liked the multi battle feature, but i have since cancelled that as i can no longer use the feature I purchased it for. Help!

Played this game for a few months and loved it. Now events are impossible to finish unless you spend a ton of money on it. "End game" should just have a price tag attached to it at this point. Months of grinding doesnt matter theres little rewards for it yet throwing your hard earned cash so they can have a easy living seems to be the plan. Dont get me wrong id love to make easy cash so cant blame them for it but they cant even get ahold of there bugs in the game from when i just started.

This game can get very addictive and fun. I played for around 3 or 4 months. Now I'm just bored. I've played every single day, hours a day, and still not a single legendary. Then you see some people a lower level with 4 legendary characters. Its just the luck of the draw I guess. Also the 100 pop-ups a day gets super annoying. Believe me raid makers, if people want to buy they know where to go. But I will say this can be a really fun game as long as the game throws a bone once in awhile.

Fun game, but slogging through the endless popups just leaves you with the feeling that it's a soulless husk trying to milk players for as much money as it can (And it is). As far as gacha games go it's definitely one of the better looking ones, with fun factions and character variety. Find something more worth your time to play, because this game wants more time than most people have to give. Edit: The stock reply that I've seen on every review like mine just confirms what I've said.

Only played for a couple of hours, but I've played a handful of games just like it. It suffers from Mobile Game Sydrome (MGS). It starts off with a tutorial, and early game it has a bunch of pop-up rewards to get you all hyped up and interested. Then of course it's going to slow everything down unless you give them obscene amounts of money. Too many little bs things. Why should I have to pay to unequip something? I own it. That's so dumb. Energy limits play time and the game. Not enough words

I have to agree with all the other reviews the pop up adds on this game are horrible. The company will probably reply to this saying "we don't want you to miss out on the offers.". Yet the also add red notification dots just use those get rid of the pop ups. On top of that te deals in this game are horrible and over priced. Save your time and money play something else.

Fun game but... Very addicting and fun. Lots of ways to fight bosses and PVP. Its definitely a time consuming game but it definitely is not a pay to win type of situation, so free players you are fine... for the most part. The RNG is really bad in this game. Takes a while for you to get a decent character. Unfortunately I have been having some connection issues a lot more (I have a good internet)

You can progress in the game at the beginning. But you eventually hit a wall. The progress in game slows and you eventually have to spend money to keep moving forward. Look........I know you run a business......and the name of the game is "make money". I'm not knocking you for it. I'm just saying it gets a little pricey for ME. That's all and it may be a similar issue for other players. The game is fun and the artwork is second to none.

Been on this game almost 3 years. If it was a viable free to play game I'd love it. You can absolutely not make any progress within a timely manner if you play thus game without spending money. You have to pay to win with this game. The packs and everything else are not cheap anywhere for 20$ to over 100$. Do not get invested in this game its not worth it. I've spent to much time on it to stop playing it.

This game is misadvertising in so many different ways. The graphics are decent, but thay aren't "next-gen" like they claim it to be. The story is completely forgettable, the game is monetised to such an extent that every time I would go to the main hub i am flooded with swarm of ads prompting me to buy microtransactions, and that whole "customizing your champion" thing is a lie too. This game is basically a casino slot machine disguised as a mobile game. I would not recommend this game to anyone

RAID: Shadow Legends is the first mobile game I've played and as a longtime gamer across many platforms I was well aware of the stigma that mobile games have with the greater gaming landscape (sometimes earned stigma) so I was a bit leery of it going in for the first time. After having played over a dozen hours thus far I can say the gameplay loop it has is grindy with RNG on rewards but, and this is a big but, I'm not bored with what I'm doing. Nor do I feel that the purchases available are mandatory at time of writing either. But if you dislike grind in any form then you will find that RAID doesn't break the mold on that front nor does it need to.  A good free to play game is one that makes you want to spend money because you're having fun not because the game isn't fun unless you spend money. And I would say RAID is the former, if it can keep up with the fun factor and iron out the kinks they're experiencing at time of writing I'd say they will certainly be worth giving money to for the fun I've had.

Simply Amazing at first. Gameplay is solid, graphics are on point, and the loot is dope. Then you get an error on your next login that's been in the game weeks and from updates 1.6 and 1.7. Unable to find resources. You then can no longer play the game 😔. Then you hop on Google Play to see if this is a just you experience or everyone......AND IT'S EVERYONE. 3/5 good game but overpowered error code.

Dont play! I've been playing a few months now. The game looks great, lots to do and it's fun. You can upgrade pretty well without paying but as always, it's a P2 win game. The bad... I run a galaxy 10e, and the game will freeze often making you force stop the game and now the game won't even play without WiFi. Plarium will also ignore your ticket requests to the point they expire. They will nerf a hero you've spent months of resources on and give you nothing in return. Good game, bad company.

it's all about the money, I've already spent a lot of money and don't have near what people who havent invested a dime, been playing close to a year. I have invested so many hours in this game, the only way you advance is to dump tons and tons of money. Skill books still cost you actual money, and great gear is almost impossible to get.... i have hundreds, if not 1000's of hours invested in getting gear alone... and still nothing great.

Stop deleting my rating. I didn't care for your game, I played it for 60 days, you have terrible reward systems and need to adjust how stingy you are. Wasted champs, misleading ads, has fun elements but it isn't worth playing overall. I advise others to not listen to the paid ads and understand you'll mostly be meant to do the same 1 - 6 missions over 200 times each and that won't even net you a 6 star maxed character. Don't play this game. Not yet at least.

been playing for a couple months now and loved it at the beginning but only way to build your characters is to pour money into the game. I've spent way too much for a game that has yet to give me a legendary champion after making purchase after purchase during the special enhanced summoning periods... 10x the chance... don't believe it. game is now time consuming and without the better champions like I see everyone else has I've lost the desire to continue to spend money on a game that doesn't reward you for all the time and money you put into it. Big let down after such a terrific beginning. If you don't mind putting hundreds of dollars into the game and several hours a day just building up mediocre characters then its what you are looking for, me, I want a game that will give me back what i put into it.. This game has failed miserably at doing that, and I have nothing to show for the money spent except the same champions I could have gotten for free, just got them quicker.. Too much hype behind Legendary shards... Dont expect much more than you get from free ancient Shards. Fun while it lasted. And now I can't even log in to play... why I'm here writing my first review.

3 yrs and leaving. Monitization, drop rates, and algorrithim is the worst I've expreienced in any mobile gacha game so far. Yes, it favors paying players. Just like any other gacha game, spenders progress quicker, but spending is still optional. The game requires a ton of time daily for players to slowly advance. It becomes chore more than fun post lvl 50 as more content opens up. The so called 'time and effort' vs the rewards are not worth the time and effort or money. They'll getcha alright.

When I first picked this up I was really excited. Progress was a little slow, but i thought it would improve. Wrong. There's an expensive system to get characters. You can grind for a month (quite literally, some rewards need a daily log of 1 month) to summon a champion. Once you FINALLY get that summon chance, it's randomized. And there are more common characters in each level of summon teer. I can grind a month and get a duplicate. Don't download unless you can spend lots or waste lots of time

After playing for over 2 months, all I can say is terrible customer service, never receive responses to support tickets, and the game crashes and error messages me out of battles. I can crush an arena team, see my team all alive and yet it says I was defeated. It tells me in the middle of battles that my purchases cannot be processed. It's a cash grab. It's a game loaded with bugs. Recommend you move on.

Don't think I will play this any more. Arena battles are not even close to being balanced. The equipment suggestions by developers are weak and the players equipment suggestions are locked, I'm assuming that changes if you spend a lot but I haven't seen where. Also the thing that aggravates continually is lots of "deals" that you need to click thru just to play. Also chat is non-existant since it's constantly flooded with player upgrades. It's too bad because it had more potential.

I wouldn't recommend this game unless you got a large phone plan, because the game is similar to Yu-Gi-Oh Duel Links, since it takes a lot of space to download it, on top of the game being heavily wifi/data reliant. My personal experience was a very laggy and just full of the game randomly stopping experience, which got to the point of the game crashing on me. Overall, I woudn't recommend it as it clearly is overhyped and using Youtubers to make it out to be better than what it is.

It's a gambling game. Do not expect to be able to participate in end game content even after months of playing unless you open your wallet. Content is released when their metrics show the game is slowing down. Offers to buy in game items scale up the more you spend. Do not play this game. I got automated response #5, what about you guys? Edit: This may not be automated, but it's still copy pasted from a list of responses you have, and that's not much better..

It is IMPOSSIBLE to play this game without paying. You could try, but might take you 6 months to get what you could get in ome week. The game also gets VERY repetitive very fast. ADS EVERYWHERE. Need to close 6 or 7 adds every time you start the game. Yoi cant even pay to make them go away. GRIND ... even when paying, be prepared to grind for hours. Indont mean 2 or 3 hours, I mean well over 20 hours just to barely build one character (and 20 hours is putting it nice).

This game has amazing graphics, but as far as the game goes, contrary to what Plarium is claiming, this game is not free to play friendly, it's a business after all, but it is very extreme, Also since it's RNG (aka Gambling) based, it's hard to progress unless you are lucky or you have the money to play the game. THE Missions and everything else in the game is very repetitive, they create tournaments to offer books and silver and other resources, but for you to be able to do it, you need to pay

Just boring. The game gives you worthless items to make up for problems they have, then they only give you a certain amount of time to redeem these "gifts". The whole shard system is worthless and frustrating. You can't get the champions you need unless you buy their packages. They have a clan system that is useless it does nothing,except allows you to battle an undefeatable monster (clan boss) other than that clans are a joke much like this game.

Ahhh the pay to win game you love to hate. I have been playing this game for a few weeks now and although it is fun to play at the beginning stages where at least there is some sort of a story to progress through, it very fast becomes a grind fest in every sence of the word and levelling up your characters to compete for example in the pvp arena or in the later stages of the dungeons becomes nearly impossible unless.............you pay.

You don't have to spend money to enjoy it. However, at around level 50 you hit a plateau where the game becomes a bit boring. If you then spend money to advance, expect to pay the price of a premium console game like GTA 5 to upgrade the gear of 1 or 2 heroes. The prices are simply ridiculous. After the last upgrade, servers are constantly in maintenance and very unstable. I still enjoy to fill idle moments with the game, but it has become a grind. Server issues will see me leave soon.

....So for some reason, I can open the app, but when it opens up I can't do anything. I'm just stuck in the main hub. I tried hitting everything, the sidebar with my daily logins, the quests, progression, shops, tavern, profile, great hall, fight, nothing works and I can't actually enter anything. I tried restarting my phone, I even deleted and reinstalled.

For a game that has been out for this long now, I don't expect to see as much maintenance and downtime as Diablo 3's launch.... At the point now where you can't play the game because it is down so much. Compensation and new content for the game is worthless, and for those who have been following, developers made some very bad calls with their rewards policy.

Plarium holds to it's standard with yet another game that has good fun potential locked behind an absurd pay wall. The amount of "offers" I get spammed with makes me feel like I'm visiting a 90's malware site where you feel like you need to run an antivirus scan. What fun the game is becomes painfully obvious it can't last without big $$$ If the game isn't fun without paying you don't deserve my money. This game is a disappointment. At least I know why they can afford all those ads!

The game itself is fine. My main issue with the game is its monetization. Basically if you want to get any of the "good" characters reliably you are forced to just out your wallet and buy the summons. The free to play model is basically nonexistant and you are forced to wait until Plarium decides to bless you with a couple blue gems. The game would be dang near perfect in my opinion if they had some ways besides omega RNG from dungeons to at least get the blue gems reliably even if it was slower

The must see, must play, top of the charts, made headlines RAID: Shadow Legends. So pros? Chat, emotes, Daily Quests, Daily Log in, Dungeons, and yes, Events! Easy to learn, but you must also teach yourself a lot about leveling up, combat scenarios, etc. Cons? People who spend money on the game get special treatment vs. Free-to-play players, such as myself. Auto-kicks every day, for just playing the game -.- Sadly, the game cannot keep up with my game style, so I will be uninstalling it.

Got spammed with ads for this game so much I downloaded it just so I could leave a negative review. Please stop pushing this at me, Google. Edit: Skipping only helps so much. Even the first 5 seconds of an ad becomes intolerable when it's the only ad you ever get. Edit 2: Also, the devs don't properly read customer reviews. They probably just have a bot programmed to leave canned responses to certain key words.

I'll give this game 3 stars for graphics and playability. Otherwise this is like every other game where you can only get so far and then you hit a wall. It seems if I spend some of my money for upgrades I'll be able to proceed but no matter which way I tried to attack whether it be the arena or the campaign I can't get any further. I can't seem to find a mobile game that I've enjoyed that hasn't pushed for money.

Worst p2w game. You will never get the character you want. You have to spend money to get the shards you need to be able to summon the character, and there are several ways to summon, even though two of them have the same percentage of just different color. Even if there is a special for that particular shard, don't bother. Then there are the pop-ups of special deals to get you spending. There are better games to play that do this better. I'm personally done with this game! Shameful.

Well, the game is fun. It has some strategy and requires an understanding of how it works... But the reason I am giving it a three star..... Because if some of the VERY questionable character design, for an example.... The "Sky Touched Shaman" there are more like this, and personally I don't appreciate how they are sort of created in way to attract younger male gamers.... 😐

App itself is decent, graphics are solid, gameplay is pretty much what you'd expect. My biggest gripe is the offer spam when you log in or return to town. I get bombarded with at least a half dozen offers every time i log in, and frankly it's annoying. The offers should display once, MAYBE twice, then go sit in their own little offers tab. It's quote bothersome.

Initially I had an issue with the game because of some starter rewards that were offered, but never got. I emailed Plarium, and they looked into my account and manually added the rewards as advertised on one of their sponsored YouTube videos. The game is simple to play, but with complex RPG mechanics. That's a good thing. Graphics are really good for a mobile. The Raids are short and quick, so you can do one here and there. The game is highly monetized, but that's the norm in Free to play games

Mediocre, was expecting a really cool game, but it is very formulaic. Nothing really new or exciting in terms of game play, guilds and raids are nothing new, lots of microtransaction options, story was less than exciting, and I was bored after two hours of basically the exact same gameplay loop. Was expecting a lot more tbh after seeing so many ads everywhere.

I'm sorry but I cannot stand an app that limits or blocks you from getting stronger or obtaining more. I've tried to like this game but I can't. It's the same boring repeating play. On high it rejected my character 5 times in a row from upgrading an artifact??? It costs too much, especially when you fail and it still takes your coin. Chickens are a joke. Fragments are a joke. Takes way too many. Green crystals give lame characters unless you spend. Why would I spend if it plays like this?

I have played this game for over 10 hours, completing the campaign in normal mode. I believe yet it is another pay to play game, in which you have little to nothing to do if you do not spend big. The game has a low skill cap with big challenging walls that you can overcome only by paying to get access to better gear and heroes. If you check reddit you will only see posts where people complain about microtransactions. Hope my review saves you some time - try something else.

Updated review a year after i quit playing because Plarium has recently targeted me by placing "Come back to Game" ads in apps I use to. Started off f2p at the beginning of the pandemic to pass the time, note, not a gamer here. Got disturbingly addicted to the game in a bad way. Had some great champs, was part of a great clan. Ended up spending a lot of $$$, wasted a lot of time in the grind. Played about a year and decided it was all too much for me. Do yourself a favor. Stay away.

Probably one of the worst games I've ever played. Not only is the gameplay shallow and non immersive, but it is an obvious cash grab. The only way to really progress at any kind of meaningful rate in this game is to either plug your phone into a charger and meticulously set up the battles to autoplay, or gamble money in hopes to get the good heros. Pay to win, pure and simple. Games like this are a cancer on the gaming industry.

Here's my take on the game it's pretty decent. The game is on the p2w side of things as most gacha style RPG games are. The leveling up system is pretty wack, considering if you're doing dungeons on a higher level, the exp you get for your champions is low regardless of the dungeon you do. The only reason I have the will to continue playing is because I've worked pretty hard on my account, so I don't want to lose 2 years of hard work

Finally played this after probably 10 years of seeing ads for it literally everywhere. It's a really easy game with a lot of heroes to get. I am personally not a very big fan of turn based games. If you play for a couple hours total you'll be stuck on a certain story level and have to go back and grind what you've already beaten to get more material to upgrade with. It's alright if you're into this sort of thing. I was nice and gave 3 stars for their effort and attention

great game outside of anything worth getting is behind a pay wall. on top of that even if you had an extra 200$ just around to blow on this game, more then likely your not going to get the character you really want. you spend money on gold shards and then still only have a small chance to get a Legendary character and they don't even offer gold shards that much.and when they do, they are to expensive for only 1 or 2 shards. the game itself is great just don't be spending real money on it.

I liked this game so much that I gave it a 5 star review. But as time went on you realize how greedy and in your face with how much they want your money. If you download this game you'll have fun for a month. Then you start to get tired of clicking out of about 10 pop ups with what they call "deals" which are ridiculously over priced. And I mean way to overpriced. If you want to buy the gold shard then you're looking at spending around 50 bucks with a terrible chance of getting something good.

I played for like 2 years off and on as a free player. Fully upgraded my gem mine, was ready to be in it for the long haul, and after all that time I only had one legendary champion. I realized that I was doing dailies like a slot machine at a casino, and dropped out. I havent missed it, but it was definitely fun for a while.

This game is so pay to play. And the drop rates are ridiculous. Very hard to enjoy this game. So frustrating And slow progress!! Everything cost money. If you have unlimited pocket book then this is the game for you. Even then they make sure they squeeze every bit out of you!! Horrible game honestly!!! Great concept but greed got the best of this game!!

Game is 100% pay to win, the new fusion event just proves that. Bumping up the required points for the summon rush event so if you were planning for what is the usual requirement then you either have to spend to buy shards or just miss out. They do a lot of dirty things to try and get money out of players but this is one of the worst. I've been playing for about 2 years now and I'm done, if you're thinking of playing, save your time and give this game a skip.

This game is abysmal. You can't even log into the game without getting bombarded with 4-5 popups trying to get you to spend spend spend. The gameplay is boring and they make you go backwards and ruin your hero setup in order to "progress", only to make you pay to undo what they made you do. In 2024 you will NEVER be able to compete with anyone in the arena, without first spending ten thousand dollars first.

This game was fun in the beginning filled with tons of loot and rewards but as you get further in the game it seems to be less about enjoying the game and more of how big is your bank account I can't even level up at this point without waiting like 4 days to get enough energy to do so but if I spent the low price of $50! I can almost level up! this game is a money trap just don't download it they are money hungry developers can't even create a proper loot system without needing $20 for it -5 ⭐

Cool game but... ease off of the constant overpriced bundles that pop up for real money. Soon as I log in, I get bombarded by deals that can "boost" my progress. Beat one mission & BOOM another bundle pops up. Consider when a player declines offers constantly, they likely can't spend money. Let us disable it or hide offers. Lastly, the summoning in this game is a huge gamble. The %'s to gain a high rarity after dropping $100 on a sacred shard even when summoning is "boosted" is horrendous.

As far as energy based mobile games go, it's pretty solid. I hate games that limit actions to try and artificially slow your progress, but that's the reality of the platform. If you can get past the usual limitations you'll probably enjoy the game, if not you should probably invest in a Nintendo Switch or a 3DS XL.

Tried to like this game.. Positives go to it's visual polish, it truly looks like a "AAA" title. Everything else is all downhill, it's the single most aggressive microtransaction spamming infrastructure I've seen. Every minute your slammed with "buy me" pop ups. I am not one for gatcha games anyway, but if rolling for what seems like infinite bottom of the barrel characters is your bag you'll be home here. Of course you could always spend a house payment just to feel digitally "powerful" ☠️

This game was fun for a bit, but they advertise several packs Everytime you log in. The gameplay isn't special at all. It's fun for starters but you quickly realize this is just a slot machine. If you have a gambling addiction steer clear. I played this for about 4.5 months and spent $1500 I wouldn't consider myself to have a gambling addiction, and it just goes to show how fast this can get away from you. You can spend $60 on a retail console game and have a much better experience than this.

This game is okay! I enjoy some of the game play, but the summoning aspect is kinda garbage. I originally started playing this game, aiming for 1 specific character. And in playing for 2 ½ years, I was not able to get her, so I quit. Now I'm trying again, because of the Ronda Rousey promotion, but if I don't get my character in the next 6 months, I will probably be done playing this game. It's just not fun when you have to purchase to get characters worth investing in!

I would really like to give the game a higher score, nice graphics, the gameplay is interesting and RNG aside the frustrating thing is the grind. Just to complete all daily tasks and CB , all the basic jazz, etc. You need about 2 hours. If you want to get anywhere in the game you need to play actively and daily for several hours, usually around 6-7. So what is supposed to be a relaxing side game, becomes almost like a second job. And everything is gated by time you invest into the game.

The game is good , but I don't like the limitations they put on players (certain missions having very specific / difficult requirements , how hard it is to continue to make a strong team due to the other limitation added. Other than that the limitation on how many gift packs you can redeem a day which makes no sense , and how slow the gameplay is compared to how hardcore , crazy , and combat driven the ads show the game to be , Plus their replies to the rating from what I seen aren't genuine

P2W predatory game so much so that I am one month in and getting frustratingly tired of closing the deals tab every time I return back to the menu. You don't need to keep reminding people how broke they are. Such a turn off. Look at Epic Seven. Same age, same playstyle, none of the wasting my time closing deals I don't care for. Also Plarium Play on desktop is not working 90% of the time nowadays. Also been occasionally getting bugs when I'm upgrading artifacts. Do better.

Game is beyond redemption, it's insane how expensive this game is... and free to play really is not a option, even if they tell you that. The amount of content you miss out on is sad if your F2p. They will spin you examples of accounts that have been around since day 1(years of progress) that can manage around the money-making system but if you are new here, you will see at what a huge disadvantage you are because you can't afford Plarium's "deals". Btw couldn't care less on that AI response 👍

Game it self is a load of fun and the grind is real. Energy mechanic is a bit dated imo and for a company that wants to squeeze money out of people its a bit rough to have players sit there with nothing to do. While I understand the balance of the game is based around some of the time gating of the energy mechanic and the P2W players buy energy pots. There should be something in the game to do (even some kind of mini game) just to avoid players jumping out of the game and to something else.

I'm liking this game a lot more than I thought I initially would. The only problem I have is the constant annoying promo pop ups saying buy this and buy that. I just want to enjoy the game and if I choose to buy something the Shop button is there for a reason. Id increase the star rating if they stop bombarding me with promos. Update 1: I don't like being lied too so I've reduced the stars down by one. Dismissing doesn't stop the promos. Update 2: Referrals don't work! This game sucks!

I'm not one for writing reviews but overall I find the game to be quite enjoyable. The only real negative I can say is the amount of popup ads for their bundles. When I start the game I have to sit there and close about 4 to 6 ads for their bundles before I can go and play the game. This sort of thing does want to make me stop playing. EDIT EDIT: Goodness a proper reply this time. EDIT EDIT EDIT: they have made no improvements to this so called algorithm, they lied.

I am sad to say, that even though the game is wonderfully made, and easy to grasp, it seems, to for some odd reason, have a nack for not allowing the user to log in to the game. The FAQ has a server status button that simply says it's running and connecting which is a bold faced lie when my app just told me it can't connect to the server, and using the support button doesn't allow you to actually submit a report because it spends forever loading only to tell you to retry

If they spent even half as much money on the actual game as they did on the ads it would be the best game on the app store. But instead it has subpar graphics. With a high pay to win base. And stupid amount of grinding if you don't wish to pay. But hey at least the ads are top quality otherwise the entire franchise would have nothing going for it. I could name at least 4 other similar games with better graphics and at least three with no pay to win but worse graphics.

Game is already over 4 years & I just started playing. Graphics still looks good but everything else felt like it was from the older era of gacha rpg. Game is heavy on the grinding & multi mats for levelling. You also need to PAY TO UNEQUIP GEARS & UPGRADING HAS A CHANCE TO FAIL. Hero models are unique only by skin design. Depending on the body type, idle animation were rehashed. Overall, fun at first but it is designed for hours of hardcore grinding. Casual player like me will be left out fast.

A nice variety of races and characters, good looking graphics and easy to learn mechanics. The problems I have though are: a cost to unequip items; frequent popup ads that force you to close the window which sometimes has a tiny 'x' which is difficult to tap and instead often ends up opening up the advertiser's page; too few characters worth spending any time/resources on as so many are little more than resources themselves to sacrifice for exp.

I gave this game a second after two years and I still see the same issue. The game might actually be decent but as soon as you log in, you are harassed by at least 10 pop ups that try to get you to buy something. I'm not able enjoy the game because every time I go the the home screen and goo idle for 5 seconds, I get another pop up from the store. I can't enjoy the game because I'm constantly reminded as harrased by the in game store trying to heavily suggest that I spend my money.

Gameplay is what you expect from a mobile game these days. The reason I give 1 star is bc I've never seen more pop up ads in my life. When you first load into the game you'll get no less than 5 "special offers" and you'll get them again and again every single time you go back to the home screen. I can handle gacha games and the need to make money, but the sheer amount of pop ups completely ruined my experience.

Game looks promising but after a few days you are going to find out nonstop game crashes, freezing, support is zero to none. On top of everything the game will freeze or crash on you when you are making a purchase and as a result developer will take your money but you are not going to receive your goods. Game rewards are probably same as in most games, spend some get some however the rewards are not worth it. The most fun is in arena but once your game crashes you are going to lose the battle.

This is a great game and I love it so much I've learned to accept it's very few faults but one thing I can NOT get over is that I can't change my name again after I had chosen one. My name is a bunch of 1s and 2s because I had thought it wasn't working because all the variants of the name I tried weren't available so now I'm stuck with a name I hate, so if you could add a way so players can change their name for like 100 gems or make it only able to change it every month. Thank you for your time

Progress missions dont line up with other types of missions. Alot of in game energy is wasted on this. It seems like the game has been programmed to only give drops at any level and or rank that arent useful. Finally get an accessory for a mission and guess what as usual its for something you dont have. Cant get to dungeon you need unless it is the real life day they open it. Can wait up to four days to open. High price for gear swapping. As bad as all this is it isnt an exhaustive list.

Fun game overall, but the constant spam of trying to get cash from you is too frustrating. You'll login and be spammed with 5+ messages of different sales they want you to buy, where you have to exit each one sequentially. Ridiculous to be spammed like this every time you launch, with no settings to turn it off. It's lovely that the purchase button is also placed perfectly over very common click areas.

To those of you that plan on playing this game for fun, don't. It's not fun it's not easy for new players to progress, all they care about is reaping off your pockets. Played alot of turn based games and wanted to see how this will turn out but and already one week in and after almost 12 hours farming I finally got one of my champion 5star and let's not forget how difficult it is to get shards to summon. At least if you want to make this game fun make it easy for new players to enjoy the game.

I have played this close to 3 years, unfortunately in the recent months the RNG has become trash. If u really want to have fun I have to spend and even as a spender I don't have fun anymore. And the support team it's the worst they swear the game is perfect. If we lose out on something over a bug support team will rather call me crazy or a liar. Champions by thier prices can go as high as $500 not counting gear and books. I wish I never wasted a dime on it. But it's to late for me. Goodluck

Pros: Great game with good graphics - graphics are great. - gameplay is what you would expect with this genre of game. - Daily gifts and gifts for time spent playing the game, multiple quest trees to get rewards from. - mastery system for heroes is a great touch. Cons: Money grabber - multiple forced ads upon login. - gem mine is nice, but gems are difficult to get otherwise. -Tons of grinding if you're f2p. - pay to unequip gear makes it difficult to switch out gear and experiment.

The game has reached maturity. New players will run into walls of whales or players who have been in the game since it started. Progression in arena is impossible without the right team with the right gear and a lot of outside the game research. And when I say progression in arena, I mean just getting out of bronze rank, which only took a few weeks when the game was newer.

Entertaining for a free game. This has well developed graphics and definitely takes an investment of time to max out so e characters. Adds value in length of play time. However, this game loves it's micro transactions and constantly shoots ads and noticed up onto the screen requesting more and more purchases. If you can resist the ads and do t mind grinding a little, this can be a fun game to play for countless hours

One month in now and I will cover the positives. Game has plenty of events to help players grow. Unexpected server issues or maintenance is compensated nicely and plenty of items for growth are available free from quests, mission, challenges, clan boss, and dungeons. Multiple variables for champion overall outcome, making it more challenging. Rng based which does not favor whether you pay or not. Overall plenty of play time available daily doing many things. Plenty of room for it to grow!

After playing this game for over 6 months, I find the game itself very repetitive and the afk option of making it a mindless game started to really annoy me. There is so much you have to do just to keep up or spend a lot of money. I asked the developers to delete my account because it was taking way too much of my time and I decided my time is much more valuable doing something else in real life.

The characters are bland and mediocre, The graphics are respectable (for mobile at least) the gameplay is bad and overused. The game is about grinding and spending a lot of time but ultimately only make small progress to progress faster (which is still slow btw) is to purchase basically it's pay to win. Minor complaints: the title is horrible, if your gonna respond to reviewers then don't put your name on the end, and I could go on there's a lot more awful things about this game.

Typical p2w mobile game. After the tutorial, many popups for packs and such(5+) every 5 levels you gain. Sure not required to pay to play the game, but the method they do to force you to buy the packs is annoying. Once you attain level 30+, this will be your time to either spend months in dungeons or buy the expensive packs to progress into the game. If you are a F2P player, do not play this game, the bundle/limited time offer they have are just like adware popups. Literally.

A wonderful game, and a ton of fun, but: The free to play structure in this game is horrendous. Achievements, clearing stages, and meeting milestones are very rarely met with meaningful resource, leaving no method of obtaining a steady influx of resources to progress as an f2p player. Furthermore, for those who like to spend spare change on mobile games, the value you get for your dollar is horrendous. Two stars for good gameplay, but lacks many basic core concepts of a good mobile game.

Its annoying sometimes seems like everyday the connection drops for maintenance at random. If you are a battle it coiunts as a automatic lose for you during the connection drop. Not the best but the graphics are okay. Sometimes you can't auto target the enemy by highlighting the enemy. This is one of the rpg games were you can continue constantly by having quick ways to cuarge for enery unlike other games were you have to wait a certain time to recharge energy which is good.

The game is very addicting, i played it for 5hrs a day but somehow its really boring to play because in dungeons and clan bosses... The bosses don't change they're just the same with different levels. Characters are similar to the other, on how they walk and attack, i suggest tk make the charcters and bosses more unique than the other. Complain: I cannot log in to the game, it always say "SERVER ERROR" inalways relog in but it still does not work (my internet is strong) i just can't log in

The game is really good and I got quiet addicted to it, tho I do not support the fact that you have to use silver to switch artifacts, it's not very practical and uses up a lot of silver rather than making the game flexible and comfortable for players, I'd gladly give you guys a five stars review if it wasn't for that, either way keep up the good work!

This is hands down the worst offender of the energy system I have ever seen in a mobile game. Once you get to endgame you are forced to spend money just to play the game longer than 20 minutes a day. It's absolutely horrendous. To make it worse they have events about twice a week that require a LOT of time to complete, but you will never complete them if you don't buy stamina, as they will expire before you have a chance to finish them. Gameplay is good, if only you could play longer than 20 min

Pay to continue. It's a simple as that. Do not bother even downloading this game unless you're rich or close to it. After lvl 30 you won't progress any further with spending $$. Even if you don't spend money it will take literal years to progress essentially 7% further. It ends up being a chore you never wanted. The worst grind ever. Do not waste the one thing you will never, be able to get back. Your Time!

An enjoyable game but a tone deaf developer. Yes, game development, improvement, and sustainment costs money. I have no issues with a company trying to make money but the game has continued to develop in a way that pushes out free-to-play or low paying customers. It will only get worse, save your money for a game that you pay for up front and know what you're getting.

I love this game, however there comes a point where you need to mindlessly grind HARD to level up champions only to use those same champions as "food" to level up the champions you actually like. If 3*, 4*, and 5* chikens were at least AVAILABLE in dungen drops that alone would improve the game 10fold. And more blue/purple shards, seriously. Game can be very strategic and fun. Characters are imaginative and diverse.

The game does have good graphics and the gameplay is interesting, but that is about it. Unfortunately the game is not for new players as you cannot get very far into the game or get many legit characters. It takes way too much time to get anyone that is any good, even with the freebies at times. It is most certainly a pay to win, or really to haev any fun. This is not for the idle, casual, or new gamer. Not worth it unfortunately.

Little rewards, too much expenses. The game requires a lot of resources, but less rewarding for efforts. Levelling champions on fighting pit requires checking all the time so that it wont stuck at same lvl which sucks, like need to log in everytime for this. Weekly and monthly quests are hard in the long run, because u will spend ur silvers for doing those silly equipment upgrades, also to rank up champions its hard and to fulfill those weekly and monthly quest in the long run, its tiring.

It's an advertisement scam. YouTubers are flooded with your terribly put together, robotic scripts. It's a lazily designed game, I got bored of it as soon as I played it. There is a literal skip button, because it's not really a game but more of a facade, set up to manipulate viewers into thinking it's good. This is a classic example of advertising that outweighs the game. You guys use celebrity endorsement to get more players. Waste of time, don't install. 🙄

I've been playing the game since the begining and now I can berely think of a reason to log in. No new content, buying packs is too expensive, Plarium not caring about the quolity of the game and what long term players would like to see changed or improved in the game. Tricking new players to start is what they are after. So they can buy just one $50 pack and that is a win for them

Awsome game design...except the corporate Greed of the developers is insane. This is the first game that i see that literally forces you to pay hundreds of dollars to play. Graphic are great...game concept is pretty solid. Crashes every 8 min on my Android so i loose about an hour of gameplay to crashes thru the day. By the time youve sunk in a couple of weeks into it...comes to a sorta stalemate...either pay to play or quit because it will take years to grind up to end game. Has great potential

The graphics are nice. The grinding can be excessive. The mission are fun to do. After you beat campaign there is not really much to do. You got to level your great hall but you will never be able to do because getting to gold 1 is impossible. Better have the best gear which is hard to get. After a while this game becomes frustrating because you can not improve your great hall to do the other mission. Save your time and go play a funner game because this game is not fun.

To be fair the game is fun but it has the most predatory monetization I've ever seen in any game that I've ever played in my whole 45 yrs of living. Everything is expensive, a lot of things are lootbox style with drop rates are so low you probably won't even get what you want when you buy. The events are all pay walled so if you're not whaling then don't bother trying to get any good rewards. The game would be awesome if they weren't sooooo greedy. Their customer service sucks really bad too.

Show me the money! Show me the money! Good game turned into an obvious, annoying money grab. Log in, click through 6-12 pop ups to buy things. Finish a mission, click through pop ups. Change areas, click through pop ups. If your rich, with money to burn it's a good game. If you don't mind the annoyance, it's a good game. Otherwise stay away.

SO. MANY. ADS. The game is playable but from the moment you open it up, you're blasted with anywhere from 3-6+ whole-screen ads for in-game purchases EVERY TIME you go to the main hub of the game to use ANY sort of function. And while there are $3-4 purchases, majority are $20-50, popping up MULTIPLE times per single 5-min play session totalling hundreds of $! Also, the refer-a-friend is a sham requiring them to spend MONTHS playing the game before you get a reward of 6% chance for a legendary..

Game was fun at first and only at first. Within 2 days or so you're feeling the need to spend money. You run out of things to do quickly and summoning new units is a luxury. I'm sure if you had hundreds and even thousands of dollars to spend this game would be good for you. But it's really a gacha game at it's worse. Every time you log in theres some super crappy offer of 70 to 100 dollars followed by 7 or 8 smaller offers. This game is a rip off.

Updated review: After spending 150$ on this game, and over half of that particularly to complete an ingame challenge, the devs locked the final step behind a MASSIVE paywall. They have made many, many mistakes before, from losing rewards to constant server crashes and automatically closing service requests, but this was the final straw. DO NOT DOWNLOAD THIS GAME!

Graphically sound, even "pretty" at times, but atrocious in every other regard. This is one step above the self-playing drek you'll find in Chinese internet cafes, developed solely to derive as much profit with as little effort as possible. You will find it devoid of challenge. You will be bombarded, constantly, with advertising for packs and take more time closing the "offer" pages than playing. This is not a game and it is, by far, among the worst things I've attempted from the Play store.

The graphics quality is so high that half the time it's running on around 8 fps, and it tells me thaty game crashed when it obviously didn't. when I try to do anything and there's way too many in app purchases. Also, the arena doesn't match you with people around your level to fight against so I was stuck fighting people way stronger than me. This game might be better if they spent more time and money improving and fixing bugs, and not on all of the advertisements.

IT can improve. It is an addictive game, but it suffers from thing like to upgrade a weapon it must complete to lv up when you get to lv 10 or more it breaks a lot spending a lot of points it would be better to put a standard price without to broke. another is the quest of a artifact on a stage, it wouldn't drop I already spend 2500 energy on the same level and didn't dropped. The game is awesome with some minor tweaks it would be a lot better

I will open up the game and the start will go through the tutorial. It would then force me back onto the loading screen. Only to inform me had encountered an error, and could not load. I retried the process multiple times with the same results. As well as the trouble with loading, the game was extremely laggy, causing difficult gameplay. In an attempt to find a solution to this problem I moved around. RAID also takes a ridiculous amount of time to load, causing annoyance to the players. FIX!!

Stalls too much and they don't give back the stamina. Constantly told that I only need the same rank STARS to rank up heroes. Complete lie! I have 6 4 star heroes and it won't let me rank up the hero that I want to rank up. This game doesn't have instant clear on 3 star levels. It only has multi battle mode, that you can only do so many times a day. Your heroes are on auto and they constantly battle. VERY BORING! The drop rate and rewards suck. Bundle deals are expensive and pathetic.

Decent game, very similar to Summoners War if you're familar with it. The main issue that I have is the amount microtransactions popups there are right after starting the game. Six or seven that you have to go through before you can start playing. I understand it's a F2P game, and they need to make money to keep things running. But perhaps a banner on the side of the screen that cycles through each bundle/sale package.

I've been playing for a year and will probably keep playing since there's not much else to do while all other fun has been canceled. The fundamental problem with this game though is the worst champions require the most resources to max out while obviously being the easiest to acquire. The one exception to that would be with skill books but that's a different issue in itself. Pretty sure this company's motto is "something is better than nothing, right?"

Features as wide as the ocean but as deep as a puddle. Basically comes down to auto-play and clicking "next, start" every minute (you can pay for multi-battle, which saves you from clicking, so it auto plays for 10+ minutes at a time) then break down duplicate items/characters and upgrading ad-nauseum, you can pay instead of grind, but the gameplay is still extremely boring and endlessly repetitive. Demand better games for your money.

Very expensive if fun game. Don't bother trying to contact support, they don't deal with individual customers. And can't seem to comprehend why we (as paying customers) don't like that. "It's my money" means nothing to them. The never ending pop up ads, constant crashes and insane number of uninstall/reinstall, try agains make pc platforms impossible.

After a short period where the game wouldn't let me log in at all, I'm finally back in. What I will say is that if you like the gacha style of strategy game then you'll enjoy this well enough. The more fantasy oriented visual style is a nice departure from cartoonish and anime styles. However, like most games of these types, it's a grind fest with abysmal drop rates that tries to throw as many pop ups for bundles and microtransactions at you as possible.

I can't connect to plarium id to get back what I had before, and I can't even play this game even though I'm connected to internet. The only time it doesnt give a connection error is if I'm connected to wifi, so I'll barely be able to play, because apparently data connections don't work. I tried contacting support but whoever answered obviously didn't even bother trying to actually help. That is if it even was a person and not just a machine generated response.

The games is fun but it has a problum almost all the characters look the same just look at the ogre tribe they all basically look the same but with some slight modification you can find cases like this for every faction. Also the amount of times I get a pop up to buy somthing is kind of annoying I get they need to make money but the pop ups are constant and annoying.

Mostly fun, crashes and freezes often. Be prepared for a grind and heavy pay to win wall. Edit: My rating is more based on the crashing. I have an up to date new model Android, and don't have this issue on any other game. I've lost many clan keys and battles due to a freeze mid battle. I don't mind a grind but the performance issues weigh on my rating.

Making dungeons is really really slow! Even when you are x2 speed it takes more than 3 min to kill 3 waves of enemies. No "fast raid" function - you choose the repeat number and wait (leave rhe phone awake and in the app) to finish - better plugged in couse the battery will die soon enough. The raids are unbalanced - in one you reach stage 9 and with the same team in other is stage 2. Non-stop pop-ups of offers to buy and no option for "don't show today" and they are one after another!

Limited fun. Takes about 2 weeks and you realize the game has taken over your life with the constant need to power level and farm for items but the sad part is that you need to actually play every battle(auto play is ok only if you're much stronger than your opponents). Even Heroes 3 had the option to auto fight without actually showing the fight(and the AI fighting for you was surprisingly good). Not worth losing my mind constantly playing the game just to be low-medium player.

The game after 2 hours of play is pretty fun and well thought out. There's an obscene amount of popups for microtransactions. I wouldn't knock off stars for ingame advertisements if they weren't full screen and if they didnt pop up back to back before I can even switch screens or accept the next tutorial quest. Overall a fun game though.

I do not have a "Download Booster" that is not the issue. This App needs better maintainence and updates. Been trying for a couple hours to connect. It connected once over 25 tries but, it crashed after 5mins and still can't connect. I've turned off and restarted phone. I uninstalled app and restarted my phone. And, I've checked my in-home Wi-Fi and that was not the problem.

Love the game but if you are not paying you end up just leaving the phone with the game running on autoplay which defeats the purpose because you're not actually playing. It's impossible to compete with people who pay because the chance of getting 3 star hero is low and even lower for 4 and 5 starts. Leveling up is very time consuming and repetitive if you're not paying. To get your hero to 5/6 stars you need massive amount of time and low star heroes which is more of repetitiveness & autoplay.

was a 5 star for the first 6 months, as of today i cannot play on PC. seems to get stuck on loading server configs until it times out. i have spent a lot of money and time on this game for it to just stop working after this long. I have also contacted support, to witch they wanted me to download bloatware. The problem is cross platform. It isn't my computer.

Game looks great but gameplay is incredibly boring. It starts out exciting but that quickly diminishes. I'd highly recommend playing free for a week before deciding if it is the game for you and paying money into it. Feels like there are too many factions, like it was an attempt to have something for everyone. Good idea, bad execution. Gacha system is also very odd, not at all something I was ever excited for. Not sure what keeps players around. Not for me.

This game is horrible the way they beg for money!! You can't load the game without 7 windows popping up to sell you something, also it is way too hard to get good characters. Game is really bad. EDIT: I am not referring to the "notifications" I am referring to when you are in the game and have to click out of literally 7 windows just to play. Also you have to spend $30 on a legendary shard for a 3% chance at a legendary character?? Ridiculous!!

Love the game, but the fact that I spend lots of money on the shard packages to get good characters and all I get is really low ranked ones is not cool. I'm sure there are many players who feel the same way, and spend a good amount of money as well. You guys make it difficult to get Epic or legendary characters, even when there are summoning events. 👎👎👎

Decided to check this out after seeing so many ads from this game. I was almost driven away after a few minutes by constant bombardment of popups and offers. Then when I tried to unequip an item from a unit I noticed that it costs in game money, which is unappealing to say the least. I had almost 200.000 money and wanted to spend that on summoning two heroes, 100k each but in addition to that it requires some rediculously expensive shard thing. That was it for me.

Solid game. Lots of content and minimal progression obstacles. My main complaint is that the rate for obtaining legendaries versus time/money spent is beyond out of proportion. Once a month I get a 6% chance of a legendary from a legendary shard, or around $60-100. I would spend money on shards if it wasn't such a waste of my limited income.

I was going to give this game a shot, it looked good and had some motifs that I enjoy, even though dark elves and high elves make me cringe. However just looking at the menu sickens me, and a mediocre overly simplified turn based battle system with a rock-paper-scissor dynamic is not going to hold me though a abismally long tutorial, only to end up in a gacha game with all the worst possible fermium engagement tatics. RAID: Shadow Legends could have been more but more doesnt make money, right?

Possibly one of the best games out of there... Still trying out the game since I'm a new player before committing to any in game purchases of any kind....
