Edit: I decided to delete this app off my phone with this game constantly bombarding me with adds trying to get me to spend money everytime I open the game and absolutely ZERO chance of scoring a Legendary Character without spending money... Also, this game is just not built for a casual player who actually has a life... Time to say goodbye...

Terrible game. Super pay to win, gear's locked behind several layers of rng, & even if you get the gear you want upgrading it is heavily rng based. There's the norm that gear might roll poorly on perks as you level it up but there's also a failure chance for upgrading it that increases at higher levels. Upgrading a single piece of gear for one unit could easily cost 1m in game currency. It'd cost about $25 to buy that much of the currency. There's 9 gear slots per unit & 5-6 units on a team...

Would've given 5 stars if not the pop up offers everytime i open the game. The leveling process is awful as well, some young players might die of natural causes without seeing their champions at level 6. Other that that this is pretty amazing game :) Update after several month into the game: The progress after the initial month is slower extremely slow to the point where it is getting really boring. I get that you want to milk that cow as much as you can, but this is how you loose players...

Really annoying. Don't get me wrong the gameplay is decent and the graphics are really good but the push notifications are broken and never right. Also by far the most annoying thing is every single time you login it has to spam literally every sale in the real money shop at you before you can even interact with the game. It's incredibly intrusive to have to minimize seven different pop ups every time I open the game. There's advertising then there's begging and browbeating

The game was fun at first but slowly became the same old grind constant with minimal reward. It wouldnt have been bad if you could upgrade the equipment far cheaper. Had 14 mil silver and upgrading to level 12 on a few champs equipment chewed it right up. I gave up as i couldnt keep up with the upgrades any more. The ascending got ridiculous too. So much dungeon grind time and hardly any potions. Yep, i even looked at buying some packages, what you get for the price is laughable. Uninstalled.

Fun game, the only reasons I didn't give it 4-5 stars is because 1) there's just way too much pay to win and more importantly 2) almost everytime you open the app it displays a MINIMUM of 3 game ads for "special deals" that are ridiculously expensive. Like yeah, you gotta make money off of this but they're really just shoving it down your throat.

Thoroughly unimpressive. I refused to try out this game for the longest time due to the super annoying ads, but finally decided to give it the benefit of the doubt. The game lived up to the ads, in that it is as unpleasant to play as they are to watch. "The most ambitious RPG project of 2019". More like "Most grossly over-advertised waste of space application of 2019".

Gameplay is actually pretty fun. But getting new characters is slow grind. Unless you pay! But my #1 biggest issue is the "bundle" spam. Holy %#*@ at least 5 ads for in game bundles when logging in. Or returning from missions... or even sometimes just going to into view gear. I'd have stuck it out and maybe tried some endgame. But it's honestly annoying and makes a decent game unbearable. Last nitpicking issue... your screen is filled with little icons flashing and with timers. What for? ADS

Feel like it became Pay to Win. Can't get out of Bronze Tier even with half of my team 6 starred. Soon as you open the app you got 20 ads asking for money for armor sets, thats the worst. Haven't been able to get anywhere despite having the game for over a year. Considering deleting the game, I was addicted at first but now its just another app I can't get further in. Definitley requires strategic thinking and proper grinding to get your team where you want to be.

It's a bad game, let's just get that out of the way first. The Story: Uninspired, you'll literally be playing on it less than you shop on the shop screen/click away the shop's ADs. The Characters: Just diffierent suits of armor with different colors. PVP: The PvP is horrendous, literally 2/3 of the people their have Max Star Units and even worse their legendary character drops are 0.5-5%! Nearly impossible to get them. And it's even worse, because they're ridiculously expensive to buy them.

Game is a absolutely money consumption sink whole, that clearly has a big budget behind it only to push you microtransactions. They say the game is balanced to reward people who spend time, but really the game is a test of multi systems that drain you of your resources and time in order to make all the pop-ups for "discounted" bundles more enticing. Stay very far away from this game, and seriously question the credibility of any YouTuber who tries to sell you this game, it ain't worth it.

Locked up and crashing most of the time and then they post a little box saying that they're going to do something about it but they don't, and I'm on Samsung Galaxy Note 8 by the way. There should be no problems. They lock you out with time constraints and if you don't want to spend money then forget having fun after the beginning stages. I don't like being told I have to wait two or three days for too many locks! This game is a money grabber and waste of time. Good idea but bad design.

It's OK but it's more focused on being a money grab and torturing F2P. It would be better if we had more than 2 energy refills since everything takes so much energy to do. For instance getting 1 6* character requires a whole week of grinding XP with limited energy and 720 1* characters. That's right, 720 1* characters!!!! Please do something to make it a little more easier for F2P

Dear RAID developers, i really enjoy your game and have spent many hours on it already but now i have run into a wall where i can't enjoy it as much. The main problem for me is that i feel like i can't get anything done with the amount of energy that is given. I can easily burn through the daily and weekly bonus energy in a hour or less if I'm not careful. But i feel like this could be an easyish fix if you adjust the base amount of energy you have to use and or lower how much it takes to battle

Its not bad, good way to pass the time when there is nothing else to do. But it really is pay to play or your not getting anwhere anytime soon. I also am not a big fan of the item upgrade mechanics where as you level the item the chance of it failing to upgrade is higer also. Nothing like spending 10,000 on an item six times before it upgrades. The devs need to make that better and make it more fair so that people who dont wanna spend can still get better warriors for upgrading.

The game seemed fun. Only played it for about 2.5 hours before I found the login function. I did that to hopefully save my game from one device to another and then it started me over. So I logged out to see if I could get my previous game back, and it starts me over again. I suppose 2.5 hours isnt a huge investment, but it is very discouraging. So if you have an account, log into it before you so anything, cause you will lose your time otherwise.

Starting out the game is great. However after gearing a few legendaries I realized that the amount of resources and time it takes to level, aquire masteries, gear, and book. I discovered it wasn't worth the money. The legendaries I got were bad but they legendaries wooo.. I was excited. I quickly found out that it was a waste, the chanpions were barely viable. The exact price varies on getting champions up to raiding standards, its easy to spend 300 dollars for one champion!

So, I had this game for almost 6 months. I have 6 lvl 60s and doing pretty well since I don't buy in app purchases. But I hit the pay wall!!!! I was at the part in the missions where I need to lvl up in the arena to silver, guess what everyone in the arena is super overpowered and has multiple legendaries. I could not advance and I WILL NOT PAY FOR IN APP PURCHAES!!!!! I DELETED THE GAME, WHAT A WASTE OF TIME.

I tried this game a year ago and forgot why I uninstalled it, so I tried it again recently. It was the constant barrage of forced ad pop-ups. There's no way to say "Don't show until next login" like literally every other game that relies on pop-ups to hawk their goods. Every. Single. Time. You return to the main screen it's a pop-up... We need at least a checkbox to say Go Away until next login. The gameplay itself is good which is a shame but there's way too many pop-ups.

Great potential but currently not ftp the game has great mechanics and awesome graphics plenty of different summons etc.... but free to play simply is a slog at best the rewards for a free to play player is terrible every resource is super limited... i am not one to not spend money on a game that's how they pay their bills but i can't play a game that has no viable way to be free to play and this one simply does not. hope that changes.  Reply-  All content in the game can be acquired by playing for free but NOT in a meaningful way.... in comparison to other gatcha games i feel this one is the least rewarding.... but yes all items can be obtained through  ftp at least 1 of any particular item that is.

Pay to proceed... Level up, just to level up?... Like everybody else has stated it is definitely a pay to play game. Beautiful graphics very in-depth character... builds, almost to the point of exhausting. Definitely a game more suited to those with deep pockets and limitless time to grind and grind.. it's a mix of Diablo, world of Warcraft meets Lord of the rings.. all the characters look like their modeled from one of those three.. same with the story line.. good gameplay..

Same tired gameplay seen in a hundred other games before this one. Laggy unskipable tutorial , as soon as its over prepare for about ten pop ups telling you about this and that "special deal" asking you to spend tons of cash inmediately. Also the playstore says the game is about 90mb, it isnt, as soon as you open it, it tells you that it needs to download 600mb worth of data, and by the time it was done there was over 1GB of space taken up by the game. Also didnt give items from the video promo.

The gameplay itself is okay, and you won't get a ton of ads. In fact, you'll have hardly any that aren't related to the game itself, and those aren't frequent. However, the game is extremely pay to win. There are so many options to get ahead if you are willing to spend absurd amounts of cash on this game. You have to grind a ton just to even have a chance at competing with players like that. I had it for two years and only got two legendary heroes after thousands of total draws.

Could easily be a 5 star game if there wasnt log in issues almost every 3 days. When you go to submit a form you need your in game ID which cant be accessed unless you can log in. I've spent a lot of money on this game. I've seen other games compensate for consistent issues like this but the customer support for this game is lacking to say the least. Canned responses and vague explanations with no compensation for development issues is not a good way to keep people from playing consistently.

The core components of this game are some of the best in a mobile game. Its a lot of fun. Collecting champions and powering them up is cool along with the 5 modes. However, the micro-transaction spam is atrocious. Everytime you login 4 ads pop up with "deals" on in-game items. I get that it makes money but if I want to spend my money on a game I will. Spamming me around every inch of the interface just pisses me off. That is my major complaint.

The most grind heavy game I have ever played. Making people do the same thing over and over is not content, its just boring and repititive. Put over 100 dollars into the game, just for the progress to stall as if I wasnt paying. And every time you start the game, be ready to close out over 5 advertisements. Even if you've already put money into the game.

So, in my short time of playing this game for 20 minutes, 10 of which were of loading screens. The game itself is very good, it just needs to be optimized for performance. I even used a third-party app to boost its performance, and even then loading screens took a while. Also I wish there were settings to be able to comfortably run this game on my LG Fortune 2, which is normally able to adjust frame rate to improve gameplay, but can't for this game. It's amazing, but the loading is too much.

good game but it crashes from time to time and i have difficulty getting in at other times. needs more work and more servers for the large amount of players. was good after your service of the servers but still having trouble can't play won't load again. it has come to my attention that the difficulties i have been having are from my service not the game.

To progress in this game you have to spend money, and not just a little bit but hundreds of dollars. The game is fun for about a month until you realize it will take years to accomplish something you can buy. Shards sure if you pay the game for 3 hours a day every day you get a handful of shards a month, but what about the books. Books are extremely hard to come by for free to play and silver too. The great hall which could take literally years to upgrade with how the arena is currently.

It's a really fun game BUT....... you can only get so far. This game is not one you can play everyday and make it your get away like KOA and others. The market place is a joke the offerings are irrelevant to progression so you find yourself stuck around stage 5-7 at every battle. You don't even have the option to purchase things like spheres or Epic 4 star heroes. This sucks because without them you're going nowhere so you might as well play something else. This game could've been great.

Probably the best version of this game that exists out there. But, it is definitely an entirely different game for free and paid users. Free users, even after months and months of dedicated gaming, will be lucky to have more than a couple non-free legendaries, or even max-level characters for that matter. I enjoyed it, but ultimately stopped playing because the grind was too intense for too little payoff.

I did not play this game and my "review" couldn't be any lower. I don't usually do these but. I'll not waste time telling the story but to sum it up my credit card was used to make unauthorized in game purchases. And the company said they will not refund the money lost because the in game items were used. What kind of bull is this company running. Asked them to delete the account and refund my money but the only response given was that the decision was final....... Thanks...

I love the game but it's so disappointing to not get premium characters easier or to not get more free gifts. The gifts that matter like major upgrades etc. Not energy etc. They need to do more of those log in daily to get a premium character! It's too expensive! I'm sure I've spent a good $500 if not more cumulatively, which is ridiculous. And I have it on numerous devices, it's so good, fantastic graphics and gameplay but I really wish they had a bit more variety

The game is moderately fun, but the constant popup ads for in app purchases are shameless and irritating. I understand that the developers need to make money, but I literally got 9 popups after finishing a mission, one right after another. It's far too frustrating to constantly tap through, I'm uninstalling the game. If they get their act together, I'll consider reinstalling and changing my rating in the future. EDIT: In response to the publisher's comment, I have tried dismissing the in game popups, but they keep coming up after every mission. If they were just Android notifications I could disable them in the system settings (which I almost always do for any game that I install), but as they are built into the game, I don't have that luxury.

The game is funand good design, but it is a time suck. Should be able to speed things up to 3x or 4x and have some auto complete options. Also the fact you can not farm books is ridiculous Finally the void shard system needs to be better... they are rare (and expensive if you purchase) but only give you same chances as a stupid blue shard.

I downloaded and played this game through another game to earn credits. It gives you one week to upgrade your character to level 5 in order to get credits. I upgraded my main character to a level 5 in five days and they declined that I achieved it with a screen shot. Don't waste your time with this game as its confusing and only wants you to waste your money. A lot of money at that.

Far too many ads. More ads than gameplay. Edit: it's not from time to time, it's all the time. First 20 min of a game was 10 min of closing ads who pops uo over the game, over and over. Deals can be viewed at shop, but instead ads interrupt gameplay which is why it's is simply no good. Edit: in doing so you are driving away some of new players and getting these ratings. Don't be surprised by counteraction of yours action. What happend 2 previous times review got removed, deep pockets, huh?

Okay pay to win game. Good graphics. I like the characters and the different things you can do. Wish you could auto blitz all dailies in batches. You will like the game if you are a character collector and you have good random roles. Otherwise it is a money sink like most games only about 10 hero's are really good. I refuse to spend money on a chance to get a good hero. Is that not the definition of gambling. Idk. Whatever.

Could be great but my God so many ads it's insane. was okay at first but never slowed down. but honestly the worst thing about it...the events. near impossible unless you pay for stuff to even come close to complete it. please take a note from Summoners War and make events accessible to all players and reason they continue playing, not just make them a quick cash grab to suck as much money out of people as possible. thanks. Prob wont be back because they are so bad.

Very well done graphics and characters for a mobile game, truly beautiful. BUT , like in the hundreds of reviews pure pay to win. Even if you accept your place at the bottom of the swamp, there still may be some joy. BUT, hours and hours in auto - jumping around ? I mean , no quiq combat for already won battles? After spending 30$ - more or less, I just don't have time for this one.

The advertising is so annoying that i don't want keep playing. To start off the game you have to spend 1 minute closing annoying pop up advertisements for in game items. All you have to do is let me know with a dot on the shop button that there is something new. As for the game it's so far, ok. The graphics are good even when i turned everything down. Not sure about the storyline.

Fun game so far. Edit, have been playing for a while now and my only complaint is the amount of ads that pop up when you login. It's annoying how much they try to sell you in game packs. This is a grinding game that ypou can activly play for a while or let it run while you do other things. There is lots to do and they're expanding all the time. I threw a couple bucks to support them getting the raid pass which gives you extra money and experience. Overall a well designed game. Game freezes alot.

The game is good I only wish I could turn the chat feature off when I want to. The tutorial is okay but could be more in depth for people who are not used to this type of game. The graphics are very good. Though I am playing on my pc thru Bluestacks. I am also not a person who uses hard earned cash to pay for things in games. So unless you wish to, this is a test of patience. Though I have done quite well so far. Even though the fantastic graphics are far superior & better appreciated on the pc.

Game art is top notch, unfortunately that is the only thing that is. Development has been dismal as they release software updates that are poorly tested requiring many revisions and frustration for players. Arena was kind of Fun then they "fixed it", cheaters are still cheating but now it is harder for most to advance. "But do not worry", they say. "We will make a major release where we triple the existing broken system just be cause it will apear like we are adding new content". A lot of the Arbiter missions are outdated and by the time you get her, you won't need her. It is clear that everything is geared to get you to spend money. Which normally I would not have a problem with except most event cater to whales (big spenders) and I've gotten to the point that without whaling out I cannot enjoy most parts of the game.

The game offers a good range of battle types and a suitably complex range of upgrade paths and equipment. The greatest downfall is it requires some serious grinding to level up characters. With no option to skip battles, you end up watching the same battle over, and over, and over again when you know it is a guaranteed win. This, unfortunately, will likely lead to uninstalling sooner rather than later.

After seeing the 'goat' anniversary commercial on You-tube five dozen times, I decided to download. Couldn't collect any of the advertised rewards for joining, but it did give me some rando armor set so I guess that's fine >, already getting ready to uninstall anyway. Had a nice opening but everything afterward is the same generic stuff found in literally a hundred other games. No story, nothing to do but PvP arena battle's, Clan boss fights, and a billion worthless upgrades that do nothing ga.

Have to say love all aspects of the game. As it is fresh, I do hope there will be more variety of things to do. Side Note, month in and yet to have a Legendary. 3 Sacred shards in, no legendary. The rng is cringe. Also would be 5 stars but the Missions glitches and makes you re-grind and re-upgrade gear even if you have it to progress to next part. Love the toons and effects, and beautifully made game. Lots of potential. For someone who is not a fan of Turn Based; Love It!

I would give this game 1*, but I still actively play it. There isn't a lot of content, progression in this limited content is restricted behind huge time sinks or pay walls (your choice), and the dupe system is garbage. If you get a dupe, it can be fused to another copy to increase a RANDOM skill's level by 1. Most champions need 10+ of these. Now, you can get around that with books, but they are very difficult to acquire. 2/10, too many bottlenecks, not enough content, whaling required.

Charged my wife for purchases that she did not make. When presented with screenshots they responded that this cannot occur. Our bank statement would beg to differ. If you read their terms of service they do not provide refunds, so good luck if you get charged incorrectly. You can find further examples of this occuring with a simple google search. I don't understand how they can get away with this with impunity. Buyer beware.

It is a great game by most means. Definitely exciting and pretty much Addicting Because they got so much to do and you really do want to get higher levels in the game quick as possible, so it does Get addicting. I do like this game , but there are a lot of frustrating things in the game Sometimes very frustrating. But All and all I Give the game 4 stars Because very rarely anything is perfect . But I think they did a great job on the game to get at least 4 star. So GO FOR IT play the game!!!

I love the game I've been playing it for a while now but I had a glitch that literally took all my gear its all gone rings armor weapons that I spent lots of time upgrading and now there gone please fix this. Not sure what happened but all my stuff is back now wich is good cos some of those items I can't get again definitely glad its all back. It happened again but this time my stuff isn't coming back i clicked on the progress mission wich last time worked but other now please fix this issue.

This is just a re designed, greed filled, P2W alternate version of Idle Heroes and games like it. Completly un original and burnt out style of game. It does look pretty and have some cool looking characters though. That being said, 50% of the heroes are just re skins of other hereos. Obviously just a lack of creativity or a scheme to have more characters which lessen your odds of getting the ones you want. Do yourself a favor and skip this one.

Only been playing for 4 weeks or so. Don't approve of the 150 pop-ups you get on startup to try to get you to fork out outrageously priced packs. Don't approve of the new update and "battle pass" system like on fortnite which essentially creates a 2-paced game for those who pay 30$ a month and get surreal rewards, and those who don't. Other than that, the game's decent. Gameplay is rather entertaining, although you do need to play up to 180mn a day to get full daily rewards. Auto-battle is nice.

This game is the mother of all cash grabs! They do everything to keep the big spenders spending lots of cash and could care less about the quality or content of the game. All 'new' content since I've started is focused on the pay wall. Don't waste your money like I did to only feel trapped because you've spent so much. I'm sure some public relations person will reply to this and say they try to balance the game for f2p and spenders, but that is a LIE!!!

Extremely grindy which you will either love or hate. Definitely pay-to-win - especially in the higher echelons of PVP play and there's plenty of ads thrown at you when you first login to the game. I love this game but even for me - the grind has gotten to be too much to remain enjoyable. I've had a great time on the way though. Clans are where the real meat of the game is. Join one or suffer through solo!

The game is pretty entertaining but the servers are very slow most of the time. Lots of lag and needed to reload or reboot the entire system to get back in after frequent freezeups (and I have had my system thuroughly checked by a certified computer service agent). The game itself seems totally geared to maximize profit for the company. I have nothing against businesses making a profit but when the poor item drop level reaches what's in the game, I think I could get much better odds in Vegas.

Listen I like this game dont get me wrong. But the thing that kills my interest is that I like to see physical progression with my characters. For instance when I equip gear, I will see that change on the character. Or if I level them up they get a appearance change. All I'm saying is if you guys are gonna put so much effort into ads, then please help me and so many others by doing this one simple thing. I mean I could probably make all the gear in unity for Pete's sake in just over a month.

Extreme pay to play... good luck getting anything good without a high limit credit card. And if you buy sacred shards to get something good there's still little chance of getting what you'd expect for your money. Don't come into this game expecting to be the best unless you pay a lot. Adds for purchases are annoyingly constant in navigating tasks. And doing anything costs a resource, to which is usually very limited as it is. That said, it is a fun time killer and the champions are interesting.

I've enjoyed this game for quite some time, but in the last few weeks, it has become virtually unplayable. Characters mysteriously vanishing without a trace, unexplained crashes in battles (right after you start, taking the clan boss key) and no answers to support tickets. The Discord forums have all been changed to have insanely long slowmodes (30 minutes in #bug-reports). I played this game for a year, but I'm done. Problems happen, it's how a company deals with them that tells you everything you need to know.

Made a month raid card purchase and it worked great for 1.5 weeks. Then it just stopped. I've had issues with gameplay before where Awards would not post correctly. Each time I submit a ticket that was met with an auto response and no resolution. Same thing happened when I submitted a ticket about my purchase. No refund and no raid card. :/ Buyer beware.

Decent game but it has its issues. I like the character collecting and building but everything else is kinda representative of a classic grind/ pay to win game. First thing you notice is this game has random loot drops, which is absolutely ridiculous when you see what they try and charge for loot crystals and even worse when you realized that the 5 sacred shards you just bought for 100$ only has a 6% chance to give you a good item and even less a chance it will be the item you want.Not worth it.

Honestly, I am addicted. Can't believe that I am because I generally IGNORE games sponsored so heavily (Speaking of which, I would love to get a sponsorship for my channel). The only thing that sucks is that my Amazon Prime got attached to an account that I lost when I was trying to create a proper account. Didn't get a response in the emails. Guys, I'd love to get that squared away. Anywho...love the game, still playing it. Leveling up my guys by good old grinding. May even get a subscription for the 9.99 a mo. Get that amazon prime thing fixed and I may just have smack down an extra star for that coveted 5 star rating.

starts out promising enough, however the game eventually hits a wall of grinding that is insanely tedious to the point its obvious the game devs want you to start paying money so you can proceed. Real shame, as the game has quality graphics, art and sound and eary gameplay is enjoyable. Edit: Im not disputing it is possible to get everything free, only that the process to do so is tedious and not fun.

Like some cool type of auto chess, some of the prices in this game are over the top way overpriced, but I guess that's how they control the economy of the game, I wouldn't mind buying some things but the value you get isn't worth it. I wish the arena and content was more diverse it gets really repetitive after awhile and it's annoying when I find a hero I like but cannot upgrade them beyond their basic skills. I wish I could design my char that had the appearance skills and abilities I choose.

I only just started playing a week ago so keep in mind I haven't been playing long enough to give a decent opinion. I like everything about the game so far with one exception, and that is the being bombarded with offers on the screen. It's annoying how the second you load in, they just keep popping up. I think a red dot on the Shop tab is sufficient, or you could find a different way to advertise new offers in the game.

I loved this game and played for years. Now, though, they give me adds saying "come back and receive x hero, x supplies, etc." I go back and click where it says to receive the hero and items and it says I'm not eligible. I submitted a ticket with screenshots and recordings and they just stopped answering. Ticket ID# 3907126 Rep ID# 26719764 I can't reply. Your rep made it so I couldn't, and also said that was all they could do, and they were sorry if I wasn't happy with the results.

There is no actual game. Just a formal placeholder for it. There is no actual PvP - just a static placeholder of just another "kill four NPCs". But a lot of monetization, you can buy anything but an actual gameplay or at least client stability. Updated: generic response, not related to the problems mentions. There is no "hard" or "easy" gameplay, as there is no gameplay whatsoever.

TOO. MANY. ADS. I haven't spent any money on this game (best/only way to play) and as long as I'm constantly forced to skip through dozens of shamefully expensive pay-to-play ads everyday- I NEVER will. Tragic, as the game is actually very good. But the disgusting micro transactions earn the would-be 5 star game a 1 star. Plarium Games, you should be ashamed. Pathetic.

I understand that you guys need money, but the way you advertise the cash shop for new players like us is not a good first impression. Although, I have to say the graphics look good and it needs spectacular effects especially for higher rarity heroes like epic seven does. Overall a good game, will see how it turns out later. Update: the effects are very dull for such high quality graphics, it's such a waste as I was expecting spectacular moves especially for epic or higher rarities.

For the second time, losing your account for no particular reason. I have 2 step verification and proof of purchases of much money on IOS, Android, and PC. They are unable to locate my account. All because I changed my computer and had to reinstall. Good graphics don't make a game. The service and reliability also comes to play when expecting money from your players. If you want to play, don't spend money or rely on an account to be there if you ever get a new phone, etc..

Bugs! Inventory will disappear randomly. You get wrapped up in this thing and then stuff just starts disappearing. The game hangs and crashes a lot too. They given out a lot of silver and other goodies to compensate for the problems but it's gotten to the point that it really isn't worth the time. Also the screenshots are misleading. Equipment on hero's has no bearing on the physical appearance in game.

Great looking game, with 0 support. Updates are far and between which lack almost any content. For the past 4 month I personally witnessed 1 update with very little to give other than introducing 1 more level of campaign that most people either can not do or never bother to repeat/farm after doing it once. The ridiculous prises are another negative point, even though I spent lots of money myself that drive to spend is gone, it is simply pointless as there is nothing new to spend. Solid 1 star.

I play the game for about 1 hour and this game is boring as heck. I play many boring mobile games before but this game is just a no for me. This game is absolute trash. It pay2win. Everytime you start up the game pop up will appear, hey we got a limited time pack for you for only & 9.99. One thing I found most frustrating about it is that you have to use silver to remove item from your champion.

Horrific game. All drop rates are abysmal, advancement materials rarely come in, once you get into the mid game you're gonna suffer from energy, high grade units are so game changing it's not even funny, the story goes nowhere and develops nothing, some UIs often feel unpolished, heroes are forced to be "unique" so text walls from skills feel overwhelming. It could be something playable, with the niche graphics though (forget about the animations). Alas, too much money for your own good, 22/100

I really want to like this title, but it has been very rough experience. World chat is very toxic and negative, it's telltale how this game is like. Gameplay is not generous, there's hardly any rewards to unlock via quests or anything that would help you advance; therefore, you're immediately forced to spend real money. Dungeon difficulty for beginner is near impossible to complete, I've already hit several road block for normal campaign. In conclusion, this game is just not for me.

Breaks Moto phones: forced my apps into a crashing loop where the only fix was restarting my phone to buy myself enough time to delete the app(which i had to do 3 times, since it reinstalled itself twice). I was only able to play for a few minutes due to this, and in those minutes, I could tell the high praise this app was getting as 'near perfect' was undeserved: completely overrated for basic, unoriginal gameplay. Don't buy into the hype Edit: Not gonna get an emulator for a game i didnt enjoy

When I opened the game it worked fine but the more I played the more it caused my phone issues. When the characters talked it crated a high pitched whirring sound, and then all of my phone's processers stopped working. I could not longer load anything and had to restart my phone and delete the game. From what I was able to play I enjoyed but it doesn't seem to be very mobile friendly.

I'll do 2 stars, seems like decent early game, but (not kidding here) every time you go to your base there are 4-7 offers to buy stuff you have to manually close SERIOSULY, you often have to close 5 "sales" just to go back to a menu that has more "sales" Edit: thank you for a response that ain't a bot, but to explain more detail on the popups. When you have more than 1 screen for sales, it activates more of the gambling addicts and such, and more erroneous buying.

Made the mistake of logging in with facebook and losing the stupid account I started with. Then it made me run through the opening again and I had lost all the rewards I was SUPPOSED to have from following a link. Not happy. Very annoyed. Update:At least the developers respond quickly. I still won't be redownloading it due to the fact that from what I could see,the game is just like all the others in this genre,but with better graphics and the addition of cutscenes. In other words,pay to win

Very good graphics.. too good for phone's though. Lagging after every combat turn and disconnecting after every fight! Maybe toning down the background graphics would help, but I don't think I have the Extreme patience it would take to play this on a phone. It has the potential to become an awesome game .. I tried it in order to get gems for another game and if it didn't lag or crash .. I would have probably forgotten about the other game entirely!

This game started out ok but then you realize to advance is impossible unless you spend 1000's of dollars. Everything you have to do cost something.. And every level up cost even more. They have been promising gifts during the outbreak but instead have just taken away rewards and made gameplay worse. As I said it started off interesting but unless you plan to spend all your time figuring strategies just move on. Finally took it off.. It was like they purposely made it harder to advance after thi

Played for over an hour. Enjoyed the game but started to get tired of the bombardment to purchase. Ended up uninstalling it because it is a HUGE space drain. Almost 4GB of space required for this game. That is absolutely insane. If you can develop a lite version (maybe keep the multiplayer and campaigns separate) then I would revisit this.

The game is enjoyable but it gets to a point where either you have to grind out leveling up champions for weeks/months on end or spend a bunch of money to do so. It would be nice to get champions a little faster and have the option to possibly buy champions with silver and/or gems. I am not a huge fan of the randomness when it comes to getting your champions, I think the players should be able to select which champions they want based on the color of the shard they use.

Interesting game, but turns into a grindfest 2 hours after you start playing. You breeze through chapters 1 to 3, and half of 4 before the difficulty spikes beyond reasonable. You can however spend absurd amounts of money to make it easier, and they don't shy on telling you about it. Skip this one, don't be fooled by the nice looks.

This could totally see myself purchasing the game but all the in game purchases is too much. I'm a fan of earning and unlocking. I hate the buy your way to the top style of play. I rate this game 3 stars: game play alone would be worth a 5star rating, and the idea of earnings that you win after battles and quest, makes the game worth it. But the earnings are more "miss" and "hit" so It really puts the players who buy at an advantage. The pop ups to buy things is annoying. So - 2 stars.

The graphic are great but character collection in abysmal mostly all you get is uncommon and common characters with a very VERY small chance of getting rare characters and that's just crystal based. On top of all the it will cost you to get you gear up once to get it to level 11 it can and will take up to 10 tries before getting it to lvl 12 and that's around 25 to 30k in currency for the game. They need to fix this like the creators of Heir of Light did to make this game more fun.

Pop ups to buy stuff when starting up the game is super annoying. You have to go through about 10 of them before you can actually play the game. On the other hand. This game is for the whales with lots of money to spend to get different and heroes to play with. Edit: Plarium Global Ltd. Thanks for your reply on "you can close these offers" I will rather not play your game then having to close these offers every single time I open the game.

Gross pay to win, non-stop in-your-face advertising, the graphics are nothing out of the ordinary, I could not detect any RPG elements and gameplay is so repetitive and boring that they had to add an autoplay button. Addendum: thanks for the canned response. If that's true then remove the 6+ nag screens to buy advantages for up to 60$ a pop. But even if you do that it still remains a mediocre copy of previously published turn based RTS. This game offers nothing new. It's a whaler, nothing more.

Great game for about 3 months. After that you'll be spending A LOT of money to advance. In game items are extremely hard to get without spending money. Plarium, the developer, absolutely sucks. They only cater to the whales. They DO NOT LISTEN to their players. I've been playing for over a year and have had enough. Uninstalling after I set my arena defense team to a single bully.

Having fun so far! I really enjoy the character designs and factions. The grind is strangely enjoyable and I like building my collection. However, there are large parts of the day where there is absolutely nothing to play in the game because of the energy system. I hope this changes later in the game when max energy is higher, and advanced quests are more attemptable.

Pretty addictive! 2 suggestions, 1. (probably impossible but would make this game over and beyond any others) put the gear on the champions. We spend so much time gearing them up, would be frickin awesome to see the champions wearing the gear we selected for them. 2. In artifact upgrades, would make it much faster to have a toggle option to move through the gear while upgrading. Having to "X" out every time to switch artifacts to upgrade definitely slows 🐌 it down. But this is being very picky

Fun and entertaining to play at first and then makes a sharp downward turn towards redundancy and "have to pay" to advance. Plus, Amazon Prime is expensive as hell and you can't get any awesome characters without the developers of this game ramming a Prime "free trial" down your throat. Save yourself the headache and move on to the next, more entertaining game. Oh, Dima...do the devs seriously pay one person to read the player reviews and post an excuse (I mean "reply")?

The game is fun but I went from 4-1* for it seeing as the further you go the larger the pay wall. I am just under a month and have yet to get any legendary cards, which are best & get if you pay money or play 1 month (every day) and just 3 epics 2 week play. If you play free expect to reach about 3 weeks and the grind quadruples without pay. Plan on paying at least $20.00 if you want to enjoy for the few weeks it has left, my clan already quit. this was a money grab and beyond too many bugs.

Its EXPENSIVE!! Its a good game but the in-app purchases is way too expensive. To have "good" character champions, you need more than luck to aquire them. The champion buying mechanic is mediocre. Constantly crashing. And, as mentioned before, EXPENSIVE!! The level up is annoying as I'm stuck on level 28 for 240+ days. If you have money to burn, play this game.

EDIT: For the past couple weeks or so game been freezing every 5-10 min and a full restart is the only fix. And now theres "server maintenance " every 5 or 10 min, and lasts for 15 min.
