Was just as glitchy BEFORE todays update, and now after its almost unplayable :(..

The gameplay is not bad, though you could make a 4x speed multiplier. But the one thing that's bugging me is this game is almost exactly like summoners war and the only difference is the graphics. The main idea, the star sistem, even a lot of the champions are the same. I dont know if you collaborated or not but i think that's plagiarism.

It's a fun and good game; however, the leveling and ranking up of characters takes VERY, VERY long...it's free to play, or you can invest real money to level and rank up characters. The equipment is another leveling headache. The first four are fine, but it starts getting very expensive very quickly. If they could update and make equipment easier or less expensive to update I think it would help.

For all of this game's reputation, I expected more. Newer games have better quality of life features, drop rates, and events. It's content is poorly designed for scaling with your account level and the events are so short that it's impossible to finish any without large sums of money. I was going to try it for 90 days to get the free epics, but you'll be bored of babysitting your fights before 3 weeks.

Unfortunately this is one of those "Amazing Potential" gatcha games mired in it's own problems. While the game play itself is pretty solid, they haven't put out anything new since September. We've gone almost 6th months and the only thing they have put out as "Content" is a battle pass, and numerous balances. Nothing new for players to do as a whole. I really do like the art direction and general game play, but over all it's becoming more and more apparent they either aren't giving their dev team enough support to put things out, or just don't care because the spenders are indeed keeping them afloat at the moment. Updated to a one star because as always the updates have made the game completely unplayable.

Updating this on Dec 15th. This is still one of the greediest games ever. No benefits, tons of hurdles to jump through in order to get any rewards. There are constant popups to put absurd amounts of money into this game with little to no genuine benifit. I was offered a voide relic pack of 3 shards for 99 bucks. Such a great "deal". All of the events just throw scraps your way, you will need to spend money to keep up with the energy/coin grind that makes up all of the gameplay. Bad. Game.

Ok new review. Love this game but it is a total scam. I have 4 accounts 1 pay and 1 I spend $ on but not near as much as my pay and 2 free to play accounts. I feel comfortable saying it's a total scam. They will say it's rng and it is but it is manipulated by plarium. They manipulate the drop rates based on what u need. I have seen this most on the accounts I spend money on. I'm not going to go into detail but it's deff a scam. Free to play is slow and frustrating but seems legit.

This is actually a really good game. Creatures, gameplay, PvP, rewards, bonuses, all fantastic. So why one star? Well, the "rng" is HORRENDOUS (odds). I used over 350 green summon stones, got only 1 rare; 27 blue stones, only 1 epic. No legendary. After over 100 hours, with virtually nothing to show for it, save basic ceatures, I caved. Upgrading gear? Forget it. 100,000+ silver into a 3* gear could not get it to +12(max 16). There is a little bit more, but that it what ruined it for me.

Yes, it is as bad as you think. Don't download it. There is pretty much no gameplay, it just autoattacks through 3 waves. Endless popup spam that wants you to spend $50+ and get basically nothing in return. Shame on you for clogging up the internet with the relentless advertising. All that effort with the graphics and the game itself is a joke.

Everything is gambling. Shards are random. Upgrading equipment is random. Arena fights are guesswork because you cannot actually see stats of other teams and your team randomly won't do moves you select so you lose. Eventually it is about what character you have, or more importantly what you don't have and no way of getting any time soon since it is all luck. You feel helpless in this game and spending money won't help as everything is based on luck.

the in-game shops are super expensive, such as a chance to get a legendary hero is usually set at .5% per blue and purple drops. So roughly 1/200 pulls you may get a legendary hero. This only gets better with the yellow gems that bring the % to 6%, these gems are usually priced at $24.99. This is extremely outrageous, not only are they charging an exorbitant amount for these gems, the gems are not even a guaranteed legendary drop, not even a 50%. Not to mention that endgame and to progress your hero's you need sometimes multiple copies of said hero. I had 3 accounts at one point and ya, no life, and I only ever managed in a 90-day period to get 1 legendary hero to drop. I think I spent upwards of $100 over the 3 accounts. This is very wrong and I received an email about how "they are trying to add packs and bonuses for every player" and how I should change my review. I will change my review if they change their drop rates of their heroes and if they do a complete change to their pricing schemes. The gameplay is good and polished but right now and how it has been for the last few years is nothing but a money trap waiting to suck your wallet dry. The reason I don't lower the score to a 1 star is because most people don't read those. so Raid send me a screen shot of the ascendant shards, the yellow ones, at the price of $2.49 and than I'll change my review score.

Pay to play nightmare. 6+ ad screens every time you go to the home page. And that's when the game actually loads, which is less than 1/3 of the time. *edit* Don't believe the response here. I've been playing for a month and it's gotten *worse*. They should spend less time responding to reviews and more time making the game playable.

The game is awesome with lots of unique characters to play and has a lot of potential but the developer's only aim is to dish out money from players cause you really can't progress much unless you spend money. I really love the game but I'm gonna have to uninstall it unless the developer's does something about progress of the players without having to spend money.

Graphics are great. A typical PTW game which takes ages for upgrading your heroes. The most ridicilous part is, the percentage of successfully upgrading the Artifacts (aftet level 10) is notoriously low... Which makes you use up all your silver but without achieving anything. Other than that, chances of getting a epic/legendary hero is also very low. And you definitely need a lot of game time in order to upgrade. Willing to spend money on the game in a more user-friendly situation instead.

I enjoy playing the game but the prices are a bit crazy. If these developers would create a game as if it was on console and not worry about lining their pockets it would be better in my opinion. I would purchase deals if they weren't trying so hard to enpty my wallet and make it feel like the only way to get good stuff is to drop 50 to 100 dollars on 2 crystals some silver and gems to top it off.

Long-opinion: This game has great potential, and has proven that over the years I had it (3yr); But, this game is potentially worse than 'EA' sometimes when it comes down to when this game is like "I want your money" through in app purchases. Extremely egregious and upright ridiculous with A LOT of these bundles / items that is offered to buy. Short-opinion: Don't play if you like having money.

Love the game I do have few issues like how you can only have a total of 200 when there are close to 400 charecters. I like to collect so being about to potentially have all of them would be nice. Also you need to remove the need to click on the unit to get the next level in the gladiator area other wise it is a useless mechanic for the game and hardly anyone will use it. Also there needs to be a mechanic where you can upgrade the star rating on artifacts like how the characters do.

Played this game for a little a month.. it's literally pay to win... And if you don't have the money you can't get anywhere because it takes you forever... Games like this are the problem for most of mobile gaming Because unless you're paying a monthly fee you can't really do a whole lot... It's basically set up as the Diablo with money grubbing tactics. Every 15 seconds you're getting an ad saying spend money on this ! Update they claim its optional.. it's not its pay to win..

Its an interesting game, and I do like it, but it seems rather limiting at the start with things locked behind lvl requirements. Great overall. I also wanted to add that the pop ups are a bit disheartening; always popping up and in great numbers, overwhelming me as soon as I start. I understand their purpose to keep us informed but perhaps having them less encompassing of the screen would be better. Having an icon for pop ups like the rest would be so much better.

So complaints do absolutely nothing lol.. you get a message and they refer you to some Q&A forums..The graphics are nice and the game play is simple.. just a better graphics game than Summoner Wars. it's still rigged thought as you get 97% the same type of champions when you summon..each time. it's really more about defense than it is about attacking.. the ads for pay to win are constant. but you can still play for free. just takes a lot longer as in any game.. I still love Art of war 3 more tho

Spent a few hours playing, was having fun. Decided I wanted to play on my ipad too. I tried to link the accounts but it said it was already in use. So I logged out on my phone and tried to log in on iPad. Same error. When trying to log back in on my phone it sent me to the tutorial all over again. Hours spent thrown out the window all because they couldn't implement a proper log in/log out method. If I could give this 0 stars for wasting my time I would. Uninstalled on both devices.

Lots of ads in game/popups; its like running a web browser with no adblocking software. Highend is pay to win however you really have to $pay$(thousands) to beat the randomness of gearing and champion pulls compared to not paying. Not worth spending any money on the game unless you want to spend hundreds/thousands a month to get a "lead". Its a good game if you don't mind a long progression time and don't spend any money. The end game takes 6-12 months to get to so be aware. Not a quick game.

I like the game, but Plarium makes challenging timed events with good rewards; since they are challenging and timed, you complete them by the end of the event. But Plarium makes surprise maintenances at the end of them, meaning you planned to complete it, but then you're blocked from entering the game due to maintenance and unable to finish the event. So all the time and money you invested is down the drain, since Plarium has horrible planning. Would be a fun game, but it's just frustrating.

To my dismay, became slow unless you paid. I hate to be this guy, but the game was fun for the first while because I had free play. It took a while to run out. When it did, the game was insanely slow and not fun, especially when it was sooo fast before. It seemed the way around that was to pay for time/play.. If I had realized to what extent I would not have started because I actually loved playing when I could and didn't feel like I was being handcuffed to pay, although it was still an option.

Very slow game with very slow progression unless you pay huge amounts of money. Also sick of the constant "sale" pop-ups when I'm trying to play. There is a shop button if I wanted to buy something. F the pop-ups and your lame sale tactics. Some ppl are suckers for paying $1,000+ a mth on a game that will have no relevance within a few years or when they lose interest. I am not one of those ppl.

The game is pretty good but you need to spend money to play it. It is pay to win but also pay to play. You run out of energy quickly, so unless you are willing to spend real money I would not start this game. The monthly raid card is also not worth the money because you don't get enough energy to even do the 100 multi-battles. I don't mind spending money on a game but this one is excessive in cost.

Cash grab pure and simple. The game looks very good and they did a lot of work to make it look nice. Then you get to the actual gameplay and it's incredibly shallow. You can almost hear the executives talking about how to trap people in an endless loop that doesn't require them to pay too many developers. I even considered making a purchase once thinking, "maybe if I can get something good for $5 I'll but a legendary hero". The cheapest thing that has anything useful is $30! Should be illegal

The game is fun, with the exception that it is so difficult to advance characters. Even if you pay for extra content. I got to pretty much a stand still and if I wanted to advance more I would have to spend more. for barely any that's not even worth the money to spend.unless you are someone that has money to throw away without thinking twice. Basically if you want to go far in the game, deep pockets are needed. Or time which I don't have. play the game still due to regretful purchases

Plenty to do in this game. Lots of challenges, rewards and events. Purchases are way overpriced, but you can advance just fine without emptying your pockets, and thus far energy is a non issue, seeing as I keep getting rewarded and allowed more, sitting at 3,000/90 without enough time to even use it. Graphics are nice as well. Best game I've played on my phone.

The graphics are good and the game could be fun if it didn't crash or lock up after virtually every battle. I've played a lot of games with far greater graphics without any issues, but this one crashes more than any other program I've ever run on any system ever. I've tried to play the game for over a month, and the higher I get the more it crashes. Honestly, the only part of tha game that works 100% is the ads for exuberantly-priced in-game purchases. I wouldn't pay a cent for this garbage.

Has the coolest looking characters that you'll find in a game but I hate everything about the game mechanics. Very P2P and even items in game you have to pay for with in game currency, such as hero summons. It's not enough to have the summoning crystal; you also have to pay silver. Only one promo code accepted per day, combat is slow, too farmy to even upgrade a hero to an almost decent level. Not a game for me.

The game went from great to trash overnight. With the latest patch that was just released on 2/12/20, the game just kept crashing, bugs/glitches all over, and they just implemented everything for mainly heavy spender. We can see what audience they are targetting. If you dont have the expense I suggest not to start. I have made my decision to quit and I think it's the best thing moving forward. It's a gotcha type game and they dont care for their consumer needs. New players be warned..

My initial review of this game was that it wasn't bad, but I couldn't have lied harder if I tried. This game seems like it has potential until you realize the difficulty scale becomes so reliant on you paying ludicrous amounts of money into just to play past the initial story that going free to play is like giving you access too less than 10% of the game. If you are considering a free to play game, this is not it.

Couldn't log in for a week after an update. Missed out on a cvc which hurt the clan. Lost final rewards in two tournaments I was almost finished with. Once I could log in I noticed Plarium had reset server. Once again I can't log in and I'm being told it's on my end when it's not. And again right the start of a cvc. Been a full week since I reported the issue to customer support, and still can't log in. Second time I've been prevented from playing this long in the last month and a half.

Spent some money. Played for a couple months. Cool game. Bugs all my resources though, spending my silver for me. Even had a few legend champions to 6 star. Now I'm locked out of my account. I'm not sure why. I've had a few bug issues but when I ask in-game support they ask for screenshots and give me bland advice that doesn't fix the issues that I explained clearly in English. Noone screenshots everything like you're asking for. I didn't save 10 screenshots of bugs. I'm not a Beta player.

I'm an avid rng turn based gamer. This is my fave so far. The graphics and mechanics are both amazing. Like all rng mobile games the grind and small odds of the best summons are there....but it's worth it to be patient and play a bit each day. When you're a high level and continue to play it smart, you can accomplish so much more, that the ridiculous-seeming pay wall isn't relevant.

Updated... I am revising my previous review after playing the game for about 45 days now. The game is extremely fun and has tons to do to keep the game relevant and enjoyable. However for a causal gamer this may be f2p but for someone who enjoys grinding for new gear or leveling up champions as often as time allows this is not free by any means. Energy is required for most of the things you do and it is consumed very quickly and recharges slowly. Please make energy cap larger and recharge fastr

Changed my star rating from 5 star to 3 star. The game is great. The graphics are excellent and gameplay is superior to most other games of this genre. Lots of hard work has gone into making this amazing game what it is today. However, after all that praise, the game is designed to make you spend money. I'm almost ashamed to say that I've wasted around $20,000 on in game purchases and there is still so much that I'm missing out on. I would love to elaborate more but space here is limited.

New players beware. This game has been a constant let down. I've been playing for over a year, and I have yet to see true new content added to the game. They are constantly trying to catch up to other games and flat out refuse to reward the players with new content. The servers are always down and there is zero notice for anything that occurs in game. This is what it's come down to. You've earned it, now claim it.

It's a game with potential however it's littered with pay to win features mostly. When you launch the game you get a bunch of ads back to back telling you how "limited" these starter packs and the sort are with stupidly high pricing on them. This is a F2P mobile game that has microtransactions that cost more than a triple A title game which is just so greedy and outrageous. Everything costs silver to do every little thing which gets annoying because you don't make much from doing campaign.

Isn't good, at all. they said this game won some award in one of these ads, turns out they didn't, and it was one of those bait and switch things. The game is boring, its like any other turn based game, there's nothing new here. They have energy, meaning you can't play the game without waiting for it, doing this is a cheap way to raise player usage. The only reason this game survives is becuase it has okish graphics, a handful of mobile game tricks, and ads. If your bored go find something good

Great game, but if you don't have deep pockets please play something else.. The price wall in this game is astounding... Once you see a legendary book cost 25$ for 1 book. It takes 6+ to book most legendarys. Don't let the automated responses down below in the review section fool you, they have events yes, and these events offer some times good rewards.... BUT to achieve the high tier rewards you almost always have to spend money... It's a shame, yes you can FTP but don't expect to get anywhere

Pay to win money sucking leach. It's a game designed to make you spend money and the shove 4 pop-ups in your face after every battle asking for $30 each and on top of that the gameplay sucks and it very repetitive and boring. Also don't reply to me saying "we're just trying to keep players informed on limited time offers" or "it's completely optional to spend money". You know exactly what your doing

I like this game, and was just beginning to scratch the surface, when patch 1.7 hit. Now, all I get is a "cannot load assets" error. The game is literally unplayable. I would love to continue playing, but can't. Also, there is an option to submit a ticket to their tech support, but the submit button is grayed out.

There's about 50 ads that constantly pop up every single time you open the game. Literally dozens of ads begging for money from you. Every single time you open the game you have to avoid dozens of ads. Incredibly complicated and you won't make it anywhere in this game without a couple thousand dollars. Tencent really hosed you guys this time :-)

It was fun at first. But, it is no different then any other "free" game on here, plus bugs. To often I did not get items earned via challenges or events. If you want to get anywhere in this game without it being a boring grind then you will have to hit up the store to do so. And boy, every time you return to the main screen they just will not leave you alone to go buy stuff. I'd rather they be working on the bugs then trying to make me buy things. Looks great. Story is meh. To many bugs. P2W.

Do not install. I installed this game optimistically thinking it would be descent. The gameplay is allraight. The graphics is quite good actually. But then there is the adds. You'll get riddled with greedy ads, not just one, i countet 8 back to back last time i opened the game. That's a deal braker for me. p2p games should not ask that often. Insta delete on my part.

While the game remains fun, & the artwork is amazing, it's one of the worst gacha games for free play & paying customers. You can easily sink thousands into this game & have nothing notable to show for it. The events are absurdly difficult even for the best rosters. After the first few months login rewards disappear. Champions get added often, which is a good thing if most weren't so poorly balanced. Progression is hard-locked behind a huge pay wall.

Game was fun for a few days, then I realized how predatory it was when my kid started playing. They set up the systems with a fail chance, then only fail so you very quickly lose all your resources. But you have to try so you can complete tasks. Then it's pop up-palooza with offers to by those resources with real money. Also, Now I have to deal with a crying kid because the 30 real dollar legendary hero crystal I bought against better judgment produced a lower level hero you can get anywhere.

I've been playing for six months now, and I still like the game. I find myself playing it almost every day. You get some rewards for just logging in, including epic and legendary champions. The yellow shards are the hardest to come by, but by completing missions, you can earn what you need to level up your champions. I have not spent a single dime on this game, I'm just grinding to level up, earn artifacts, and gems to buy more Shards.

Played for maybe 10 minutes before uninstalling. Game uses Energy system (pay to keep playing or wait). This is a business practice that must be condemed. Also, you have to pay Silver (in game currency) to unequip items for some reason. Avoid this example of predatory gaming. (Edit: "...maintain the speed of...development...and helps to balance the game" = "don't play our game too much or it breaks before we get your money")

A pretty "game" with no gameplay. First the pros: 1. There's a huge amount of heroes in this game and theyre mostly fairly distinct (besides the ogres)2. Also the graphics are good, somewhere between psp and ps3. 3. The memes resulting from the insane ad campaign are.. Good? CONS: 1. The gameplay is horrible. It's so incredibly boring that if they never put a button in that had the game "auto-play" itself everyone would uninstall with a half hour. 2. Wait to play/pay to play model.

Mixed review. I do enjoy the game it's actually fun in many regards but it's a financial black hole! . If I'm going to spend money on a game it should be fairly compensated. Plarium wants $200 or more to get roughly 100 shards. But shards are not even really compensation for my money because the odds are sooo low for good champions. The costs need to drop!!! BY ALOT , I've stopped spending because it's a racket. I recommend no one spend until plarium permanently drops it's prices to be reasona

You have to pay silver for changing your heroes' equipments. I've never played a game that does this. Everything on this game are so expensive, those books are ridiculously expensive, they can be earned or farmed with very low chance but that's only possible if you are like a year into the game or high high level.

The game is ok, I mean graphics are neat and so are the controls but I wouldn't give it 5 stars more around 3 and maybe even 4 stars if ur into rpgs.(Based on graphics and controls alone) If you are into this game, why? The amount of in-game transactions they shove down your throat is awful, along with the consistaant crappy grinding! The idea isn't bad it's the execution, if u get rid of a few transactions and make this game more open/open world it would be pretty good!

A decently fun game, a lot of gameplay is left to waiting for time to pass if you aren't willing to shell out some cash. There are paywalls on most everything on the game, and while it does have more to do that most games of this style and the graphics are pretty good for a mobile game, I can't say I would recommend this to everybody. It is a wanna be mmo, and you may as well play a computer based mmo of you are going to pay as much as you would need to to really progress in this game.

Edit: It is not that there are not enough opportunities to get champions or shards, it's that whenever I open the game or get back to the main screen I am bombarded by at least 5+ advertisements, once the mine is unlockable it immediately requires a premium currency to unlock. I'll give this game another star because the gameplay is unique and enjoyable in of itself but is the essence of pay to win

From a 4 star to a 1 star and I uninstalled this game. The promotion on buying their special packs is absolutely ridiculous. 7 or 8 pop ups you've gotta click out of before you can even start playing. Once you hit level 25 30 progress slows right down and you'd be hard pressed to get any where without spending money. Great potential. Total money grab.

First thing to do is create a Plarium ID account in order to save your in game progress. I didn't and was never prompted to do so by any means like most other games that are a separate login from Google Play. I have spent 4 days trying to recover my account with screenshots of proof of purchases in game to the Support teams. Still no luck. Thousand (plus) dollar account and 4 months of playing gone. The game itself is fun but more attention should be given to the technicalities of the game.

Threatening content creators is a bad look (Darth), and other skullduggery around delaying new content to squeeze more money out of folks. This is an interesting game, that has unfortunately had no new content in over a year. I'd like to think they can turn it around, but new players are better off finding a game without any of this baggage.

So far it's an interesting and enjoyable game. Rating it 4/5 because of the incessant "special offer" spam. I understand supporting the developers but being bombarded with offers every minute (at fairly expensive prices too, I might add) isn't going to encourage me to do it, it's just going to annoy me to the point of eventually quitting the game. When I decide to spend actual money on it, I know where the shop is, thanks.

Despite having excellent Internet connectivity in every other game, this one freezes and disconnects from the server a lot. The chat area is full of bots. And on top of that the game is incredibly agressive about trying to get you to pay for really expensive game packs. It would be nice if their ads were only pushed once a week or even just once a day. Anyways while the game seems to be pretty well made, it seems to also be a little too "pay-to-win" to be worth supporting long term.

Good game and fight mechanics overall. Game is fun and the collection of heros is expansive. Reason for the 3 star review..it is nearly impossible to gain a legendary hero. Even if you buy the sacred shards (like i have) you still dont even have a great shot at it. Ive spent 200.00 on different shard packs and waited to use them during increase rate drop events..and still no legendary drop. That portion of the game is an absolute money grab..and it works caused i got sucked in.

This could be a great game, but there are a lot of big problems that just make it ultimately frustrating. First, that's this massive library of amazing, cool character but the problem is, it's nearly impossible to acquire them without spending actual thousands of dollars, the drop rates are abysmal, you get so many duplicates, and there is not enough ways to summon them being awarded by actually playing. It is also very time consuming to do daily activities. Hope devs make some changes

"Support" and the irony there. The game was good and i was enjoying it. Untill I bought a pack and it never showed up in my inbox. So i contacted their support team to figure out what happened. And the only info they gave me was saying "perhaps you don't remember opening and using the items." Enjoy the game but don't waste your money on this company. Buy yourself a sword it's a better purchase than one of their packs you might get.

Im having a great time with this game, but Ive been having trouble with the app not recognizing actions in the game. For example, one of the "quests" asks you to level up 6 life artifacts equipped on a rare or higher support champion, which I have done, but the game wont acknowlege this and therefore I cant complete this quest, which halts the entire questline. If I can get a resolution to this issue, I wouldnt have much else of an issue.

Walked away for a couple months, come back and update the game twice in 2 days and can't log in because the game is experiencing problems(big surprise). This game is nothing but problem after problem, no idea how they get people to continue to P2P when you can't access the content you just paid for. Don't waste your time with this game, go play Summoners War or Heir of Light you can actually play those games for free since events actually give you enough resources to continue to play them.

At first when you start playing is all good but then there is no new content since maybe one year ago, the game is not balanced and you have to spend tons of money in order to be competitive to others that spend crazy amounts, pay to win, server crashes all the time during battles. Events and tournament rewards required you to spend again a lot of money and effort and most of the time the rewards are trash. Have been playing 1 year and is the same since day 1.

Overall the game experience is a nice thing to have. This game is meant to grind and get rewarded. The biggest issues with this game are the the "pay to win" style of game. You get numerous ads everytime you go to the main screen to purchase more gear, better summons etc, which don't affect the game much. The grinding of this game is too steep and hard to feel worthwhile in playing long term. The arena is complete trash even in bronze tier etc causing you never to move on mission wise.

It's a standard mobile turn based RPG. It's not too bad at the beginning, but you can tell the grind requirements will become quickly more burdensome as you progress. The ads are limited to the in game store as far as I have seen, but they are pretty aggressive, every time you log in and almost everytime you return to base, and the prices there are pretty high for not a big gain. Graphics and sound are good and the game seems pretty polished. Give it a chance, it's a decent enough diversion.

Way to random and pay to win. Tons of champions are effectively unplayably bad and you have no way to target them. The color scheme of shards are intentional to get you to over value them. Events are the only way to get books and they are just for whales with exponential growth in between levels. Nothing like the adds, stay away from this slot machine.

Cash sink with little reward. The gameplay is essentially pay money for gacha, let the game play itself, pay money to upgrade characters, click through five or six popups for bundles and cash shop garbage, let the game play itself, repeat until you've sunk your paycheck and realize you've gotten no enjoyment out of it. I've had surgery that cost less and was more enjoyable.

Game was fun at first. Then as you progress, you have to spend money to get anywhere. On top of that, the ads to buy stuff are out of hand. 3-4 ads every time you go to the main screen. I play games to have fun. Not to be in first place. With this one, you have no choice except to spend money to make progress. For the prices they are asking, I'll go buy a PlayStation game. Raid is a big fail. Deleting immediately.

so far so good. little annoying with all the sales popping up. if I wanted to buy one I would no need to have them all pop up. we shall see if i keep this review or change it as i progress. Update: the amount of space this game always takes up on the phone is no good for me, as I dont have a ton of space and play lots of games this doesnt work for me hence why I have not played in awhile.

Geeeeez, in this game everything is complicated, difficult, long-winded, ridiculous, almost all characters have healing and continuous healing abilities, and the worst part is a waste of time. Even to fight a Dungeon Boss it takes a few minutes to a dozen minutes. What's wrong with adding 5x or 10x additional speed. The Dungeon Boss has already been defeated, in fact it can definitely be defeated. I've wasted 3 months of my time playing this game.

This game is fun but here's the kicker it has way to much suggestions to buy your in-game stuff. This is not only annoying but completely unnecessary. This killed any and all enjoyment I had. Please do all of us a favor and leave those pop-ups in the past. A suggestion: if you make a market tab that has all of the packs etc. This way it's there but optional to view. If you add new stuff to this market just put a notification or the word "new" next to this market. (Please do this)

Why is everything so horribly overpriced!! I love raid. Been playing it for years now but I've always ran into the issue that everything is so ridiculously over priced. I just logged in and found out they added a "battle pass" alright that's OK I guess. Let's just follow the terrible trend ever game is bringing on (make you pay for content with real money and still have to play to earn the content you paid for. The big issue that disgusts me is that the battle padd thing is $70 for the basicwtf

It is a game with so much potential but it is completely build around monetization. Everything takes soooo long and only randomness decides whether you progress at all or not. I was barely able to get an epic hero or two while others just demolish me with their epic ones (playing daily). Not thought through enough so... No recommendation.

Total garbage. The game does nothing but freeze. It's only got potential if you plan on investing hundreds of thousands of dollars. They falsely ban accounts and do not reply to any issues at all. The game freezes so much it costs you money and resources and their only reply is to buy and play a mobile app on a PC. It's literally a money grab that doesn't work to start with.

As a free to play player, progressing... It becomes almost an insane grind. And even if you wanted to pay. It's almost the price of AAA console or PC games just to progress just a tiny, tiny bit ... Meaning to progress without painful grinding and investing a ton of time over consistent basis you have to spend a lot, a lot of money. I understand to keep the player base playing it has to be a massive grind. But thats also what causes so many players loose interest. Its less rewarding as you play

After playing the game for over a month now, I most change my review. The game is too repetitive and the developers are way too greedy. With loot boxs coming under fire maybe the government should look at this game's summon statistics. So since everything is color coded here is the break down: Blue (15 for 94.99) has the ability to give you the better characters in the game than the more expensive Purple (5 for 94.99) which the game builds up as the better summons. In short, dont give money to.

Stay away. After spending money on this game, I've barely progressed. Plarium is greedy and it's made evident by their insanely priced micro transactions and the tons of popups you have to endure with every login. Everything is also stacked against you and the dungeons are designed to drain resources fast w/ minimal return to get you to buy more to "progress". Events are also designed so that a f2p player almost gets a good reward but just short to encourage more in game spending. Stay away.

The game is cool enough, but support does nothing for you in terms of making server maintenance, which happens almost daily, obvious to the player. I've also had an issue with missions for almost a month now and have opened 4 tickets, none of which were resolved. Overall, great game, but actually playing it is more difficult than it's worth.

This is a great game, it was fairly balanced in the Arena. Now if you are not PAYING don't expect to rank out of the bronze tier. Its an intentional bottleneck/pain point to push you to purchase items so you can rank up your Great Hall, before the last update, as a free to play player you could rank into silver and farm reliability (it was balanced). Would advise against downloading unless you want to be extremely frustrated after all the time you spent in game is rendered moot because of a Arena update that puts all free to play players behind a what seems like a pay bottle neck.

I've been playing this for a few months. It's not bad, but progress is slow without spending money. Shards have a very low chance of spawning strong heroes, except the legendary ones and those need a month + of work. I wouldn't call the transactions micro either. Most are 20+ euro. Even built in mechanics like the monitor have a low chance to drop good loot.

It's a really fun game... until you're stone walled and it becomes pay to win. Gets really boring after a few hours playing. You can clearly tell who is paying money in PvP, as a free player you will have virtually no chance of beating anyone. The nice graphics are really all it has going for it, the rest is just the same generic recycled game play style.

Going by their own advertising. This game is not 100% free while all in game items can be obtained through gameplay being able to buy items and currency desiged on a pay to win platform is not 100% free. At 4.1 while reviewing, this game is not close to a perfect score on the Play store. The graphic are in the top quarter for mobile but nothing special. And the story seems to be written by a preteen nerd who had a fever dream after watching LotR and bringing on candy and cheese balls.

Ads for buying things. After EVERY STAGE. Played since it's release, waited til now to give a review. In the end, the only... ONLY... saving grace of this game is the graphics. Besides that, devs, you are foul for putting this on the market and taking hard earned items... oh sorry, "crashes", right? What a joke. P2w all the way, devs will lie to you and send automated responses. No joke, I just spent 20 minutes looking at their responses. Uninstalled, will not support a blatant cash grab lie.

I've been playing this game for about 4 1/2 months now, and feel it's a good time to give a review. A pro for them is the game looks great and at the beginning you are moving along with the game quickly,. There is a lot of champs to get and level or use to level others. There are daily rewards for logging in a doing things, you have a bunch of different gear to collect and level also to build the best champs and team. HOWEVER - It doesn't take long to realize how much the value hooking you in to get money off you. While this is a "free to play game" it should be more called "free to download and mess around in" And while it doesn't take you long, I mean the massive amounts of pop-up ranging from 2.99 pack to 99.99 pack for items to help, some times 7 in a row! should illustrate my point. And it's not just once,I log in I have had them come up when Im in play, like I feel like if I told a girl scout I didn't want to buy cookies today, my be I'm low on funds, or I have a stock pile of thin mints and don't need another box right now, and then they follow me home asking every 10 steps to buy more cookies. And then the packs are so random. Like 1 day for 2.99 I get a bunch of items that are harder to get like books, banners, chickens or keys, and then the next day a pack is 9.99 for a book and some silver which you can farm silver in the game super easy. BUT GET IT NOW THE DEAL IS GOOD FOR 6HOURS! *FOMO FOMO FOMO!!!* I don't fault a game company for being a company, heck I have bought game play for ones I like MANY times. I fault the need to have your hand out all the time, I know where the store is in game and how to use it. There other thing I quickly see, is at 4 month, if I unlock all the levels with the team I have, what's for me to stick around? Why should I buy your things it I already played the game. I am board and will move on.

Great game, love the graphics, characters, challenges etc... however, after the last update, to upgrade weapons it costs an insane amount of silver. Be prepared to start dropping lots of money just to upgrade. Ridiculous to spend 2 million to upgrade one level, it used to be a few hundred thousand. I hope the developers fix this.

While game itself is quite fun and playing it at first feels rewarding, it quickly turns into money grab, where you need to spend money to upgrade your champions, that might get nerfed right away. As well as some events, like our latest one, where you need to spend 100+ € to get rewards from. If it was toned down a bit game would be 5☆

The game play and design are amazing but the ridiculously high priced pay walls this company has implemented is beyond belief. I have no issue paying for something in a well designed game but I'm not going to be robbed blind. Im not sure what the devs could possibly be thinking other than trying to get rich quick but all its going to do is turn people away from their game.

This game is a pay to play, make no mistake about it. I've had countless shards that can give better than blue heroes on the account I've played on and not a single one has given above blue at all. They have 4 shards and only 3 sets of drop rates. Get a purple shard and think you have a better chance at a purple hero than a blue one? You don't according to their own table, which has a drop rate on epic/legendary characters that's about as good as the actual lottery. And these companies wonder why things like loot boxes were about to be made illegal. At least other games have put in place things like getting something better for sure after X chances. You would think game that's got the money to advertise on every other game would at least not screw their players like this, but that's expected from a company that also expects people to grind all day and night or have nothing good at all in the game.

They seem to like punishing you for playing. It costs way to much money to switch gear around on different characters putting a huge halt on gameplay until i farm more money. Getting any decent character will take a long time and minimum 50 shards or what they want you to do is just buy 4 star + shards. And if you want a specific character you can't buy specific faction shards which needs to be a thing. The game has potential but honestly is way to money hungry...what a shocker.

I have been playing for over a month now, and at first there was no problem. The game was fun and engaging, but since then I have invited players using the codes provided and have recieved none of the rewards for their level benchmarks. I have reached out to support and received only automated responses, and lately the game rewards haven't been applying. It shows I received it, but doesn't actually add it to my inventory. I am a bit frustrated, because I have spent money on the game. Please fix.

Amazing graphics and sounds but NOT worth the time. In the beginning an overload of information. Free, but the same old (expensive) pay-to-win type of game with a different coat. Set the attacks to automatic then you realize you're not actually playing a game. It's all about tricking you to spend your money. Installed after annoying Youtube ads. But de-installed it.

I want to start over but can't because if I do, then I will lose Ronda and there is no other way to obtain her. She's my favorite character. So stuck farming levels I've already beaten. And for what exactly? Add more to the campaign levels. Make the energy caps higher. Actually do what other apps do and make the game more player friendly and not so EXPENSIVE. Very close to just giving up and uninstalling and finding something else. Too bad. I actually liked this game.

Great graphic, gameplay can be a bit of a grind but it's still rather decent. What I don't like about this game is the RNG, for example I've waited for 12 days in order to recieve the epic crystal which can be used to summon epic or legendary heroes. What I get instead is a rare champion, it's obvious that this is no different than loot boxes. There are no options to purchase higher tier summoning crystals without spending a dime. You'll have to wait it out.

Plarium play is absolute cancer, do NOT use the PC version. It's 100% the exact same without any PC optimization, but hey you get bonus plarium points when you spend real money there compared to the app. Signing in is a nightmare, constantly getting "unexpected error" when I try to send a recover email because my normal password got an "unexpected error". This is a game designed to siphon money, not be fun. Not even a game, this is an addiction.

This is a cool game. Turn base, strategy base game and the graphics are the best in the industry. Now it is repetitive and the grind is long as heck for gear because it's not just about collecting champions but developing your gear, because you can smack around top tier accounts with great gear. Nonetheless the game is addictive and fun. The secret is play at own speed and don't let the content creators make you feel like your behind. And yes if you want to grow fast you have to spend $$$

*Update: Down to 2 stars. The chance of getting decent characters is very, very unlikely which makes this game unbearable to play. I will be uninstalling. Not worth your time! Good game that's unfortunately ran poorly. Their server can't handle this game often resulting in numerous game crashes and loss of progression. The support is equally as bad. Fun game, but one I would not suggest putting any money into.

Nice game, indeed. The reason why I'm rating with 2-stars is that the game promotes too many in-game purchases. One after another. There are times when it feels like it's never ending. Plus, this is Pay-To-Win game. If you'll depend on the free ones which is obviously based on too low chances, like getting a higher star tiered champion, then there will be a point in the game where you'll feel stagnant.

Love playing the game, but it is incredibly hard to obtain essentials if you are free to play. Things such as upper ranked champions, high level and rarity artifacts and other in game items used to upgrade champions are rarely obtained. You can buy a lot of the stuff you can't simply obtain from playing, but it's pricey. And while you get sacred shards once a week for free, the odds of getting anything higher than rare is practically 1/200 even with boosted summons.

Pay to win. There's ALWAYS a way to buy yourself to the top of the ranking, and with every update they kill off more of the soul of the game and replace it with flat-out GREED. Plarium are squeezing their player base for every penny, and they are making the game more and more unreasonable for free to play players. Additionally, the support is absolutely abysmal.

You will be met by a ton of promotional offers at each login where they show how worthless the in game purchases are. I recently had an offer for $70 to get the shards & skill books that normally cost over $400. Without spending thousands of dollars you will NOT win or even come in the top 20(groups of 50) of any summon tournament, and some are needed for their "free" rewards to be fused. Characters do look good as long as you ignore how they're posed. Remember, the things you buy cost them $0

Game is entertaining and I enjoyed it because of the auto play in battles so you could get a lot done while multitasking. On the flip side, getting champions and weapons upgrades is all by chance so be prepared to get whooped by someone at half your level because they "happened" to get a better champion than you in this "lottery" of champion summoning.

I played with another account, where I spent money, and find the in-game progress similar for paid and F2P players. The real difference is if you spend A LOT of money - then the balance is indeed turned However, the tons of adds you now get when starting the game is really annoying. The developer reactons to other such complains are also quite offensive - they look like templates of the type - we don't care as long as you pay. At least add an option to turn them off with the subscription plan

Honestly, it seemed really good from the recolections of my friends and I agreed at first. Gameplay is after a while really slow and confusing. Paying to unequip a piece of gear should never be a damn thing, this is the first game of its genre from the many I played that wanted that from you and not a measly silver coins at that. Also, who is the nuthead in charge that decided that players getting blasted in the face on each relog by NINE damn purchase packages is a good thing. Horrible.

Overall the game is very entertaining. However it is FLOODED with microtranactions. The pay to win wall is very high, as in if you are strictly Free to play you'll struggle against those who invest heavily. It's a fun experience, very grindy, a lot of pop up microtransactions you MUST click out of whenever you load up. Worth your time if you're looking for something new. Not recommended for those looking to get good really fast without spending money.

Decent game, good graphics. About to drop the game however. Had it for nearly 4 years. But the latest update leaves the game a very time consuming mess. Used to be able pause game to use your device for other things. Since last update EVERY time you leave the game screen instead of picking up where you left game now reloads each time, each time you get a call, a message or anything else. It makes a huge waste of game resources. And a huge waste of time. As is game/real life is incompatible. Bye.

Somewhat okay game that can keep you busy but wants nothing but money from you. And the shard pulls are a joke. For one ex. -should be some type of system set up to where when you pull a champion (especially out of sacreds!!!!!) That you can't pull them again for at least awhile, as someone who doesn't or can't spend money and only has a limited amount of shards it really eats me up to see 3 of the same champions back to back.

Finally got past the "loading assets" after nearly 3 hours and already got into the game again. The game is really nice with the occasional summon rate ups along with the double legendary champion summon events. Wish there would be more events that are dungeon raiding related but it's still a nice game. Takes a while before you can compete as an f2p but that's how most games are. 9/10 but still rated it as a 5/5. More crossovers please.

Not horrible, not great. The grind to level up champions and accend makes the game too tedious and boring. Even with higher priority shards, the likelihood of getting epic or legendary champions is disappointingly low. There is like 5-7 purchase ads each time I log in, before i can start doing things in the game. The game has potential but it feels too much like pay to win. If you can buy packs and accend your champions that way then great but the grind is unreasonable.

Once upon a time this was a great game but ever since things have gone downhill. Developers dont care what players want and support doesnt care as long as you pour money into their coffins.If you want to play for an hour choose this but if you think you want to play something for even a few days then i recommend choosing anything else. So many players are leaving already so i believe theres nothing left in the future.

I left and came back, twice... At some point you have to just say, developers... Graphics are amazing, the game is fun, but it just isn't rewarding enough, free to play yes but even F2P games need to have some niche that keeps people hooked, i've never gotten any other shard, you have so many heroes and I just get fodder heroes, you can't even invest in them to make them strong. Right direction but no one is steering the car. You don't even give return gifts, I don't think you care for players.

The game is becoming less strategy and simply RNG luck if you happen to get a few of the overpowered champions in the game. Even then it just becomes boring and repetitive constantly grinding for enough resources to make your champions stronger to be able to grind a bit faster but not actually feel like you are achieving anything or being rewarded for it. The game is not growing or adapting fast enough, or in the right directions, to keep up with it's growth in player base. I've played over a yr

I changed my mind. Played for a while, made a bunch of accounts, checked everything. Yep it's pay to win. Played tons of games like these, this game still has hope. I understand you need money to progress the game itself but man your paywall's too high. Look at the other summoning gatcha gamws out there. They lasted for years cause they are not cash hogs. Anyways, good theme great graphics goodjob.

The game is fine. The graphics and effects are great. Raid was able to provide a way to do tasks efficiently without taking much of your time. For the battles, all is fair given that you will face opponent that has at least or almost near compared with the rarity of the champions you have to win. In terms of acquiring a Legendary or at least Epic, that goes the what you called, PTW player. In the long run, definitely, you will required to purchase. Recently, deleted the game.

Had to drop my rate from 5 to 3. As it is a fun game the character build is a very low drop rate and if u do get a decent character u go broke almost immediately trying to gear him. You should be able to build your characters alot more before the game tightens up like it does. The grind starts almost immediatly giving almost no distinction between players for quite a long time. We are all weeklings until u either pay or play for a really really long time

After playing for two weeks and investing time and money, suddenly the game wouldn't launch. Sent out two emails and recieved confirmation of their delivery but no response. Also, the game can be classified as a pay to play. Advancing is quite slow if money is not spent and they constantly push their "amazing" deals in your face. The game finally started working but my account was logged out and is lost now. The game is fully updated. Still no reply to my emails. Why reply here? To save face?

Hey Plarium, here's an idea, since you like to literally force pack offers down the throats of players, GIVE US AN OPTION TO TURN IT OFF!!! Seriously, every time you open the game, go back the the Bastion, you get bombarded with offers. Seriously, after almost 3 years it's extremely annoying and counterproductive to do anything when you literally have to close out 5 to 10 offers at a time. Get your heads out if your asses and do something to help the player base for once.

Not enough progression rewards to move forward at a certain point. Money has to be spent in order to get to end game. Legendary champs are rare even in their highest champ crystal and you need them to get anywhere. Of course you can grind for months and months lol. By far one the greediest of all mobile games. If you at least want some small gratification from investing a large part of your free time, play Marvel Contest of Champions. It's not a dead end if you don't pay the ransom!

I play this for free, no money spent. There are ads that popup on every start but it's not that bad to X through them. It feels like maybe these popup a little less now. Also they definitely did something to Arena (PvP) cause now the matchmaking is much better. I can find teams around my skill/power level to try and get dailies done now. Thank you devs! ❤️ The art and animations have always been pretty awesome, I'm just limited in character length for my review. Cheers!~

After all of the commercials and marketing behind this game, I want to hate it. The minute I jumped into the ganeplay though, I couldn't find anything to hate. This is a solid game with great graphics, idle esq gameplay, and you can tell the devs genuinely enjoy making this game. Only reason it's a 4/5 is because I think the story could be executed better (if there even is one). If you're looking for something fun & rewarding, this is it. If you're looking for something deep, keep searching.

Don't bother installing this game. Unless you have deep pockets! This game is catered towards P2W. As soon as you enter the game lobby you're bombarded with at least 3-5 of their in game ads to purchase their "limited & hot!" bundles. What's also infuriating is the complete RNG in game rewards. So even if you shell out hundreds of dollars, you're gambling on a fraction of a percentage drop rates. Avoid this game all together. Better games to play that don't have your wallet as their main focus.

If you like endless grinding and leaving your device on to autoraid, by all means, play it. Otherwise, steer clear. The upgrade chances for gear is miniscule, chances of getting a legendary hero are nil (still haven't pulled one after months), and common gear drops 99% of the time. Like someone previously said, if it says free, it's pay to win. If they have ads all over tv, it's because they make a lot of money. That's the only way to progress in their game. This game is the #6 grossing game...

Good graphics but a very poor story play. "Battle" has each character taking turns for hitting the other while the other justs waits to get hit. Lmao. It has an auto play mode (which you can fast-forward as well 🤣) so you can just watch the characters play the game instead of playing it. Could have watched a FHD youtube video instead of downloading the game and seeing the characters play themselves. Useless. Uninstalling it straight away.

Pay to win. Do not expect to get far in this game without dumping hundreds of dollars into it. I have bin playing for years and people just months old that spend money have surpassed me. What a waste of time if you play free. Oh yeah, and ads galore! Everything you open to the main screen, prepare to get overloaded with ads!!!

I want to like it. The biggest issue I have is in the dozen or so in game ads for deals in the store, I get a phone call and come back to the game and see them all over again, the game crashes and I see them all over again. Also I keep having to turn off sounds and notification it seems to reset every 3 or so log ins.

Overall gameplay is enjoyable, unfortunately I have continual issues with the game freezing upon entering or while playing in battles. This has been an ongoing issue starting from initial intall and persisting nearly two months now. Over the past two days the game has frozen in the first 3-5 seconds of entering the clan boss battle, this is highly inconvenient as clan boss keys are limited and when the game freezes there is no return of lost keys or energy. I am playing on a samsung galaxy s8.

Overall it has been fun and a good game for when you have 10min to kill or an hour. Would be nice to see the story expanded. It is pretty short. It is too difficult to get sacred shards without paying. Not enough good small cheap packages and to many expensive ones that really don't seem worth the cost. Too many pop-ups for purchases every time you log in. Will continue to play but the game has become more boring as you get to higher levels as all that is really left is to grind to lvl 60.

New content outlined by devs never arrives. Any update to the game ( bug fixes or minor ui changes) cause weeks of server instability. Not worth required time investment much less spending money on. Edit reply: I have played for a year and ther has be no meaningful new content. I'm not spending and the review isn't going to go up if all you got is "please wait"

I like the game overall but there are a few unfortunate downsides. The rate of drop for high level characters is way too low and the first free legendary characters are at 180 days. It's also inundated with ads for packs which are at ridiculously high prices. I don't think I should have to drop $100 or more to be mildly competitive. That being said it is entertaining and overall enjoyable. I understand the f2p model but tweaking the prices to entice people to buy more would benefit only you.

I got to play the game for about an hour before it crashing with the error message "Unable to load some of the resources". After waiting 4 days to hear back on a support ticket, I was told to "reinstall the game using a stable connection". I run with 4G unlimited data and my school wifi has a download rate of around 450MB and I have had no issues running other games. Very poorly maintained

Absolute trash. I'm really good at coming up on games that are pay to play without actually paying, however, this game has it set up perfectly so the only way you're going to do well is with money. I don't need to see an ad offering me a "deal" every time I have one instance of a battle. To the devs: Go put a bullet in your head. I mean if not, someone else might.

Do I really have to pour money into this to just enjoy it? This feels like a waste of time, and if you want to progress in this game at a enjoyable pace then prepare to waste your money. So much bloody potential wasted by turning what could be a brilliant game into money making scheme. This game is the perfect example of pay to win, I'll even go as far as to say that it's free to download but pay to play. My disappointment is immeasurable. Thank you for creating something so utterly substandard.

no support Event going on with Amazon and I was getting my rewards until one day I wasn't. Was getting a message saying "only 1 account can claim prizes" contacted support only to be told it was an Amazon issue not theirs. To which Amazon said the same thing. Game isn't terrible but to get anything good you've got to buy it. Its a grind fest to level up your better fighters. If you dont buy any thing. Never got my rewards from Amazon event which really sucks!

Progression is so slow. Even after you finally get past the "tutorial" at the beginning. Graphics are pretty good but even the game play is lagging at times. Can't obtain more characters even with the skull gem thing. It in itself costs coins to even summon more fighters. Some of the characters are identical some the only difference is the name. Others it's just a different color combo to differentiate.

Uninstalled. Took a break for a bit and came back to a season pass system. With already abysmal pull rates, and overly grindy systems that don't feel polished or thought out, this was just the icing on the cake. Add a nebulous "season pass" which is basically just dlc that adds like 4 heroes under a timer and you have the perfect storm of not caring anymore. Never once got a legendary hero from any summons. Not even from the legendary crystals. Feels like Destiny's engram system in the first one

Good game been playing for 2 weeks getting really tied of everytime I login there so many advertisements for purchasing in game items. Kinda like there throwing it in your face.
