Do not give them money, this game is false advertising top to bottom.

Money grab components. Artifacts updating is terrible. It's a game that pretends it can be played without spending $. You can not begin to understand how much time you would need to put in to play effectively for free. My least favorite part of the game is playing for several HOURS to build up coins. You fight hit after hit gaining as low as 4k to 12k at a time only to have it all wiped away because it can randomly cost you 500,000 coins to raise an artifact to level 8 in less than 1 minute.

When I first started playing this game it ran super smooth and was a lot of fun. I have spent a bit of money on this game because I wanted to support the developers, but now ever since the last major update the game freezes and i have lost raid keys and about 5 refreshes worth of energy. Not worth playing right now until they fix the game, the state it's in isn't worth playing.

Totally unbalanced game, campaign is a joke, all the enemies, have multi attack, debuffs and buffs that greatly benefits them, meanwhile your "heroes" have to wait several turns for a simple multi attack while the enemy can attack all your heroes all their turns and spam buffs, also I know this type of games must have micro transactions but this one is FULL of them, bombarding you every minute with packs at ridiculous prices, I guess it's an ok game to pass time but don't waste your money on it.

This game had alot of potential but losses it after you get a couple of 5 stars and need them 6 star and it's long and boring with doing the same thing with no progress at all. Yes I know you've kept the same formula and some bits and changes but it's not enough to say "best game" when you got a tedious grind fest for both areas, dungeons for equipment, campaign for money and xp. pvp sucks it's unbalanced cause I can barely hit the last tier on bronze to silver to finish the missions.

Had potential, but I think they must have brought in some big shot project manager that had visions of a marketing strategy way too big and targeted it way too broadly. The result is a game that has become pay to win, as they try to recoup their losses from a horrible marketing campaign. I feel bad for the devs because I highly doubt this was their intention, and they designed a fun game that otherwise would have been awesome.

The game is amazing and I was truly excited about the updates when they were announced but when they finally arrived they came with almost game breaking bugs. My champions and enemy units will sometimes run around in circles after they perform an action that involves them moving and will sometimes not even perform the action which can result in them being killed. This has lost me a lot of matches and the only reason I continue to play the game is because I like the game when it works properly.

Graphics are fantastic! Gameplay is a bit repetitive, but it's to be expected. There needs to be less advertisements before I can play. Put them all in one window to scroll or close. It's REALLY annoying to close sometimes 10 pop ups just to get in and play. It costs WAY too much to swap out gear from a character. Just cut the prices down. There needs to be a better way to preview armor sets on specific characters before I apply it to them. Game is good, but it needs improvements to get 5 stars!

I am a brand new player and this game gets many things wrong. It looks great and is easy to play, but the grind is way, way too long. Other games of this type are generous up front, this game is not, I"ve only gotten 1-2 star draws out of 15 draws. The rewards are mostly useless. The game constantly annoys you with popup ads. Real money buys you very little. Your supposed to make players want to play this game, not make them want to leave.

You can progress without spending money, but it requires a lot of grinding. Spending money allows you to progress way faster and is promoted every time you open the game. In general the game is enjoyable if you don't mind grinding and being prompted to pay, which is not required, but does make things way easier. I'd say try it for yourself before you make a final desicion.

Game is nothing like advertised. It's like most other bad mobile games where there's 2 forms of currency, coins and gems. Also energy is always a pain in the ass in every game and if you want to have infinite energy it usually costs money. Graphics are also terrible when most of the ads and sponsors advertise it as "console level graphics" overall, don't download, the game sucks

It's a gotcha cash grab game that's just like so many other games I played of this style. The game at the beginning lags, you get at least 10 pop ups to BUY BUY BUY starter packs constantly. The game play is kind of boring and it's honestly not hyped to what it said it was gonna be. It's basically pay to play and if you're like me, you can't spend money to get stronger characters your always going to get your rear end handed to you on PVP. I don't recommend downloading this game.

So far so good. I'm in, lots of characters and team combos. I'm a little torn on the cost of EVERYTHING but overall it plays nice and steals a lot of your time. Good game for me cause I'm a truck driver so I can put on a radio stream and let the game play itself for hours. Drop some of the costs of some upgrades and I'd be ALL IN!

Once you can get past all the ads that pop up every time you open the game cause it wants to buy there microtransactions it not bad. I just have a issues with get hit with the same ads over and over everytime I closed them they pop up again when I try to play the game again. I am done with this game. Reply to Plarium. There is no dismissal option! I closed out of each pop up and they show up right back. This is just money grabbing at it's best.

Absolute pay-to-win. Not even an option of grinding to really earn the better heroes and after all the hard work to get Legendary Shards, you still have such small chance of getting anything good.... I stopped really playing months ago but kept logging in to try and get some decent heroes, but thats also a lost cause. No way to make any headway in the arena without spending an exhorbitant amount of real cash to buy things. I get about 9 ad popups every time I log in, which is very annoying..

Honest two star review. This game throws too many popups, when one is too much of an annoyance. Want to give us a hundred dollars? Oh, what about sixty? Oh... twenty? Plus there is nothing special here other than lackluster business models from other games. It just a reprint of tournaments, events,... Nothing special here. Even though I created a guild I'll give it to another player and delete this app.

Arena needs an over haul, nobody is ever going to get their great hall done at this rate. I've been playing for almost 3 years and still far off. Why not give more hall points per match? (Like 5x the pts. cause 2 and 3 to get over 700 takes forever). Game freezes on loading certain matches which eats energy or arena tokens, that's not fair. Graphics fine, game play ok and plenty to do but unfair mechanics make it harder to keep enjoying daily. "Sale spams" are ridiculous on opening the game.

I used to spend a lot of time on this game, but after constant neglect from Customer Service regarding several of my issues regarding linking my amazon account and random crashes. I think I've just about had enough. Features are updated at a glacial pace, and even my team of stacked legendaries can barely scrape by on Faction Wars despite great success in the hardest Clan bosses, campaign modes, and arena. Its just poorly balanced and maintained, and I don't see that changing anytime soon.

Was great having a blast till.... So many connection time outs, now it's affecting purchases Bought a pack, charged for pack, and never received it. Prolly never see that money again and prolly never get my stuff. Support for these games seems to be a joke. They don't get back to you ever. So I have learned my lesson and you should too save your money for something more tangible and important. Let them make there money

A game that is actually pretty fun. One of those fun at first experiences that get ruined by every action costing one of their many currencies. I understand it's not a business model to not ask for money here and there to keep the game going. But it's crazy the amount of currencies they have. Sorry can't complete that action. Not enough clicky points. Sorry can't remove armor not enough remove armor bucks. Sorry can't participate in this clan battle not enough clan pesos. To bad really.

Just a standard mobile Skinner box mobile game. Figured I'd give it a try after seeing literally every YouTuber ever promoting it, but it appears they are all scripted. Yhis is not a console quality game, it's a regular mobile game complete with tons of microtransactions and progression walls. If you don't mind those things you may enjoy it, but I don't like games designed to be tedious so they can sell me the fix to finally make it fun.

I originally gave this game a 5 star rating, but it's going downhill fast. The reason for 2 stars is because the art and community are the best things about the game. The decision making from the higher ups is horrendous, the lack of actual content for how long the game has been around, the drop rates from shards is bad, the quality assurance/playtesting is non-existent...the list goes on. I couldn't, in good conscious, leave a 5 star rating up for any longer. I'd stay away for now.

The gameplay is truly underwhelming. The ads for microtransactions are extremely intrusive, while the value of those deals is laughably low. There's barely any story, there's barely any real gameplay; this is barely a game. It's just something shiny to dump your cash into. Like a slot machine, but without the payout.

I don't know how long I've been playing for but it's been long enough that I've collected all of the monthly champions. And into my first month of all the random high-end daily items. I love this game its very addictive!, but I do agree with a number of people on the adds that keep adding up "Pun intended" is Crazy Nuts! The game is fun for No Pay players, I like to buy the monthly pack and save the shared for a Champion that's is 10×change to get on those Events days. Game 5/5

i had been having fun for weeks until i was "banned for too many refunds." i have never refunded ANYTHING, and have online made a couple purchases to begin with. i reset the app, hoping it was an error but it then allowed me to log in, but started from the beginning and i lost ALL my progress and time investment. either this is a game breaking bug, or some sort of error, but it's terrible treatment of a dedicated and daily player, and I'm hard pressed to want to start over unless i get it back.

Coming from other competitive gotcha games on the market right now this game really needs work in a few areas such as energy, silver cost, and events and tournaments. As it stands right now there is no feasible way for a new or mid game player to compete in tournaments and events to even touch the good champions. Other games well at least give you some sort of route to be able to reach a great champion. I've spent nearly 3 months on this game and feel like I haven't gotten anywhere.

Great graphics , and play . Terrible drop rates . Turned in 80 plus souls and got garbage . Not a single Legend 1 epic . Theres bad luck and then theres a money grab . The pay wall for me was far to quick . They claim their legend drop rate is a whooping 1/2 a percent . But hey they double it to 1 % 🤣🤣🤣 If you like this style of a game , play legacy of the beast . At least they give you a couple chars to help you compete against the top tier . Great game thats horribly managed

Lots of pay to play ads I'm sure it's going to get to the point where you will need to pay to play. Update: Big pay to play game and cost too much I spent a few hundred dollars never got 1 legendary character. You would think I'd get at least 1 out of that much money I mean statistically I should have but didn't so assume it's a rigged game.

Been playing this game for about 6 months and only ever received four top tier characters. Only 2 were from shards, the other 2 were rewards for things. Like logging in every day for 6 months or spending money on thier season thing. The chances to recieve top tier characters are so low you have to wait for special events to even have a chance of getting one from shards.Overall, game is not worth time and money you put into it.

Honestly, the game is entertaining, and has lots to do. The two-star rating though is entirely based on the crushing tsunami of thirsty ads the game bombards you with when you first open it. I understand its a f2p game that makes money with p2w players and i actually appreciate the paradigm (no payers = no game), but the sheer volume and intrusiveness of the pop-up ads make the game quite literally unplayable when first opened. Will definitely return in the future when this is not true.

I have been playing this game for 3 weeks. I have been kinda of enjoying the game, but there are a ton of bugs still. The main one that has been very frustrating is that during any gameplay. The game freezes. You have to close the game and reopen it. The bad thing about it is that you lose arena tokens, energy in campaign, or even lose a key in clan boss if it freezes in mid game. TBH I might play for another week and if it does not get better than I might just quit playing. Hope this helps

So many times the Beatles knock not me out then the li lost my key, or coin, or bone and am out of luck, never got to play the round. It takes a two million and a half coins to upgrade 2 armor pieces. It's ridiculous. Why does it cost so much, I already bout the pieces for hundred thousand coins, now upgrading cost an extravagant amount. It doesn't seem worth it. And it isn't fair for what we have to do.

The game developers out there themselves in this game. I really do like the game BUT!!! I have to give it a three because of all the times it has kicked me out of battles constantly. It is a minor issue in the game. But to a player is a large big issue.... Hopefully they get that bug fixed. Overall a good game..

A very smooth gaming experience, UNTIL you run out of the starter's welcome goodies. Once you run out of the energy, you'll need to wait about 20 minutes to replenish enough for the 10~20 seconds long "raid" again. Those guys definitely DON'T WANT YOU grind through the dungeons on their servers. Then the game is designed the way that you need to collect a minimum of 80 champions from all Factions (16) and 4 Affinities to successfully play the game. One legendary "naked" champion costs 500USD.

I've played the game for around 3-4 months now and I have to say that there's not much you can get either as a free player or as an occasional buyer; The whole structure of the game is designed to make you spend more and more on a daily basis with no much content or reward to enjoy in the mean times; the rates for dropping competitive heroes or items are ridiculously high making virtually impossible for someone spending up to 50-70 dol a month to get somewhere and satisfied with their progress.

The game has beautiful graphics gameplay is awesome, my only problems are that the games is not for f2p people if your a new player you have no chance of winning when you beat a few levels so you have to pay. Also I didnt understand much in the game as a new player the tutorial wasn't that great but overall the game is pretty good just fix a few things and the game will soon be great.

Super addicting game that keeps me hooked in wanting to level up more characters to rank up my main team just to increase how much damage I can do. Sadly I'm at the point where my energy runs out extremely fast and I can't play nearly as long as I'd like but I still love the game. If I could play it for an unlimited amount of time with no energy it would be a 5* all day

after playing for a long time (a few months), i 've gotten fed up with this pos game. Seemed fun at first. But, there is no in-game support. You will constantly lose vauable items (Void Shards, Clan Boss keys, Arena coins) due to loading error freezes, and they make no attempt to recover those items for you. Even after multiple "support" tickets submitted with screenshots and a detailed explanation of what happened. Stay away if you like to enjoy playing a game!

Overall great game would reccomend it in a heartbeat. However, I had a separate issue with my phone got that fix then was not able to reclaim my original account. I placed a trouble ticket with support and after two days I've still not heard back from them. If there were better communication between players and support this would be a game of the year 5 star all day every day.

This game is actually fantastic. The visuals, the stats, all the small knobs and dials you can turn in this game and the sheer amount of mostly well done heroes make it a very interesting game.. Sort of a hero simulator.. There are many aspects to it. The things I do NOT like about it is.. The amount of time you automatically have to put into it.. To make it worthwhile.. Is abysmal.. It's way too much. And then the prices for all the packs inside the game is crazy.. Much much too expensive.

Love the game, my only complaints are when you rank up a champion you shouldn't have to start back at lvl 1. I get that there's a gring but it's kinda ridiculous. My other complaint is the amount of silver it takes to upgrade artifacts makes it really annoying when you spend the money and the upgrade fails. I understand what the game is doing but maybe only take half the silver when the upgrade fails so that it's not quite as discouraging. But dont get me wrong overall I love the game!

The game is entertaining, but a few flaws make it tedious at times. - 2 to 4 pop-ups on login, even for users who have bought a pack. - The game starts by choosing a champion, and it has a huge impact in the late game. Maybe an option to change or buy back starter heroes? - The AI is dumb at times when playing on Auto: use of aoe when only one enemy champion remains, use the finisher move first, use the cleanse when there are no debuffs... Other than that, good character design and gameplay

This game is good but not perfect there are many problems with the game for example the game is pay to win every single time I open up the game there's always deals showing up on my screen for items as for upgrading artifacts when you get them to a certain level they it gets more difficult to upgrade once you get them to a higher level it gets way to difficult upgrade the artifact that is all. I will give the game a four star the game is awesome or good but not perfect please improve these probl

One year later, after my first review, this game went from cool to nightmarish. Unstable and laggy server, updates with NOT ONE cool thing in them just other ways for them to make u spend money, bugs....soooooo many bugs that are not fixed, broken champions that do not work are not fixed even after a year. Devs dont listen to the community, and so so so much more wrong things with this game, all because the company it runs it. My advice for everyone would be just:STAY AWAY FROM IT. IT IS A TRAP!

Edit: Game relies on new players with gambling addictions to spend your well earnt money on pixels. Save your money and spend it on a proper game. I wish the pop ups when you first launch the game were listed on one pop up rather than having 4 to 6 pop ups that come one after another. It is a real deterent to playing this game.

Only download this game if you're expecting to handover hundreds if not thousands of dollars to stay competitive. While you can grind for a long time for champions levels and equipment, the real game changer is in the money you spend upgrading artifacts and levels. These can only be done with coin that you can get in small amounts in game or real world money. On top of that it only gives you a chance to upgrade, meaning even if you saved millions of coins there's no guarantee you'll even upgrade

It's litterally just a money hungry cash grab with pay to win, you can buy gear and shards and even specific characters in certain packs and I think that's disgusting, and when you log in you're bombarded with said pay to win packs just being constantly thrown in your face, then there's the fact that there's an auto play feature with a fast forward option, so the game itself thinks it's gameplay is so boring that it lets you skip it, I wouldn't bother downloading this again, it's not good.

Massive casino disguised as a game. Plarium also loves milking the player base to the point of absurdity. Cannot recommend in good faith. Decent if you are ok with either spending money or never being competitive. The community is the only saving grace. I am basically level 100 (max level). I do ultra nightmare demon lord, completed the campaign on all difficulties, doom tower normal, and the dungeons in all difficulties for normal. I have given the game more than enough time.

The game is great, graphics are amazing however, constantly freezing at random points is completely ruining it. Especially when there is a timed event going on and can't even compete in it when the game freezes during a battle, having to restart the game and therefore losing out on the energy spent on a fight. Would give it 4 maybe 5 stars but the freezing issues and losing out on resources for battles and losing the edge on events is keeping it at a 2 personally.

Game is absolute garbage from the F2P experience (which makes it hard for me to want to support it financially). Fantastic art, absolute miserable experience in skill-ups of anything above a natural-blue monster (and blues aren't exactly great), and 6-starring anything is a repulsive experience, particularly when getting started. The game has potential, but the devs could milk more money if the start wasn't so terrible. Way too may pop-ups as well, let me try to play the game!

Fun game, terrible priorities with the company. Long delays on new content, bugs and crashes, prioritizing pay 2 play content, derpy PR releases. Have had a ton of fun with it but can't recommend to friends without more free content, more low price pay options, better incentives to play in events (outside of the borderline impossible tier rewards requiring pay/hoarding), more paths to progress without paying (ie summon fusions, farmable ancient shards).

I'll give it a one star until I hear from someone. It may get a four or even a five after they help me with my account problem. You'd think if you spent money on a game they'd give you some attention, no matter the amount. It's a great waste of time and helps pass the days when things are slow. I was really into D&D back in the day(I'm old, I know)and this game is as close to it as it gets. Other than my account problem I do really enjoy this game. You dont have to spend much to advance far.

Awesome game, but good Lord I am absolutely bombarded by pay to play packages. After I click X out of the first one why do I then have to continue to do it literally 6 more times. I legitimately had to click out of 7 offers jus to play the game. Keep them in the menu for people that want to spend money because honestly being bombarded like that only made me NOT want to spend any money

They want your money, badly.... Fun for an hour or 2 when you first play it. But then the grind sets in. There is just no way to play this game f2p. And the worst part of the whole game is the atleast 10 pop ups you have to close every time you load in. The pop ups range from begginer packs, heroes, summons, other stuff, and range from around $5 to $40, every time...

Been playing for two months now. Enjoyed it at first. But now that you have to spend money just to be able to play. Not so much fun any more. Up gradeing your characters and artifact eats away you silver. Then you have to spend more money. Almost impossible to get legendary characters. Unless you spend money. The rewards you get in the game don't help much. Every time I open a shared . I keep getting the same crappy characters. Might get a good one. 1out of 100 shards. Out of room more say

Great game, it would help if the ads for in-game purchases stopped popping up, I'm not spending money no matter how great the deal is. Otherwise it's a fantastic game. Really like the lore and neat little details they've started adding, but the entire game might need a guide for new players, maybe even the seasoned players could use a little help now and then.

Overall it's a pretty entertaining game. Great way to pass the time, fairly easy to learn and progress. There's a nice balance between attentiveness and engagement with gameplay. Although, closing the game and reopening gets kinda of annoying. seeing that no matter if you logged off for 5 min or a whole day you get in game popups for offers. Which are a little rediculous in pricing, granted you don't have spend money to progress. It's still bother some.

Writing this review as a whale, spent around $700 on this game so far. Normally I would still enjoy the game with an advantage however this game goes beyond your normal skinner box. The gem mine which costs 1500 gems to upgrade only gives you 15 gems per 24 hours, meaning around 100 days before a return and their $$ currency(gems) doesn't allow you to buy anything above garbage and non-competitive stuff. And grinding potions has around the same 90% chance of dropping a single potion end-game.

Besides the classic micro transactions this game does not offer much. The gameplay is ok but obviously after a little while it just seems bland and like tons of other fantasy games. The only decent thing in this game is arguably the heroes. With that said a lot of the heroes look very similar aside from maybe a slightly different color palette. The heroes, like in most fantasy based games, make no sense. How is a barely clothed woman with crude axes more combat savvy than a full armored knight?

So I changed my review from 4 stars to 2 stars. Ads IDK about. When you have a free game and only get 3 to 5 pop ups that are easy to exit every 30 minutes, no big deal. However, the game freezing every hour and losing game energy, champions, tokens, and matches is A MAJOR problem. I have found 40+ complaints about this issue and it still has not been addressed. Tech support does not reply and customers service is nonexistent. I still gave it 2 stars because the desktop version works great.

Way too many popups, when you open up, but it is a fun game. But come on, stop with the 15 popups limit it to 2 or 3 and I would give you 4 stars. Quality graphics, gameplay, and everything else. Get rid of some of the popups. Okay I got your response, and I get you want to keep players informed, but having popups multiple times in one playing session is a bit much.

I never write reviews but want everyone to be very careful and I would HIGHLY RECOMMEND TO NOT INSTALL PLARIUM. It is an additional way to play on your desktop. I did this twice and it has been verified twice that my account was hacked and twice they tried to get into my bank accounts. Twice I had to get new cards and both times when I complained to the support team they did nothing. Be cautious with this game. Otherwise a good game but not worth paying for!!

Still sucks, 06/08/2020This is a standard RPG, nothing "Ambitious" about it. Everything, and I literally mean everything, is designed to get you to buy from the cash shop. From charging you to remove gear(you read that right), ALL the events, to many heroes to buy, the list goes on. You get in-game store purchase ads, that attack your screen when you log in or just return to your camp. Play for yourself to see, but if you've played a Mobile RPG before, you've played this. Nothing ambitious here.

This game has all the potential to be a great game, with good graphics a creative campaign story and unique characters. But it all falls apart with relentless pop-ups everytime you log in, insanely hard clan bosses , it takes so long to level up champions as well, the concept is good but it lacks in execution.

It's not a bad game. Your progress halts once you have to have 4 rank characters. With very few ways of getting rank 3 and even fewer ways of leveling up those R3 characters the progress starts to slow down. Unfortunately it's one of those kinds of games where it pays to pay with real money. You get an arena where you can level your character, but it needs your imput, also, to unlock a second slot requires gems. They always make the start fun...

The game can be fun, and I'd gladly give it a higher rating if I wasn't constantly bombarded with popups to buy in game stuff with money. I get they need people to spend money to run the company, but seriously, they go way overboard. You spend the first 45 seconds everytime after logging in just closing the pop-ups trying to sell you in game items. The incessant pop-ups, have insured that I will never spend my money on the game. Be more friendly about it, people will feel better about buying.

Still freezing to death sometimes making my progressing even harder but the game is pretty well done overall. And the devs are sending gifts for the inconvenience I think cause the error reports I'm always sending so I am half-pleased. After the random freezes are gone, I'll make this a 5* (but you need to rank up some food first :D) Edit: the game is worse than ever in stability, so I'm changing my score to 1* after tons of patches.

It's was very enjoyable for a few months but it's grown stale with the lack of new stuff to do. Update: Starting to see some improvement! The Doom Tower looks to be very promising and I'm excited for its release! The game still has a pretty high wall to climb if you're free to play so if you're not looking to spend at least a little money I wouldn't recommend playing to be honest because it will be a heavy grind. The content creators for the game a fantastic though and helpful for progression!

Since they feel the need to keep pestering me for review I'm going to knock a star. I'm taking 2 more, cuz this game is ridiculously pay to win. Good, if you're still with me then it is worth noting that this game is massively addicting, has great graphics, has a really good selection of diverse characters, and has actually managed to hold my interest for longer than a month. (Rare for an Android game) Pros: As above Cons: Absurdly expensive m-purchases. EXCESSIVE "deal" popups(30 a day). P2W

One of the best mobile games I've played. I've read other reviews and I do agree that the grind to level up champions, espically common, uncommon champions is annoying because of how weak they're and how little exp some levels give, but I normally try to level them up when I've double xp. Another thing I read was people saying it's pay to win, I'll disagree because if that was the case you wouldn't get a free green shard every 24 hrs and a free blue shard every 7 days, well you've to claim them.

Graphics are good and the character designs are well done even if the same model is reused for other images. The gameplay itself is boring as can be, offering a monotonous grind through missions or arena battles with little variety. The story is truly the only feature that kept my interest. The biggest nail in the coffin though: 4 ads every time the app opens.

This is a pay to win game. Every time you log into the game you have between 5-10 adds for in game purchases. Progressing with out spending money is very slow and tedios. Most of the fusions are impossable with out paying lots of money. The main summing shards that you need for better champs are very hard to get and are very expensive to buy. If you are not willing to pay money to play this isnt a game for you.

I have been playing for the past 4 years, and every year arena becomes more pay 2 win than the next. Especially 3vs3 arena which is a complete joke of a mode. The chances of getting good champs out of shards are horrible. Which is the main reason people would want to play a gatcha game in the first place. The game does have it's fun areas, but paywalls for those modes are plentiful. Unless you have unlimited time,patience or money. I suggest a different game.

Great graphics and action but it is a long grind. You will also need to spend some money or you are going nowhere. You will not be able to clear some challenges and earn the rewards. Best example is the arena were you need several 100s of win games and reach a high lvl (gold4) but this is not possible without some legendaries which you will only get if you spend money. I don't mind spending some money but this game will constantly ask you to buy stuff.

The game is grindy and they throw packs you can buy in your face when you load or return to the game screen alot. You have to pay in game money to unequip items, if you grind levels which gets you alot of junk items, they go into your mailbox, and when its full it does not warn you it just starts deleting mail; which cost me alot of rares I had't claimed yet. The game is fun up to a point but then the grinding has no end game. The summons are weighed to give you junk even with the good shards.

Mostly a good game. Raid shadow legends is basically just a reskin of Summoners War. It has its ups and downs. Pros the graphics are amazing if your phone can run it. The heroes are all really cool. The gameplay is fun. Cons. Extremly pay to win. The game is very grindy. Like spend 5 years to get anywhere grindy, that could be fixed but they decide to use energy. The battle pass is just a no no. All in all the game is good if you have time. Just dont expect to get far for free.

This app is really good about not sharing your data with third party app trackers which is a plus. If you are excited about getting your legendary shards, dont be. Enjoyable 'game'. Lots to do and figure out at the start. There is a lot to learn. Get's really grindy and repetitive really quickly. Once you get past the first few stages of the story line, the story fades into the background and is pretty much forgotten due to the time investment required to get much further being quite significant. This situation isn't unique to this mobile game. A nice feature is the 15 auto battles (multi-battles) you get every day after the time runs out on the initial 30 you get in a day when you start. This helps you level up your characters without requiring too much of your attention, but isn't enough by any stretch considering how many characters you need to get leveled up to their current rank's level cap in order to rank that character up, which in turn enables you to increase the rank of another character you have already leveled up to that ranks level cap, and then you have to re-level that character up from scratch to the higher ranks' larger level cap. There are lots of characters to level up and rank up and re-level up. Can you see the grindy bit yet? You get your best characters to rank up by sacrificing other characters you've ranked/leveled up. This is a slow process and gets really slow after each character gets to level 30... and each character can possibly get to level 60; You can pay $ for more daily muti-battles which last for a limited amount of time and then you need to pay again. Like many similarly structured mobile games you could drop a $grand$ on the game and still not really advance much which makes the value proposition of this "free" game pretty poor if you really like it and want to do well. I could buy an immersive PS4 or PC RPG game for $100 and get a massive amount of entertainment value for the money. Why anyone would fork out anywhere between $2 and $160 AUD for a pack of items that only gives a player a minuscule fraction of the games' available entities/progression, I don't know. There are a lot of mobile games like this, in which every bit of the game is divided up into small sections that carry an option to extract cash from you. These things are called 'games', but really, they are the front end of a business model designed to tempt you to pay $ to progress after it becomes clear that you'll probably die before you really get anywhere whilst playing for free, if you have a life, of course! Then there's the 'random' thing: You $buy$ a crystal that can possibly give you a legendary character OR just an epic character . You get an epic, but your mate gets a better legendary for the exact same money. I really hate this. It makes the value proposition of the thing much less attractive than it already was. Essentially, this is the same game you see all over the mobile space but with it's own idiosyncratic elements unique to it, and ideally, it wants your time and money on an ongoing basis. All you have to decide is, do you want this type of game in a fantasy RPG style, or a Dragon style, or a Zombie style, or.... or... or... take your pick. If you like the the fantasy RPG style of game visuals, this will visually satisfy you. The graphics are great. I also like the fact that this game doesn't force you to watch a load of video ads to obtain minuscule rewards. It tries to stand on its own two feet, which is admirable in this space, I suppose. 4 stars - because all the others in this genre I'd only give 2.5 to 3 stars on account of the advert overload and blatantly obvious 'free' but not really status. One more thing, I wish those multi-battles had an option to progress to the next battle rather than only repeating the same battle over and over again.

Update* I appreciate the response to my review, basically stating, ya about the ads, we really want people to spend money though, so... Games pretty fun, and they give good starting bonuses, but like other people say, the amount of pop up ads trying to get you to spend money is just too annoying. Highly recommend people to stay away from this game. Play for months and put in the time, get champions and grind just to get beat by some guy that played for a few days and put hundreds of dollars into his account and have 1/3 of the power but still beat you in arena due to having better champions. Play for months and still not able to participate in most of the good content due to being too low of a level.

WHAT THE FRAK! Just changed review from 5 to 1. Fix the freakin OP heroes and stuff OR make them available to all, otherwise Raid is doomed to die forgotten like so so many other PAY-to-win games. Yeah, we ARE there already free players do NOT stand a chance anymore and thats ruining the game. Grounding it for a bit, then I'll try picking it back up for a bit in a month or three and if its still pay-to-win its getting the boot from all my devices!

Pretty good! if youre into fantasy or medieval stuff, the aesthetics are great, character design is fun. Gameplay is dope. This is NOT one of those games where you never get new heroes unless you pay, you can get new heroes VERY frequently, which i appreciate. The game often shoves pay options in your face, whenever you return to base after doing a bunch of missions you are bombarded with spam for paid packages. You literally get like 10 at a time. That is the only reason for 4 stars and not 5.

It is pay to play, and before platinum says everything can be obtained for free. This is true but misleading and mostly untrue at the same time. Just because there is a minuscule chance of obtaining a legenday character that doesn't mean you will EVER get one. I have used many of the gold shards in summons and I have never obtained a legendary nearly 10 of them. If the odds are that trash then why play? The games cycle is repetitive and and the story needs to grow over time. Balance it better.

The RNG is deliberately horrible to get you to spend. You can run thousands of missions just to get 10 of some weak, mid-range item as an objective to progress a quest. Or even fail to get those 10, and you are simply stuck - you cannot progress the quest no matter what. Finally, it is the most boring, repetitive content. Massive waste of time and money.

This game is moderately entertaining however you probably shouldn't bother unless you plan to put money into it. The free daily pull only gives you the chance of getting up to 3 star heroes, and even the ones that offer 4 or 5 stars your odds are so abysmally low due to them leaving the 1 and 2 star heroes in the pool that you almost shouldn't even bother. Another annoyance is that their in game advertising is extremely aggressive. Expect to have to close out 3 to 5 of same ads repeatedly.

It's a fun little game that can really play itself for the most part. There is some champion usage strategy needed especially in the new tower challenge. Most of the in game purchases are waaaaay overwhelmingly over priced. They sure are proud of those things. They aren't really necessary unless you are one that must have to pay to win. I just wish they would get to releasing the other three races already. Cripes it's been a flipping year long teaser .😁✌🖖😎

Painfully boring, far too much grinding, too much work for little to no reward. The shards used to summon the champions mean little when you end up with the same type or even the same character 2 to 3 times in a row. 2 of the 4 types of shards have the exact same % to summon the types and level quality of the champions used to progress the game. Why? Why bother with 4? Just use 3. Anyways.. rant over. Game is great for those that love the boring grind and little return. Otherwise avoid this app.

Steal your money, if you don't receive an item due to a bug or just the game you don't get a refund nor do you get the item, to many pop ups every 5 secs cant even enjoy the game. They say it's Free To Play but they only cater to the people who spend money on it. Update: after they say this review they commented on it to act like they was going to resolve the problem I took the actions they asked for and messaged them and still didn't resolved the problem. What a joke 😂

Im not rating 5 because I haven't been able to play in about two weeks. When the last update came out I did the update and haven't been able to start the game since.. It just sits at the loading screen forever. I have missed out on so many daily rewards it's rediculous. But for the review - I read through the reviews and then got it and played it nonstop. I even got an emulator on the pc to start playing it on there. Highly recommended.

The account I had registered during beta was completely obliterated when I wanted to switch to a new device and DESPITE being linked to GooglePlay I still wasn't able to recover it, so that's my main gripe. It's also a really lazy game to play. If you can put 80% of the gameplay on auto that's not a good sign. The RNG is atrocious, and even with the top tier gem you can't be expected to receive legendaries. It was just really grindy. Otherwise, it's cool to look at.

The game works as intended. Which is a pay to win. Everything is programed to make you spend resources, time and energy to get not what you want. Ex in the dungeons to get your ingredients for ascending your Champs. There are twenty levels. More then half of those levels is gonna give you primarily the first level of the ingredient. Other then that upgrading armor is a money pit. And don't waste money on sacred shards. 6% is the chance for what you would get them for.

Solid design, nothing reinvented, though. Supports many visual languages (with a few mistakes there and there). Besides tutorial, no voices in-game which, nowadays, makes it feel quite empty in and out of battle. For me, this is a big selling point. Graphics are very good.

I would have gave it 5 stars for only one thing, the offers would pop every time you log in. I understand they are new offer but eventide :) Other than that, the game is really fun, the graphics are amazing and plenty of things to do. Very well done. Would be nice to make getting shards a bit easier , just a thought.

Uninstalled. Rate of drops for a legendary are ridiculously low. Start the game you're bombarded with sales, at least 6 to 8 individual pop ups with a deal to spend money. It's obvious that you must put in $100s of dollars to be formidable at best. I cant continue to play a game that insists you put in money into the game that doesn't give you nearly the value you spent. Suggestion users points for money spent that if you spend $200 Is a guaranteed legendary.

Beginning September 2019 I started playing the game. Here's the results...... overall I enjoy the game but I see some deafening pitfalls that ultimately leave the player base with a sour taste in their mouths and a hole in their wallets. Let's make one thing clear plarium, people want to have the choice to play your game for free without spending hundreds, to thousands, of dollars on a game. Personally I will, and do, throw money at a game I enjoy. But your drop rates/EVENTS are a sham.

This game is great in a lot of ways, except the fact that you have to pay a lot of money if you want anything substantial from it. It's too hard to get top tier stuff without paying insane amounts of money. If you are free to play, it will probably take you like 6 months before you get a legendary champion. It's a 6% drop rate to get a legendary champion with the best shard in game (which of course is hard to come by - without paying). This whole game is for people with money. Be warned!

The price gouging is relentless. Been playing the game over a year and a half. I'm so frustrated with the game mechanics imabout to quit. It's the slowest most grueling grind hard or pay to win game I've ever seen. My friend spent about 60 bucks on the game 2 years ago and hasn't played yet. I've been grinding hard for literally almost 2 years and I'm not close to catching up with him. Keep the free gifts and incentives coming. I'll continue updating my review.

Initially fun, disappointing over time. There were warnings about the game's lack of progress without spending money and they were right. Even though I have collected numerous epic and legendary characters, I cannot get to silver in the arena which had stalled my progress in two of the three challenge categories. Not even a refresh every 15 minutes would get me closer since my defensive team was constantly being beaten too. Arena rankings are garbage and misleading. Uninstalling after 75 days.

I must say, sceptical due to the add, but I was pleasantly surprised, as I normally don't like turn based games. • Combat system could use more depth, for starters, more Affinities, and the option to skip specific units' attacks. • Some abilities have great visuals, others not so much.

There are far too many pop-ups for their in game transactions. When I wrote support about this, they said that they wanted to make sure that no one missed their specials. Just proves to me that they are moeny mongers. Also, they have a pop-up for rating their game. Twice I've given it a single star, yet when I came to the Play Store it didn't show that I had rated it. Maybe it's for a different rating page. The game play is fun, but the pop-ups ruin it.

The game itself isnt bad, however my one star is because of the blatant amount of pay 2 win pop ups. EVERYTIME you go back to the bastion at least three pop ups happen and each cost money. I personally cannot stand p2p games. I'm just trying to relax and play a game, not spend money. I understand free mobile games depend on people spending money, however there's better ways to go about it. Forcing it in your face is not the way. Will not come back to this game again.

It's a fun game in theory but after spending about 100 bucks I've realized it's very unbalanced. To make the max out of your champions, you need to increase star rank and upgrade the character's skills with books. Plarium does not make either accessible. In Fate Grand Order, a similar gacha game, you have the ability to grind for both levels and skill upgrades. So the dedicated player can earn both without spending a dime. In Raid, there is no guaranteed way to farm for either. Pay 2 win.

Pay to win. Get bombarded by constant ads whenever you play. Can't turn them off. Boring. After developer response... Periodic ads is not 4 to 5 per action. Start the game, 4 ads pop up, do the campaign for a few, more ads, do a raid, 4 more ads, etc. Please don't try to make it like there isn't as many as 30 to 50 in under 30 minutes. Sometimes there is more. It's the same ads.

Great Game, plenty of game modes to explore, Never Crashes, updates are consistent but unfortunately to really get into this game you have to pay a great deal of cash to play, your silver currency will always run low which is a main factor in this game and the company pushes pop up marketing hard. Don't get sucked into spending serious cash. All in all it is an interesting experience & a competitive game to play.

This game has great graphics. There are many different modes to play on. Free daily/hourly gifts are available. Progress is slow without buying packs, but that's to be expected in any game. It's a fun game for people who like to play these kinds of games, and if you want to be a "competitive" player ot takes time or a little boost from many available packages.

Ever been part of a social experiment that aggressively tried to make you spend money? No fun! They got us used to the x2 event, after that took it away to starve is into spending precious in game gems on other lesser events, rewards for events also keep going down and they have a rough relationship with the youtubers that are an important part of the game (lots of players watch and enjoy the strategic discussions that make the game fun and challenging). The bar is to high 4 newbies these days.

Overly detail oriented. Unless I'm mistaken you can lvl one avatar 3 different ways at the same time i feel like I'm looking at a menu where I have to decide every little thing that gos on my burger and how I want it served where the prices are variable depending what else is put on it. Its a game on a phone sorry but I guess I'm old fashioned but idle is the idea. If I want to worry those details I will do it on a larger screen that is more user friendly. But you have fun paying to take off

The game has nothing to offer to free to play or low spender. You'll be dead before getting 6 start champions for faction wars as free to play. They never listen to community feedback. Only advantage is graphics, but that's not enough to keep the players. As this is quarantine time, many are just opening the game. Once things go back to normal, this game will just die. I'm writing this review after being disappointed with Christmas update (mainly fusion champion).

I really like this game, but they seem to be frequently doing maintenance. There's nothing more frustrating than getting an alert from the game saying I earned a new key that I can use or that a new area is open, and then I attempt to log in and I find it inaccessible due to current maintenance.

I wish the .models were different for each unit but that's asking too much. Okay graphics. The girls are mainly barbarians? If you're going to put a ratio of females into one faction might as well just make an amazon faction.. the ads, spam so much. I dont want to go back to the home page to turn in quests because the ads for in game purchases wont stop.

I have tried this game several times over the last few years with multiple devices, on wifi, on service, on both, and it never fails to amaze me at how horrible it is. I'm at the point that I will not be coming back again. I have to restart several times just to get into the game, countless times I'll click on buttons without them doing what they're spose to, and I get stuck so much just collecting rewards that it's ridiculous. Not to mention there's is a redemption code cooldown, wth 😡

The game itself seemed fun for the brief period I had it installed. The problem was Everytime I went back to the home/bastion I got buffeted by a million pay to win ads. I just love waiting for them to load one after another after another (counted six ads for pay to win, totalling 20 seconds of closing them Everytime I went back to the home screen).

I have played the game for 6 months and spent $$$. The ingame purchases are expensive, at times it's actually pay to play requiring purchases of energy, progress is sloooooow even with purchases to a point you wonder if it's worth playing. The game is like a slot machine - hours of monotony with the occessional win. Auto battle at least lets you play another game at the same time. Probably the big issue is the bugs, I can't play ATM cause the game requires an update which isn't on playstore yet

Removing game. Too many ads! Pay2win is what this game is and you will get super annoyed with the buy this and buy that. Your character will hardly level because things you need are near impossible to get or cost money. PC version is just the same. You say it's optional but you sit there putting up buy this and buy that 3-4 times in a row forcing people to click them repeatedly. Unacceptable! Deceptively put update dots on things that is just more buy this and that.

I have played a lot of gachas including Summoner's War, Dungeon Hunter Champions and am now playing Calibria and I can say that Raid is hands down the least amount of content offered in any game I've played. On top of that it is very VERY predatory in the way they offer their paid options. I do not say this lightly: this is a horrible game. Do not download, do not install. The devs lie and all the ads are paid. This game has been out well over a year and is still plagued by server instability.

This game seems cynically designed to waste your time and push you into spending money on overpriced currency packs. At no point in the several hours I spent playing this game did I ever feel like I was having fun, nor did I see the potential for having fun. What I did see was 10+ pop ups for LIMITED TIME SPECIAL BEGINNER BUNDLE EXPIRES IN 24 HOURS BUY NOW BUY NOW BUY NOW, ONLY $25, EXPIRES SOON BUY NOW!!! I guess the character designs are cool but graphics aren't a substitute for gameplay.

Recently tried this game again. The game is entirely designed to force you to grind a ridiculous amount or to get you to pay to skip that grind. Every action takes in game currency, even unequipping armor from your heroes. You have to pay a lot of silver just for a CHANCE to upgrade equipment and that chance goes down and cost goes up as The item gets to be a higher level. I spent 2 days grinding worth of silver attempting to upgrade an item.

I've been playing for years and haven't got very far at all. I spent real money on Void & Legendary Shards and received nothing but Rare Characters. Are you kidding me!!! If people are willing to spend their hard earned money (especially these days with times being what they are) on your game, shouldn't they receive what they are paying for? Let's be clear. They are selling you a CHANCE of advancing! You can easily spend money and still get mundane characters that add up to nothing. I'm done!

Game can be fun with cool characters, but the hero pull rate is absolute garbage. Even buying the overpriced shard packs gets me nothing but basic champions. Ive put probably close to $100 into this game in the last 3 months, and only have 2 of the Free, in game legendary heros. It's annoying as hell because you can't progress without these heros, and I can't even buy one if I tried. Do better Plarium....

This game is trash. I only downloaded this game after seeing ads on YouTube for it multiple times. The ads made the game look great and fun. Not only does it have one of the most old, simple, and boring fighting systems in RPG's, the ads made the graphics look great, when they look like they were pulled from 2006. Not to mention the story is just plain bad. Imagine Avengers Endgame without watching any of the other films and you get RSL. There's just no context. Has cool characters though.

As P2W as P2W can be hahaha. But what do you expect from this kind of game loll. Pros: The graphics are pretty, you can enjoy certain aspects of the game without being P2W (like the campaign~).The game gives you a LOT of free energy too. Cons: If you wanna enjoy the other aspects though, then of course its P2W what do you expect lol. You need to spend to get the really good heroes and sacrifice your other heroes to 6 star them, get those heroes good equipments and fully booked.

Been playing for about 3 months. Definetly pay to win and not a game for casuals. Fun at first as you begin to collect some cool heroes, but then reality sets in. Youre not winning events because you either have to save up tons of resources or you pay to gain them. 3 months playing and yet to pull a Legendary... Understandably as it should be difficult, but as a casual it feels like more of a let down. As soon as you log in you are bombarded with "special deals" before you can even tap toplay

It is a fun game, but the support absolutely sucks. When I tried to buy a monthly membership, I was informed that i did not get validation from the server. It gave me the option to file a complaint with support. So I followed through, took a screenshot of the issue, attached it, along with a written explanation, and it repeatedly told me that I had not completed all fields. I had completed all fields, and I followed every instruction to the letter, and was still unable to file a complaint.

Pricing system is unreasonable....you get very little for spending money, yet the dev has designed the games mechanics to force you to spend money, (if you want to progress in a timely manner). The battle system is on point and fun, graphics are good, skill effects look cool. Hope you enjoy using resources to unequip gear....silly... Maybe a month of enjoyable game time... 3 star is only because the actual gameplay is nice... Nice game....greedy Dev....Typical...

Played it for 2 weeks to give it a try. At first it's ok, trying to understand the mechanics of the game, then I plateaud at lvl 50. Upgrading shouldn't fail so much at a "high" chance of succeeding, easy way to burn through your little gain of silver a day. P2W is really heavy on this game and new players have no chance to getting all rewards from events without spending money. Tournament's are unfair for new players as well. Warframe is better F2P game imo even though it's a console/ PC game.

UPDATE: I've played on both my Pixel 1 and iPad Mini, with the games updated, but both still freeze/crash every now and then (seems to freeze more on the pixel, and crashes on the iPad). Sometimes even while loading a fight, which has wasted a lot of energy on both devices. Very fun and addicting. Just freezes a good amount, but only has been during loading fights and not in the middle of actual gameplay.

The game has a good take on the genre, with great graphics, interesting skills and strategies and a gear system that lets you customize your champions. Long grind for leveling up your team plus skills and masteries, but I'm enjoying. The microtransactions are terribly overpriced, and the PvP is pretty stale (only a few must-have characters or strategies). Biggest problem is frequent game crashes/freezes that consume your energy and rare resources. It's a huge pain, unfixed for months

The game is relying on grind patterns, which is OK. But there are not enough things given to new players to progress unless they spend on the game. Overall the graphics are nice, and game play is smooth. Adding options for new players or even low spenders to catch up with content would make this game way better.

Very Difficult!!!!! I'm not rich so I can't afford anything!!!! No matter how much I play the game to get stronger this game will show you just how week you are!!!! I've gotten online in search of help and every promo code is a dead end... Nothing works!!!!! But if you have the extra money to spend for different clothes for characters and extra strength for Elite Characters this game is for you!!!!

Game in itself is straightforward and pretty enjoyable, good graphics although the sound quality is a lil iffy, unlike some p2p style games they give you a large sum of "energy" to start off. I was told the "special offer" tabs that spam pop up when you open the game where able to be turned off, this was a lie as the app resets your settings again when you close it, and turning off all notifications still allows a few pop ups with "deals", although they arent deals if you're asking for 20$+

The game itself is fair, gameplay is interesting and can keep my attention for awhile each day. However what gets this app a 3 star for me, is EVERY time you open the app for what seems longer than 10 minutes you'll get bombarded with in game micro transaction ads. Quite surprising that there's not a. " □ Don't see these ads the rest of the day". Option for the game, that way players can jump back in, without wasting time hitting the X button. Overall it's a very solid app and worth a try.

Excellent graphics, customizable champions (although it's a bit too expensive to unequip them). Fun hero collection that look amazing. The only thing holding back a 5-star review would be the typical mobile format of wanting a lot of your money. Energy/Time Gating is the worst idea ever and you'll all agree. However, I think Plarium does a pretty good job of balancing it so you don't NEED to spend money to progress (at least so far as you level into level 30s and beyond but we'll see).

Not worth it. This game is actual trash. Downloaded it because it looked cool. The story and animation is there, however, all you do is click the next thing, there are no real choices or strategy and you can't control your hero you just go from one fight to the next. It's like watching a story but you click to proceed. The narration is also annoying at best. Also you get items called artifacts after each battle and your character's appearance doesn't change. It's basically a facebook game.

The game is a grind with no endgame, the pop up ads are horrendous. Everytime you log in its 5 full screen "Spend Money!" ads getting in the way. Also it costs an insane amount of in game currency to remove equipped gear for some reason. That said, the graphics are great, good turn based combat (when its not on auto, which is like not even playing the game) and the characters & their abilities are unique. You never seem to run out of energy, are always earning more so it isnt wait to play. 7/10

This game is amazing and i was loving it... But it has been acting up so bad lately and only getting worse. It would freeze once and a while on load screen. Okay, i dealt with it. But then it started freezing in middle of battle. Now i cant play more than two rounds before it freezes in combat or load screen... Exiting and going back in over and over made me realize how many ads they dump on you at begining when signed in. They work at least!

Cons: - crashes - multiple banners (7 ads buy this, buy that). - in order to remove or switch your equipment, you have to pay in game currency. - you cannot choose what skill of your character will be leveled up (🤦‍♂️) and that's extremely annoying because resources for upgrade are rare to find unless you're paying real money for the game. - doesn't require any skill to play. - auto-battle is bad on high level dungeons. Pros: - graphics and animation - story - time killing Only 500 letters here

I loved this game cause the graphics are fantastic, hero designs were cool, and there's many quests to keep you busy until you run out of energy of course. Seems like they give you a few good champions in the beginning so you can spend time and money to upgrade them. It's f2p but if you want to progress faster, you have to spend money. So it can become time consuming and expensive. I also can't believe they still don't have a personal messaging system for such a big game too. Uninstalled.

It's actually entertaining. It's not an easy grind too, but not an overbearing one either. The graphics as most peope would advertise is actually decent. So far I'm not getting frame drops in the highest settings as well. If you're looking for some time to kill outside the house (or inside as well), work, school, travel, give the game a shot. It's pretty good.

It started out pretty fun. Graphics are good, gameplay is smooth, etc. The bombardment of shop ads every time you pop in is obnoxious. It doesn't take long before you begin to understand just how grindy this game is and it seems to make it very clear to you that your stuff just isn't good enough for much of anything (pvp pairings, tournaments, hell, even dungeons). It's very demotivating to play after a time as you pick low end stuff up knowing its a waste to upgrade, but having to do it anyway

Had the game less than a week and had to contact the support line 6 times (not joking ) just to get to log in or wait for them to fix some bug problem ... It's a fun game when you actually get to go on ... Otherwise if your looking for a game to play on your time and not when they decided when you can and can't play ... Maybe look at something different there is some games if you scroll down at your suggestion that would atleast run better ...

Is game is amazing and has great potiential. But Plarium is exceedingly greedy they only care about money more then they care about the condition of the game. And the one thing I always hated is the ads when you open the game it is extremely annoying having to close out several ads before playing unless you quick enough to click on the Sparring Pit. If I want to spend money then I will, I don't need a barrage of ads.

Enjoyable with great graphics. I'd like to see a more robust system for the fusion function where one can upgrade to high end characters. Right now much of the character aquisition is pure RNG. I'd prefer, even if farming low level characters was intensive, the ability to put direct effort in and get results. Otherwise, so far it's distracting enough.

I wasn't ready to write a review about the game or even give a rating since I've only been playing for an hour, but what I just experienced has to be voted down hard!! After completing a mission and going back to the main screen, I was hit with 7 (seven!!!) pop-ups with cash-shop deals. I kept clicking them away and new ones kept turning up. Really, I'm not someone who doesn't understand monetization in F2P games and I've used microtransactions myself, but this is just annoying. Uninstalled.

Complete trash! Game constantly freezes during battle or at the end. When you reopen the game it asks you if you want to report the failure, but nothing ever happens.. you lose energy and its never given back. It happens during dungeons campaign and clan boss. Also there was an update that lowered the drop rate of lesser potions of certain level dungeons, but thats all I am rewarded is lesser... i hardly ever get greater or superior potions. I have reached out to the support. They never respond

Tbh, I had a lot of fun at first. The second time you log in, they shove their ads in your face, some of which are uncloseable, leaving you with the option to restart your game or buy. The gameplay is also repetitive, but the character design makes up for it. If you like character collection games, install it. If your looking for an epic rpg, this isnt for you

First off don't think I think this game is bad it is fun at some points and the characters are well designed, I particularly like the lizardmen, but it does get a bit repetitive and auto mode kinda sucks to use as characters will tend to use their stronger abilities on one shot enemies instead of saving them for the boss. I also dislike the amount of silver you get per a mission that seem like pennies compared to what it takes to upgrade and that's if it even succeeded.

I really wanted to get into it. The character design is outstanding. The story seemed like, it would be interesting. But I can't stand the constant ads. If they were a little more discreet with it, I wouldn't have stopped playing. Also I hate you have to keep redoing the same battles. I wish you could sim what you 3 stared. I normally enjoy grinding for loot. But I found the grind very boring.

Not bad, decent graphics, gameplay, and even a hint of story. Took a lot of battery life though, and it's very grind heavy. There's no way to mass speed through dungeons beyond queuing and running at 2x speed for the drops you need. Very generous on the premium currency and loads of bonus loot to get you started. Ultimately after about 20 days of trying it, I found I was just doing the same thing over and over.

They broke one of the cardinal rule of gaming. Controlling the players gameplay by limiting freedom to play uniquely. The questing system is set up so you LITERALLY have to follow their EXACT order of ACTIONS for the 1st tier rewards FIRST before doing ANY OTHER ACTIONS. If you do otherwise then your time spent becomes inefficient. This means you have to do 2nd tier actions over again because you didnt follow their steps. The creator is forcing players play it their way, and not the gamers way :(  To clarify lets give an example. I'm at level 30 and I've completed a number of quests. I farm the stages for an easier progression on campaign mode. I spent A LOT of time doing that. Now to my surprise I did not unlocked the "suggested" quest progression for level 2 because level 1 quest was not completed yet. I can't memorize every quest here. Even though I had already fulfilled all of the quest requirements for level 2-5. Now I have to do them all over again. Waste of time IMO. I just feel that there is no need to lock quest rewards. If I end up doing quests unknowingly, it should still count towards those quests. Play the game people. If its for you, awesome. Not me

Last edit: You don't actually earn gear or characters, it's all based on a draw system. Ironically (sarcasm), the draws are terrible. The success rate for gear upgrades for "high success" or "minimal success" are pretty much the same. It's all set up to get you to need more energy for more slot machine style gambling for good items. It's almost impossible to upgrade character skills at a certain point. Loses luster at around account lvl 30. Fun costs maybe $200-300+ real life money.

I love the game, room for improvement. The game features strategic, turn-based gameplay, with beautiful graphics. Heavy char collection w/ lmtd evolution, lots of gearing... there could be a much more robust gear and character management system. One layer of filters leaves you wanting more. There should be multiple filtering options for chars and gear. Increased depth (#of encounters) and path selection within the instances would be awesome, with varying difficulties and rewards for choices.

Pretty visuals alone don't make for a good game. The equipment system is lame (and has no visual effect as is occasionally advertised). Every fight is the same (three waves of 3-4 enemies, with one being an overly large boss at the final level of each stage or "special" dungeon). The choices for champions are not actually varied ("Rare" and up are the only real options for late/end game, as Common and Uncommon don't have anywhere near the necessary versatility). The animations are super awkward.

Fun but unplayable. The game is fun and offers many different activities and heroes. The problem is its extremely hard to enjoy for long due to three primary reasons. The first is the ads. When logging in you have to clear 10 plus ads. Whenever you clear or complete just about any activity more ads show up. Secondly it's a p2w game. Everything cost resources from summoning to leveling up skills. Last is the abysmal loading freeze after completing any activity making the game unplayable.

well it seemed like a good game, was able to get almost through the first area, then got kicked out and stuck on the loading screen. cant log in, cant play. giving it two stars only because I liked what I was able to play. I contacted support but have yet to hear back. will rate again if my issue is fixed. edit: gotta love all the generic answers. here's one I'm sure you have heard before.. I'm uninstalling this game cause it doesnt work on many of the android devices you made it for.

Smooth game play. Nice graphics and UI. Really complex game. The guided intro was a bit annoying - can't explore on your own until you get through that. You can spend a lot of time leveling up chars in this game. But what caused me to uninstall this game is the incessant popups to buy this pack or that. Just now I had six popups in a row. Never even got back to the home screen. Fed up, I force closed the game and uninstalled.

Initially I really enjoyed this game, but feel really discouraged by not being able to equip my champion with gear cause I'm out of silver. Sure, I can grind it out, but it's exhausting and frankly it made me decide to just play and spend less. Multibattle should be a free feature, or just sweeping the levels like you can do in other games. Despite that, I see a lot of potential in this game. P.S Something like the battle pass would bring in more revenue than the """""deals""""" on offer now.

Six pop-up ads in a row is unacceptable. I'll decide if and when I want to spend money on your game, thank you. In games that *don't* spam me with offers, I actually do make occasional purchases. Games whose ads make it difficult to play, however, I simply uninstall. /edit: In response to the developer's follow-up - It isn't periodic, it's idiotic. if YouTube forced everyone to click through 5 or 6 ads every time they visited the site, nobody would use it. And it's a shame, because I probably would have continued to play and supported the game with "periodic" purchases (the gameplay itself isn't bad... once you can get to it), if it wasn't so obnoxious about trying to get me to spend money all the time. Commercial interruptions are the number 1 reason I and everyone I know subscribe to streaming services instead of watching over-the-air or basic cable. Mobile games seem about a decade behind the times on this sentiment.

Boring. Not an RPG, not a strategy game, just another garbage mobile "game" where the only goal is to grind forever, and from time to time challenge other players to see who looped the most the biggest dungeons in the arena, a Pokemon Go's gyms-like system where only the attacking player can make decisions. Not to mention the multiple popups trying to sell you packs and boosts every few minutes at an unreasonable cost. Only the graphics are good, but that's not enough to save the whole thing.

Installed the game 2 days ago, and I'm already over it. The app froze numerous times while playing. There's no support either, so I ended up repeatedly losing progress, energy, & keys every time it crashed. I purchased a few "deals" from the continuous onslaught of popups & regretted it since I can't play the game without it freezing. Each time you restart the app the popups respawn, which is an especially annoying reminder. Imo, it's a repetitive p2w with very little story, lore, rp or tactics.

Played this game for a couple of months only because the youtube sponsors for this. It seemed like a typical unit upgrade game, but I wanted to try it out. After the first month it became really repetitive and annoying to progress. Then it just got straight up boring in the second. The mechanics were typical, but the characters designs were really the only enticing thing for me. Overall a game thats fine for a month, but after that and its just extra space.

Very nice graphics and concept. Game play quickly becomes a repetitive grind, and without spending plenty of cash to advance, you'll never really get anywhere or be able to compete above bronze level in the arena. Also, having to spend silver just to unequip items is totally ridiculous. RESPONSE: Considering you have to spend millions to upgrade each artifact fully, you shouldn't have to pay again to switch gear you have spent so much on already.

At this point I've got about 2 weeks in and more info. The story is alright, kind of short, but it's mobile 🤷‍♀️. Graphically the champion models are very well done👍. The biggest issue I'm running into is..glitches: daily clan activity progress resetting AFTER I've used 2 attempts on the Clan Boss, and cleared dailies, plus, the game completely crashing when loading up dungeons or campaign battles (as much as 10 times in a row) and still using energy makes the entire thing a headache. Fix it.

Fun and addictive. Can pay to play but no need in order to have fun. PvP doesn't seem balanced, too many times needed to refresh in order to get teams of my level. Not sure 8f my phone or the game, but sometimes pressing a button doesn't work, and then continuously tapping to make it happen makes it work and then the button afterwards that wasn't intended to be pressed right away. Overall fun.

Definitely pay to win "free game".. legendary drops are abysmal at best. Raid does give freebies once in a blue moon that include an arena refill, a clan boss key, and free energy. Whoopie!! Let's get excited for things that mean absolutely nothing in terms of progressing through game. Even when you have a team of level 60 characters, it is still often times impossible to progress through doom tower on normal setting. Enjoyed the game for a bit of time before I became uninterested.

Most of this game is great, it's basically what I wish Galaxy of Heroes was. My biggest problem is the pop ups, whenever you go ingo the home menu they just suddenly appear, and they aren't cheap either you have to close about 3-5 $25-$50 dollar ads. And if you go to try and click battle or anything else in the bottom right then you'll get vortexed into the purchases page. The game also lags quite a lot and the animations rarely run as advertised.

This game is beautiful. It is a well thought out hero collector game without an intellectual property to lay out the next chapters or characters. The down side the crazy monetization. The easiest way to get to a goal or make progress to to spend. The more you spend, the faster you will progress. This is further emphasized by the near continual splash ads.

Playing the game for about 6 months now. My personal experience with support has been extremely poor. Two support tickets submitted, the second one got a form response with no attempt for a solution. At the time of the support request, I spent at least 350 on the game and felt I deserved at least a human response (seems I was wrong). So many popup ads -- way more then any other phone game I've played. They do not announce in game events ahead of time to allow the player to decide how to best use the game resources or to hold off until a game event. If you are a collector like I am, beware that you can buy some additional storage space for your champions, but not nearly enough to collect all the champions, and still be able to farm food. (main aspect of the game to improve champion levels and ranks) It is very cumbersome. It is a beautiful game though. The teams you can build and the strategy aspect is nice. Highly suggested if you have much disposable income.It is very expensive game to play. If you have Gambling addiction stay away, shard pulling is worse then slot machines.
