Low review because lack of support when needed, very slow on releasing new content, overly aggressive push to spend money for a slight chance to get something "good". Lack of ability to get additional storage for champions.

The game itself is a blast. Lots of different types of charaters to summon and use. The one star is because of the push notifications. I get them approx every 7 min or so first on my computer then on my phone, even after turning them off in game. Then when you do log in there 5 seperate screen directing you to by stuff. Gets old quick. Update - now the game loads and after the second pop up it crashes. Finally uninstalled it. Users beware.

Most of the time, the game never logins. always says "technical issues cant login". good graphics but very cosy purchase option. game is really very very very hard at mid to high levels. most battles are very hard. For upgrading one champion we need to sacrifce multiple champion. thats a stupid ass hole concept. almost an impossible scenario to get epic and legendary champions. lost interest. uninstalling the game

Good idea & nice visuals, however unless you have hours & hours to waist, you'll never get anywhere. The time, energy, silver resourse to rewards ratio's are not worth the time. Probably a great game if you want to spend allot, & I mean allot of money. 9 months in & everything I've accomplished has been stripped from me due to polariums on ability to update! Think about that kind of aggravation when you're getting ready to put in the time! It's that easy to watch it be stripped away! Wasted Time

No excuse for a game with this kind of potential to have the amount of micro transaction based offers, sales, deals, ect, shoved down your throat constantly. There should never be an auto play feature in ANY game, period. The only good thing this game has to offer is it's graphics. It's extremely boring and completely revolves around micro transactions. Don't even bother trying it. Also they claim you can play without paying, but good luck getting anywhere that way. Seriously. Its pay to win.

This a great rpg mobile game! My only two complaints are long grinding moments and the game freezes often. This game is very rewarding except when it comes to grinding for armor and such for upgrading champions. I have to play stages several times all to get rewarded just one piece of artifact. Also rewarding just one character a scroll out of 4 or 5 of them that I play to obtain more upgrades. It gets boring to play for hours for very little upgrades.

I tested the game out for ~2 weeks, and I'm amazed. Even though there's barely any real gameplay involved, it really is highly addictive. First, you make quick and easy progress. Then, it slows down, but there's still great stuff to be earned without spending money. Then you realise, progress becomes agonisingly slow. And then you start getting short on "energy", that is required for most activities. Ultimately, this is one money sucking machine, barely disguised as a game. Just don't do it.

I find it eats inputs. I often have to reclick things to get things to register. Edit: I have to click most things twice or three times for what ever action it was supposed to do to happen. Eg: load the market, open a character screen, or even select an artifact so I can see it stats. The game is laggy? I wouldn't even say that. Just an unreactive user experience regardless of settings

After the first few areas, goes almosy entirely pay to win. You can still grind your way through, but you run out of energy so frequently that you almost have to pay anyway for more stamina if you want to progress in a timely fashion. Really pretty game, but repetitive gameplay, and the abundance of need to sink money into a "free" game overshadows the graphics.

I overall enjoy playing the game. The graphics are good. However, the money grabbing in this game has become too much. Pay 30 dollars and you get a limited pass for "free" champions. I'm assuming it is not just a one time charge. I'm F2p, I feel like this puts F2P players at a serious disadvantage. Didn't mind the 5 or 6 pop ups that appear but now this 30 dollar charge is too much.

I played for less than a week. The game is cool, love the graphics and gameplay. However, the monitization is outrageous. Every time I came out of combat to my base, or when I log in, I get BLASTED by add after add. Literally, 7 pop up windows in a row before I could do anything. Every. Time. I try to play these games without spending money, which is why I don't play mobile games much. Terrible experience for someone trying to get into mobile games.

Great game. Just a little glitchy. Have to tap icons several times before they perform the action. Edit: changing my rating to lower stars game crashes too much and lose out on energy or reward from battles, they know it crashes cause a box pops up and ask you to report it or not. And the clicking of icons to perform any action is way worse than I originally thought. I probably spend more time clicking in attempts to play the game than I do actually playing.

Constant crashes. Developers are always handing out freebies because of how bad the app is. The push notifications are completely broken and go off every 10 minutes if you dont disable them, which should probably be illegal with the way they constantly pressure you to buy more nonsense, like spending $30 on a single champion or artifact set. Highly addicting and great visual game. Extremely poor execution by the company.

I like the game for what it is. But it rarely works for me. After a few minutes of gameplay, if I close the app and come back later, the game gets stuck on "authenticating" then saying the wifi or maintenance is the problem and the only options are to contact support or relogin. But this will go on for days, not just a few minutes or hours. Prompting me to uninstall and reinstall the game.

Loved it at first, the graphics are amazing. Spent more than I should have which I regret after realizing it was a never ending money sink. An example being skill tomes, a thing each champion, of which you will have many, some which will need replacing, it's very easy to burn through these books. They are super rare though or hidden behind events and tournament's you can only get enough points in if you pay in. This is just one example. The storage for your champions is a clutter fest too.

I was having a lot of fun, but then all of the achievements focus on the PVP option, which is so fundamentally broken that I ended up not playing instead of trying to get better at it. If there's a "skip mission" option added, or if the guantlet wasn't set up where I never have people to fight near my strength, and the only metric that matters is speed I'll pick it back up.

Talk about a game that builds it's own resentment. The grind in this game at the upper levels is beyond that of W.O.W. or any other MMORPG, yet it's game play is repetitive and monotonous. It's terribly fun at first, with dynamic graphics and a complex economy, but once you start to get to high levels to raise a 5 star to a 6 is a level of work that is almost a game in itself, no to mention you have to do that multiple times. Tldr, fantastic game at the beginning, becomes painfully slow.

The game was fun to begin but I have been playing for almost a year and it quite literally the same game as it was when I started. If you are cool with doing the same dungeon run on auto play hundreds of times per week just to hope you get a good piece of equipment this is the game for you. There are so many flaws with this game that it is ridiculous. Takes months for each patch to come out only for them to release a couple quality of life changes with no new content. Money grab game.

Its was fun until you get tired of the ads. Every time I play about 15 ads pop up about their deals and their pay to win style. It really takes you out of the fun until the game just becomes a grinding game for money that will just last you for 5 minutes Another issue is that sometimes when I exit and enter the game a lot the game bugs out and the match never begins it just keeps loading.

it's a good game dont get me wrong. but.... it's not that different from all the other similar games. theres more strategy then other games but you have to pay several expenses bundles and then pay for the items needed to stat boost to get to that level. you hit the paywall but I dont mind they deserve it. but I realized that even if I pay for bundles a lot more money needed in the next level. the grinding is unforgiving. you can grind for a CHANCE to get what you need. but wow it's a lot!

I enjoy playing this game as I play it every day. But I'm getting tired of the constant crashing. What really drives me crazy is I don't get reimbursed for your mistake. If the game crashes, I lose my arena token, energy, clan boss key, and so on. I get the beta testing, but I want my expenses back and I don't want my arena fights to be counted as a loss!

great game... if I could play I've been trying but all I get is this error this error unable to load part of the resources. it is really frustrating. everything the issue gets fixed it pops up again. all I've gotten is an automated response that provide no information on the issue. I would love some help with my game. >:( great game otherwise. it's a bit of a grind but it's a fun game to just sit and play when I'm bored. 4 str if the issues can actually get fixed and i can play again....

Great game so far. Anyways, some features, like the way you upgrade items 1 lvl at a time is too tedious considering the fact that u keep changing ur gear over and over again while you grow. The "Ten tries button" It doesnt seem's to work, at least for me. Maybe an Item lvl transfer feature would be possible too?. And I think that an easy "auto win" button once you cleared stage with 3 stars, must be added. I've been playing for like 5 hours without stop and I still have 400 Energy to spend haha

The game itself is ok. Gets super boring after five minutes, my problem is the aggressive marketing and newsletters every time you log in, it's always pop-up after pop-up. yall must think we are stupid. the store pop ups are not important event information. its shameless marketing to the underage children using their parents cards. enough with the damn pop-ups your events are not that important to have a pop up every single time

Could easily be the BEST game on the app store if it weren't for a few issues. 1. The grind is insane which wouldn't be too bad if they had an auto battle loop feature. (They have auto-battle, but you can only have it loop for like 15 times a day, this should be a standard feature with unlimited use due to the grind) 2. Developer greed. I get that it takes a lot of money to make a great game like this, but be prepared to have ads shoved in your face every time you start the game. High pricesToo

Bad, bad, bad. Not free to play....at all. After 6 months of constant grinding and hundreds of dollars spent still 0 good champs and or good enough gear. Which you need both of to half way compete. Otherwise you are wasting too much time. Also, constant adds trying to get more money out of you....DONT BE TEMPTED. You have to buy the artifacts just to see what the stats are, which 9.5 times out of 10 you will be disappointed. Wish someone would have warned me before I wasted Time and Money.

This game is pretty cool. I love the graphics and overall gameplay. Lots of moves, characters, items and customizations. I would have loved to give this game 5 stars however, it crashes waaay too much! Also, when you're in a "Battle" your "Shield buffs" that are placed on your entire party from a champ within that party, wont follow those characters to the next wave within that battle even if they have residual shield left over from the prior wave. Only the initial caster of the shield buff will

It's a really fun game, enjoyable and well made. Up until now I've been fine with the aspects of it that are bought using real money (quick way to get new characters and gear) as I've been able to grind passed this. But after mistakenly assigning the wrong armor piece to one of my guys, I was charged 20k silver to remove it. Really?! It's a scaling cost to upgrade items, starting at like 200 (you start with 30-40k). I get people make mobile games to make revenue, but make it logical. Jesus.

Good game with excellent graphics and a solid story. Not necessarily pay to win as long as the player is willing to do some level grinding. The prizes are good and you can have a good lineup of characters in no time. Unfortunately the developers designed it in the manner that many games of the same genre are designed today, including the biggest flaw IMO which is the auto play. No skill is needed and in the end players get a nice visual (never ending) fairy tale, to be forgotten soon after.

This game is an enjoyable experience with decent voice acting, good graphics and easy to understand gameplay/combat mechanics. The cons that brings it to 3 stars is constant game freezes in arena n dungeons as well as "buy this deal" windows that pop up alot. Dev response edit: i have turned off every notification i can find in app n phone, but since your game has a new "timed deal" seemingly every 5 mins I still get pop ups often. If I want to buy I will buy, I dont need constant reminders.

Very addicting at first. Best graphics on a mobile game Ive seen. So many dungeons, heroes, and areas to power up and explore. The randomness makes it exciting. After I was 2 months in and got my first 6 star champion, I started to lose interest as there isnt much to see or do after, except to grind and climb the arena. Battles are not very challenging.

The game is definitely pay to win. They try to sell you very expensive packs of goodies that a lot of time don't seem worth it. If you really want to play end game you going to have to spend hundreds of dollars to get a chance at getting the meta champs. There adds for the store are super annoying and Everytime you log in to play you have to close out of 5 plus add deals. Campaign is short but has multiple difficulties. You just auto battle everything eventually because it's super repetitive.

For a mobile game it's a solid effort. The story line is cool. The various characters (champions) are imaginatively interesting and the various armor sets allow for multiple customizable outcomes. Problems? The awfully long load times especially when logging in, too many ads. The often delayed reaction times when trying to navigate through different screens. The scarce drop rates of level up items and higher star equipment and the unfair match ups in the arena.

I'm enjoying the game so far my only two gripes are one there are way to many ads trying to get you to buy things every time you log in you have to deny buying 4 to 6 things. Secondly the game keeps freezing up causing me to have to log back in and having to look at all the offers again. Still having fun with it at the moment though.

When you are ramming multiple popups into my face to buy stuff everytime I log in it makes me hate the game based on this alone. Packages are way overpriced. You should not be paying the cost of a console game for some of these packages. The pricing screams predatory and money grabbing. Outside of those things I do like the graphics. I like being able to upgrade and level up armor weapons and units. I even like the autoplay function.

Simple "3 fights" per level format. Been around for years before this game. Tons of tiny options, 9 pieces of gear for each character, ways to level up and mod each of those pieces, spells for every character which can all be leveled up. Honestly, it's too much. It's just too nitpicky for me. And there's 8 trillion popups to spend real money on the game. Like 4 in a row when you first open the game. Get real.

Alright game I guess. Another "free" game with tons of ads. Just opening the game you go through about 5-6 ads. Then in between battles and things. Even though you pick the theoretical "skill" it still auto plays the actual fights and interactions. Might as well just set it to auto play overall and not bother. Frankly disappointing as it could be a far greater game.

Operation: Game has a lot of bugs,glitches,crashes, instabilities, malfunctions,technical issues,lots of problems. Reason for only 2 stars: Greedy,selfish, coldhearted to CC's, uncaring,only in the playstore for a profit. To be fair it's a good game that needs a lot of improvement. Has a lot of potential if fixed. If you're lucky in the shard pulls can be free to play and get far without having to spend any money on the game!

It's a great game and I enjoy it as a f2p player. However, compared to other games, the cost of premium content seems unreasonably high. Update: I've been playing for over a year now. I really like the gameplay, the collection aspect and the visuals. The game just looks amazing. Sadly, imo, the huge money aspect destroys the game. As a Ftp, you cannot compete with spenders. Just forget Tournaments and High-End arena completely... Also, the constant barrage of Pop-Ups kills the fun.

Initially it's quite fun, a little overwhelming with all of the different macanics at play, but it felt good. Soon it become more a chore to enjoy. Passing higher level campaigns, bosses, dungeons, or do well in the dungeons requires lvl 60 champs with very specific gear, all your masteries, fully ascended, etc. Gear and champs are random on what you'll get so you need to gamble and hope for the best. If you're looking for more a casual game, & maybe spending a little here or there, look again

A very solid turn based game, haven't hit much of a "Pay to Win" wall yet, but the rarer champions are nearly impossible to get without spending cash. There's a very small chance of getting one from a rare or better crystal, but you gotta get lucky to get those in the game. Crystal rarity doesn't guarantee you'll get any set champion, though, since you'll likely get nothing but "rare" heroes instead of the two next tiers. Also wish the game didn't throw random pop-ups to make me buy items.

There isn't a game. It's just an awful repetitive movie more than anything. There is essentially no gameplay, just auto battle. The game looks fine but to say that the graphics are on par with AAA games is incredibly misleading. Everything costs something. Upgrades are randomized and cost silver. You literally have a chance to upgrade characters, and not a very good one. The game will try its best to get you to pay real money through tedious and repetitive "gameplay". This "game" offers nothing.

Review in progress. Downloaded and installed game to see what the ads and reviews were all about. Got past the tutorial and explored the achievements, quest line rewards, ect. The total potential of free things that are feasible to get. In short, if you are active you can get a fair amount of free stuff every month. If not, for the low low price of 500 USD you can get a chance at high tier champions 5 times a month.And for 50 USD every 6 months you can get more exp and silver. So far, typical.

Graphic i can say its good. But gameplay is boring. And the worst for me is the upgrading heroes system is too tedious. You'll go back to level 1 on every champion upgrade. Removing equiptment also require you to pay. No option to sweep 3 star cleared stage. So progress is extremely slow because player will stuck grinding on the same stage back to back to progress. I tried to stay with the game for a week but...nah, this is not for me. Pop up ads also very intrusive for me.

This developer reached out to me and explain I could progress normally without paying money, you can, however it doesn't mean that they won't slow down that progression to such a degree that it makes you want to spend money to speed it up. So I end on two notes, one the developer seems to care, that's good. Sadly if you download this game you are in it for the long haul but maybe that's just personal preference. Finally I originally installed the game, left a bad review, to try to stop ads..

I love the game but this game crashes more than any other game I play or have played. would have gave it a 5 star instead of 4 if not for crashing every 15 minutes. Also it could update a Swipe or Clear option on dungeons and things that have already cleared would be helpful so did not have to watch every single time run back through them over and over trying to get Ascend items. Thanks.

This game is great in the beginning. Great graphics, fun fights, cool champions. Once you progress towards end game, you realize that the game is a money pit and the only way to do well is to throw $100s their way. I don't have a problem spending money on a game if it translates into worthwhile content; however, giving money to Plarium translates into stupid contests instead of quality content and updates. Plarium needs to spend time on making quality content instead of having dumb contests.

I love the graphics but not the game. The game is good and have a numerous character that is not just a color swap and characters is modeled nicely. The game does have stamina system, but the dev is just so generous that they give you tons of stamina that somehow will last like, forever. But, seriously tho, those banner at the first time booting this game, it's so many and i honestly can't keep closing it forever. Removing equipment need money, it's not for me or anyone that like to experiment

This is not a good game.. very repetitive and boring. Search Darth Microtransactions on you tube and he does a great job of describing all the issues with the game. I did play this game for over a year and there are parts that are fun and the graphics are great but overall it gets very repetitive and no new content. Plus you need certain over powered champ to get stuff done.

People said this game had great depth, so I decided to check it out. It really doesn't. If I had to pick a game to describe as a shallow cash grab, this would be it. It consists of getting ads for $70 "microtransactions" thrown in your face every time you're in the main menu, grinding out high rarity shards over a month for a minuscule chance of getting a good character, and going against the same bosses over and over, just at a higher level. There is no lore behind the characters or in general.

Game is fun at the beginning but once you build your characters the drops become minimal at best. One lesser potion for defeating a dungeon boss on level 12? REALLY?? Then there is the constant freezing and lagging. If the game freezes on you in the midst of a battle then you lose energy, arena coins, and/or keys. Please fix, this is really getting old.

Great game! All of the characters especially all the legendary tier characters because they're all unique. I love the dungeons though they tend to get a little repetitive. I'm not a fan of ads that pop up back to back to try and push me to buy things. I really like the interactive leveling system, though having to max a characters level to boost their rank by one turns me off from it a little. I never understood why energy gets put into games when you WANT your players to keep playing your game.

Do not spend money on this game. Incredibly bug prone, freezes on a regular basis, rewards you gain disappear days later. Resources you buy are lost when the game freezes, with zero compensation. If collecting heroes, grinding them through levels, and putting together great combo teams is your style, then this is the one for you. If you want to be competitive then stay away. As with most F2P games, this one tops the P2W cash grab required to be even to be mediocre

This game got me hooked very quickly. The champions are all so unique and many of them look really cool. It definitely gives you the sense that you want to collect as many as possible. However the game has been ridiculous in the sense that it has given me terrible duplicate champions from sacred shards (these cost about $30)!!! If I'm spending ANY money at all (which I have) I sure as hell don't want it wasted on a duplicate champion THAT ISN'T EVEN ANY GOOD! Definitely losing interest quick

Fantastic Game With The Worst Ads For a mobile game this game definitely delivers on quality for the gameplay. The graphics/textures are fantastic and the game plays in 60 FPS. The battles have cool camera pans to make the battle feel more intense. The gameplay is very easy to understand and would be easy for people new to this type of game to pick up. Now for the BIG issue. Advertisements are ok, but they really push them on you one after another after another after ANOTHER consecutively.

Great game, nice graphics and overall gameplay. But surprisingly I found it better when it was in Beta. Because in Beta I never had a problem with the game crashing everytime I went into a new mission or repeated one that I had already played. I don't know what happened on full release but something is broken with the mission loadings now, can you please fix this issue?

wth game. I just spent the last 2 days leveling up and ranking up a bunch of common heroes to use as material just to have them all get deleted. The time and silver it takes adds up, and it all was for nothing. Think it's time to move on. This is a problem that alot of players have been having. That plus needing silver for almost everything is too high of a price to end up with nothing to show for it. Might have to uninstall the game if not fixed.

Good for a bit. Got about 2 top tier characters in at least half a year playing. It is hard to move to the top. It takes a loooooong time to really get good and get far. My fiance played twice. I was daily, but I got burnt out of the same thing day after day with little to no results. The game is great to look at, but that is it's best quality. I hate fighting the pop ups every log it, or going back to the main page. They say they listen, but they don't. It has so much potential.

They really oversell the graphics. Almost all the battles are on identical maps against identical opponents. That being said they do look great, but seeing the same map 10 times gets pretty old. The controls are easy, theres plenty of different ways to tweak your champions, and there is good variety on gear. The reason why I uninstalled is there is about 10 popup ads for ingame purchases every time I log in. I'm not against purchasing items, but damn, let me play before offering $100 packages.

Great graphics, and I enjoy the insane grind to try to level up my champions. The problem with the game is that half the time i try to log into the game i cant due to connection issues. (know bug, just read others post). And half the time when im able to play the game, the game crashes AFTER i have used a key, or energy, or a pvp token. Thus you lose all rewards and your energy or whatever as well. (know bug as well). Could be a fun game if it worked. Android users be warned.

POP-UP FIESTA! Seriously though, 5 pop-ups every time I open up the game with "buy the starter pack" and "high-value gem-pack". It's annoying to the point of making the game extremely unappealing to play. Before you even start a "game" it's a process of clicking away loads of pop-ups and then going over 4 different menu-buttons collecting 'free' rewards. Maybe the game can be fun.... if you get to the actual game part....

Great game at first - really sucks you in. Beautiful graphics, and really cool characters. But Plarium has managed to make it near impossible to progress without paying them a LOT of money. They give you just enough freebies to make it seem like they are not doing that, but there are certain things they just won't give you, and without them, it will take weeks (if not months) to progress a single character to a competitive point, let alone a team of characters.

Update: I've gotten my ask account back and game to update. It's a really enjoyable game, but there are a few things that still need better balancing. Several dungeons are severely overpowered, changing equipment costs too much, and prices for in game purchases are not proportional to their value. Ie, a "sale" of $20 for 6k silver, which a player can earn in 2-5 mins depending on level. Champion shards are crazy expensive too.

Too many ads, too little content. Lots of connection issues. I've been gaming a lot due to a broken leg and I would not recommend this to anyone. --The ads are set to overkill. --Its PAYable, not PLAYable. The game severely limits your ability to earn XP. So you can't advance without LOTS of in-game purchases. --The Arena pairing system is broken. You get paired up with teams 30 levels higher than you.

This game is trash. First let's start from the beginning. The fact that the game explains type advantages after choosing your starter is just so stupid. After getting through a tutorial I cant skip for some reason it blows me up with ad"s about spending money. After getting gear to lvl 10 when u enhance it again 99% of the time it fails. And when u need to remove gear, cost an overpriced amount of coins. It's a pay to play game. Period. The combat is garbage. It's turn based, boring combat

Half baked cash grab. If you're looking for a time killer and you don't have gambling issues go for it. The action is repetitive and boring, The level up is grindy (unless you pay them), the champion selection they boast about is mostly fodder monsters you fight during the campaign, the others you'll hardly ever see. Leveling up, and switching gear costs silver but it's not a guaranteed upgrade . You pay for a chance to upgrade. If you need a toilet game its fine but don't expect quality.

Very good game troubled by unacceptable technical issues. You have just two keys to fight the clan boss, you send in your best team ... and the game freezes while loading the fight. The key is gone and you get nothing. Fun, right? Or, you try to sell some of the junk in your items inventory. You fight the clunky interface, select your 50 items to sell, hit sell and ... error, artefact not found. Your selection is gone and good luck finding which item causes the game to choke. Please fix it!

The game has a lot of charm, intriguing gameplay and diverse characters. But, the devs have done little to improve the game since its been released, and the constant pop-up and ads are too much. obvious this game is just a cash pit to them. play if you dont mind 4 pop ups in your face everytime you go to the lobby. (also there is a delay whenever I try to use abilities, I play on pc so it shouldnt be lagging at all)

Entertaining enough but literally every time I load the app I'm hit with between 5-7 in-game ads trying to upsell me on some promotion or package; also, this repeats several times per gaming session whenever I redirect to the "home" screen within the game. I get they need to make money, but this seems a bit excessive. As for the campaign mode, it's entertaining enough but quickly cleared with even casual gameplay, leaving a lot of monotonous level grinding and resource collecting.

I like the game, I play it with friends. I just wish there was more lore for champions and factions. Also wish there was less ads. I am used to ads for this point just wish it was toned down a bit. I also think maybe a slightly higher chance percentage for the epic, and legendaries would be benefical. All in all the I like the game, hope it continues to improve, and become better. More LORE!!

The game itself is great. I get they want us to buy their stuff but it gets frustrating when i am trying to exit out of a battle to upgrade my heros. I then get a damn pop up that comes up and end up back in the battle when i was trying to go back to the tavern in the first place to lvl up a hero. I can deal with the adds when i first play the game at the start of the day. But i shouldn't be getting it every hr or so. Especially if it's interfering with game play itself.

Trash absolute trash. I can't even navigate through the town without 5 ads popping up for their cash shop and it happens every time. It's maddening it does not make me want to buy something it makes me want to uninstall the game which I did. One the plus side the character artist should move to greener pastures because they are pretty good (.)(.)

It's very clear 90% of the game's budget went to advertising and the game itself really got put on the backburner. The graphics, in today's day and age, are comparable to a ps3 game at best, and the "hundreds of champions" the advertisements boast about are mostly reskins of other champions, without any unique gimmicks or strategy. Shame I had to delete the game so quick, it could have been a great one.

I thoroughly enjoy the game, it's got a well driven story, the characters and animations are awesome especially in battle. That being said, I haven't been playing lately, and I recently decided to get back into it but the game just freezes in the middle of downloading additional update files! Please fix this issue, I really want to get back to this game 😫

Game has potential but is too linear! No replayability! From the battle system, heroes, to gear system. 1-2 hours into the game (level 15-20) you are forced to back track, burn all your energy, level up and get gear. You need certain hero combinations to advance. Have not gotten any heroes better than my original 3 star heroes from the start! The game gets boring fast. The equipment system is even worse! 20,000 silver to unequip a piece of equipment!? This game is a soft version of pay to win!

you get a lot of different heroes while playing but the shame is you dont get to experiment with them because the leveling is painfully slow and too linear. This sucks the enjoyment out of the game. This game makes every effort to advertise micro transactions every chance it can. It gets old to have to close 5 windows of offers each time you play. New additions to the game focus on this which is disappointing. Would rather pay a flat price for the game and not have the miceotransactions.

I think this game has done a very good job in a lot of things, it's very fun and has a lot of fun features very well implemented. The negatives I could name is mostly how everything has a high price (silver, at least no real money), and doing simple things to upgrade or even remove equipment quickly burn through your savings. The character progression is a little slow. At last, the rng could be better, or at least to be given more rewards after battle so we are most likely of getting what wanted

overall it's a fun game and in the beginning the game gives you enough "freebies" to allow for free to play content. That being said, the game gets incredibly stingy when it comes to being able to grow your teams and your collections. Too many of the items needed to strengthen characters are very difficult to obtain without dropping your hard earned money. as I said in the beginning, overall it's an entertaining but unrewarding game.

Fun game, looks and plays great...just way too expensive to play if you're trying to progress further, on top of the 50 ads shown seemingly everytime you start the game. In app purchases are just way too expensive to even consider purchasing considering what you get and the chances of receiving higher quality heroes is extremely low. Even spending $50-$100, you're unlikely to get anything great and for the number of legendaries, I would expect at least 2 or 3 for the prices offered.

This game only gets 2 starts because the art and graphics are great. It's a shame the summoning system is so trash, and it lacks any meaningful content updates. The only events present are basically "who can spend the most money? Go! " or who can do the most grinding of a thing that already exists in game, which is a protracted version of the first. Quality of life for everything you have to grind is abysmal as well. If gameplay improved to match its art, it might be as good a game as its ads.

Was a great game until this last update. Now it constantly freezes on my note 10+. Kind of hard to enjoy playing a game when it won't let you play. Edit: I understand it's not easy to accommodate every player, but freezing shouldn't happen this often. Especially on new devices. After another update, it seems to have gotten even worse. I hope it's fixed soon so I can give it 5*.

Another Gacha based game with ridiculous odds and an obvious corporate cash grab in this sea of Gacha based games. You finish the tutorial and you get hit with at least 3 different money based offers. Hit level 10 and make that 5 offers. There's even a monthly based subscription where you get exp and gold boost. Don't waste your time or money. Game has solid voice actors, assets and features but if you're not about that pay to win life or that grind life then you won't enjoy playing it.

The game is ok but its rather repetitive. If it was not for the 10+ mandatory offers every time you start the game i would play more. It has an auto play feature but it is only available once a day unless you pay. This is a game for people with more money than skill. The only real act to effect the outcome of a battle is equipment. That in itself requires repetitive battles. This game has a great add campaign but leaves you unfulfilled.

The gameplay has had a lot of ups and downs. Server instability is better but the game sometimes still hangs after a battle causing you to lose whatever resource used to fight it. Lots of Champs are worthless. Way too many micro transaction pop ups on entering. You have to click through 7 to 10 screens when you first enter the game. I would have given this game 3 maybe 4 stars, but 2 stars for the popup spam on entry.

It was OK for the first couple hours. Then I realized how the lack of shards given to you for free really starts to make the game impossible to progress though. I played the game for 2 hours and got stuck because I could not upgrade my heros any further. As in other games, there is a "home" screen. In this game, everytime I went "home", as many as 5 in-game ads would pop up in a row. This game is impossible to enjoy without making purchases and the ads are over the top ridiculous. Pass on this!!

Ive been playing for about a yr now and I can say I love the art style to the game and the progression. The reason I am giving it a 3 rating is because in the almost year I've been playing there has been very little new content in the game ie faction crypts. That is all! Everything else they have added is not new content it is more of the same (platinum arena, nightmare campaign) they still haven't fix simple issues with the game. It'd list then but I am out of characters they only allow 500.

Great game so far. I'm really not one of those pay to win types. I don't mind grinding it out to level up. But it is definitely geared towards pay to win. You don't get access to a lot of the epics and legendary characters if you don't shell out the cash. The games is a unbalanced in that sense. And going through the different keeps is quite repetive to get minimal potions as rewards to assend your characters. The developers could improve those rewards as well. All in all though it is a fun game

When logged in, was asked to update. The update keeps "pending" but nothing happens. Can't open the game at all. Will change the rating once it's fixed. PS I have played this game over two years. Definitely pay to win set up. Frustratingly slow unless you purchase a very expensive and overpriced stuff. Even with that, VERY SLOW and REPETITIVE!

Very entertaining app, awesome gear and warriors. Only issue is dealing with the ten different pop up advertisements almost everytime I start playing the app. Edit: Had this game for almost a year. I still have never been able to get a legendary champion. I've had rewards randomly go missing and no help from Support. The blue and purple shard have the exact same odds so they might as well get rid of one.

The game crashes multiple times a day. Often back to back to back. It has crashed up to 13 times in a single day on me. Crashed 7 times today. Everything just freezes. I've submitted several reports, but no answer. Kind of a grind. Costs several thousand coins to upgrade artifacts. Getting a legendary champion through shards has like a 1% chance at best. You get about 5 popups trying to get you to make in app purchases every time you log in. Otherwise, its fun.

Its ok, apart from the bombarding of ads for ingame purchases when you log in... Its also incredibly grindy to get to some stages and at times you never really feel any progress. Your champions look the same throughout. The abilities are somewhat lacklustre at times. This game is good for what it is, a grindy and pretty basic experience when it comes down to it. You as a user just sit and wait, sit and wait.. there isn't any actual interesting gameplay. Expect to do a lot of tapping.

I love the game and the champions, the graphics, lore and everything else. I do spend about $100-150 per month on the game (not a whale, but still a spender). After a half a year of playing many things become extremely monotonous and time consuming and that is ridiculous. Dungeons that you three-star 10, 100, 1000 times should have an autocomplete button..I do enjoy manualing the Doom Tower, however champion training - it's repetative AF. I do have a though of quitting because of such time waste

I lost interest.. You open the game and you get like 5-10 pop up windows daily, one after the other in a very annoying way, all to pay for overpriced pack of items... You play a campaign or something, get back to the main menu, and more pop up windows to pay something, one after the other! Super annoying!!! All the game screams "pay loads to get somewhere". The raids (multi-battles in a stage), you have to see all of the battles from start to finish... annoying and a lost of time. Poor events...

fun game! interesting characters, story, and gameplay. REALLY wish you could sweep stages instead of watching your team plow through at 2X speed. that alone takes up 50% of my playtime. EDIT: the new ability to sweep is almost no better than if it wasn't there. it saves almost no time since you still have to watch each sweep at only 2X speed. I think a better use of the sweep function would be (near) instantly sweeping the stage x number of times.

This is a good game, and a game with a lot of potential, but it is held back by a few REALLY annoying mechanics and UI pop-ups... - One HUGE issues new players will find is the astronomical (in-game currency) cost to expand your hero vault - The sorting mechanic - sometimes doesn't work, but when it does, it still needs a LOT of fixing - The ULTRA ANNOYING pop-up EVERY time you lose a battle (even if you lose on purpose), telling you that you need better gear (I KNOW)

A large chunk of the game "could not load", despite me downloading the whole game and going through the tutorial. It wouldn't let me actually do anything, and many things I was trying to collect wouldn't let me collect. It said to reload or that it was my wifi. My wifi is full bars and fine, or I wouldn't be able to write this. I reloaded a few times, still didn't work every time.

Overall a very well done rock, paper, scissor strategy game. Could do with some cosmetic changes as your heroes rank up. The reason I take it down from 5 stars is the constant bashing over the head for you to pay for packages. Yes, I know I can pay money to play this game. You don't need to remind me 5 times every other minute with game pausing pop ups.

The game is a bit mediocre. The models, load time, and character designs are good, but the story hollow and their no compelling heroes, Villians, ect. Unlike most mobile "games", their is some player engagement during the game. However, it's not any where near engaging as most traditional RPGs. Also, the levels are on-rails and ones in the same area start to look the same.

This game is EVIL, don't play it. It's designed to make you addicted, to keep you constantly playing. It showers you with a lot of stuff, so that you'll keep playing it 6-8 hours day, until the day switches over and all your quests reset and you find yourself still playing so you can complete those as well. All the while you don't actually accomplish much. Leveling/Ranking up heroes is a MASSIVE resource/time investment, and getting good equipment take a lot of time as well.

The game is beautiful but gameplay is where it sucks. Crashes often, forcing restarts and losing progress in a mission but still using energy. And then every time at the main screen you get bombarded by as much as a half dozen different item box sale windows, even if you had closed them all just a few minutes ago in the same play session.

A lot of fun to play, cool graphics and I love the grind most times. Unfortunately for most pay to win games you'll be pressured to pay a little here and there. Not in this game, drops are unbalanced, 4 payment options are thrown in your face every single time you open the game, and all the payment options are way over priced for what you get. Wouldn't recommend this game if your tempted to spend money recklessly

I deleted this game because of their own pop-ups. Every single time you go back to the homescreen, you receive a pop-up trying to sell you in-game currency. Every. Single. Time...it get so repetitive and annoying. I played for several months and enjoyed it, but, ultimately, their pop-ups and the tedious amount of leveling up a single character killed it for me. Raid is a well-balanced version of the idle formula, but there isn't anything spectacularly new about it that stands out from the rest.

The game started great, daily rewards, extra stuff by linking to prime, nice jump start. But the prime rewards quicky stopped. Then the daily rewards ended. Now the only reason to log in is to grind away one a slightly above average tactical fight game. And the ads, dear lord, just STOP with the ads. If I were willing to spend hundreds of dollars playing a game, I'd be on a course with a nice paintball gun. The ads never stop, and what you get is grossly overpriced. GL all.

I love the game, it is really challenging compared to other summoning games out there. I have been playing this game for like 3 weeks now everyday and its difficulty is really something that makes me feel the urge to level up my heroes and items more and more. I rated it 4 because, I find the dungeons too unkind to drop items I need. Like for example those potions that I need to ascend a hero, even though I already reached a higher floor, it is still giving me 1 piece of that lowest one.

Fun, but greedy. The game has some solid mechanics, great graphics for mobile, and easy single button controls. However the developers are extremely money hungry. You have to spend the in-game currency to do literally anything, and without spending real money on the game you'll find yourself running low on that constantly. I've been playing for about 3 days, and the new player rewards allowed me to advance quickly at first, however now that I've run out of the in-game money, it's really grindy.

Interesting for a few hours, then the "free" limits kick in. Also the very first "starter set" is over $35. I will generally put $5 into a game like this early on, to get a bit of a head start. However, this game starts at expensive and goes up. Multiplayer is fun, if you have a bottomless bank account, otherwise its a solo game with soft pay gates every step of the way. I am not afraid to grind out some levels, watch adds and work for progress, I found this to be excessively slow in this game

It's beautiful, well crafted, and actually has a campaign... it's just not that fun to play. I think RAID has everything I want in a mobile RPG. Except everytime I open it, I don't actually want to play it. I'd rather just turn on auto mode have the game play itself which turns it into a glorified idle game without that genre's charm or addictiveness. Still it's far too late to change the fundamentals and what the game does, it does well. Definitely worth a least a moment of your time.

This game is way too expensive. I'm no stranger to dropping a couple bucks on in-app purchases but every pack in this game is so expensive (average price of around $15-30) and none of them are worth it! They also blast the packs in your face through notifications every time you log in. Before you can even do what you want to do you have to close like 6 windows advertising the overpriced packs of gems and consumables. It's a fun game but there are a lot of things that need changing.

Commercials ruined this game for me. Ad after ad I had to click thru to play. I like a good story, might have been one, but by the time you click thru the ads you'll have forgot whatever storyline is supposed to be happening. Not worth it. So, create a mechanism to allow players to opt in/out of deal options. Instant deals are one category, 24 hr deals, weekly deals, etc. Each with an opt in/out option in settings. To totally opt out of all ads, a 1 time fee.

The game has a lot of potential but hamstrings itself somewhat with insane real-money prices (encouraging third-party farming services) and a silver cost for unequipping items - the only game I have ever seen that does that. With a fun array of heroes and mechanics, this game is certainly able to be better than it currently cuts itself down to be. Unfortunately, developers in this genre do not seem to be vying for customer love so much as copying each other's successful cash-grab methods.

As good as the production values in this game are, ultimately, it's just a boring free to play treadmill that offers little in the way of actually compelling gameplay. While a bit of skill (usually just a bit of forethought) can win you games against other players and the CPU when they're closely leveled to the player, get too far away and the numbers just won't allow it. This leads to the game being very grind heavy, giving it the treadmill distinction. All glitz, no substance.

The game is fun as you progress through the early stages, but as you get further into mid game the content doesnt change it's all the same. The in game options to purchase shards and other power up packs is absolutely ridiculously priced and when you do purchase them hoping to get a better champion you get kicked in the balls with a duplicate champ or some other waste of a champion. The draw is always annoying the percentage rate is far too low, and the artifacts provided are pretty much junk.

Decent system, beautiful design but 3 big issues... 1. Obvious gatcha is obvious there's too much garbage and it takes way too long to feel like you are progressing. But looks good. 2. UNEQUIPPING GEAR costs massive silver for a full set and you lose it ALL if you sacrifice... Fix this alone and I'm back in! 3. No real direction... The quests are far too samey to want to plow through like a couple hundred individual battles just to get through part 1...

It was fun while I can play it, I keep getting stuck in authentication screen. Has allot of customization, loads of champions, loads of pop up offers(gets old fast, like I know where the store is, please chill) Everything I look into says I should switch to wifi (and I'm like what's the point of a mobile game if doesn't even turn on when without it) I switched, no change btw. Gave it 3 because I feel when u give lower score they push your review way down and it is fun...when you can play it.

For the sheer amount this game is advertised everywhere for the past year or so, I was kind of excited try it. Quickly got bombarded with in game ads and tons of free things. The game itself looks lackluster. You could spend hours grinding free2play or just pay2win and get the end game gear right off the bat. The game wastes no time reminding you of this fact! My opinion, your time is better spent somewhere else.

Just came here in disbelief after seeing an ad saying there are no in game ads in this game. There are no external ads, true, but you get smacked in the face with at least four near full screen ads for in game items when you go to the home area in game..and we are talking most over 24.99, many 49.99 or more for stuff that is overpriced. 60 dollars for a set of good armor, for example. That's nearly a Triple A title for a set of armor for one summon. Fun, but bonkers $$$.

Becomes too repetitive very, VERY quickly, to the point of boring the player. Also there is a annoyingly inappropriate amount of microtransactions advertisements popping up the screen EVERY time you enter the game, last time I counted, there where SEVEN. The developers tell us that there will be hundreds of characters, but 80% of them have the same base model, changing only colors and details. The progression is the worst, it gives you one impression at begging AND frustrates it after 4h.

It's so obvious the game mechanics are nearly identical to Summoners War. If you've played summoners war and got tired of the story and art style then this might be for you, otherwise expect an immense amount of time put into grinding, grinding, and more grinding. There's nothing wrong with a good grinding game that keeps things interesting, but unfortunately with the way the stats are set to get good heroes, upgrade the artifacts, and everything else, you're going to grind for a very long time.

Tried this game but it just seemed to keep crashing and hanging. I clicked on a mine in my city or whatever it is I didn't get to play long enough to find out. And it zoomed in on the mine all menus went away and there I sat. I could find no way to zoom back out or get the rest of the city and menus back. Also the game just randomly crashed twice before I had played much more than 5 minutes. I uninstalled get this thing fixed and it might be a good game.

I'm updating my review to 1 star as I've become disillusioned with the direction the game has taken in the last few months. There has been zero new content, zero new champions (with the exception of 2 trash fusions) and no new battle pass. It feels like a game which is no longer supported by any Devs, there is a constant bombardment of 'offers' to spend money with nothing additional to show for it. Really disappointed as the core game is great. Really hope that the Devs can actually make chang

It's pretty much impossible to get new characters without paying money. It takes forever, even for weak basic characters. When you do get characters, most of them are boring and generic. The gameplay is dull, as it pretty much amounts to pressing a button and watching the character do a short animation (you don't even have to do that with autoplay). Story wise, some elements are there, but it's confusing and a lot of it seems out of context. Honestly, I don't understand the appeal of the game.

This is a well-designed collecting game, but in-app purchases are exorbitant. I'm not a fan of collecting games, but I found myself playing this game quite a bit. My main complaints are the frequent problems connecting to the server (lots of waiting), inability to contact support (the in-app contact window never seems to work), high in-app purchase prices, and you have to spend coins to unequip artifacts/equipment (that was what ultimately caused me to delete the app).

I rated the game 5 stars when I started playing almost 5 months ago. Since then the game hasn't changed for the better. It was exciting to see the first battle pass, but the second one is nowhere to be seen. The events are repetitive (the whole game is really). The events are now pay to win and/or requires the event to be a full time job. They also seem to cater more and more to the big spenders... a real shame 😢

Mediocre at best, graphics are portrayed to be similar to console graphics...Not even close, the graphics are actually pretty poor in comparison to what's available. To top it off its auto-turn-based fighting is a big turn off. This game would have been great 20 years ago but who plays turn based games anymore? If your into that download a card game you'll get the same experience and the depth of the game will be better.

When I first played this game I loved it, put money in regularly, jumped up the PvP rankings, and thought I was progressing. The game then became greedy: earning worthwhile characters became harder during events, accomplishing any event no matter what type requires cash and or months of saving resources, you can't login without being shown tons of limited time offers, they not only have a subscription package, but also a season pass with the option to upgrade to premium. I recommend you pass.

Mediocre. An all right Garcha style game. While it's visually pleasing, the gameplay is shallow and repetitive. While sure you theoretically can get everything free. The games balanced to be really really slow and frustrating to do so. Free players will find good summons few and far between. And being bombarded with popups telling you to pay money to speed up progress, and for no small sum, it sucks the fun out.

Account was lost when I logged in with facebook for an achievement. Second account lost when I removed it from facebook. This seems to be a consistent problem, with multiple reports on their forums. I played for about 2 hours and, after watching the agonizing unskipable tutorial for a third time, completely lost interest. There are better, more stable games just like this one out there. Give this one a skip.

Hands down the best commercials out there to get players interested. Played the game until lv30+ and maxed out first chars. I did like the amount of things you can do if you're not into competitive gameplay, because that requires tons of patience or money. After not playing for a year I decided to give it another try, well.. because of the commercials. 1 min in i closed the game and uninstalled. I had to click through at least 8 ( or even more ) advertisements and it reminded me why I quit.

I like the game, but at the same time it gets a bit tiring. There's a lot to manage, lots to do, which is fine. But it can get repetitive after a while. I tend to play more involved RPGs..Like ESO, Neverwinter, etc on my pc. I play word games and match games on me phone. I do play ES Blades now and then but it's awkward on the phone. I'd rather play it on a pc. So this is more of a management game, which I have to take in small doses.

no depth gets old really fast. Ok the game is the same few levels that just repeat three times for thd campaign. The dungeon have a lot more levels but they are the same even as they get harder. In addition the arena is not very interesting. Yes, there is a lot of loot and ways to upgrade your characters to get stronger but there is no feeling of achievement for getting there.

Disguised behind great artwork is an expensive cash-grab right out the box. The entire strategy system is based off of rock, paper, scissors. PERIOD! In the tutorial, it's not possible to read what skills do. Played for about 2-hours, then uninstalled. If you get an amazing weapon/armor and equip it, but you get a better hero, you cannot unequip without severe penalties. 3 of 4 starting characters have identical skill sets. Obviously the dev's have very little imagination beyond the artwork.

WAS a fun game. Played Raid for a couple days, and as soon as I got into game, it crashed. It would not recognize that was connected to the internet. I went through everything that support suggested I do. Nothing worked. I lost my progress and all the characters that I had acquired. My advice? Simple: dont invest to much time into a game that may crash on you at anytime. It's highly irritating and extremely annoying. Good luck!

Basically it's fantasy themed Contest of Champions with turned based JRPG style combat. Looks nice, played through the first area, decided it was fun enough to warrant creating an account. Created account, forced to re-log, received error can't connect to resources check Internet connection. Internet is just fine. Uninstalled, not worth my time to troubleshoot. Would probably be 4 stars if it worked. UPDATE: Workaround helped. Only 3 stars until actually fixed.

I only tried it for one day because not much going on with the quarantine. But I remember being overwhelmed with information. The story. The ability chances. The unit type. The character star system. The RNG shard system. The equipment. This game is definitely going the distance in both the grind and the ads. But I really feel this game was going to have too much filler to be fun. They can do more with less.

The game is fun...BUT... it has been nothing but random maintenance and connection issues since I started playing this week. I don't know if that's common. Also, every time you log back in you get slammed with every single pack ad. I know where the shop is. Still don't know why it costs anything to swap out armor. Should just put it back in inventory. Could be more enjoyable if some things were tweaked.

Every day you go to open the app, you have to close 3 to 6 in-game promotions for 10+ dollars. The game is a little complicated and has a lot going on with the number of champions you have, and all the different gear you pick up for them. Gameplay is fine and definitely keeps you logging in every day, but I dont really like the fact that the first thing I have to do when I open the app is decline a bunch of offers.

I like games in this particular style. The graphics were good, it was easy to follow, seemed like a good story. The advertising in game killed it for me. Coming back to your base from any activity and get swarmed with ads for purchases in game ranging from $0.99 to $99.99 in price. I have other games that will do this, and I understand money needs to be made. However, the amount and frequency with which the game presents them kills most attempts at immersion.

Pretty good combat and the graphics look amazing. I don't mind micro transactions, I even purchase some to support a game if its good. My issue with this game is: if I want to buy something I'll go to the ingame store please don't spam me each time I log into the game with 5 or 6 different ads for 'sales'. Really making the game seem super pay to win. Each time you log in again its a constant reminder to feed these guys more money. A 'good' game shouldn't have to do that to get sales imo

Great in a lot of ways, but there are several major flaws that just ruin this game. The auto battle system is a pain to use because if you want to auto battle, you just have to set your phone down and let it play, because you can't use your phone for anything else, or play the game while an auto battle is going on, and when some of the battles take 5+ minutes, it feels like a pointless battery killer, rather than a feature. It is extremely pay to win, and the endgame is just a paywall at lv60.

The amount of adds/notifications when you log in is ridiculous! You have 5+ screens popping up everytime, all for limited time in game purchases, none of which are under $10. I am not spending $25 on a grindy game so early on, as theres very little advantage to me doing so. There is no way of turning them off, I even went into settings and tried turning them off like they suggested in other reviews. When you change your graphics settings as well, it resets your notification options back on!

To many promotional sale packs. I get them everytime I log in. Two would be fine, but I get seven. And then just when I think it's over and do a stage of the campaign, I'll come back and get five more. At least put an option in game for us to turn them off. This is honestly the only complaint I have. I get making money, but it's pushed pretty hard that in order to get anywhere in game, spending money is a must.

After reporting some bugs and putting a lot of time into the game.... The in game pop up adds to buy items got to me. I stepped away from the game and recently saw a review where a customer service person stated there was an option to stop the pop ups. This was false as there is only a way to disable notifications out side of the game. Not the pop ups in game. I did like the game but it shoots itselfin the foot. Ps: Consider a less aggressive way. Maybe a small side pop up.

It's just not as fun and as polished as I'd hoped. The concept is great, but it falls flat when it comes to champion design and variety of skill sets, so many things feel homogenous and samey. Upgrading characters is tedious and doesn't feel very rewarding in comparison to the time you have to put in. It's definitely not free to play friendly and the content is lacking in general. This game has a long way to go to size up to other great gachas.

OK, what we have here is a relatively fun pay to win (Free game).  Now... if you go in with the attitude that you want to be competitive at the very top level.... give it up.  Unless you want to spend a lot of money. Example:   There are $99 packages that have a.. get this... limit of 5 per month!     OK.. let's just say it. If you pay enough money on this game where you could actually but a full console, TV and games... you're an idiot.  Yeah, do what you want... but this game is NOT worth "real game" money.  But people must be doing it... idiots in my opinion, but whatever.  I have been playing it daily and enjoying it. I have thrown them a little money (The $5 beginner pack you can only buy once ever... I would possibly but another of these, but nope.  From now on, only expensive stuff... give us your cash).  The game is fun.  It's nice on the graphics.  I'll give it to them.  Some of the competitions are not possible to get high without paying.  I pretty much ignore anything that is a ladder and do the ones that only depend on yourself.  How many champions you've summoned or whatever.  I still won't get too high, but that's ok.  It all depends on your attitude going in.

So I will start by saying this, this game is addicting. I have waited until I finished the initial boost as a new player that you always get though, and I do find some minor issues. Just a few things that i find have kept me from getting as wrapped up in the game as much now that the endless energy is gone. The biggest issue really, if you can complain, is that you burn through energy quickly, and there is no efficient way to refill. Luckily this just forces me to take a break. Lol.

USA Player: An interesting 1v1 royale type game. Send units on both sides and control a hero, which makes it very unique. Don't think I've seen any ads. Cons: There is a 1-2 second movement delay which is extremely frustrating. I know if you are from the USA it just came out for us. Others have been playing for six months. They can spam fighters, and since they are well upgraded... don't think you'll get far past 1.5k ranking lol... I also feel you take a huge trophy loss to advanced players.

Gave the game a shot because I keep seeing it advertised everywhere. It has good graphics but the overall user interface feels crowded. I did not get very far into the game before I had to quit for the one thing that gives this game a 1 star. My problem is with the constant, multiple offer popups for limited time packages after literally everything I do. Like not even exaggerating beat one mission 2 or 3 pop up, go equip new gear and oh look 3 or 3 more. Made the game feel like a cash grab.

i am updating my review to 4 star. my problem with loading and the sound not existing cleared up. im not sure if it was a minor update that fixed it or it just cleared up on its own but thank you. i like the game, the advertisement for bundle deals can be in your face a bit. what would be kind of neat (that is if its not already implemented and i just haven't encountered it yet) is "meal times" set times of the day that give you some extra energy for free or maybe for some silver

Graphics are great, gameplay is fun. However, the constant and immediate pop ups as soon as the game loads to buy packs that I already know exist destroys any interest I had for playing this game and I've only had it for 7 days. Seriously, if I wanted to spend my time closing pop-ups I'd go get a virus on my computer. I wouldn't have had an issue spending money on this game once I reached a level that required it to advance, but with how pushy and "in your face" it is I'll be uninstalling it.

To be honest, I love the game play, I love the concept, I love that there is strategy.... It's way to expensive and overpriced. It's 100% pay to win and I got tired of paying especially for gambling and hoping I would get legendary heroes. If you ever make this game cheaper, I'll actually come back because it's a great concept, but it's too greedy.

The game in the beginning gives you a fair amount of items to progress in the beginning, and just as quickly takes away any chance of getting better "champions" behind several tiers of summoning crystals, 2 of which you won't be able to access in a reasonable amount of time for any person with a couple of spare hours on their hand (or spare cash). In-game currency is only given, not earned. The game after level 10 or 12 devolves into click level, turn on auto-battle, confirm rewards, repeat.

The ads for this game doesn't represent the game at all. It is not a revolutionary mobile game, it's just a regular gacha auto dungeon game. The story is not good. The User Experience is bad, littered with ads every time you login. Each character doesn't have any interesting ability, just a different stats for each character. There is also an annoying random upgrade mechanic. You need to use real money to be on top. The game has a good 3D graphic. But that's the only thing good about it.

The graphics are very nice but the game doesn't help you much on progression it is way too much grinding for a phone game and the quests hardly give you anything. It is super fun the first few days after that you will hit a huge wall and get stuck and have nothing to do except grind out past maps you beat already. Not to mention the pop up screens while in town that always try to get you to spend money and if you want to progress through the game at all you have to spend cash or wait forever.

I've heard about and played played this game as a means to complete an offer for another game. I was quite impressed with it at the beginning. It looks great and fundamentally it's fun to play. I like the game and I have no problem supporting the developers, however I have never seen the level of pricing to buy even basic items be so high in any game ever. Even basic items that are needed to make progress in the game are absurd. $28 for 3 summons (that are not even the highest value), no thanks

Microtransactions all the way down. First time loading in required closing three separate 'offers', one of which cost as much as Outer Worlds did on launch. Gameplay is deliberately designed around making said transactions look enticing. The hero rank system is utterly terrifying if you think about what a rank 5 hero requires. Skip it, it's just as bad as you think it is. You're welcome.

Okay, but tiresome to do simple things. Everytime I open the app I am bombarded with sales pitches. If it were just 1 that was an actual deal and not $29.99 or more I might buy something. Autocomplete missions don't even do that. They have to completely play out. You don't have to interact with the game, but you still have to wait for it to complete missions you're replaying even though you've already beaten it. I never come close to using up my energy because each battle is just too long.

First impression was solid. Good progression and with battlepass you got a lot of good stuff like energy refreshes and gear. What is already annoying is the permanent display of sales and offers which you can take. It is constantly and you cant stop it unless you buy. Here the game shows what it really wants. Buying in order to progress. The pricing is high and as you play against older accounts you either deal with it or prepare to receive lower rewards as for arena

I stopped playing as soon as i noticed that you had to use in-game currency to unequip items, even if it is easily earned currency that is a red flag to me. The gameplay also felt stale, the auto fighting is just boring to sit through, and turning it off and playing how i would expect to play this type of game it just felt...boring, like there wasn't anything exciting, interesting, etc. with the combat. Overall it felt lackluster with poor design choices meant to intice heavy grinding/paying $.

Game is pretty enjoyable. The graphics, characters and fighting is all fun and engaging. My 1 huge dislike for the game is when I go into multi battles. I'll save up all 15 (the max) and use them to farm afk and when I come back I'll have lost most my battles (these were battles I should've easily won). Turns out even though all spots are filled - it's bringing in a random amount of heroes. Maybe 1 or 2 heros actually spawn and I end up losing.

Game is fun, addicting, will designed and complex. I enjoyed it enough to l play for most of a year regularly and pay some each month for bonuses and to support the game. I was progressing well into end game and that's where things went off the rails. I collected the items required to acquire the most powerful (legendary) characters in the game for months, waiting for an event that increased their likelihood. Events came, I got nothing. No bad luck protection ruins the game.

good game, but going from the Bastion to different places or leveling characters is touch sensitive. this means that you may have to click a location or character multiple times for a reaction. the other issue is that after defeating some levels, the game just freezes up at the victory stance like the game loses connection. they answered my post and are working on it.

Game play is decent, but have a few issues. Ads at startup are a bit much. made a purchase but it didn't give it to me then it took a couple of days to get customer support to do anyting. Tried again and had the same issue. Still waiting for a resolution. Bottom line, don't buy anything unless you enjoy contacting support and waiting. Packages and items little bit on the expensive side. By little bit I mean take out a second mortgage. Other than these things, I give 2 stars.

This game is like all the others out there like it. It brings nothing new to the table. In a few hours of play I had to reset x1 and restart x3 for locking up. The ads for micro & macro transactions bombarded me everytime I left combat and went to the main action screen. Just to upgrade or select character options I felt like I was playing a clicker just to shut down the ads. I know the devs need to make money, but when it interferes with the game this bad... Seriously, come on now.

I've played the game, and personally I think it is amazing. There is always something to do, the graphics are amazing and more! my only problem is that I downloaded this game via YouTube promotion promising me an epic character for free, and I haven't gotten this yet, I hope someone can help with this problem... but dispute that the game is great.

So many popups... SO MANY. I could hardly play due to the sheer number of "deals" and "specials" this game forced down my throat. I will, from time to time, buy stuff on apps if I'm enjoying the content enough - but I won't ever spend a dime on this. I spent more time closing popups than I spent in the game. After response: "Periodic"... It was non-stop. Every 30 seconds or more. Never seen anything like it

The game is great. That said, I have YET to receive my promotional items (the "free epic champion" that was advertised). I followed the download link from the YouTube video, which was SUPPOSED to give me extra items, but I never got it. Like I said, the game is great. Aside from a slight lag when viewing champions from certain groups, I've not had any issues whatsoever. It's fun; good story, great graphics...but the promo was the selling point for me. Any help from the devs would be appreciated.

I've attempted to get into this game on a couple of different occasions. Both times I was left feeling like I had a mountain to climb. Your early game will be spent exclusively in the same campaign modes, leveling multiple "food" characters to rank up 1 of the usable characters. The character rank up system is extremely grindy for new players, and is quite daunting. Sound boring? It is. Great graphics though.

I really like this game! BUT.. I have had the game for little over two weeks now. The first 3 days the game worked great. I like it so much I dropped $10 on the starter pack, The day after that I have been unable to login the game via mobile network. I have done very thing i can think of to fix it, I even have 2 support tickets with screen shots and they were next to useless. I have lost timed items, fell behind and even been kicked from my clan due to inactivity.

This game is very good for a mobile game, but lock your wallet in the other room before playing as they do a good job trying to get you to buy microtransactions. the graphics are great and the campaign is really cool. they provide an auto fight feature but try it with out to do better in fights. lots of ways to level up and better your character. I only give it a 4 out if 5 because of the psychology they employ when introducing microtransactions.

The game is nice. However, one quickly realizes that one will need a tremendous amount of time to progress and it is discouraging. What I like is to see my heroes becoming strong. Taking a month to put a hero at full power is fine for me. Longer than that, it is not motivating. The game multiply the trees, skill set and sacrifice to do in order to move on. It's not for me.

Fun game but a bit complicated to understand when you're starting. Thankfully the company have released a few tutorial videos that help. This game is all about grinding so be warned, it's quite a bit of fun though. Can't wait to unlock my first Epic or Legendary hero! **Update:** Deducting a star because having 3-5 ads that have to be dismissed pop up every single time that I open the app is incredibly annoying.

The game is awesome, I enjoy all of the mechanics besides 1...the upgrade attempt mechanic, it's a good mechanic but I feel we should be able to get at least 25% of the silver spent back for a fail attempt and not loose all of it and or remove the mechanic for the 1st 8 levels then have the mechanic in place for the higher levels. Still returning at least 25%. But all in all it's a great game

No progress, same characters, same levels, updates every other day, tumult of ads when turning on annnnd here comes the PR message as to why they do it, watch. It was fun while it lasted. The graphics are great. Game play cool. But since I can't progress without sacrificing players I like that are far and in between to summon I'll just leave it along. 😐

Experience is bad for new players, it's probably too late to start the game if you don't plan to spend real money heavily. For example, progress mission is not quite helping for new guys, you'll get stuck very early (around the "reaching bronze 3/4 arena" one), people say you'll need good gear which requires few months grinding, but what the heck the quests after that are waay easier! The order should really be removed or re-arranged. It's just one example, there are 'barricades' everywhere.

Fun game, played a lot in the beginning. However, the prices are ridiculous. 30, 50, 60, 100 dollar packs for literally nothing.
