Ive already spent almost $300 and still continue to struggle to get any decent character other than my starter. Not to mention getting it past 5 stars since it's way too time consuming and gear is almost impossible to level up to 16 unless spending millions of silver

As with most mobile games, there are ups and downs. The longer I plyd (over a year), the more obvious it became to me, that getting some of the games best heroes was going to be next to impossible, without spending real money. Prices on game packs are ridiculously high, in my opinion. Frequent glitches and server problems, slow, nonstop, grinding is necessary to make minimal progress. Hours of the day will need to be spent, in game, in order to make incremental advancement. NEXT!

It's actually pretty fun for what it is. It earns its 1 star from me for now because of the asinine artifact upgrade system. Usually, when they make you gamble silver to upgrade items, they sell some mafia-esque protection scheme to increase your success rate. That's absent here, but silver is easy enough to grind out while also being consumed in large masses, so it's basically a waste of time for no reason since they're not profiting off of your failed upgrade attempts anyways.

The game itself is good. The issues I have are: 1) No catchup mechanics for new players (outside of spending money). 2) AUTO feature is the most efficient way to "play" the game, meaning AI battles for you, 2-3 times faster than you could ever play it manually. You'd be stupid not to use it in a grind game. 3) The grind is way too long and gets exponentially harder. Combine that with poor RNG and you have one boring experience.

My personal experience is that there are some aspects of the game that are potentially good, but the arena is broken garbage. Part of the 'progession missions' involve reaching a certain tier of the arena but you hit a wall and can never progress. Also, you are constantly bombarded with pop ups from the game about buying this pack, or that pack; most costing $30+ for very scanty rewards (that may be random anyway) - sometimes 6 or 7 ads in a row. Definitely a cash grab game.

Alot of hype for the game. It's a clone of shadow of mordor, Marvel strike force and DC Legends. Upgrade champions to upgrade new champions and so on and so on. Pretty good about the stuff you need to level up without having to pay anything. 30 auto battles a day-cycle, so it takes some of the monotony out of grinding for levels or gear. All around... it's not bad but it's nothing new.

The game is really great and I enjoy it a lot, but there are some annoying issues. When it comes to the reward for completing tasks, they are hardly an incentive. For example, getting 50 energy for upgrading a player 500 times! We get more than that from the reward for playing for an hour. It hardly seems worth the effort and it's really common to be given these mediocre rewards. Also, I think it would be better if you didn't have to redo progress missions if you've already done the task. Thanks

Great graphics, cool heroes, bad gameplay and expensive purchases. Every time you log in you get tons of "buy this" prompts. Gameplay is pretty much leaving it on autofight to get loot and levels. You have to repeat stages MANY times to get what you want and to level up so that you even stand a chance on the next stage. With all that said I still get on and do stages once in a while. Developers do need money, but I do not plan on supporting the money grab that mobile games have devolved into.

This is a somewhat decent entry into the mobile games genre. I've enjoyed it for the most part, however where the game falls flat in mine and a few friends opinion is how aggressively "special deals" and in game purchases are pushed. Ive gotten a total of 6 in a row. I'd be much more inclined to purchase said items if I could be left alone to enjoy the game. Great marketing aside, the ads really are all that subtract from my initial score of 4 stars. Cheers.

Good but I don't like the prices for the battle pass tho. I understand the idea behind the battle pass - yet it's just way too pricey and implies an image of "pay-to-win" structure. Too many commercials when opening the game. Feels like I'm forced to buy something by getting thrown all the "special" deals in the face. Kind of annoying.. The game also feels repetetive - but that's just the game design I guess..

Game was fun and felt challenging at time, honestly I really enjoyed it. However, my main complaint is the constant spamming of extremely expensive in-app purchases. I say extremely because I have played plenty of games that give you the same stuff for $.99-$4.99 that this game offers for $15+. This isn't really the issue, it's the fact that everytime I return to the bastion, i have to wait for 3-5 pop-ups to load before I can do anything. Other than that, the game has graphics atleast...

Little new content of worth since launch. This game is designed to extract as much money as possible from new players and is not free to play friendly. It is very difficult to be even remotely competitive without spending massive amounts of money or getting absurdly lucky with random character pulls. It does have excellent artwork though to make it look all shiny and attractive to lure players in.

Do not download it is full of grief. I dont know where to start. #1 problem with this game is its ability to sign in and authenticate its connection. Its consistently freezing up and you have to completely shut down and reload the game over and over again till you get lucky IF it loads correctly. If it were possible to give ZERO stars I would. Even after this last update the game seems to have gotten worse. Now the game freezes constantly and it takes forever to load not worth downloading.

The game itself is fun. The app constantly hangs up and stops loading or loads indefinitely, I constantly have to close and restart the game like 3 or more times an hour, it is infuriating. And there's no reason to suggest anything, I've cleared the cache, uninstalled reinstalled, etc, I did all the things. My wifi is fine, every other app on this device works just fine and every other device on my wifi network works just fine as well. Memory leak, net code, IDK what it is but it's bad.

If you like clicking the close button on endless ads before you play. As well as a crazy slow progression system. Then this might be the game for you. There are better team building RPGs out there. Go play them. If they stop the ads that try to sell you in game stuff (it's literally like 7 popups) after each couple missions, it might be passable.

the "immersion" and "fluidity" the game touts is undermined by overly aggressive BUY NOW ads. I took a year off and thought "hmmm maybe I'll give it another try, I remember the characters looked neat." Not but two seconds after logging in I was bombarded with nine, NINE, different ads telling me I could pay money for everything ranging from energy to full sets of high stat armor. This is toxic, you are pay walling players to the highest degree. can't wait for the " no ads: ad" to be added.

I wish I could do 2.5 stars... It really is a great game, but recently since they startes updating and adding new features the game is just constantly freezing. Always during battles or during the loading of battles process. I've spent a boat load of money on this game and its making me want to play the game less. Otherwise... The game itself is fun... Fix the freezing issues and everything will be fine...

It's hard to give this game just one star because of the beautiful graphics, writing, and voice over. Time clearly went into this and it's promising as far as that, however, the rise of Adblock culture was clearly lost on this team. They must think that it happened by accident when they show several ads (many recurring) with absolutely no way to turn them off. Accidentally starting the payment process against my will (the pay button is right over the game menu!) was the last straw. Uninstalling.

Actually good gameplay (if you enjoy turn based combat). Plenty of different modes from campaign to arena and dungeons. It doesn't feel impossible to level up your characters without paying money, so long as you have patience. And yes there are scantily clad men and women of various races. Downsides You are bombarded with 7 or 8 ads whenever you open the game. Leveling up characters becomes exponentially more time consuming with each level. You must sac other characters of equal level.

I installed this game after a while and realized it was just as much a hassle as before. Most of the time when trying to run the app it would say I didn't have enough memory despite having several gigs free. The startup screen in camp always has 5 or more pop ups which just makes it even longer to start to play. Plus the RNG is just awful when it comes to good units.

I love playing this game, when it works properly. I've had constant crashes playing and loading the game. I've tried clearing cache and all that, and with constant updates, it's still not fixing the issue, despite reporting. Also, it's definitely a pay to play (or rather, a pay to win, I should say). Constantly bombarded opening the game to buy packs and other items you definitely need. Otherwise, it's a grind like hell to level up. Graphics and sound are really good and storyline is decent.

Good game, but persistently pushes you to spend ridiculous amounts of money. Each time you open the game youll get about 5-7 pop ups to spend like $30 on each one. I dont mind spending money on a game i enjoy (which i have spent about $5 on this one) but its just a little frustrating at times when I just want to play and not have to close pop ups.

Infinite treadmill to nowhere. I'm currently player level 54 and quickly losing interest. It's clear at this point that the only way to make noticeable progress is to feed it LOTS of money. The game exponentially increases the amount of time needed to needed to make progress. You reach a point where your time efficiency is so low that you cannot make reasonable progress without spending big bucks. No real end game content. Looks pretty though. Reply to dev: I am not free to play.

I love the dark graphics and theme of this game. However, It simply misses the mark on overall design. It requires an endless series of micro-transactions that ultimately leads to slow play. It is the most heavily monetized game that I have ever played, charging big bucks (hundreds of dollars) to access the most interesting parts. The battle action is repetitive with insufficient variation to hold your attention long term. But hell, hats off to the illustration team. It looks very cool.

I want to give the game more stars than this. If I can log back in, I just may. I've honestly played for a total of 10 minutes, tried collecting my daily reward, the game froze, and that's been that. I was excited to experience the actual gameplay as the graphics are nice, but.... I'm stuck. If I can get in and have a better time, I'll update this.

Great game, but PLEASE do a skip intro option 🙏. Sometimes I log out and when I go to log in I accidentally push the home screen and I need to go through the whole intro in order to log in and by that stage I don't want to play anymore. 😆 I do understand there is a login button, but if you read it correctly above you would see that I mention that sometimes you accidentally click start or brush the home landing screen, instead of login, and the whole intro runs and you cannot skip the intro!

Pretty good for this type of game, with graphics setting it apart from others. Just not interesting enough to keep me coming back. It just becomes a chores after a bit, no longer something I'm exite to open up and play. Pop-ups are on a more aggressive side though. Not the worst I've seen but definitely aggressive. You don't need this much to "make sure player doesn't miss out."

The game has both good points and bad, but overall it's fun. Unfortunately, as time goes on, the events have become increasingly difficult (most often impossible) to complete without a large purchase. As the content has increases, the importance of continual in-game purchases increases as well. It is to the point that one cannot compete and win without heavily investing real money. I'm fine with 'free' games being better or easier with a purchase (or even several)...but this us too much.

I really liked the quantity and diversity of champions. Meanwhile, sometimes after beating a stage, the connection failed and I had to relog several times. I've got very good WI-FI connection, so, it was the game's server, I guess. Also, quite a bit donate required on higher levels, but the game is definitely worth a try, so, check it out yourself :)

I've mostly enjoyed this game up till now, even if the in game purchases are 10x overpriced. The new battle pass though is flat out deceitful. For the free to play option, the are 100 levels of prizes. Each level appears to cost 20 points. Each day you can only earn 20 points. The whole thing resets in 54 days. This means that HALF of the "free" options are completely unobtainable if you don't buy the overpriced battle pass.

3.5 🌟 I think it's cool that it's grindy and complex, but the limit of how much one can play it just takes away from it. You run out of energy. Plus, there are heroes that are just way too strong and you will never ever get them unless you pay big bucks. Update: Been playing it for a few weeks and I put 3 hours into it almost every day, I haven't even gotten close to upgrading my first character to six stars.

Very good graphics, animation and RPG elements.... but gameplay requires too much time in front of device and cannot be played casually - need to stay in front of device. One cannot spend 3 hours a day waiting for next auto battle to end - there must be ways to make gameplay faster. So uninstalling until improved. Otherwise I did enjoy it.

It's fun at first, but then it's just an epic grind to get anywhere in the game. It becomes really sluggish and boring pretty quickly. Also, it's really not cool thatyou made switching armor between champions so expensive. Once I earned it, it's mine! Players would be able to switch weapons and armor freely. 100k coins to switch sets to a new camp is ridiculously expensive.

DO NOT, I repeat DO NOT download this game! Had it running for about 10 minutes and phone started going haywire. Ended with the black screen of death. I tried everything to save it, but ended up doing factory reset. Here I am a couple hours later. There's obviously a bug that needs to be worked out somewhere. BEWARE!! Also, what I did play wasn't great. The graphics are good, but you just tap a circle to choose a move then tap an enemy. Kinda lame.

It's an easy enough game to grasp: fill out a roster of 3-5 characters, progress through waves of enemies and bosses while upgrading levels, gear, and skills. Not really much challenge, just time-consuming. The UI is a bit cluttered at times and takes a bit to navigate. The worst offense in my opinion is the barrage of real-money offers that smack you in the face every time you boot up the game, and shelling out $40-70 is unrealistic for gems and whatnot. Not worth the install.

I initially really liked the visuals and variety of the Champions, and the thought of collecting them all. However it gets very difficult to enjoy that aspect of the game when there are so many popups to get through once you're on the home screen. That combined with an endless amount of different places to claim rewards, and you end up taking about 5-10 minutes before you can get to actually playing the game. Then the popups all come back once you run even a simple story mission. But even if you're okay with that it doesn't take very long to suddenly run into an invisible wall that all but halts your progress unless you pay a bunch of money. I realize it's free to download and play, but it just feels like way too aggressive of a monetization model and after a while the game stops feeling fun.

One of the most graphically detailed game out there on android. The animations, the textures are next level amazing. But it is a completely pay to win game. And the most frustrating part is most of your opponents are on the same level as you but they buy high level accessories and you can't win against them even though both you and your opponent probably started playing the game at the same time.

The game is decent in the charecter department, many cool options and even some 3 star (out of 5) are strong enough to compete at a high level. However, all the events are impossible to complete unless you spend a ton of money and the game is soooooo buggy. Crashes all the time and, when it does, it deletes any progress you made in that round/fight but takes DOUBLE the resources away for some reason.

started playing RAID about the time of its release, easy to play, navigate and understand. Many, many options to choose from and tailored to how you want to play. One major downfall of the game....WAY too much time and re-hashing of the same things over and over again without enough reward, (ie. legendary characters) I would be spending if I had a legendary character to build from early on, therefore, no incentive to continue. Epic characters aren't bad, just not what the game really calls for.

PAY-TO-PLAY, not even pay to win. This is just ridiculous. Even to swap an item within the inventory costs in-game currency. To upgrade a piece of equipment there is no fixed fee, but are paid ATTEMPTS to upgrade it. Every step you make, every breath you take costs money. The possibility to play for free is minimum. This is really annoying. I put three starts for graphics only. The design is good. The game is not designed for you to think or develop your game skills (auto mode for battles).

Pop-up adds, pop-up adds everywhere !!! If you want people to notice your "special offers" then everyone else have simple indicators (!) for that. So people can go and see the offers themselves (if they so wish) in their own time and not interrupted while being in the middle of something. After all, it supposed to be a game and not a purchasing simulator. Being able to buy something shouldn't interrupt the actual gameplay itself. Thank you!

This game was an ok time killer, until the last update. Now it's a buggy mess that crashes so hard it freezes my phone. Maybe I'll play a little longer to see if they fix it, but I definitely wouldn't recommend it to any new players in this state. Update: I spent way too much time seeing if this problem would go away, and it didn't completely. It no longer freezes my phone, but crashes and/or unscheduled "server maintenance" get in the way of playing more often than it should. Combine that with the terrible monetization and unnecessary annoyances like having to pay in game currency to move armor around, and this thing just sucks if you play it very long. Don't waste your time or money here.

It's a great game with incredibly detailed models, lots of characters and very cool combat sequences... But the sheer amount of ads to make in-app purchases *really* brings my rating down. Every time I load the game, it's at least four ads. When I return to my camp/home screen from doing combat or anything else, it's the same. If I wanted to make a purchase, I would. Being constantly reminded that there can be a purchase made is extremely tiresome and annoying.

This game is a lot of fun😁. Im already addicted to it, but its very frustrating when Im updating my gear and I loss money when it "fails" to upgrade. It will do that sometime 3x in a row. 😠 Also the game has froze a few times during games. If these bugs were fixed it would be a definite 5⭐ until the its a 4. Update 9/29: If the problem has been solve I can't tell. The freezing has not stopped, in fact it's happening more than ever. I'm losing a lot of energy because of it.

Fun, but costly. I just bought a gold shard on sale. $20 is really expensive, even on sale, and it's double the chance to get a gold character, and 10 times the chance to get a specific character. Instead, I got, yet again, the lowest quality possible, and one I already got to boot. Either drop the price, increase the chance to get the rarity I paid for, or I won't be buying anymore of these. $20 for a 6% chance to get what is offered is ludicrous. Fun game though. Just to costly + 2many popups

The game itself is good, the graphics are great and the story is great too. The only thing, is that its very pay-to-win, to earn even decently good items and characters in the game is very hard without just paying out of pocket. Plus the chances of you getting a, say legendary character from a crystal you can earn is super low, thereby almost forcing you to buy them with real money for a good shot at them. I get the purchases are optional but in this case it seems like they are almost necessary.

Too many pop ups telling you to buy super insanely expensive packs. Other than that, a very unoriginal combination of star wars Galaxy of heroes and idle heroes, nothing new. gameplay is super boring and repetitive, no option to skip fights,the only good part about the game is the graphics. Otherwise I would give this game zero stars if I could. In the end, the game is fun. But the popups and lack of skip makes me uninstall it instantly and not look back.

It's a really fun game with excellent graphics. But the ads for ingame purchases kinda ruin it and it's a huge pay to play and not a cheap one. I would rather pay for the game. It's starts to get quite difficult to not spend big amounts of money but continue to level up after you get through the first 20 levels as well as leveling up your champions.

This is a wonderful game. Original characters, a story, and the system while grindy is no more grindy or less so than other games of this style. While there are lots of options to get ahead for pay, nothing is stuck behind a pay wall. Now, that being said, it freezes during battle so often it gets frustrating. I hate restarting the app so frequently. I'm using a galaxy note 8 and shouldn't have these problems. I'd like to see something done about that.

Very pretty. The champions are unique, and certainly a few are cool looking. However, the gameplay is repetitive, and boring to watch. Champions quickly begin to blend together. Often, you aren't watching the screen at all. And you'll stare at champions that look awesome... but you won't have them for awhile. The game gives what seems to be a plethora of rewards and content, but you'll be lucky to get something unique and cool, and paying for it WILL become expensive. Overall, hard pass.

Be honest, now. It is just another game to waste time on... tapping a button to progress. It has a very rudimentary story to it that can be finished quickly. It also hounds you with ads... But these booster packs! At one point, eight pop ups in a row prevented me from just jumping into the game. And finally... Lag city! Want to work on multiple characters? Be prepared for slow screen changes. Despite these things, it is still a good game. You can progress without purchases if patient.

I dig the game, and it is one of the best ones on Android to date. The graphics and story are great. My two complaints would be the cost of unequipping weapons/armor, and the pop ups. It's way to expensive. You have champions, and you have the armor/weaps. It shouldn't cost to equip it, only to upgrade it. Fun game otherwise. The constant pop ups piss me off.

Fun, but crashes a lot while loading or starting a battle. That wouldn't bother me as much if it didn't mean losing whatever resources were used to start the battle. So if you used a key to battle the clan boss and it fails to start the battle, you lose the key. Makes me very reluctant to spend any money on resources in this game.  Edit: I was already using the latest version. I checked again today to confirm there was no updates. As of today, it's still crashing from time to time when loading battles. The game just freezes and I have to close it.

Although I like playing the game, I wish it were more like a game that has a storyline, which would allow you to see you heroes in action, fighting enemies along a journey, as opposed to just running up to a set amount of enemies to alternately challenge. It becomes a little redundant over time. It's exciting getting new shards, which allows you to strengthen your fav champions, if they are not especially strong. Give us more drinks in tavern as rewards, pls! Thank you :-)

The game is pretty fun, lots of options and tons of things to do. 2 stars because it's excruciating to play. Constantly lags, every time you click something it's a 5 second wait between clicks. It might not seem bad but it seriously adds up and becomes annoying. The other part are the in game adds for the microtransactions. Every time you load the game you get a tidal wave of windows you have to exit out of. I will never spend a dime on this game just because of that.

Fun game overall. My only issue is the draw percentage for legendary heroes. I understand the randomness of it but it's almost like you have to spend like crazy half the time to attempt to get one only to fail more often of not. Could just be my luck but that's my only real negative. Outside of that, the story, graphics and gameplay are on point. Easy to navigate through and jump right in. Again, if the draw system wasn't so low I'd rank it all the way up. Still good game though.

Decent turn based combat. Way too aggressive pop-ups in game trying to get sales. At one point in levelling, I had to close no fewer than 8 "BUY NOW!" pop-ups back to back. If there was a reason I would REFUSE to play this game again, that's it. 1-2 sale windows every now and then, not 8+ back to back. That's a great way to annoy your players to not return. After about the 4th one I stopped paying attention to what was even being advertised, and closed everything without looking.

This game is so oversaturated. Too many mechanics, too many ads, too many pop ups, too many characters and items and abilities and bosses. There's no way to make meaningful decisions or have any agency in your experience with this broad a surface. The graphics are great and the core mechanics are fun, but the learning curve is just way too high for new and returning players, not to mention the predatory marketing and microtransaction options.

Game is great. Graphics are nice and game play is also very good. Maybe implement a turn slider to see who's next to attack? Lot of pop ups to buy stuff though which was pretty annoying. If you wanna do that then cool but don't want to see "buy this pack for..." nearly every time I go back to the home screen. Pretty much the only reason I didn't give it 5 stars since I am having fun with it.

This game is almost great. The art style, pacing, combat, all great. What's not great are the upsettingly common freezes that force a relaunch (the lag when selecting things and changing screens isn't great, either). If the freezing got fixed/improved, I wouldn't hesitate to give this 5☆, as I've been greatly enjoying it for a little over 4 weeks now. I still do recommend this game. The freezes are annoying and frustrating, but haven't ruined the game... so far.

This game has a ton of potential with an engaging combat system and tons of different champions with varied abilities and usefulness. Unfortunately, a lot of the game is hidden behind pay-to-win walls simply because the drop rates are absolutely abysmal, and a lot of the game has some ridiculous mechanics designed to get you to spend money. For example, simply taking gear off your champions requires a vast amount of in-game currency, something which discourages innovation and experimentation.

The game is really well done, and has the potential to be a fantasitic game. I will give the developers some props for the lack of ads in the game, but the popups when you log in, or when you complete a stage, come absurdly often, and in large quantities. It would ne nice to have an option to never show the popups again, that way we wouldn't have to spend an entire minute clicking X's before we get the chance to play the game. It would also he nice to have an option to reset your account.

A good time killer if you like auto battle games. But the combat is slow, even on double speed, the grind to get anything to keep you motivated in the game hits a brick wall after a few weeks of playing, and once you finish the campaign theres not much to do. Loved it for a bit as a distraction in class. But thats all its good for, a quick distraction.

The game started fast with plenty to do. After a week, it stalled out and became tedious and boring. The visuals are quite good, but does nothing for the shallow battle system. My time was full of turning low level "rare" characters into higher level characters capable of taking me to the top of the lowest rank of pvp battle standings. The game rewards you at every turn, throwing game currency and energy at you all the time - but if you don't pay real money, good luck breaking out of the bottom.

This is the fastest I've ever become completely sick of a game. Didn't even make it three days before the constant, relentless attempts to solicit money drove me away. The last straw was when I had to click through twelve different ads for in-game purchases in a row before I could actually continue playing. The graphics are great, sure, and the gameplay was somewhat fun, but the sheer volume of ads was atrocious.

Game was fun to play for awhile. Graphics are good, game play is okay. The real headache begins when you start trying to upgrade gear, change gear, ascend champions, and level up. Equipment costs obscene amounts of silver to upgrade, or even change out. Rewards are ridiculously nerfed so you have to grind for hours to get anything usable for higher levels. If you're looking for a fun game that you don't have to spend lots of money on, avoid this one.

This game was fun at first, and time in = experience out, so if you want to spend all day on a phone game, this is the game for you! Unfortunately, they have changed it so every time you go to the home screen you get 5-6 ad pages, so in an hour of gameplay, that's something like 20-40 ads you have to load up, then click off, and you must play hours each day to keep up. There is some strategy involved in battle, an extensive hero collection and upgrade interface, and lots of content to play.

I would give 5/5 except for 2 things. 1.) Let us disable the store popups! I don't need to see these 'deals' every time I login. There is something in settings that makes it seem like you can turn it off, but it does nothing. 2.) There's a bug that doesn't send in all of your set characters for multi-battle. Really annoying coming back 30min later to find you were defeated in 1st battle due to the bug so the rest didn't go through. Other than that, great game.

Fun game but always crashing.. Eh, guess it depends on if you are willing to put up with the constant freezing and crashing if you want to download it. I've been playing for a few months and it's not p2w, it is possible to get everything without paying it will just take ALOT more time. The ads are annoying and a bit excessive, but I don't know a game that doesn't have them. But overall a good game. 2 days and no crash, :) groovy.

The game really encourages you to spend money after the starter boosts, or you would make slow progress in game. Also, the combat system is way too simple; no formations or positioning of characters affecting the battle like in some other turn based RPGs; it's safe to say that battles are stat based, which is common in turn based games, but also like some turn based games, the game did not do too much to change that. The graphics and art style are good.

Its alright. Turn based combat, gear upgrading, and a bit of strategy required with enemy types. Now, the problems. First, when you open the game you are bombarded with a slew of promotions, requiring you to close upwards of 8 of em before you can actually play. Secondly, character progression is rather slow, and the further you play, the more of your champions you once thought to be badass are just bad. Then you have to level up new hero's to your current level, which takes a while to do as wel

Too much investment for a VERY LITTLE FUN. The high rating is very confusing... the graphics are great, but after several months of playing it is still unclear to me how to progress and win other players. The whole thing FEELS VERY RANDOM although I invested a lot to follow the instructions. The many purchases I did in the game are expensive and didn't help to progress, so I found myself "working" in the game instead of enjoying it. Too many pop-ups to purchase, that are overwhelming.

Desperate for $$$! The game itself is fun. LOTS of characters and creatures to collect and with the items you can equip AND big teams means huge customization for your teams. BUT How the hell am I supposed to even play the game when every time I log in or come back from fighting I have to close 7 full screen windows trying to get me to pay $10-$70 for all kinds of different game packs. EVERY SINGLE TIME I go back to the hub. Would be a great game if it weren't for the constant begging for money.

The game is not very good, It is at best Ok. Many of the characters are re-textures of models, the gameplay is dull and not enthralling, and the story is extremely hard to follow, very hard to understand and seems very fragmented. Gameplay is 2 to 3 buttons but gets taken away for auto battle, and the character items like gear seems pointless if you have to pay to remove the items, Especially for new players who do not have money to sink into the game. Would not recommend. Needs more work.

This game has pretty good graphics, I'll say that's one thing good about it. However, the game adverts its "invigorating battle system", which is the exact opposite of what the battle system is. It isn't satisfying at all, and you can even set it so the battles fight themselves. You get a lot of ads most of the time when you return home from a battle or close a menu. Also, after a few days, the game is basically pay2win.

It's a good game. The gameplay is nice, and the legends are plentiful. There are two major issues here though: 1) the amount of in-game ads is much too many. I have to close 7-10 different pop-up 'deals' when I get into the game just to play. I understand a game needs to make money, and a reminder for something is to be expected. However, that is waaay too many. And 2) if you don't pay, the progress is much too slow. The legends take alot to power up, and it takes time. EDIT: a good response!

At first when seeing all the ads for this game I mocked it because it looked boring and stupid. But I finally cracked and tried it, aside from a few things here and there (like having to spend silver to remove and equip new gear) the game is pretty good. Yes you can easily pay to win, but you also dont have to. It's actually fun grinding out to get upgrades. I do wish the auto level system would auto level so you didnt have to check back every 30 minutes to level, however.

Never had a game, where you have to spent that much money to progress in game. For everything you want to do, you have to spent resources, which takes a lot time to build up. You get so little back while clearing the dungeons, it gets frustrating. Also the drop rate of the heros is a joke, most time you get the same one, without some special events, you are not going to see epic or legendary hero drops. This game is just a money grab.  Can't recommend this game!

The game play feels good, there's enough strategy to keep one interested but it's still simple enough you can pick it up quickly. The reason I'm giving it 2 stars is because it's pay to win/progress, and every time you go back to the home screen where you upgrade heroes, buy items, etc. You are barrage with ads to buy in game content. These ads are not little nickle and dime transactions, most are $20+ (on sale too!). So every time you go back to town be prepared to spend 10 seconds closing ads.

I would happily give this a much higher rating but unfortunately I cannot. It has some big problems with crashing. I can usually play the game for roughly 1 hour or 45 min straight. Then it slows down and becomes unbearable. Then it will exit the app and I will have to reload it. Sometimes it decides to just crash and exit the app without slowing down. I love the game but it stays a 3 stars until this gets fixed. It's not almost unplayable... 2 stars now. Crashes even more

Overall the game seems great so far. The gameplay and Graphics are fun. My only concern is being constantly bombarded by monetization attempts. Like there are often times where I have to exit 5 ads in a row trying to get me to buy some sort of booster pack. It's really excessive. There should be a feature to turn those off.

Up by one. I can now at least play the game. I'm annoyed with all the popups though. Condense it down to one pop up with all your deals in a scrolling screen. It's annoying when 6-8 popups trying to get me to spend money. It makes me want to delete the game at times due to the number of popups that are back to back. Please try the one pop up screen idea. It is less annoying and more informative by seeing everything at once and being able to compare them together. You can even add timers to it.

Idea of the game is great, and intuitive. However, after two weeks it because constant repeat of grinding your heroes through levels in order to level them up. And if grinding wasn't bad enough, you have to close about 8 to 10 sets of ads before you can even start navigating through the game each day. The ads deter me from wanting to open the game.

Game is sound and by far the best in it's class. The graphics are amazing, the game runs smooth and for the most part I think it's pretty fair. Unlocks are reasonable. Now for the negative, the game has annoying popup ads (in game ads) every time you go back to the main castle thing. And the only reason I uninstalled is because unless you have good Internet access, you can't even open it. Unfortunately where I live I have very limited data and it won't open for me. But overall I recommend it.

This game looks alright from the outside, but progress is unbelievably slow and you have to do the same battles repeatedly to make any headway. Fast forward is not fast enough and the gameplay is repetitive. On top of that, the rewards for most things you do in-game are miniscule. Plus, the character models are kinda crusty around the seams.

Basically a gambling simulator. Upgrading gear is a pain and can take over 2mil just to upgrade a couple levels. Leveling/feeding characters is slow and painful. Cost of everything is way too much, suprising we don't pay money to hit people in the game. Hopefully laws are passed about this type of game in the near future. Game is very bad, AVOID AT ALL COSTS

Games graphics are amazing and I love the combat and easy to learn controls and systems. Although, my number one and only real issue is the amount of "buy this" packs that they slam in your face everytime you open the game. Before you can do anything, they throw upwards to about 4-8 buy this ads or packs that you have to keep exiting out of and that seems like overkill and gets to be very annoying.

After a couple years, I've ended up quitting the game. Unfortunately Plarium has become relentless with trying to drain people's resources in the past year. Every event/tournament costs more resources for minimal rewards. Sadly, if you want to approach the game as "free to play", it is nearly impossible. Holiday events are literally just changing a couple pictures. You have to spend hours upon hours in game to complete anything. At this point you either fork over your wallet or lose.

So this game is a time and money sink, but it is a well built one. The champions are well made and feel different, and not cheap like most games of the like, and while the good rewards are hard to come by, the game does a great job of providing plenty of quests, challenges, and lots of small rewards so it doesnt completely feel like a pay to win. Overall i expected to hate this game, and have played it for a week straight.

Really fun game, but it crashes about 5 times a day and sending an error report does nothing. Maybe at least refund the player for what they lose when it crashes FIVE TIMES A DAY!!!! Also crazy expensive play to win, wouldn't recommend spending money on this one, you won't get much back. **EDIT doesn't really crash anymore, still very expensive to play!

It's a definite cash grab, but not mandatory. Popups on login can be annoying, but like anything else, once you expect them, they're just there to be overlooked. The game though is very enjoyable and I've spent quite a bit of time playing without the necessary purchase of resources to continue playing like so many other mobile games. Overall, a great mobile gaming experience!

WAY to many pop-up ads/announcement each time you start the game 5-9 +. Please make it just one big ad/announcement to save us the time and clicks. Also, the leveling and raking up process is super tedious and time-consuming because it's not streamlined so it takes tons of time clicking through the same stuff that the game could do much more efficiently. For example, I could choose all the champions at once* that I'm willing to use in order to get another champion closer to a chosen rank.

My expectations coming into this game were pretty low, but somehow this game managed to go even lower. It gives some useful stuff in the beginning, that at one point is going to be useless, because getting new equipment and characters is almost impossible. So paying into this game becomes a necessity, which ruins the entire gameplay, since it's just a pay to win. And character design is alright at best, same with the graphics. I would much rather just pay for entire game once than multiple times

Honestly, my only gripes with this game so far, is the upgrading equipment and removing. It cost WAY too much money to remove an item. Like an obscene amount. And the rate at which you fail upgrading an item is also bad. It says high chance and I failed over 7 times in a row, wasting 20000+ in game currency on it. Like it kinda kills the immersion when I spend 100,000 on just two characters when I only have so much. After awhile, it's not easy getting money.

I'm still in the early game, but so far so good. We'll see if that holds long term. Update: The game remained fun for quite a while, though I probably spent more money than I expected to. I've quit the game since I didn't feel like I really had anymore end game challenges that needed to be conquered, just mindless grinding. Changed rating to 4 star because gameplay loop itself isn't really that fun, the fun part is putting teams together to defeat difficult challenges.

Starts off great: easy to pick up and play without being complicated. Once past the tutorial, the constant spam ads to buy stuff hits you while in the main area. No way to set a "don't bug me again" setting so you get one, sometimes two every time you return there from, say, equipping your hero. Ruins any sort of fun the game coulda had otherwise...

Great game for a week, and then you're addicted for a couple of months, and can play it as much as you want...and then the energy runs out unless you pay. And the resources that are abundant and helpful early disappear. The micro transactions are major transactions- it's outrageously expensive. Player suggestions are ignored and free to play is impossible after a certain point. It does have nice graphics, though.

The graphics are pretty good, better than other games like this. The character development is above average. I haven't found that it is a pay to win yet, however I am a casual player. This game is extremely buggy and freezes quite often. Been playing for a few weeks now and I am having to restart the game ever 4 -8 battles... they don't seem to be too worried about it as I've read several complaints. Here is hoping it is fixed soon or I will be finding another game.

The game itself seems solid enough. Decent graphics and lots of systems in place. That being said, you can't return to the main area of the game without CLOSING POP-UP ADS LEFT AND RIGHT! It was bad enough that I uninstalled, can't stand being bombarded with "offers" and "deals" constantly. No wonder they can afford so much advertising.

It constantly crashes, about every two taps it says something about being unable to load resources and it makes navigating it a nightmare. Also within the first 5 minutes 3 pop ups appear and ask you to buy things. Perhaps a setting to turn said pop ups off would be a great solution, since the players who aren't interested in purchasing would be very annoyed. Currently unplayable to me and very discouraged by the pop ups. Love the graphics though, it's a beautiful game for a mobile game.

It's a good game. Latest updates fixed some confusion with weapon upgrades. My biggest gripes are firstly if you're using the continuous battle mode you should be able to skip the long drawn out fights, especially if you're using the same team or better. It takes way too long to use. Second is the buff system. If the buff disappears when moving between rounds 2 and then the cool down should reset also or the buffs should remain. It's very annoying to get a good buff and then have it disappear 3 s

I love the gameplay loop, just hate when ever I start the game, or go back to the hub, I usually get bombarded with news, events, and offers in the form of invasive pop ups. I understand it's free to play, and they need to make their money somehow, but maybe if they just had a singular popup with events, offers, and news all in one, rather than half a dozen separate ones that also repeat every now and again when you come back to the Bastian, it'd be less annoying. Otherwise, great game.

Excellent game, with extraordinary graphics. Though it seems there is a "bug" in the game ATM. It is not possible to "multi battle" with max level champions, even if you check the box that allows this on. For instance, I've chosen 4 champs. Two under max level and to at max level, and when I start the multi battle, the two at max level is left out. Hope you can fix this, it's quite annoying 😉

I started playing this game shortly after it had came out many years ago. It was fun and full of new content that no other mobile game had. I have never been so annoyed and disappointed in a game that was advertised so well. When you log in your screen is absolutely flooded with ridiculous purchase options and seemingly inescapable popups. It is extremely hard to get decent heroes and trying to gear them up is just as hard. Feel free to play, but don't spend any money because there is no return

Pretty standard turn based system, enjoyable for killing time. Extremely dangerous for someone susceptible to microtransactions built to speed up progression. I could do without being bombarded with "pack" purchase pop ups when playing. Graphics are excellent for a mobile game, story is meh but there was some effort put in. UI is a mess in some areas, but I'm not sure how much better it could be with the limited screen space they are working with. Do not buy packs. Have patience.

The only good things I can say about this game are that it has a lot of nice looking characters and a good combat system. Everything else is meh.. I got bored quickly because it gives you no clear goals and I got really annoyed at the multi battle function because it doesn't allow more than one max level character and it decreases the counter as soon as you start playing, which means I lost like 10 tries just trying to figure out the max lvl thing. This game should figure out what it wants to be

I like the game itself. Could use some work though. The spamming of pop ups as you log in is a little annoying but its better than getting it everytime you open the screen. But. My issue. My BIG issue. Why do i keep disconnecting or freezing mid fight. Ill start an autobattle and 45 seconds in.. its frozen. Needs some work. Other than that. Its great. Would give a 4 or 5 star with a fix to the freezing issue, seems a little pay to play, but I like it.

Became repetitive extremely quickly. It has about three different options to go through to try to keep you engaged, along with some reward bait. But ultimately it does get pretty tiring after about 2 days. I got the feeling that would be the case from their expansive advertising, after all that stuff costs money. As does the game. And I understand these people need to make some money, but getting bombarded with purchase offers every time I went back to town was frustrating.

Pretty good in terms of options for play. No gimmicks and straight forward turn based play. Although, I will say that if this needs anything, it is either less damage or higher health for players and enemies. The fights do not feel very strategic with casters or healing or buffing option and feel more reliant on a race for damage output. EDIT: PLEASE DEVS, add a friend list feature. it's so basic but it is really nice for when you just wanna talk with some people you have met in a channel again.

I enjoy Raid as it has many events, challenges, goals and dungeon options. Leveling up isn't too difficult, ascension only requires potions and the rewards are reasonable and the sign in is a nice resource. However I found the storyline a bit lacking. It is only available in campaign at the start and end of each fort, but after completing the last fort on normal mode, the story ends entirely. This caused a loss of interest for me - I no longer felt like part of the world. Still, amazing game.

The graphics are good, but very expensive to really get anywhere, I've been playing this game for well over a year, and have made it about halfway through level 54, which takes forever, have gotten a few more legendaries, but takes forever, unless you want to spend a fortune buying all the stuff. You can spend more just upgrading one artifact, than playing most games, all the way through.

I enjoyed the gameplay for the most part. There are some aspects of the game like leveling up armor that gets a bit annoying since there is a gamble for success when upgrading it. My main problem comes with the constant ads. It gives you an option in-game to disable notifications. Which I did, but yet when opening up the app I get an absolute slew of ads wanting you to do micro- transactions. I'm talking 6-8 back to back ads and there are still more that pop-up while playing.

I think it's a pretty cool game overall. The graphics and characters you can play as are also pretty cool. Even the story progression isn't too bad for me so far. However, the one thing that keeps this game from getting 5 stars from me is the fact that each time I open up the game, I'm constantly bombarded by the number of pop ups. Like 5 or six times something comes up at the start, asking if I want to purchase something. Once all of them are "X" out it's fine. But its seriously annoying.

Longterm leaves something to be desired. As you begin playing, graphics are fantastic, there is an interesting opening story, character design is incredible and it is really fun to play (and I typically dislike turn based combat)! However, there isn't much to the story after the intro, other than brief narration. And after playing a few weeks, the grind is endless with little reward. Finally earned that Gold Shard, but won a purple champion, then what? Expensive microtransactions and autopilot.

The game is pay to win. Progress is extremely slow unless you pay real money. You get a solid bombardment of ads every hour or so, and once you equip something to a champion you then have to pay to remove it. Combat was interesting, hand a fair bit of strategy. Overall, not my kind of game but seems pretty popular for a lot.of people. It's free, so worth a try at least.

Extremely time consuming, with no way to skip any part of the grind, that's just depressing. The game is very well developed, graphics and mechanics, I'd like to continue playing it, just can't put so much time in here. Also, no compensation for any bugs and issues. Overall, good if that's what you wan t and ready to spend most of your free time in it (can't progress otherwise).

The game is an alright time-waster. There is quite a bit of depth to powering up and gearing your heroes. My issue is that the game is constantly throwing ads in your face trying to get you to buy their ridiculously overpriced packs. I usually have to close 4-5 ads every time I log on to the game, and every now and again it will throw some at me while I've been on it. I've dropped money on this game for smaller, more reasonably priced deals, but I can't deal with how forced the monetization is.

It was fun to play at first but then it just became to much to keep up with. So many different characters and so many different sets of armor with different stats it just kinda hard to keep up and decide which characters to use. And it was also really annoying getting bombarded with ads telling you to spend money on the game everytime I went to the home screen. I also didn't like that you had to spend so much silver just to switch out a characters armor which made no sense to me.

At first, this game was great. Good graphics, fast paced runs, lots of champions etc. It was good enough I was willing to give Plarium money. Over the last couple weeks since their Battle Pass, the game has been nothing short of a mess. Constant crashes, won't work half the time on desktop, and the game not even letting you log in, but they say "sorry" with a few gems or a shard. Unless big changes come soon, I think my time will be better spent elsewhere on a fully functioning game.

Overall great game, user interface is lacking a lot, tho. It's ugly, slow and non-intuitive. Which is the biggest downside of this game for me. It should feel medieval, fantasy... team picking screens feel like EA Sports game. I also dislike that ton of pack sells at the startup, it's annoying. Game has a lot of potentional, but at the current state, I can play it only casualy.

After playing for a few weeks the negatives far outweigh positives. Issue 1. the HUGE time sinks involved. There is no quick resolve of any combat. there is extremely limited attempts at a series of autocombat. so if you are grinding to raise levels it becomes a huge chore. Like EQ raid level chore. Which seems odd for a cellphone game. Issue 2. The game has like 500 champions (actually more but they are little more than growth fodder). However you can only keep 100 in inventory. So now you need to pick and choose which can be quite frustrating. issue 3. inventory management is just horrible. there is no filtering options, only 5 sorting options. so trying to find the character to upgrade/train etc is not quick. additionally there is no retention of sorting options or place in the list. so if you leave and go back you are starting all over.

Update: I love it when the game forces me to close and restart the game every 2 campaign missions. It's not annoying and doesn't ruin the fun at all. A decent game. One of the worst skill up system I have seen by far in a game though. Nearly impossible to skill up a legendary if you happen to get one through sheer miracle. You also get a facial of iap ads everytime you get in the game as if their intention wasn't obvious enough.

Every time you open the game, you are greeted by a minimum of five (5) limited-time offers, that last for two-three days, and seem to repeat every week or so (real-money offers, if I was not clear). The visuals are excellent, the gameplay is fluid, but gets boring really fast. I mean, at least randomize the order of attack between stages or waves. The game offers lots of heroes to choose, but apart from the visuals, I had a very hard time figuring which ones are best (apart from the obvious star rating and rarity) and sacrificed everything above the bare minimum needed for the missions.

Leveling your heros, finding the right build, finding out whose good and bad; these are the good points. Now for the bad. Most of the time you return to the main hub you will be hit with "ads" for their latest "deals". This is obviously very annoying at their frequency, and these deals aren't that good. As others have pointed out, the shop has access to loot boxes and items to level faster but they are behind 30, 40, 50 dollar price tags. Would never recommend to someone without self control.

Got up to level 15, was casually upgrading heroes and completing quests, doing really well! I liked the game and was enjoying my time! But then..... then I saw that I could log in with Facebook to keep my progress saved. Great idea right? NOPE! AN HOUR OF PROGRESS DOWN THE DRAIN! The game reset entirely and I lost everything. I lost it all why trying to ensure I didnt... well... lose it all! What a joke.

The game is good actually, the graphic and the gameplay are quite simple. But the problem that always happens to me is during the fights, i will encounter some random crash and the game will stuck. When i restart the game, it says that i can continue my previous unfinished battle. But nothing happens when i choose yes. It already happens many times. Please fix this. Im already considering to stop playing the game if this keeps happening again.

This game is a shameless cash-grab. Not recommended! Every time you start it you're greeted with several pop-ups being you to buy things. Every time you get one upgrade or increase one level for some great it takes exponentially longer to get the next to the point where you'll have to grind for days to get enough silver to upgrade one item another level. And you're always using six pieces of gear on several heroes at once. Of course you can skip all of this off you pay up to not play the game.

The game play & graphics are very good...once you can get to them. When you open the game you are bombarded with far too many purchase ads before you can get to play. IT'S VERY ANNOYING!!! Also, I've installed the game on my phone as well as my tablet and I can't find any way to log into my original account AND it FORCES YOU to go through a tutorial. Why can't we opt out of the tutorial or sync accounts?? I don't want to lose all my progress when I switch devices.

Its pure trash, i can't believe people play the game basically forcing you to pay at every corner. You want to level up, no problem just allow us to take most of your time. No? Then how about 4.99 or 1.99 for a small boost. It has amazing graphics for a moblie game but on pc it looks like a moblie game ported to the pc (which it is). I have no idea if it me but this could have been amazing if they don't try to make you buy everything. Thanks for time. Have a blessed day.

Graphics are good, games tends to be fun to play but, AI system that runs the games seems to work inconsistently. I'm new to the game, but I just noticed during the Christmas Fusion event that it seemed a little more difficult to get potions from the dungeons for leveling up my characters. I'm not one to complain, but I just notice it took longer to beat the bosses, I kept getting forced out while playing, having to reload the dungeon. Maybe its just my account. Hope the information is helpful

The game is great. You have to put a little effort and a lot of farm to get strong without paying but it's possible so i liked it. The graphics are amazing. The gameplay is nice. But why would it cost silver to remove an item from a champion without destroying it? In my opinion, It's completely meaningless. The gear of a champion is a big part of the game so it is essential to be free to test different variations of equipment. Ignoring that, you've done a very good job creating this game!

Very unstable recently. It used to be great, but over the last month or two it locks up very often (almost once each session) which usually results in a loss. Sad. Oneplus 5t with plenty of ram and gameplay is smooth when not crashing. The game itself is pretty standard summoners war clone, lots n lots of popup ads when you start, and with all the crashing it's added salt in the wound with each restart. Quite fun and not too pay-wall-y. I'll raise my rating when it gets more stable.

Very simple, fun and addictive. Knock a star off for the sheer amount of in your face advertising for in game purchases. Granted it doesn't exit out or break immersion like a lot of mobile games do, it's in their interface, but I wanna get on and do a couple quick fights during a break at work and it's X X X X X X NO I DON'T WANT YOUR BOOSTS. $10 is the lowest buy-in for starter packs, given alot of games like Madden even, can get you a solid one time newbie purchase for $5 or less.

Great game. Great visuals. And great starting gear for the first 90 days to keep you in it. Why did i give it 3 stars??? Because of the pop ups when u start the game.. 4 to 8 ads for "specials" or "limited time offer" to buy things.. seriously intrusive and annoying. But once you close them all finally.. you can enjoy the game. If they back off that or add a option to disable it. I'll give this game 5 stars! Update. I've stopped playing because a game bug.. was actually part of the game. 2 stars

Good game for eating some time. The pop up ads are a little excessive. I don't mind one here and there, but 9 back to back set me off. I saw in a previous Dev response that dismissing one makes it go away, but it will return. I've seen the same dismissed ad 4 times. Aside from the game telling at you like the person signing you up for Best Buy credit cards every 60 seconds, great game.

I would rate this much higher but it's got stability issues and a memory leak. It has, on multiple occasions, caused the phone to become unstable and have to be restarted. Often when closing the app it gets stuck and the sound keeps running until you force close it. Update:. 'our game causing phone instability is a known issue'... Uh, sorry guys, that's a non-starter. If it's unstable and causing phones to crash and have to be restarted it shouldn't be on the play store. period. uninstalled.

So I've been playing these summon style games for several years. I'll say that this one is very straight forward in terms of playing the game and moving around the UI. I have a couple small gripes about the game though. Mostly about the gear system. There's too many gear options. It feels overwhelming trying to get the gear that's recommended for your champions. Upgrading this gear also takes a lot of silver to raise a level. This needs to be balanced in my opinion.

I'm a big fan of turn based RPG games (remindes me of FFX in essence) and after seeing an ad on this, i figured to give the game a try. It's a lot of fun with a deep grind, especially if you do not want to pay, but the one big issue I have with the game is that you have to pay Silver to unequip inventory. With silver prices steep depending on the item you have, I've ran out of silver when I needed it for crucial tasks. Should NOT be penalized for wanting to change out your equipment.

Fun game, crashes continuously on my note 4. Entering battles, finishing battles, going to a different screen.. crash crash crash. Also a space hog.. takes way way more space then any other game I've tried. Continued-it's getting better, but still crashes fairly often. Not sure about the space it uses, haven't checked in a while. Still a fun game, just needs time to clear up some bugs i expect.

The game is pretty fun, but there's a lot of aspects that makes the experience worse. The buff or debuff notification didn't explain much of what it does, (example : hex) also the fact that multi battle is only limited to 30 times and need to buy to get more. The artifact system is confusing, also need to farming for good stat artifact. It would be great if the developer could fix these problems for better playing experience.

The game itself would be great for its amount of characters, skills, items and content in general, if not for several flaws. First, each time you log in, your bombarded with pop ups about spending money on special offers. Then there is no auto win option for already finished missions or levels, so you have to sit through everything while the maximum speed is 2x normal, making it a chore to collect anything. Lastly the incredibly slow progress which goes hand in hand with the point before.

Stopped playing after 95 days. After 90 days, you don't get login bonuses any longer. It became boring and it is a money pit. It's basically just a simulator with too many champions. This in itself, makes you feel overwhelmed with too many stats. You can only autoplay 15 battles a day unless you pay for their monthly passes which will give you more but still not enough. Then you have to hit replay after each battle. There's usually no point to manually playing the battles....

Turns into a grind VERY quickly. The Arena system is broken. They use inactive players with maxed out teams to fill your opponents list, which makes advancing almost impossible. Unfortunately, it's also a requirement to advance through the missions. This makes completing your mission list also impossible. You very quickly get to a point where you have nothing left to do because you can't move forward. They need to fix this or they will continue to lose players.

The game is really good to play while working if you set a good team up for auto battles. You don't need to spend money, but it helps to things faster till a point. However instead of mobile games which suck for the most part. Just buy a switch light or a retro handheld. You will be much happier, plus you can save space on your phone and use it while playing. In total to be on top in this game you would have to spend $100s a week.

It's a fun game! Good graphics, lot of heroes, lot of items and things to learn about. A bit overwhelming at times, but take it ow a d learn as you go. My biggest complaint is there seems to be no uato complete battles. You can auto attack multiple battles at 2x speed, but that still takes a lot of time. I find it odd that a feature in pretty much every other mobile game isn't in this one.

Complete trash. This app crashes 20 times a day. Everytime you log on you get bombarded with pop ups to buy to play over and over. I get it. You sell stuff to make a buck but I don't need reminded everytime I sign on with 10 pop ups. This game could be fun without the constant begging to buy and the crashes. Fix it. The developer responded and it's ridiculous to just say yeah we know just close the 20 windows that keep popping up. And when you want to upgrade stuff it fails 90% of the time.

This game is a bit frustrating because it's ALMOST good. Looks really pretty for being the standard gacha fare, that's for sure, and it has enough depth that it won't leave you immediately bored, along with plenty of things to do and a good enough champion variety. Right! That's for the good of it, now here comes the bad: - The ads. Ads ads ads ads ADS ADS! You will get bombarded by a TON of ads. Plarium excuses it that most of their deals are time-limited but honestly, I don't buy it. I know where the shop is. If there's something I don't want to miss on, I'll check there. There's no need to show me 10 ads as soon as I log on for limited-time deals that, frankly, don't provide that much value. Oh yes, to add insult to the injury, most timed deals are newbie traps. - Storage limits. You will be expected to grind a lot, fair enough, it's that kind of game. However, your actual storage space for champions is extremely limited and even if you're the biggest whale, you'll get frustrated by how you won't even able to keep a proper collection with the kind of limited space you're given, even after paying up. - Artifact unequip fees. This one I'm going to list it the last because I know Plarium won't change it, but it's still worth mentioning. You need Silver (The free currency) to change a champion's artifacts (Gear) with their justification being "it's in the name of balance." However, costs do mount up pretty quickly, especially if you have a lot of champions and rarer gear. If you're going to keep buying YouTubers to advertise your game, then please, address some of these concerns so there's at least a somewhat enjoyable game to be had.

This is an edit to my initial review. The game is still fun and the champions are pretty fun to collect. However, It suffers greatly from balance issues and from microtransactions that are extremely bloated in price. The game crashes fairly frequently and doesn't refund spent energy on incomplete missions. All in all I would say that it's a pretty good time sink. However, until the prices come way down and the balance issues and bugs are addressed... Your money is best to spend somewhere else

Have been playing this game for quite a while now, time to give a review. The games graphics and gameplay are great. The huge downside is the unbelievable price if you want to invest and the incredibly low chance of getting good characters. I have spent over 200 dollars and tons of playtime and only have two legendary characters to show for it. Would love to give a better score but this is a phone game with ridiculous prices and terrible return on investment. Your reply drops it to 1 star.

There is a flaw in the calculation of Silver cost when you Upgrade weapons/artifacts multiple levels at a time via the button for specific levels (4, 8, 12, etc) that is not accounted for by the Fail rate. I have lost hundreds of thousands of Silver with this bug. Thanks for the response, but that is not what I'm saying, at all. There is something wrong with your math. Instead of being charged roughly 10,000 Silver per Upgrade level, I was charged roughly 100,000 per level. Bug in math

This game started do strong. Great graphics and really the appeals to the collector in me. However, the reality is that's it's pay to win. I have no problem investing money in a game if its great, but everything is completely luck based. In effect, the game is a casino with the worst aspects of the "loot crate" system. Everything is very high priced and you'll likely get rubbish for what you buy. Combine that with major issues in the arena preventing progress in missions and I'd say avoid this.

I haven't played the game properly in weeks because there are always 8-10 ads that pop up one after the other everytime I launch the game. It's too much. I end up closing the game before all the ads finish popping up. The sad thing is I might have spent some money on the game if I'd been able to actually play it, but I'll actively avoid in game purchases because of the number of ads. At least make those pop ups optional AND make the option to disable them easy to find.

Edit: After playing the game for more time I have discovered that it is entirely made for pay to win. Despite putting in a fair amount of money and time I found that I could not progress efficiently because I required certain abilities/champions to progress and was stuck waiting for RNG to help me out. The game is designed to be a cash grab with no free ways to progress in a timely fashion. A pretty fun game that has some minor to moderate annoyances. I love the detail they put into creating the champions and a lot of the unique skills and effects making each one have its own flavor. Quite a few champions just look like re-skins of others but the detail of the skins is nice and for the most part you can tell each one apart from another without issue. Now whats keeping me from giving it 5 stars is the game can force you to grind a bit too much and even locks the otherwise awesome multi-battle function to a limit per day that is only increased through a paywall. The arena is pretty terrible and required if you want to continue progressing. When you first log in you are spammed with popup windows that you cannot disable (at least I cant find a way) and this can be even more frustrating when you factor in the not uncommon crashes to the game. Then there is how you get champions, if you want an epic/legendary champion usually you would have to open shards to get them and they are uncommon unless you are dropping some dollar bills and then there is a small drop rate for epics and an appropriate one for legendary champions, which would be fine if every epic was good. Often the epic champions are extremely niche, okay or downright terrible. There is nothing more disappointing than opening 10 blue shards, getting an epic and finding out no matter what you do its useless. Overall its a solid game and a fun waste of time that helps flex the mind, but it has its flaws.

This game does a tremendous number of things really well. There's a mile of content with loads of collectables and game modes, a detailed campaign with short voiced cinematics, swarms of quest types to teach you and urge you onwards, and a lot of rotating events ensuring that there's always something happening. On the downside, you get bombarded with far too many popups every time you log in, gear upgrading is frustratingly random, and grinding is very time consuming as there's no skip option.

The game is actually pretty great in regards to content and replayability. However, Everytime you go back to your base to manage your line up, gear, and claim rewards. You get bombarded constantly on all the sales, boosters, and starter items you can purchase with real money. I appreciate that the game is free, but if I want to buy something I will make it happen. I would advise upon first login you get a single pop up interface that shows you all the things going on with the shop and no more.

An exceptional crafted game. Unfortunately I cannot rate higher than a 2. Graphically and mechanically speaking the game is perfect. My issue lies not with the mechanics of the game such as the random champion and gear drops. My issue lies with three particular things. #1: the greedy and overly pushy in app transactions. #2: the low level cap for champions. #3: the ridiculous cost of in game coins, and the low success chance to upgrade gear.

One of the worst experience I've ever had while playing a mobile game. You load into the game, hoping to be able to pass some time being a mindless drone by repeatedly pressing the repeat battle button. But all you get to do is close ad after ad which they throw at you, hoping that you'll buy their in game currency. The worst part is that this does not only happen when you load in but every single time you go to the main screen.

Good: Turn-based Hack & Slash Bad: Endless Grinding. The graphics are excellent and the game-play is a decent hack & slash (with an auto mode so it can play itself). You don't have to spend money on the game (which is a define plus), but you can spend a fortune. The downsides are that there is little to no hook to any role-play or story, and the grinding is endless (and fairly pointless in the long-run). It's fun and addicting for a while but it can get old really quickly.

In many ways this game does it right, they're decently fair on giving free to play players good loot if they grind for it, the game looks phenomenal, and the gameplay is better than I expected. But, there's always a catch with these type of games. First off, events will be practically impossible at times to finish due to the ridiculous amount of loot needed to be saved to not spend money. Also, artifacts are not well explained and took me almost a month to figure out. Overall, good, not amazing.

This is a long haul game unless you're willing to drop a whole lot of money right off the bat. Graphics are amazing. Characters are diverse. The devs did a good job on that aspect. There are glitches. Very frustrating ones which do not always recognize the completion of challenges and missions. Example: Artifact challenge 6.1, 6.2 and 6.3 have had several thousand energy spent on them and have been completed but not recognized.

The graphics are good but this game just has way too many core problems with balance. I played for about 2 months but suddenly felt like I couldn't progress anymore without spending absurd amounts of money and time. They bombard you with pop-ups asking for money all the time. It all became too much so I uninstalled. Grinding the same dungeon hundreds and hundreds of times in a row for imperceptible progression just isn't fun gameplay.

good enough game, but all the purchase options are crazy overpriced for what you get. the 5 dollar starter pack was worth it, but you would have to be crazy to buy anything else. Dropped it to 1 star. The gameplay is still decent, but the constant spend money pop ups when you open the game, crashes, and horribly overpriced battlepass have convinced me to reduce the rating. This is just a dumb phone game. There is no reason the battle pass for it should cost 3 times as much as a real games.

Been playing this game on and off for over a year. Recently started again about two months ago.. simply put, I love the game. I love the way it looks and the gear management and buffing champs etc. But there is actually LESS to do the further you progress in the game.. no new content is released and the rewards for clearing content at and game are very inconsistent. Straight garbage at times. My biggest gripe has to be the predatory systems and overpriced in game items / currency etc. Terrifying

I played the game for over a year. Got to mid-late level game. The pros are that the championship are interesting and the graphics are ok for a mobile game. However, the cons outweigh the pros: its not an RPG but a champion collecting game. The story is very generic. You are spammed by constant ads. You might luck up and get a legendary champion once and a while but the odds are heavily stacked against you. Very little champ customization, as speed is the only thing that matters.

I enjoyed the game early and had high hopes as the graphics and diverse champions seemed to be something that I would look forward to unlocking. Sadly, there's no way to seek out specific champions, it's all random. The grind is endless. You don't even really play the game but rather auto fight everything or push "replay" so you can grind for coins and exp. I paid a bit in, but was eventually turned off by the constant grinding and bugs on champion skills.

I mean the graphics are amazing. The characters are great but, holy same thing over and over Batman! Doesn't matter whether it's faction, arena, campaign...its just the same thing. A game that can literally play itself. Run forward, kill some enemies three times, done and then eventually run forward, kill some enemies and boss, done.it gets boring fast. Most of the time I just scroll through characters and then quit. This could have been a cool wow-ish or Diablo but for mobile instead.

I had very low expectations for this game (in fact it was only their amusing, well-produced ads that convinced me to even try it), but somehow it still managed to disappoint. Upon starting the game you are dumped into an unskippable cringe-fest of a cutscene. Unskippable! I wish I was making this up. Almost like time-travelling back to the '90s, but not in a good way. I had to bail then before that mess killed off any more of my braincells, but I assume the actual gameplay is just as bad.
