Overall the game is enjoyable. The graphics are stunning and the combat is fluid. But to actually progress/thrive in the game you are stuck behind a number of paywalls. You'll get around 4 "offers" every time you login prompting you to use real money. The only way to get decent rarity champions really is to pay for them. It becomes very obvious who has payed for some of the games "package deals" when you are in the arena. There is no way to combine equipment to a higher tier as a balance

After finally gave it a try, it's becoming my most played game. The gameplay itself is interesting, with the complexity and randomness of the characters, it's just that the AI for autoplays are not that well built hence playing on that mode is quite a challenge. What's more annoying though, is the overwhelming ad on the game starts that together with in-game news produces like 5-6 popups! Not to mention that some extra packages costs as much as two PS4 games! They have one zero too many.

Enjoy playing the game. It has good graphics and is pretty good as a TBS game. I am very much a collector type player and this game has plenty for me. There is a bit of a grind but that's with any game. ISSUES OF NOTE: the sound settings are at max yet I can not here the music very well, also when doing combat replay or multi-battle I lose the combat sounds after 1st run though. I can see I may hit a pay wall but all in all the in game economy is not to bad ( just grinding)

It's a time wasting game like any other on the store. Sure it has pretty graphics, but the gameplay is super repetitive and the updates are lackluster. As always the things you can buy are super not worth it. If you're willing to download the +3gb of data to run the game you'll have more fun than you would just sitting in the bathroom without a phone.

Tons of popup ads for micro transactions and it can feel like pay to progress because of the bonuses. Drop rates could stand to be a bit better given the sheer amount of content there is to play, but overall, the game is enjoyable, animations for some heroes could use more polish, the running animations can look janky, and there is a fair amount of champion customization and stat tuning you can do with different pieces of equipment (which also applies to the drop rate comment).

Beautiful looking game with lots of neat characters. That being said, the only realistic way to get any decent ones is to pay or be the luckiest person on earth. Draw rates seem unreasonably low and anywhere from 2 to 6 pop up adds for the cash shop whenever you go to the main screen just took me out of the game. It's not a bad game, just heavily pay to win focused.

Enjoyed it at first but the cash grab is extensive. The most greedy I've ever seen on ANY game. They want money for xp boosts for what I would call a simple membership, additional money for a battle pass, and an obnoxious amount of ads that you can't turn off. 1 or 2 purchases (aside from the battle pass) are cheap, then they ramp the prices up and there is no turning back. My advice, go play a game with substance and less repetition. Farming Diablo 3 is more enjoyable than this.

Game was okay to play a few months ago, if you can look past the constant prompts to buy packs then you'd probably enjoy the game. How ever with all the recent updates this game is becoming slower and slower to play, by this I mean the spinning circle loading icon. It's become a contender with purchase prompts. Finding it more annoying than enjoyable. And that spinning circle has happen 4 times I've went to battle out of 6, and the time it takes to load in takes longer than the battle itself.

If it wasn't for the intrusive moneybegging on every single login, this would be a 5/5 I would have spent more money in this game without them even. So I began playing this game due to its gameplay style and graphics. And for a good couple months, I was hooked. After a while, however, it became clear that the gameplay mechanics were just as "fixed" as he chat mechanics. (I am unable to end a sentence with an exclamation point as I right this review, for example). But I have just completed my 3 month period, and I have noticed a sudden and significant change in Arena fights. For example, I went into a fight recently against two opponents, on level 50, and one level 60. I went into the fight with 4 characters, two level 60, two level 50, with one of my level 60 characers being a dominant "color" to my enemies, with my other two characters being dominant to their respective targets. Despite these overwhelming odds, I was absolutely dominated. Now keep in mind, my two main level 60 characters are completely maxed with their respective skill upgrades, and basically have four of their 6 armor pieces maxed at level 16 with the other f at twelve. (I wish I could actually type things like the number two, three, four, etc but no matter how I try they come out as random letters, not their proper numbers). I could go on and on about the games various bugs and game imbalances, but I have personally come to the opinion the the answer to these mysteries is simple. Pay money, and you're treated fairly. Avoid paying money and grinding the game with time and effort, and you'll be screwed one way or another. A very hard conclusion to come to. I have played plenty of games where purchasing content came with perks. But this is a game that seemingly, as far as I can tell, allows players to reach a certain point before gradually beginning to squeeze them out of the non-paying portion, and begins to force them into either paying for the game or being dominated by inferior foes.

Also the ability to reverse mix potions would be cool. Frustrated, have loved playing this game. May be time to move on.

The game itself is fine. Looks good and the gameplay is similar to most RPGs in this free 2 play genre. Nothing special but not bad. What is a problem however is how heavy they shove micro transactions into your face. Without fail, every time I went into the main hub I got a banner shoved into my face trying to sell me something. I'm not exaggerating, it happened every time and you gotta open the main hub quite a bit. Can't recommend this unless you can look past really aggressive monetization.

A ripoff. I joined in the recent summoning event where I was supposed to get a second champion in addition to the first for using a sacred shard. I didn't get it. I contacted customer service twice and they tried to tell me I had the wrong shard type (which I didn't) and that I used it before the time limit for the event was up (which I didn't). I have screenshots proving I wasn't too late. BE VERY WARY OF SPENDING MONEY IN THIS GAME BECAUSE CUSTOMER SERVICE WILL NOT HELP YOU. THEY ARE THIEVES!

Newer to the game was going to drop some money on it too as I was getting sucked in and I'm glad i didn't give them a dime. Played daily and then yesterday i try to log in to a ban alert. I opened a ticket trying to find out what happened and rather than restoring my access they rolled my account back 48 hours and i ended up losing 2 epics that i had dumped alot of resources into along with a ton of progress. I wouldn't recommend this game to anyone if this is how they treat their customers

Edit: Came back to try again, it's gotten better, but the monetization when you first load is tiresome and the guild chat doesn't stay for long, so no one sees my messages. Uninstalling again for a while. Not a bad game, but I wouldn't spend money on it. It's pretty much a clone of Summoners War, with both it's game play and summon rates. If you've played SW, their summon rates are absolute garbage. It'll end up being a waste of time and money just like they were. Gotta Pay2Win!

I've been playing video games since pong in the 1970s. The upgrade system for aritifacts/accesories is the dumbest system i have ever seen! It is a complete waste of time. It takes at least 10 minutes to upgrade an artifact to level 16. Just give me a cost and let me move on!!!!! I like the game but things like this are so annoying I am considering quitting.

Wow. Pay to win right when you log in for the first time. I get companies need to make money. But this is not an acceptable model. Cant wait till google ads more filters to the play store. I have no problem dropping money to support a good game but graphics are not the end all be all by far. Who ever came up with this transaction model needs to have an employee review done. This is a failure to understand a target market and also failure to think long term. Customer retention is a thing.

It's very addictive. But the constant freezing or just completely getting out of the game itself is quite irritating as it usually happens in the middle of a battle. An having to get hp% or attack % on a certain level an stage is beyond frustrating. I spent 4 days trying to get 3 start attack boots from stage 6 of the sewers leave.

This is a nice game, actually got me hooked enough to play it every day for over a month now, which is an achievement for a mobile game.  Pace is nice, I don't feel that I need to pay to win (only for energy which is planty at first but then the sudden jump becomes.... well too sudden when you stop having energy).   Probably the only suggestion I have, is to have in the tavern and in the champions screens, ability to sort the Champions by Name, as this will help finding duplicates easier.   Otherwise - awesome game.

It's basic for levels and characters. CP is a joke. The amount of grinding is astronomical, there's no xp valance other than keeping it low. Wayyy too much pushing for their store, not closing 8 boxes just to play. Store is also wayy too overpriced. If you put money into this, I actually feel bad for you and wish you better decision making in the future.

Spent a couple hundred. Stopped playing for a few months and got hacked. Plarium refuses to restore my account unless I can gather my in game name (I don't remember?? You know how many games people play?). I have all the original receipts and email account verification but apparently that's not proof enough. But then again maybe it's a good thing. Raid has thee most predatory monetization model of any game I've played.

When I first came across this game in sponsored YouTube videos, I was hyped to give it a try. But after just one hour of gameplay, I realized that the boring, repetitive and uninspired combat served as a red flag that I should quit playing, as I realized that this was all the game served to you. These greedy devs also use all the psychological tricks to lure you into spending money, and the constant pop-ups are indicative of this. Don't play this, for the sake of your sanity and your wallet.

Been playing loyally for over a year and I will change my review to *3 from *1. They have made changes that allow for better progression. They started listening to their players and have been working to correct a lot of the issues they had. Only drawback is when you log into the game to play, you are bombarded with purchase packs over and over.

The gameplay is fun, But too expensive n too much time spending on heros to get better ones. If u want to get better heros. U need to spend money/be super patience. I hate how it takes so much time to get anything good n dungeons. It took me 20 times to get 1 or 2 different potions OR (NONE AT ALL) to help level up my champions. It's not only the potion either. I get lower ranks can be great champions. But the game gives u a low % to get higher rank champions. I got one epic out of 25 shards.

The rich get richer... Hope you like spending money, on this "free to play" game. Plarium tries to get money out of you at every chance they can. Even their gameplay tutorials are on YouTube or they will use their content creators (as if they weren't already loaded with EXTREMELY hard to get legendary champions) to put out game info. Most game purchases are geared toward them or the rich. ($50.00 to $100.00 quite often) Yes you can play for free...Good luck!!! (Even if you spend 1000's)

It's okay as a free to play player I can't say I've actually enjoyed any other mobile game for this long. I'm 4 months in but the game is starting to break.you can't progress through the bronze arena right now, unless you get lucky with extremely good champions. Once you hit the midway mark everything seems to come to a stop. FYI they've been saying they would fix the arena for months now and most recently they had a patch "dedicated" to fixing it. I'm sure you can guess how that went.

What a lame response to my review. Go play WoW instead (better game). Too much of this game is based on you spending $30-$60 to progress your champions. Too many champions that do not have any worthy skills or enough multiple skills to make any good progress in the game. Even with maxed out champions and artifacts - you get stuck/plateau to no progress in doom tower, clan bosses & dungeons. I have plenty of epic champions but out of 15 of them, only 2-3 are any good. Green shards are useless.

my only issues are: I've done most of the missions and not gotten any credit for it, you almost have to buy stuff just to be able to keep playing, and there is very little instructions or guides ingame to explain things to you, the amount and of grinding you do in comparison to what you get is practically nothing. why do we have to pay to unequip? shards and gems are too hard to get but the graphics are 10/10, the game play is smooth and the variety in characters is great.

Simple combat of "make numbers go higher", not too much in the way of skill-based play. Tries extremely hard to make you buy something within the first hour, and the frequency of the pop-ups made me resent the reasonable need for income. If it were toned down, or at least delayed a while until after I understood the game or had a foothold in it, then I'd be more open to spending money.

One word: Greedy. Right now, the cheapest pack containing a top tier summon item is $24.99. You're only guaranteed a top tier hero every 12 summons, so you could spend almost $300 and never recieve a top tier hero. The prices need to come down or the drop rate increase. I don't have enough space to go into the flaws with the hero fusion mechanic, but its just as bad... maybe worse. Fun game, but the greed has sullied my once glowing opinion of it.

In the 10 mins I was able to play it was a good game. Unfortunately the game is riddled with bugs in various aspects. Firstly the updater and initialising screen will continue to give errors with no way of fixong other than deleting all storage and cache of game and if you are able to get into the game you will find more issues with crashes and loading problems. however, its a fun game, great graphics, semi afk and lots of variety in characters.

This is a good game I really enjoy it. However, when you enter the game you have go the training place to upgrade your character. That do not make any sense at all when you off let's just say for a week within those days the game should level up your character for you. Entering game and leveling them up make no sense. I hope my suggest helps you making the game better. Another suggestion is that make unlimited characters slots because you have grind that will long and have to purchase a slots.

Listen to every other negative review, the game just isn't worth the frustration... and frustration is the one feeling that is guaranteed if you play long at all. The game is measurably worse than when I started playing. This is partly due to Battle Pass being removed and replaced with... actually less than nothing, since a sequel was promised and then cancelled. Customer support is imaginary. They'll sometimes pop up on bad reviews, though. The developers seem to want you to spend obscene amounts of money and hate them at the same time. It's a no thanks from me.

I like the game but after an update a few months ago it's been crashing far too often. Also leveling up and progressing is way too slow. The in game purchases are absurdly expensive for virtually nothing to help you progress. I know you need to profit but this is robbery. If you lower the prices you'll get more purchases and people will progress more, making the game exciting again. UPDATE: I'm on the verge of deleting the game even though I've played for like 5yrs. It crashes way too much.
I really like this game. I don't have to worry about getting attacked while I'm away. It also has really interesting champions and challenging arenas and dungeons to build my fighters.

This is a long term progression game that has potential, but the Gotcha element part of it slows everything down. They added Mythical champions that created a huge power surge. So if you are not a whale you will never get the good gear. All the Content creators get to have fun playing this game from the sponsorships but regular players have to either spend the coin or trade your time. The team that has made this game is amazing, but like I said. As long as money is the goal, is death Of Game.

Good game but so 'heavy' it shouldn't be under a 'mobile' game. Be prepared to invest hours that just gets laggier and laggier. The game gets so heavy it it will unexpectedly crash after some time, if it hasn't caused you to do a complete reboot. This goes for mobile and even on a PC! Lastly, but there is much more,if you say you have a way to turn off ALL of your sales notifications, please test to ensure it works. You can turn off all notifications in settings but their pop-ups are relentless

The game can be quite entertaining. It looks good, but runs horribly and crashes very often. The amount of energy, keys and tokens I've lost because of this so far is staggering. Deducting 2☆ for insane amount of crashes. The amount of nagging and pop-ups in game when you go to the bastion (home) is immense. This is an annoyance, but not a big challenge to click past. And certainly not ruining your progress like all the crashes. Deducting 1☆ for all the nagging for money.

The game itself is great. Your referral stuff is totally broken. I had my husband join through my referral link to download the game. He hit the required level for me to receive things per YOUR rules. He was also supposed to get gifts when he joined. Neither of us have gotten anything. You are either not paying attention to the players, you don't care, or it's a ploy to get more members. I'm dropping my rating until this is fixed. If any current player plans on referring someone, dont.

A year in and I'm still playing. Plarium is a bit mercenary with the pay to win stuff and for someone trying free to play (such as I am), progression is pretty disheartening. Having said that, I still love most of the design for levels and characters. Not a fan of how much of a time sink the game is though. So why 3stars, not 2? It's free and the community is pretty cool.

Game would be 5 stars if artifacts didn't cost so much to upgrade, take off, put on a different character, etc.. also everything costs an arm and a leg. And then if you make a mistake like accidentally clicking get all masteries for a champion they won't give you gems back and reset the masteries. You're stuck with your mistake because there is no safeguard from making those mistakes and let me tell you gems aren't cheap. Plarium is.

Game has potential to be 5*. Two horrible issues are drop rate % and arena power ratings. The drop rates need serious improving. Some quests require getting specific drops and after 50 runs the drop still has not occured. What's the point? Casual gamers lose interest very quickly. Arena power ratings are out of line as well. No way a 20k should lose to a 10k. but I have seen it happen, repeatedly. I personally like the characters and combat system overall but don't have hours each day to play.

After seeing commercials for this on various YouTube channels, I finally decided to give it a try! I was able to log on twice and really enjoyed the experience each time. This game has great possibilities. And I do enjoy playing the game for the most part. Would not suggest getting involved with the game at all now. The quality of play has gone way down and the amount of pay to win items has gone up. It's a clear indication that they do not care about the state of the game and instead choose to try and get more money out of people. Most likely going to stay this way. The game is great, got easy controls, has a good entertaining story and is very enjoyable. However opportunity to get sacred shards and hope to receive legendary champions, legendary items and upgrading is very difficult almost impossible. Game stucks up or sometimes crashes after the battle giving you an option to re-log in or retry. Can't send error reports. Please try to improve the game.

Drop rates are horrible, just like any other gotcha game. Drop rates also seem to decrease for specific items or champions when you need them for challenges or missions. The gameplay itself is fun, but the level of greed, lack of much needed fixes, and obvious disregard for how the playerbase feels about the current state of the game, means this game is not worth the trouble.

I understand you make money from people buying package and such. But when I launch the game and have to close 5 pop up back to back like a virus infected computer. You're asking people to uninstall the app, not buying package. Have a setting so that it only have a red dot notification like the other UI. I can't even rate the game objectively because this is the second time I launch the game.

My advice is if you play (which I don't recommend with the huge PTW aspects of the game, broken systems, etc.), play free. A lot of people, including myself, have had people logging into our accounts and making hundreds of dollars worth of purchases. Save yourself the headache, the game's not worth it.

Very boring. I don't understand how people enjoy this game. It's an endless grind with minimal strategy and tons of ways to pay real money to speed up your progress. Too bad that progress is meaningless. Edit: Nothing makes me feel heard like an irrelevant copy/pasted response. Great job, Plarium. By the way, is it truly possible to get everything for free? I strongly suspect the servers will be shut down long before that could be achieved.

I would say this, the game is a good time killer to say the least. But if you even want to remotely make it further in the game, you're pretty much gonna have to grind EXTREMELY HARD to get your units just barely strong enough to beat campaigns and dungeons, OR spend at least $100 USD and hope to get powerful units. Oh, and arena? 👎👎👎 I've been playing for 3 days, is level 25, and has gotten decent champs... but boy is it TOUGH to make them stronger. Not impossible, but is impossible almost.

good game, gets repetative after a while, like all the likes of that genre. the biggest problem with this game is the luck factor. i spent quite alot of time and effort on this game, got to level 37, and still not a single legendary hero. now, obviously legendary is hard to get, but come on.. i used countless void shards and mystics and the best i got are rares and epic. stamina isnt an issue in the game, you basicly can play all you like. good luck. i gave up.

If your cool with Spending like 500 bucks for top level characters . Then by all means join in for the "fun" For the other 99% of us. That's an absolutely ridiculous price. You could spend thousands in this game and barely get anywhere. It's not really a game for free to play people. Because if you want to get anything you have to play hours and hours a day. Which changes this from a game more into a job or a chore. It's not much fun . If I could post pics I would . I'm otw out . not worth it

How can 4 lvl 30+ people die against 1 lvl 26? All 4 star epic heros even. Its pay to win type of game. Unless you buy their passes and stuff like that you are stuck where you are. I have only played for a month and figured that out. So if you are rich the you will be good at it but if you are average then you wont go far. Not only that but every time you log in so many micro transactions just thrown in your face. Sorry uninstalling.

This game is way too expensive to be a mobile game. They have so many interesting characters but they are either behind a 30-40 dollar paywall or you have to grind for MONTHS to maybe unlock a single legendary character. They also have promo codes but you can only unlock 1 character with the promo codes only ONCE in your whole account because they want you to buy the rest with real money. Drop rates are really bad so you have to keep playing the same levels over and over.

The game is great! Monsters are cool. The artwork is amazing. But...my only grip with this game is the price. Id totally be down to use more money but the market offers are just crazy expensive. If the price of what they sell was half what it is now, it might actually be worth using my money. Great game but market prices kill it. Greed is strong with this one.

Connection issues Been playing for 3 months and had no issues until the most recent server maintenance. Since then I am unable to connect via mobile networks. Plarium support says it's a connection issue on my end despite the ability to still connect with the exact same device over WiFi. If they can take responsibility for their own created issue then I'd give them a much better review as the game play is good and the graphics are some of the best on a mobile platform.

Had to delete my original review, because while I love the look and play of the game. I HATE that I get hit with multiple ingame ads for packages I can buy with actual money. I get it, this isnt new, but its really obnoxious. You think youre done, and BAM! Another reminder that you can spend actual money to get ahead. The main issue is that it happens EVERY SINGLE TIME you log in.

Been playing for a few months the graphics are great.dont like seeing the same character with a different skin on it. Gameplay is nice. But the game is way to exspensive for what you get deal or not. Silver especially. Same with gems and books. 200 to book a legendary. By the time you book level and everything a legendary you can spend up to 500. Also doing auto you should be able to pic if u want to keep leg, rare, or epic and specific stats. not just stars. Same when going threw ur own gear.

It is a really good game, probably the best in its kind. It leaves a bad aftertaste tho. It takes multiple hours a day to do daily stuff. Games i played this long makes me want to purchase stuff to support developers, not with this one. They are trying to maintain a constant tug of war between time players need to complete in game events, and overpriced booster packs. Rely on long term players setting up a third party program to progress while not playing activly. This is deeply needed ingame.

Great game, but pay to play/win. You will never have more than 20 min to 1 hour of play time each day unless you hand over money for energy aka minutes to play. It's sad because most things in this game are gated behind a pay wall including monthly items that you need to get to stay ahead. The energy aka play time should be unlimited or bundled into one of the monthly payment options. Until then do not play this game, just a fast grab for cash and will eventually collapse under its own greed.

New review. New updates have improved the game. Bug fixes, new content etc. Very time consuming, but enjoyable. I still have the one problem that burns my backside. The cash shop prices. There's over 400 champions to collect with skills that require skillbooks to upgrade. They want 25$ for a skillbook, and it takes up to 20ish, depending on how many upgrades that particular char has. Everything in this game is horribly overpriced. I can buy 4 triple A console titles for the cost of a few items.

Not a bad first impression. Not the very best either. Not my usual style kind of artstyle but it does play similarly to other games so gameplay should feel familiar. I'm hoping for more collabs in the future. For now, I'll make good use of this current collab while it's still going

As you load into the game, you are presented with an ambush of promotions, finally after clicking those away you get into the game where you will soon find out that this is exactly what you would expect from a money sink. Auto battles, fights that take way to long to gear up to pass, and even after a while slow leveling. This is 100% pay to win. Upgrades are pay to win, gear is pay to win. Need I say more. Another disappointment. Thanks Rykerr for giving me another disappointing game.

Not sure if there is a point to this game. My player can only get so high(before u have to purchase an item) I've been login in daily(doing all the tasks) and guess what my players r still "weak" at the end of my month it says I finally can get a Legendary player. Smh not to mention all the ads the put in for you to buy their crazy expensive items

Nice graphics you get thrown in to the story without any knowledge and aren't given any explanation wat is happening when you start. Basic tutorial that says you need to grind for stuff and upgrade. Gameplay is like you are just watching them do some basic attacks with some "special"attacks. It feels like the this is the first game of it's kind while it actually isn't. Gets way to over hyped. The reason why people play is advertising. In short good graphics, bad gameplay to avarage, bad story.

It's important to say that I spent a decent chunk of money on this game, JUST to test exactly how good/bad it is if you pay. And there are two MAJOR issues I found. 1st. The amount of pop-up in-app purchases there are on the home pg is gross. Borderline desperation, which makes sense w/ how bad this game is & how much they spend on ads. 2nd. EVEN if you DO pay, you won't get much. Around 40 summons - 0 5 star heroes. And that stingyness is EVERYWHERE in the game. Waste of time. Waste of money.

MONEY MONEY MONEY !! Absolutely the most expensive game I have ever played. Their bundles range from $0.99 - $100... Seems ok at a glance but getting right down to using what you bought is like feeding a one armed bandit... It just NEVER pays out. They even have special events where you can blow a bunch of money on bundles and try to get that special LEGENDARY Champion... 3 words, just 3... NOT GONNA HAPPEN !!! The graphics are not that great, learning how to play it's like walking into a void.

The ads for this game are all over the internet and I fell for that clickbait. I have to say that the animation and graphics in the game are brilliant. Weirdly though the game interface is so cluttered and badly made that it's impossible to click the little X on the top right. Also there is literally no gameplay. It's got basically AFK combat and the whole point is to only pay to upgrade. Would never install again.

Fun Game...When It Works I began playing recently. I found the game to be fun, great graphics, and immersive game play. Then after about two weeks, I began getting random disconnects and log in errors. I am currently using an emulator on my laptop to play the game. I have no issues with the other games I regularly play. It's really disappointing that such a promising game has such questionable support and maintainance. Hopefully they get these issues fixed soon.

As free to play player for almost a year my opinion is, you are able to play without spending money, it's harder, yes, but still, there aren't things in the game that you can't reach if u don't spend, you just have to be patient, I've meet free to play players playing the game 2 years and they are having accounts that most pay to win players wish they had,

I was enjoying the game for a few weeks then my progress was wiped and I tried logging in and it wouldn't allow me. The game itself runs like trash most of the time and the button for chat is right where the X would be to close out of something and I would constantly click into it. I don't care if you fix the game I'm not playing anymore.

Positive: Graphics are great and the game have depth enough to be entertaining. It also combine some of the good stuff made in other games of its kind. Negative: never thought a game could be so grindy. And I like grinding games but the drop rates of good/useful items or heroes are so LOW that the game gets too much repetitive to be fun. All the fun you start having discovering many of the good features of the game become feeling like work. Good if you are unemployed. Also very expensive.

8 to 10 advertisments every time you open the game, no option to turn them off, the only good thing about this game is the artstyle, the rest is just ridiculously money grabbing, the game is just a stat spreadsheet; invest X hours of your life or X amount of money to raise stats by a specific factor, no skill, attention or focus needed. If you like the game for the characters just extract the models from the game and then mod them in a decent game, I personally 3D printed them for DnD.

Will be deleting! Game has good graphics and decent gameplay. But it's nye impossible to get a legendary character without spending exorbitant amounts of money. They want you to spend upwards of $100+ to get a CHANCE at getting a good/cool legendary. Can we acknowledge the ridiculous ancient to void shards percentage rate for acquiring rare, epic, and legendary characters. ITS EXACTLY THE SAME, and it's a scam! Spent money to get nothing out of it! Would not recommend this game to anyone!

Game could be better with more multiplay instead of just 30. Nowadays most games are autoplay for free, not having to pay for it. Shards could be better, the yellow shard should at least guarantee a legend instead of chance for an epic. The annoying part is the events tab where event end, the whole tab is gone. It could at least still be there for players to claim the rewards that might have achieved due to multiplay. Like the tournament tab, where it ended but stays for few days more.

Changing my review due to the smartass response to my previous review, referring to the frequency of the microtransaction ads. I am not a damn idiot. I know full well that I can close the ads if I don't want to take advantage. But when I see the same ad multiple times in one game sitting, and so MANY ads, it makes the game seem more like you're trying to just squeeze money out of us than let us enjoy your game and decide to WANT to spend money on it on its own merits as a good mobile game.

Edited - This game shouldn't just be 5 stars, It is. After redownloading a couple times due to "Connection Issues", I can see this is a game developers put a lot of time and effort it. I really do Enjoy it, Graphics are good, Gameplay is entertaining. Truly a good game,  Sadly there is a lot of Pay to Win content, but it a free game, we shouldnt complain
thinks are too expensive if you spend money. and they try to press on you too much every time you log in to buy over priced products. but fun game in general

Played for 5 months. The game was fun in the beginning, but then the tasks became so repetitive and the level grinding took way too long and tedious. Not worth the time playing on the mobile, maybe if you run it in the background on PC. The clan element is pretty minimal so not much social interaction.

BE ADVISED! This is not a game, this is a money making slot machine, the most PAY2WIN I've tried in 30 years of gaming. There is not even a shade of consistancy regarding it's mechanics. One buff works in one way in one area of the game and in a totally different way in another area and there is no description on it. Every aspect of the game is made to mislead you & make u spend

its just sad that no matter how much effort youll put into them lower star characters will never be good. they're just food for the good ones that everyone uses. Also its barely a game at all. Every single aspect of this game is a paywall you cant do anything without throwing 100s at it and the events are impossible to complete without paying they ask you to do absolutely inhumane amount of grinding in a very limited time. It looks good but there are far better games out there.

Changing my rating because I'm honestly sick of getting bombarded with offers to buy gear and whatnot. There should be a setting to turn those pop up ads off because there are people that don't pay to play. Also the multiplayer options are severely lacking. I'd like to be able to compete with my clan members maybe even possibly trade champions or help each other get better gear. Honestly pretty bored of this game now.

The game is highly addicting, a grind into infinity and beyond. Not sure if I will eventually win or something. Thats possible right? Whatever the case I am hooked and I'm pretty sure that is what they were going for. If you are looking to get legendary characters plan on playing a lot everyday for 2 months then you will possibly get one. I still don't have one and I have 4 accounts and I've been playing for 2 months, but they just upped the summon rate temporarily. Hopefully soon I guess.

Managed to make it to the end of the first battle before I lost interest. Graphics are good, and that's it. Nothing else in this game is unique. All Archer animations are the same, no matter race or rarity. The story is weak and obvious and mundane. The main menu is a copy/paste of every other raid game. There is nothing original in this game. The only good thing is the graphics and that's it, literally nothing else. This game was punched out for money, not passion.

I still say the game is fun - just don't forget what kind of game it is.

This game is greedy, constantly spamming bundles that cost $30. Even on my fav game for 4 years now, I've only spent $14. The game often gets stuck on a loading screen. After getting through that, here comes the $$$ spam. Lastly (I hope), animations are so slow. The 2x makes the characters run faster but that's it. Upgrading weapons is the worst of this. You'd think auto-upg to a certain lvl will shorten time. No, you can play LoL while waiting for the awful animation to cycle through every lvl.

I have spent quite a lot but I always felt that it brought value to the game play. Recently all the content the game has to offer are for money grabbing, not even a decent login reward system, nothing I can do with over 20 legendaries in my storage, no option to extend hero/item storage even if I am willing to pay for it. There are a bunch of problems but I am sure they know about it, I won't be playing till they fix it and hopefully it won't be too late that I completely lose interest

After everything you do you get 500 popups trying to selling you in game stuff. I tried hard to like this game because a friend plays... But the constant popups ruined it. I read the responses from the developer who say "we like to have the ads pop up from time to time". It's constantly. And not just 1 or 2 ads, it's like 5 everytime if leave battle.

Most of the characters are hideous. You don't get a single legendary hero right away. It costs in-game currency (which you'll never have enough of) to unequip armor. When you upgrade armor, there's a chance you fail to do so and just waste resources; it'll say the chances of upgrading are high but then you'll fail six times in a row. One of the worst games I've ever played.

Unable to play the game. I am a massive fan of Gatcha games so I was looking forward to trying out Raid. I finished the download. It connected and I started what seemed to be the introduction to the game. As soon as the team dies I'm met with a scene of the battlefield with the gold in the background. Then iy tries to connect several times but then times out unable to go past this point. I restarted to see if this fixes the issue but was met with the same issue. Any way I can fix this?

Terrible Customer Service. After playing for three weeks I finally linked my game account to Facebook. Which is an achievement within the game. As soon as I did the game completely restarted and I lost everything! At this point I had even spent $17. After requesting support in the app it took DAYS before I recieved a response. Eventually, someone told me what the issue was and that they'd fix it. However, they never did and refuse to respond to my request for an update. After 8 days I gave up...

It's a good game, nice to play when you have other things to do (thank heavens for Auto combat) but some of my biggest frustrations are the hero's. You get a purple shard and I have always gotten a blue hero. When I get the gold shard I always get a purple hero. Whatever calculations you have aren't working really well. Last would be your "incentives" paying $30 just to get nothing.. really? Dont use your money because you aren't going to get any upgrades.

It started off fun, quickly became a greedy company. The absolute #1 reason to stay away from this game is the silver requirement to upgrade gear, because it's not enough to post a price in silver to elevate to each level, it does not convert on one try it takes millions of silver to upgrade a single piece of gear, each champion takes 6 pieces of gear. For 600 champions, just let that sink in for a minute. Shards are absolutely ridiculous. They are greedy and don't care what you think about it.

I don't care about graphics, i want game play. After the update I can't even play the game. Every time I login I'm bombarded with ingame transactions. It's a bit of a hassle to navigate through everything as this is more designed for a pc game than mobile devices. If you want to make a decent mobile game, get some room for fingers to touch the space.

It's a fun game, really, but it is extremely pay to win. The main reason I've been uninstalling it is because I've been stuck at Felwins Gate for A few Months. Plus the champions weapons always clip put of their hands. Edit: another thing I've been noticing is that some of the "events" and such are only for high level players or people who dump cash into the game. Wow, just wow.

I've got mixed emotions. I really love this game alot. Would give it 100 stars! But here recently I've been having alot of issues playing... It keeps freezing and making me log back in alot! I've invested alot of time I mean alot of time and money on this game. And tonight I had problems with a purchase. Please oh please fix the issue. I have way to much invested. And I really love this game.

As much as I enjoy looking af the graphics and enjoy the UI, the game itself is very repetitive. It's the same thing over and over. Not only that, but the pop ups in the game make me not want to play anymore because it's always annoying having them show up when I open the app. Also, I think it's ridiculous how much yall are charging for the things in the shop.

It's a great game, it would be a 5 star rating from me but there are a few major problems. The drop rates on the heroes is horrendous, 100 slot max storage for them and the events are unrealistic, they also priced themselves completely out of the market for my local currency and the special offer spam on log in is a bit of a turnoff, sometimes up to 4 or 5 "offers". I like the game however and have referred friends who are all still playing but also share my feelings about the core problems.

I find the game concept overdone, the tutorial and the mechanics competent, and the trailers hilarious. This is a fine game to play if other things are boring you, a nice thing to do without much thinking, like marathoning law & order. I unfortunately experienced severe lag from the beginning, and this is reflected above, I would have given 4 stars otherwise. Success is not when there is nothing more to add, but nothing more to take away.

So I spent 10 hours now for 3 days, and this game is addictive and in the beginning feels nice, BUT as you level up and complete camping it just gets shallow and automatic, repetitive, no new conten or story, which is a must for RPGs. Second, it is a huge money grab, but you can still free to play and it is not that satisfying, but I will continue to log in for rewards(which was supposed to balance the game, but actually not). I know you won't do anything cause you tasted that sweet money.

They need to add more content and clan wars or something similar to make it more interesting. Spending money on the game doesn't really provide much in rewards. The game is a huge grind/time sink to level up. Graphics are nice and the gameplay is okay. Unless they add more to the game, don't waste your money. Fun to pass some time but no real end game makes for eventual boredom.

Some advice after playing for a long time....don't spend any $ on it and uninstall it the instant you think spending ANYTHING on it will make it more enjoyable. It won't. It's the top grossing game for a reason. Never ending rabbit hole of pop-up promos and "give us more money" events that only the video content creators of the game can reasonably afford.

Game is veeery redundant and bland. Enjoyable the 1st few weeks, after that it's just a waste of time and money. Ads are abundant. whenever starting the game, 4-5 ads will pop up. Support takes forever to respond. The tournaments group system where they change the prizes depending on the account level is reeaaaally unfair. Plus it's really difficult to get a decent champion, taking hundreds of shards, and even after all that, they just give you multiple duplicates of undesirable units.

All in all, this is a very solid game if you're specifically looking for a turn-based dungeon crawler with some PvP capabilities. It is quite a grindy game however, especially to max out your champions. You'll spend hours farming, grinding, and upgrading your gear and heroes between3 campaign difficulties, dungeons, clan bosses, and the arena. The biggest turn off is that while it isn't pay to win, they definitely push the microtransactions and the pop ups are extremely annoying. Overall, 4/5!

Huge game and hugely boring. Its got great graphics. But highly, extremely, unoriginal gameplay. Also every action costs something. Even removing armour costs outrageuous amounts. What made me delete the game is not receiving the reward I was promised from a different game for completing the task of getting a 5* character. I wasted 7 days on this boring game. One plus: there is voice acting and it is really good.

Thank you for responding. I did find an option for your barrage of ads. You know this is a completely one dimensional game, right? Your business model seems to be to suck money out of players, but why make prices prohibitive high? That's just bad business. If I have to pay to have anything good, and I could buy whole actual video games for the price of your "deals", I guess it's time to uninstall this tragic failure of a game.

the game itself is great, so great, but its just like any other mobile games : pay to win. first week u are fun and games, made 4 of my heroes to 4 stars all ascended, it felt good, but when a week ends, so does the double exp bonus, something u probably don't realize was there in first place coz i don't, how to extend it u ask ? $20 for a week, yes a week, for a month its worth $80, u can buy collective of great games on pc with that money. and so much more money for others, so much more.

First the good points. Character designs are amazing. Graphics are very good. Now the bad... drop rates are horrendous. Very pay to win influenced. Been playing for about several months now and not one decent drop. I'm going to uninstall as there are a lot more variety of these types of games. In response to the developer. Yes.. you get 1 blue shard per month which typically results into a 3 star character. Like I said earlier playing for several months and not a single epic.

A waste of time. It takes forever for the screen to load, like the login and events screen. I also had to update after I just downloaded it. Really? I thought I can dive in after the download. Unless there's an event or you spend some money, there's no progress whatsoever after an hour of grinding. There's limited content and the ads always overexaggerate.

It's fun for a few weeks until you realise it's a really grindy game. It takes way too long to level up your heroes and armor under normal circumstances. It's basically a pay to win game if you want to progress further and faster. There are about eight to ten adds as soon as you start the game and more pop up periodically throughout the time you play. The adds are helpful if you want to spend money on this game but they are annoying. Otherwise, this is a fun time wasting game.

Very fun game but extremely money and time intensive. I started playing the game after seeing so many ads and having no mobile games to play. After lots of time and some money invested, plarium continues to add more content that takes a lot of time to keep up with. They compensate the new rewards you get by taking away free login rewards, thus forcing you to play more in order to receive the same (usually less) rewards. Would not recommend starting this game if you haven't played it before.

The game is graphically advanced. This game also takes a lot of patience. There is less possibility of advancing in tournaments and events if you are early in the game. I am 30 days in and I have noticed that the farther you get the easier it gets. Though at the beginning it can be agonizing when you can't get anywhere on these, especially the champion summoning event's. It is possible to play without pay, but you have to be patient, and skip events sometimes if you don't want to pay. Not "FREE"

Ruined by greed and boredom. To start the game will pop up sometimes 3-5 ads for 'limited time resource packs' in a row when you start it up, the gameplay is functionally killed by an autoplay feature that means you can start a level and just put your phone down, and even starting off you can tell the grind is gonna be intense. After playing a while it asks you to rate it. I hit 1 star, and had to go to the store myself to actually review it. Maybe it takes you here automatically if you hit 5.

Well it looks like the glitches got repaired. I have to admit, I was extremely disappointed and without the technical issues would have easily rated this my new favorite Android game. If I don't experience more log-in issues I'm sold! So for now I'll give a cautious 4 stars. ***Recommend you sign up for an account. It is crucial if there are technical issues to retrieve your progress and/or purchases***

It's a fun game but I don't enjoy all the advertisements. it's ok to have them when you first log in but they just pop up randomly. It would be nice if you guys added a more active mode like a chance to dodge attacking enemy if you clicked at the right time or just more then just taping 3 attacks. the game has potential so 4* is what I think.

Been playing a few days.. liked it, so made a couple purchases, as i planned to play a long time. Shortly afterwards I received a message after battling the clan boss that I had no internet connection. I rebooted the game, and could no longer access the game. that was over 12 hours ago! I've uninstalled the app and reinstalled, sent several emails too support a long with screen shots of the error. Support has no replied at all I've seen several reviews on here and Facebook with the same issue

A lot of farming, also I referred a friend but he downloaded it with out the link and clicked the link after installing and never worked I put in a support ticket and they said they couldn't do anything about it. So make sure you click the link to download the game. Anyways probably won't be playing too much longer it was fun for a little wile but a lot of grinding if you enjoy that.

After playing this game for three weeks, I have decided to change my review. The game actually has more depth than it appears, it requires decent level of resources (energy, coin, diamonds, materials etc) management. Energy replenishes quite quickly. As a free to play player, doing all the quests and challenges is a must, they provide decent rewards including energy, summoning shards, coins even diamond.

The game is pretty cool and I appreciate the number of female characters. my issue is that I hate all the pop ups when I load the game. I wish I could turn it off. The grinding can be decent but it takes forever for characters to level up. They payout for leveling up can be disappointing if you don't have a full roster to help with that process.

Feel like Epic Seven does this way better. So, here are some pointers that I think would help: 1. Make obtaining hero crystals a little easier. 2. Give your characters more of a story and voice bites, it makes them feel less like another unit. 3. Make your different modes more than just campaign dressed up as something else. Have a dungeon exploration where you can control where your party goes. There's more but this game is ok, just squandering potential I think.

Game cuts out no matter what connection you have, tried on three different wifi connections and one mobile data. Reloading doesn't help, clearing cache doesn't help, changing connection doesn't help. Storage size is enormous, got to 3.9gb within 30 minutes of installing, most of that time I couldn't do anything because of constantly having to close the game or "re login" which led to an endless cycle of loading and errors. Can't even load enough to contact support. Won't be trying again.

I love the game, but it freezes all the time. Usually when I'm collecting a reward or have just finished a battle, and when that happens I don't get the rewards. I've missed out on energy and coins and other rewards because the game freezes and crashes. Also, recently actually logging into the game has become a problem. I'll have to try 2 or 3 different times until it will actually let me into the game. And no, it's not my internet connection.

Fun game. However I believe the fail rate on improving equipment needs to be taken care of it's a little bit ridiculous, you saw that artifacts take effort. Of course i get that. But what you sell silver for. It would cost 50$ to upgrade one piece of gear from 12-16. Hours and hours and hours of play. To earn a couple million for upgrades. And in 5 minutes its all gone and 99% fails. Thats a bit excessive NOT TO MENTION, the EIGHT pops trying to get me to buy something EVERYTIME you turn it on

A bit too pushy on making me buy stuff, but the game itself is a 10/10. Edit after response: it is not up to you to decide when do I feel the pop ups are too annoying. Whenever I open the game, I need to close 3-4 screens making sure I don't press "buy" by accident. When those "temporary" deals are gone, more will come, it is just a marketing strategy, so don't try to justify it. Still, a good game.

Game is incredibly fun, but the support team sucks for it. It is irritating when you have an issue and submit a ticket, only for it to be played off as a "isolated" issue, and it gets ignored. Other than that, it is fun. Your progression slows quite a bit but you dont HAVE to buy things to continue, just takes a lot of grinding.

Fun game concepts with managing your heros and trying to get better gear ect. The issue is I'm trapped. At this point in the game you can't progress without better gear or heros but they are charging ridiculous amounts for random things, like $15 for a set of items that have random stats, or $30 for a small pack shards that give you random heros at random rarities. It's loot boxes 100%

While I can have fun playing the dungeons and leveling my characters, the constant pop up of ads to buy packs is way over the limit of tolerable, every dev needs to make money, but every time you boot up or finish doing a bunch of quests and come back to the hub, just to be bombarded with around 7 to 9 pop ups to buy packs, sucks the fun out of anything, no real need to be always updated if it's always there, let alone if it's the same offer. The reasoning is just horrible for the overabundance.

So I decided to give the game another shot and honestly it's a fine game, love the design on the characters. However there is room for improvement, and I highly suggest raid so it can make the gameplay more fun and less boring, put live 3d animations on the skill of the characters please!, make it cool, less boring and bland, make the skills have good live animation that makes it look like a movie of some sort, also improve on the skill animation effects they are not that good. Trust me on this

Oooooweeee, so many ads for in-game-items, like a lot. Every single time you log in. Not once a day but every time you open the game. Sometimes all you want to do is a quick in and out to check something, not with this game. I get they want to sell but OMG the pop up ads are a lot, you need to close them before you can start playing. Developer argues that you can dismiss 'em n they stop showing, spoiler alert, they do not stop. Too many ads all day. Takes forever to start playing because ads.

My review was removed for the telling the truth about this game, that its developed to take as much money from you as possible while giving the least amount to its player base as they can. There was no cursing in my original review, it was well thought out and described my specific grievances (no new content, super grindy nature, abysmal rng, constant ad spam when switching screens, events with weak rewards but huge requirements and much more). And yet it was still removed, what a joke.

Started playing just a little after this was released. Have opened hundreds of crystals that had the potential to give me legendary characters, and usually during a period where the chances to obtain one was boosted. I have received 3. Two of them were the same one. All of them useless and thrown into storage. 👎👎 After a short campaign story line this game becomes nothing more than a grinding annoyance. It had so much potential and they failed. Don't waste your money play Black Desert instead

My reviews keep getting removed for some strange reason. The game itself is pretty good, but is managed horribly. Almost nothing is free, or designed to help you progress without trying to get into your pockets. They will pull you in with tons of free energy early on in the game, but once that ends, they will try to get into your wallet. They start out with decently priced offers. Soon enough that gives way to overpriced garbage. You have been warned. No, you really can't get everything as ftp.

Pop Ups are horrible. They are not from time to time they are every time you click back. The advertising is a waste because the x is immediately pushed. I play an awful lot and when I am finally able to get the shards needed to get a legendary character it gives me the same useless characters. I have spent a lot of money on this game just to get the same rare and epic characters. Whenever I do get a legendary they are weak and takes a lot of money to build up. It's like gambling.

I played this game for a while and even spend a decent amount of money, but I had to reluctantly quit because this game's energy system does not allow you to constantly farm without spending a lot of money. Summoners War gives so much free energy and crystals that it allows you to farm runes constantly. You cant do that in raid. After a few hours, you are at a point where you can either do pvp for marginal rewards, pay money for more energy or..... not play. This was a foolish decision, I think because I don't have a problem with spending money occasionally, but I am not going to spend to simply be able to farm equipment, which you really shouldn't have to do, because there are plenty of other games out there which don't force you to pay to simply play a lot.

Guys, you have a good base for your game. The heroes are cool, the gameplay is fun for the most part, etc. However, there are some things that desperately need fixed. For one, stop shoving the buys down our throats. Every time I log in, every I come back to the bastion from a battle, when I go in and out of the tavern! We get it you want us to spend money. I won't buy on principle alone now, and it makes the game unenjoyable. And stop charging silver to switch out artifacts, it's just nonsense.

I like everything about the game except the item upgrading system. It is a total scam, just have a set silver price per level/or a guaranteed limit to attempts and have a set result from the glyphs. There is nothing more frustrating than trying to level up gear starting out with a million silver to find out 25 attempts later you are out of silver with nothing to show for it, or a 5 star glyph that gives the same result as a 1 star

Game starts out awesome, but Plarium is ruining the free-to-play experience with short-term money grabbing over the long-term longevity of the game. Not a good time to get into the game because it is crumbling. Game is fun and addictive at first, but then you invest so much that you feel like you need to keep playing due to the grindy treadmill set in place. Content is overpriced, and they are making in game events with diminished rewards for free to play players to keep up with those who pay to win. Every event is harder to achieve the maximum goal and the rewards are increasingly worse in order to coax you into paying money. Once they hook you, they try to bleed your wallet or make you frustrated with managing your resources to climb in ranking. With little tweaks and less greed, this game can be legendary. They've even introduced "tournaments" which are ways to create bidding wars between players to unlock exclusive content for whoever pays the most money. Dirty, greedy tricks designed to entrap players with "micro" transactions (in quotes because they charge $50 for top-tier shards) of a gambling nature. Corporate bottom line ruining yet another game.

It's a pretty alright game. The characters are decent but some are flat out Worthless for no apparent reason, even their higher tier variants. It takes planning and a bit of understanding of how your characters work to get through harder encounters, sometimes you'll win out of luck rather than skill or any sort of strategy, and "stat numbers" are flat out wrong. One character has a speed stat of 3800 and one has 2750, that lower one attacks first, somehow. But pop up ads SUCK DONKEY WANG. REMOVE

This game does not allow you to log in on certain networks. Certain networks on which everything else works fine this game just won't work. Many people experience this yet the team refuses to admit that this issue exists. "Ohh you've put multiple hours and dollars into this game and can't log in and use is? We don't really care". The in app prices are also absurd! I'm really disappointed!

Really wanted to like this game but it is terribly pay to win/play there is a block in content that requires you to have strong characters which aren't available unless you shell out money. The game design is nice but the pay aspects of the game ruin any chance it had to be great. Don't bother, tons of better games out there that don't buckle and dime you.

Fun game at first, but eventually things start to bog down as you reach higher levels. Due to the way the arena is designed you hit bottlenecks where the only opponents are 3-4 times your power level, meaning that not only can you not maintain standing int he arena, but also that it's essentially impossible to reach higher levels. Once you beat the campaign area, there's not much to do. You can up the difficulty, but the rewards don't really change making the game basically pointless once beat

The game was great. I enjoyed the content. It was very blatantly pay to win but if you played the game you could level and get good champions. With their most recent update it is incredibly discouraging. There are champions, even legendary ones, that unless you spend $30 you won't have the opportunity to get. The last two tiers of shards are a joke with what they offer. The events are redundant and unless you save up you have no chance. I could go on and on...

Im not one to complain, but since the update, i haven't been able to log in at all. I contacted support, almost 3 days ago now, and still don't have a response. Everytime I attempt to log in, I get a relog/support pop-up and have to open the game again. Like a broken record, the pop-up is there to greet me again. All my software is updated and everything cleared....this is mighty annoying. Would be have been a 4 star, but this is goofy.

Nothing about this game is "giving" all it does is take and the most valuable thing it takes is not your money but your time. If you do not spend any money with them you will be left behind and left with some green shards to keep their user base up and going and keep investors and ad revenue high. Why they run "return events" so that all their players can come back and get a free hero then get left behind once again. I've reached level 44, I've tried most of it. Don't waste your time. Trust.

The mechanics is quite nice and the story is decent. Graphics are good and the grind is real. What bothers me are the fact that they advertise this as a game without adds and boy have there ever been a bigger lie.. don't know why they bother though, as the first thing you meet when logging in is 5 or 6 popups with different adverts and/or time-limited offers which you have to go through before you can do anything else. This is made even worse by piping up again after a set amount of time.

Good game for passing time, although there's way too many ads and it takes too much time to view and close all of them, by the time the ads are finished I hardly have time to play the game. Edit: The ads are push notifications and therefor make the game almost unplayable, the best way to display your deals is to make one ad that pops up and tells people to check the current deals, have that under a seperate menu that is easy to access. Not to mention how expensive they are!!!

Edit: the whole point of my review was the annoyance of spending 30 seconds closing all these windows for an on-the-go game. Most devs put up 1-3 ads and then hint the player to check them with red dots (unopened mail) or free offers next to paid offers over 24hs. All I'm saying is to check your competition and listen to your customers... Review: 7 ads before I was able to get to the game... 7 pop up ads and I had played 30 minutes ago... Why have you done this? Is it to recruit more YouTubers?

I tried to enjoy this game, but it's just not worth the time (it's a pure grind based and pay to unlock game). Some characters are cool but why so many reskins? So lame. Drop rates are so terrible and you are spammed constantly while playing in an effort to get you to pay to win. What you win(?) by paying I won't ever know as I already saw everything in this game FTP... it's literally the same thing over and over, just more difficult at higher tiers. Nope, tried it and hard pass.

I liked this game, play every day. I will say that the gaining silver and cost for everything ratio is way off! Everything costs so much! Even unequipping gear cost $200,000!!!! That's nuts cuz gaining silver is so slow!!! Now since the update, I can't even access my game!! Says it can't log in and when I try support, it just won't load.... SMH.... Better fix it fast or I'm out.

I played this game for over a year. While the concept and the graphics are great it is 100% not free to play friendly and if you are not willing to fork over large amounts of money you will never be competitive. Further more the features get added or removed based purely on cash flow. If a popular new feature comes out and that players enjoy but it ends up causing less money to be spent in game they get ride of it. Game has so much potential but it ran but the most greedy company I've seen.

This game is trash i think, because of the way its ran. Yes, thank you, I know there's a time limited offer, please tell me when I go into the cash shop instead of everytime I touch the screen. Played for a long time. Beautiful graphics, but after a while, you just get sick of the the whole "Freemium" grind. I'm not gonna put money into mobile games like this and after seeing about 500k in hard-earned silver melt to nothing with no results trying to upgrade an item one level today, I realized I don't wanna play this anymore. Also the champion management menu is ridiculously laggy.

This game can be addictive and fun to play. Unfortunately, like most ftp games, it's all about the money. The drop rates from shards are a joke, leveling gear is ridiculous and it's basically " sorry about your luck " if some error happens. To truly compete you will end up spending $$, especially since their items are way overpriced. Good luck to you all. God bless,
So far it's kept my interest. Haven't had to pour money in and I'm still advancing.

be very very afraid. I love this game but it is dangerous on so many levels. for me the religious aspect from selling souls to champion design should be concerning for us all. STAY AWAY!

Fun if you are free to play, but you don't get anything very fast without spending money, and the packs are way too expensive for the little you get from them. I bought a few, but didn't get anything special. Been playing for awhile now, and it's getting old. If things don't change soon, I will be out. It would be a good game if you could get more for the price, and if they actually cared about their customers instead of people that are gambling addicts. Get good, or lose customers.

Raising paywall, infinite self advertisements every time you start the game. And good lord, the battles are shallow. I do have to say it's a nice farming game though. Edit : yes, everything can be obtained through low quality grind and deathly boredom, fighting the same bleak enemies over and over. And pricing, except for US of course are purely prohibitive.
