Not pay to win, you are all just spoiled! Lately there's enough free resources each day, for any player to be able to reach any and all areas of the game with no money spent. Youtubers prove that with F2P accountsnall the time. I played the game for over 5 months and achieved A LOT, progressed fast. If they increase automatisation and allow more things to be done over night, I would consider coming back. This way, the hours spent playing to do well interfered with real life too much.

It's just a card game with 3D graphics. Should not be marketed as an open world game. There can be 5 or more full screen ad popups in a row that have to be dismissed to play at all. It's a cash grab and there is nothing here for gamers. Addition: they will not delete your account! Consider blocking them from your linked account. Every response asks for more and more information. Today they demand 3 screenshots of in-game purchases. That's impossible, because I haven't bought anything.

I have decided to change my review, mostly because this game feels like a casino, and it never has any new and good content for people that have been playing for a long time unless they spend a ton of money. The game has basically no possible way for a player to get a legendary hero without spending money, and every single thing costs silver, even taking off armor. Want to upgrade your equipment? Well, that is literally gambling with your silver. TLDR, don't download Raid unless you spend.

I have spent thousands on this game. New update locked me out. Says server isn't working. Raid need to fix this. Years of working and spending money on a game and it's just gone! Cannot even contact support. Isn't it some sort of theft or fraud when you take away stuff that people pay thousands of dollars for? And no, my phone is less than 3 months old, top of the line, have 5g cell service, and over 6 for wifi, it is not on my end, says it's a server issue. Game crashed again, this getn old.

I made no progress in 12 months. They force you to play p vs p in the arena and it's a long tedious battle every time. You can't auto all the time. The difficulty of stages rises at certain hours of the day. The pay to win players have a huge advantage every time. It feels more like a second job just to make progress. It's the same game as summoner's war.

There is absolutely no gameplay. The graphics are PS1 era. Every time I go back to the bastion, there is always a pop up special offer that keeps trying to get me to buy it. The combat system is the most boring thing ever created by mankind and you I don't even need to think about tactics and strategy. You just click a button and the game plays itself for you. Overall, I think think this game is a terrible cash grab and a dump for old PS1 models.

The game is good, but the amount of pop-ups trying to get you to spend money on overpriced items is ridiculous. They have events that require you to do really tedious things which reward you with breadcrumbs. If you play this game on mobile, it's basically going to be a dedicated machine as it takes forever to get through the daily challenges. Farming end-game bosses, you'll end up running the game overnight while you sleep.

Pay to win/play is a model that will fail. Just as our bloated two tier capitalism is no longer fun, and is killing those who can't afford to play the game anymore. Great graphics and what not are cool, but it could be affordable and fair for all, but they chose to leach off the rich and well to do. Not sustainable. Playable sometimes. infinite battle loops, much failure unless you pay for in game boosts... pretty... addictive... bad. Drugs and a smack in the face are healthier.

Raid had amazing graphics, intuitive interface and variety of champions to play with. However I personally play a game for its story and so I am disappointed with how the campaign progresses. I found it difficult to figure how the story is proceeding upon completing each level. This and comparing the gameplay with other korean based games of this genre overall it feels a bit pale.

While the graphics are better than many other mobile games. The 'gacha' system is bland as many of the heroes are just reskins and pallette swaps making them lackluster and not rewarding at all. The gameplay has straightforward 'paper, scissors, rock' and JRPG lite mechanics but this quickly becomes stale as it is the only actual gameplay. The game even reinforces how stale this game will be by offering automated and sped up battles. The advertising is not representing this game well at all!

It's a gatcha game. I understand the p2w aspect, but there is no help if you are f2p. There is no farming champion and the 4 you start with are not that great. The way to get even another 3* is on another level compared to others games of this genre and the grind to get 6* is way slower than other games of this genre. It is better to just play those games as it would be easier to get a decent champion that will help you progress easier and be more worth your time if you are f2p. Also, pop-up ads

Plarium too greedy with game design. Ignores players. Does not reduce time spent in game. Does not give newer players any way to catch up in arena or by offering previous fusions / login champions. This game could be so much better / more fair and fun but they ignore the playerbase and cater only to the whales. Also swapping artifacts off champions is waaaaay too expensive and punishes players for wanting to build and experiment with their champions in different content.

It's a good gameplay but i think the battle scenes are bland and could use some work, like every attack has a camera close up of the hit on the enemy. The characters I've noticed that the form and animations are the same but with different texture's, and i think that in the next update you guys should focus on that and make unique animations for the characters, but anyway I still think this game is great and one of my top 5.

Don't waste your time on this one. There is absolutely no support. They just ride out your "support" tickets until they decide enough time has passed & then close it. I've never once received a response or an inquiry from someone. The game constantly crashes & when it does you lose progress & resources. They are neither recovered nor reimbursed. The icing on this one that makes it truly infuriating however, is that the game can't seem to swap between game screens without bombarding you with ads.

Very bland game that's just about increasing the stats of champions and then doing nothing with them. PvP algorithms are poorly designed to the point you'll hardly ever be given opponents that are near your power level. The only positive this game really has is the character design. Otherwise, there isn't anything the game has to offer.

There are plenty of these collectable hero games, and they all feel like the same game with a different coat of paint. Raid plays well, looks great, has an actual story to it and has some well designed characters. The only thing stopping me from giving it 5 stars is the fact that it's just another coat of paint on the hero collector genre, and despite all I said it still FEELS like another coat of paint. Theres no real way they can improve on this without just making a different game entirely.

Very good game, but the fact that I'm spammed every time I go into the bastion with pop ups that seem to never end, why can't there be a button to turn off those pop ups. I don't wanna buy anymore things as I have bought 1000 energy but since my game lags randomly it will either freeze or move less than a frame a second I'm forced to restart the app to the point where I'm pretty sure I've lost more than 1000 energy. Other than that good game tho definitely a pay to win game with their 99.99deals

Game has a ton of potential but just feels incomplete and is a total cash grab. Pop ups for "Daily deals" spam the home screen for the first minute of gameplay each day and the prices are outrageous. Easily spend $70 dollars on nothing, the chances to pull a legendary is 1% or worse and books are expensive. Don't waste your time.

Played for less than an hour. Came back about 12 hours later and it struggles to sign in saying that i have bad connection? No i dont. Tried every day for a week to get it to work with no luck. I wanted to play but if it keeps having issues like this, and support doesnt help me, then fix it for android users properly. Waste of my time.

If you like building characters and turn-taking combat, this is a fun game. It can get costly if you choose to buy things, but you don't have to buy to enjoy the game. If you want to explore or build worlds, this is not your game. If you want realistic combat styles, this isn't for you. If you want real interactions with your allies, it's not great. The ridiculous (lack of) clothing on female fighters is gross. That's my biggest complaint of the in-game world.

It's a job, not a game. The best thing about Raid is its models and lore. That's it. Otherwise, you're made to spend hours in dungeons and campaigns (and most of the times you don't even get the desired loot) just to level up ONE champion. The shards and their drops rates are a scam. Don't play if you can't put in an ungodly ammount of money just to have "a bigger fish" overtake you in the tournaments. Free2play in this game is worse than a 9 to 5 job.

I really love this game. Above average graphics, fun to play, rpg style, lots of champions to collect, etc. The problem I see is their customer support. They value not their players. Arena is just one occasion, I cant progress because you keep paired with players way too OP for you to handle. I'm in bronze 3-4 and in here you will be paired with players that has 2-4 legendaries with at least 60k power. When you can barely even have 1 or 2 epic champs. Arena seriously needs to be balanced.

This game looks amazing and it really does hook you in the beginning. After you get past the initial excitement and you have played and spent money on this game, you start to realize how little the developers care. Everything the say is coming out never does. I want to like this game, game play and graphics are top notch. If the actually released new content and fixed a lot of issues with pack prices i would give this game 4 to 5 stars. WHERE IS MY BATTLE PASS!?!?!

Wow, it's been awhile since I've stumbled on a gem like this. It has latest gen graphics, an interesting story, and addicting gameplay. Really enjoying myself so far. Edit~ I have been playing for about a month and I gotta say this game lives up to the hype, zero advertisements, it does pop up to suggest pay bundles but none of that is necessary. You can free2play through it, or pay and get through content faster completely your choice. Great job on this one guys.

Paradoxical game mechanics. You need to grind the living daylights out of this game to level up your guys, because that's the only way to get them strong enough for a dungeon, yet you are also limited by how much you can do so. How grind-heavy is the game? It comes with an auto-battle button so you don't actually have to play. Why the limited energy if you need to do it a bazillion times anyway? Stinks of over-monetization. Either increase rewards or ditch the energy system.

You guys started it all along with summoners war. I play four current games just like this. And each one is missing a part that could be improved and make it a much better version of itself. The graphics on this game need to be improved, The style of art could be improved as well as specialty attacks. The big pro you have going is being able to take a low-level character and making it a high rank and game style character with enough effort. The hero roster is very lacking in unique design.

I wouldn't recommend this game to anyone i know. Egregious monetisation schemes suck all the fun out of this game. You get "offers" to buy stuff every 2 seconds and all cost upwards of EUR 30. They are very stingy with "new players" as they don't allow you to redeem promo codes, and when they do, it's only 1 every 24 hours. Additionally, they are very stingy with the chances of summoning champions as I always get blue champions out of purple crystals and even out of yellow crystals (rarest).

This game is all about the money. The first 3 min after logging in are wasted on ads. The content from the ads is very misleading. You pay for a legendary item and you get uncommon. If i wanted that i would use the free characters. The graphics are pretty thats the only good thing about it. $$$$$$ thats all they want with zero content output. Please spend money on a game that really values their players. You work hard for your money, and they are to lazy to even give you what u pay for..

I love this game until the introduction of Dark Knight, in the Arena I am twice as strong than the opponent, but somehow Dark Knight would not lose his energy and killed all my heroes or a lot of times I would be fighting opponents for 2 hours and we still cant beat each other. Whats the fun of that its a waste of my time. Mobile games supposed to be a quick game and moved on to the next.

I played this game for about a week before buying a $4 in game loot pack to give me more play time. Then a big event started where it looked like with a couple small pack purchases I could get my first legendary hero. One step in this large event wasn't revealed until you had spent all your resources on earlier stages. The final step would cost $100 to complete - the classic bait and switch. After getting 2 of 4 purchases refunded by Google, I was banned losing everything! You have been warned!

it's fun but some of the levels are to easy and some of the bosses are way to hard your characters have to be atleast lvl 100-200 to Evan beat a boss it's decent but they have to lower the hardness on the bosses good game I recommend

Would be a 5 star cause this game is very enjoyable, love the characters, and the battles. It's only 1 star cause EVERY single time I log in I have to close almost a dozen pop-ups of them trying to push me into spending real money. It's very annoying. I see the shop, I know where to find this stuff so stop with the pop-ups.

Okay I enjoy playing this game. But I really don't think I will play it if my husband leaves the game. He is experiencing issues with the game he just purchased a new phone and although he has uninstalled it and was doing the updates it is taking to long. And now he cannot get into the classic arena so he is upset. When I tried to get to your bug issue and report to raid support I couldn't even find it. So you have some serious issues going on right now. So you have lost two players.

I want to like this game; it has great graphics and mechanics. But the developers' greed is overwhelming: none of the in game events or tournaments can even be completed without at least a $200 commitment. These events happen weekly. I don't mind spending some in a game i like, but when it's required to just complete content, i tap out. This game could be great, but i won't recommend it to anyone i know in its current state. If you love spending big cash on these games, this one is for you!

Oddly, I've been sticking with and enjoying this game. I'm not hardcore on it or anything, but find it enjoyable. I've considered buying stuff since I like to support things I enjoy, but none of the packs seem worth it in the least. I do see that there will come a point soon where the pay to win cap will kick in. Once you get a handful of four star champions, it's pay to advance from there more or less. It's not a huge deal yet. I do like I can set off a grind of 30 battles and go to bed.

This game has so much potential, but their money hungry and do not care about there players. It's the same events over and over , the points you need to get the rewards get higher and higher, therefor you run out of resources and there hoping you will buy more in order to get the rewards. I saved my resources for the Christmas event, (rip off) only to find out it's only good for pay to win players. I am now looking for a better game to play.

this game is fun in terms of gameplay, but literally EVERYTHING ELSE about the game is horrible. everybody knows it's pay to win, but it's not only that, it's pay to play. if you don't pay for energy every 10 seconds, you have to stop playing so that your energy can regenerate. there's no reason for this game to be free because you pay for EVERYTHING in the game that actually helps you. I would be able to let it go if the price of all the micro transactions were 69.99 CAD for a crapy mobile game

The game itself is good with a variety of units to collect that each play differently making team building fun and the graphics are good for a mobile game. The combat itself is a bit boring but the biggest issue is the constant pop-ups for in-game currency packages. I had, no exagerration, 8 of these in a row when returning to the main village hub once. Expect 2-4 every time you go back through the hub village (i.e. every 10 min of gameplay or less).

Fun game that is played over years and any attempt to force progression requires you to spend. In general it can be played free to play and still have a ton of fun and progress but the developers are predators. They have proven that they can still make money without stooping to new lows but they continue to use scummy tactics and phycological tactics that aren't really required. If you haven't started playing this game steer full clear and don't let anyone you love go near it.

I played the game for 2 months and kept trying to convince myself that i can play without having to spend money but the reality is that all of in-game content is created around the "pay so you can do it" mindset. So after 2 months I am dissapointed and quitting the game because I dont want to spent 35$ just to draw 1 freaking champion that wont make a difference. I DO NOT ADVISE YOU TO PLAY THE GAME. Goodbye

Well it's a fun game and with so much to do it's never boring but unfortunately it constantly freezes which is extremely annoying especially when you pay to play. It freezes in the middle of a battle and you lose all your progress this is especially crappy when you fighting clan bosses. But when you pay for energy and the game's freezing every 6th to 10th try it's almost a waste of time and money.

Galaxy S8+. Game is laggy and freezes. I made plenty of adjustments to internet providers and game settings but still crashes and doesn't register my finger taps often which frustrates me to no end. Game has a ridiculous amount of paid content pop ups every time I log in which get really annoying. I've already submitted an in game ticket but I'm bitter that I spent money on this buggy game. Game looks great but my device just doesn't like it. 😭

Content is everything in a game and Plarium has lost sight of what it takes to keep a great game running and keeping its player base. Updates are minor and designed to appeal only to the highest spenders. So much effort poured into marketing versus development, it appears that the company focus is to lure in as much new players they can giving as little they can to the existing community.

This game is a predatory scam, not a fun RPG. The game is full of pop-ups that bombard you with money offers and deals. The game is designed to make you addicted and spendthrift, so that you will buy more gems and shards. The game is not a fair and balanced game, but a pay-to-win scheme. It is sad because the game has decent graphics and gameplay, but they are overshadowed by this aggressive monetization method. Do not fall for this game’s traps and lies.

Spend weeks developing your characters, gone in one click to add facebook. No palarium id because its never been needed, to bad for you and all that you did. No warning, no option to stop before you delete weeks of effort. On top of the game being filled with literally dozens of pop up ads begging for your money and it's only expansions being more complicated versions of the same game modes, This game does very little to be worth anyones time in the long run this game requires to be enjoyed.

So far, very repetitive. Almost the exact exact same as DC Legends. My real problem is how huge these types of games are. Over 3 GB? For what? There's no maps. There's no open world. Just a small game where you pit two teams against each other, that's it. I played Future Fight for years until I got bored with it. This is just restarting all that over again, not a "new" game. Now, I can't even update it, because it's so big. I'm about to uninstall.

Fun game, requires tactics and skills to build a solid team of champions. Sucks to get stuck with 4 star champions because you dont want to sacrifice your other same star and dont get many chickens unless you buy them. Only annoying thing of this game is the popups for all the packages that are offered. It's frustrating to go back to the bastion and have to click through all of them, every...single...time. Otherwise good game, drew me in after trying to get some emeralds for another game.

It's addicting and fun. Regretfully, I spent probably about $2000. It kept me entertained for probably 1500-2000 hours, so I'm telling myself that I paid a dollar per hour of entertainment (I guess I'm rationalizing). Not that spending that much money should guarantee me instant problem resolution, but the fourth time I filed a complaint regarding a "hiccup" where they got my money and I didn't get the shards or a refund until AFTER a timed event expired, it soured me enough to just quit.

the graphics are pretty decent for a mobile game and the gameplay is more engaging than some games out there, but it really seems like a big cash grab to me. every time you log on they throw offers in your face for "deals" that cost more than id ever like to pay for a mobile game. if you dont empty your pockets for this game prepare to grind the same level hundreds of times .

I have installed the game only 8 days ago and I really liked it. Made a reasonable progress playing it about 6 hours a day. Connected my social media, email to it. However, some error occurred which forced me to log out. Since then, all my progress is lost, upon the start of the game it leads me through the tutorial and there is no way to log in with my old credentials to my first account. Seems I have 2 accounts now on the same device. Don't bother, not planning to waste my time again on this.

I've played this game for over 6 months now, in that time I waited for new content to be released and the only new content was pay to win arena. I continusly find that getting things as a free to play person is near impossible and I've seen the free to play rewards get progressively worse. As this trend continues it does not make sense to continue to play the game. Would not recommend.

Graphics are nice. Unless you spend money, you'll get stuck with no way to level up characters after about 2 weeks. Upgrading relics means battling 15 times. Then I can MAYBE upgrade one piece to level 8 because the developers thought it'd be nifty if upgrading relics would be a gamble. Then there are the multitudes of ways you have to level up characters: Levels, stars, colored stars, abilities, relics, completing sets of relics, etc. Pay to play. That's the only way to enjoy this game.

6 purples on a boosted summon day, and not 1 summoned purple. Never spending money in this game again. Update: Been playing the game for some time now, and it was good up until the last update. I tried using high speed internet, and mobile. It is updating extremely slow 🐌 The game is now unplayable, and I am really tired of the predatory microtransaction ads.

Plarium is greedy with this game. As I'm playing other games and actually grinding xp, Raid has a problem where you can't really devote time, ideally 2 hours for all of the login rewards. But like trying to get a champion to rank 6 when it takes 2 hours to make a rank 3 into rank 4... Well, you get the picture. it's a huge time sink but it's disengaging and not fun to play. The only real way around the time sink is spending a mortgage payment in their store.

There isn't a months worth of growth and gameplay accessible to the average user. All endgame resources locked behind paywalls. The mandatory adds are relentless. Even after spending over 100$ in a week, they keep coming. And their value only gets worse and worse. I'm to the point where legendary characters are all that matters. 30$ for a 6% chance is not remotely worth it. This is not the game you are looking for, move along. Edit: No new content yet. Champ shards are a decent step forward.

Standard gatcha game, with great visuals, but nothing outstanding. Needs some QoL improvements like, the ability to make set teams, 3 would be good but 5 ideal. The "challanges" should recognize when I've done something before I've gotten to that tier of the "challenge". Having to go back and do it again with characters I don't want to use is tedious and unfun. There's more but 500 limit.

At the start it was a good game but now that I have been playing it for two weeks it has started telling me that it needs to be upgraded like every to days this is fustrating to deal with other than that the only other problem is the constant in app perches that thay ask you to do. You are supposed to be able to get your people up to level 60 but to do that you need to bye the in app purchases. Other then that it's a good game love it

Changed a lot since last I played it, but it ain't bad too be honest. Lots of pop ups showing the MTXs of the game but for all intents and purposes, nothing really forcing you to buy them. Game seems to be generous with the rewards and resources it dishes out. However, there is a fair bit of grinding. If that doesn't bother you as a player then you will enjoy this game. Also, really liking the story and design so far. But can't really give it 5 stars just cause of the MTX in the game.

This is a great game! Awesome graphics! I dont see a paywall at the moment. There are a few minor bugs like the crusader running in circles while returning to his place or sprites that doesnt disappear. My only problem with this game is the UNCOMMON 3☆ weapons and armor are so rare. I mean come on guys. Its not RARE its UNCOMMON. You cant even use these late game!

I like the gameplay & the champions on the game. What I hate is how I've been playing for 5 months and still haven't gotten a legendary Champions . Some players get lucky. Others spend money to get them. I put alot of work into this game & receive crappy champions! In all, if you do play this game don't get your hopes up. Set the bar low. Don't expect to get the champions you want even with spending money. A lvl 28 player has 4 Legends Vs me at lvl 45 with 0 Legends! I spent 60+ summoning with 0

Good, now I'm addicted, thank you very much. (Edited) I updated to 4 stars because I also think it's ridiculous to pay silver to remove armor; but, besides that, I would like to defend the game. I'm 37 y/o, I grew up playing games that weren't that easy to beat, I can say I've spent a little more than $25 and not planning to spend more since the game has been giving me rewards everyday. And I also enjoy a game that I won't beat in a week or less, you like that? then pay for your convenience.

I am so sick of seeing so many "influencer" advertisements that I finally downloaded this game, just to review this. This game isn't innovative, it's not amazing, the graphics aren't that great. It really is just another gachapon Skinner-Box with bland fantasy designs tacked on. I will be honest, I didn't play far enough to hit the paywall, but I don't think I needed to.

Well this game has got me hooked!! Its easy to get champions even though its not the ones you want. Progression in the game is quite simple and easy, however if you want to progress faster, you will have to spend some money in the game, but you dont have to if you don't want to. The only small problem I have is the energy. Maybe give bigger energy rewards for completing quests,because this game is addicting and you wanna play for hours but if your energy is done you have to wait a whole day.

The game is fun as hell. Server issues, unending grinding, super super low champion pull rates, and crazy prices if you want to buy make this game not as fun. Most of the game is a cash grab. Rewards in tournaments suck for the resources/time invested, book (upgrading champs) requirements keep going up with new champs, they change things in the game after you invest a ton in champions and screw them, etc. The company does not make things right for THEIR mistakes. DO NOT SPEND! Not ftp friendly.

UDK was designed to try and goad people into spending more $$ by being a frustration for new players in the arena. He is the worst affinity match up for every single starter champion (you know, the ones 99% of new players level / gear first and lean on for all of their progression) and was released in conjunction with a free set of gear that is tailor made to accent his kit making him almost unbeatable. Your response does not address the issue of putting a ridiculous character into the game.

These developers are the scourge of the industry. While they are constantly refining their money machine to require cash for reasonable progress, they lie to us about being unable to do anything about RNG. RNG is an absolutely adjustable set of variables that are well within their control and they use them to keep us from making progress after the point that they can say, "Gotcha!" I'll play but I've stopped paying. When I start dreaming of killing people, I'll stop playing.

Sucks. Way too many characters and variants. Too many micro transactions. Waste of time. (Edit) of course the game rep says its your choice to make purchases. It's 100% their choice to make it so frustrating you want to make those purchases. This game is terrible. Play Summoners War instead. Less in your face in-app store.

Pay to win. It is a gambling game that teases good rewards, but the chance of getting them is crazy limited. I've been playing this game for years and I only have five legendary champions, of which I think 2 were obtained from shards. The others were from giveaway tasks. It's sickening and disheartening to open 40 blue shards and only get 1 or 2 epic champions. Even the higher tier shards will not do anything. Don't play. Don't waste your time.

Was enjoying the game even though it is long and seems impossible. I made alot of in app purchases and would deal with issues receiving my stuff. I'd complain obviously and I've had other issues with the server being slow or kicking me out. I don't know because I'm on android but it's my money if I'm not getting what I pay for I should be able to complain and ask for a refund or give me my purchase in the first place. I e spent thousands on this game and they banned me for asking for 2 refunds.

do not top up! this game has a very low chance to pull decent legendaries. I played this game for almost 1.5 months and even spent money in a game but not a single Legendary champion pulled. I deleted this game today (June 10) estimated top up - $200-350

This is probably the longest time I've played a mobile game. Lost track but it was around 8 months before i stopped playing. I persevered with the frustrations and I did enjoy it. However all the comments I've seen are valid. I also thought the micro transactions were ridiculously overpriced and that events didn't have enough incentive to invest energy into but my biggest gripe was the drop rate. In all the months I played and free Legenday shards I got in the monthly rewards, I never got 1 Leg!

Just a horrible money grab of a game. Asks you to buy things at least 1-2 times every time you load the main area. Game play itself is just bad. Edit: there is a difference between notifying once and just pure money grabbing. This game only wants you to spend your money on it. It asks 1-2 times at least per visit to the MAIN GAME AREA. You can't do anything until you click the smallest x on your screen. Plus there is no game itself. Predatory game, just wanting your bucks.

Exceptionally expensive gatcha game. Good gameplay systems. Variety of challenges. Good graphics, especially for the genre. Free to play experience is great in the beginning amd can get you a nice stable of fun and interesting characters to experiment with, but energy becomes an issue after a while. Not sure that I will ever spend actual money as the system seems to prioritize getting tons of money out of a few folks.

Good game, would be a lot better but keeps freezing up when selecting fights. Has already cost me a few hundred energy and at least one Clan Boss key due to the freeze ups. Still freezing. So far have lost 5 keys for clan boss, 9 arena tokens and over 500 energy for campaigns and dungeons. Very hard to make progress and not feel frustrated when this keeps happening and there has been no apparent progress in fixing it. DO NOT WASTE MONEY ON THIS GAME.

Way too many pushes for micro transactions and they're all super expensive. Literally shoves it down your throat. Any time I finish a mission it has like 4 pop ups to try and get me to buy something... A piece of advice to the game makers. Make the game fun and maybe I'll want to throw money your way cause I appreciate the work put into the product. As of now I don't want to give you my money because you haven't given me a chance to even enjoy the game before asking for it.

Stay away from this game. It is a money scheme. They lure you in with "boosted" drops when summoning, but that is just there to keep you spending more to try and get a decent character. pretty awesome game! I enjoy the variety of characters and styles. the story is cool to. I recommend this game for people who like turn based strategy fighters

Game is okay, you can get decent champions by playing through the game quests, What I didn't like was spending 10 mins declining offer's when I load into the game very annoying. I do understand trying to make a sell but there is players who don't want to spend money on games and that is taking time from actually playing the game. I uninstalled for that very reason

For a Cellphone gacha-pon game, this is excellent. By having two full cutscenes for all the levels it is strides above the stubs of stories I have become accustom to in other games. The visual polish also works greatly in this games favor, the clear art direction, full 3D character models, and lack of glaring glitches show a grate degree of polish. Now only if it didn't have pop-up adds ...

It takes more than very good graphics and sounds to score a great game. It is a good trail before you buy. The gameplay itself is decent enough, I can see why it's popular, but my god does this embody the worst tendencies of mobile gaming monitization. The game is fun enough to keep playing. I had an issue with loading twice now and support to over a week to send an automated message. Then a week later sent generic messages about clearing cache. I tried to like it but I couldn't . I heard RAID from Youtubers advertising it so I checked Google Play and saw no.6 top grossing. I played it for 2 days then uninstalled it then reinstalled it a few days later to give it more time; 2 weeks to be exact. Cleared normal campaign, half way through hard, went in all the dungeons, joined a clan, got bronze 4 pvp, even spent a bit of real money. All in all, still the same feeling I had as the first two days of playing; not liking it. The game gives 2 epic champs with gears in the span of 2 weeks which is relatively long considering how poor the drop rates are for both gears and champs. I've opened a bunch of epic and legendary crystals and nope, no legendary. The drop rates are just HIDEOUS. While there are challenges to farm specific gear, it sure didn't go well. Constant grinding and farming for 2 days and yet, not able to finish the challenge. The game's achievement system is a mess. There are 3 categories: progression, quest, challenges. They are straightforward but extremely repetitive. Progression quests are already repetitive but wait till you get the same thing in challenges after you finished a progression quest and vice versa. It's an infinite loop. Everything about this game is an infinite loop; rise and grind with barely any reward with no direction of where the game is heading. Once the campaign is finished, there's only pvp and guild left and more grinding waiting for you. While reward is little to none, the grinding isn't fun anymore. Nonetheless, the graphics is GREAT and the old school fantasy characteristic of the game is intriguing. Yet, the repetitiveness in the game is a real turn off. I wouldn't recommend it. Oh also, the characters' skills and effects are just the same skills with different colors; it gives no characteristics to the characters.

I am going to be very honest, this is a free game and as expected it has micro-transactions. So do not expect too much from it. That being said this is my pro and con review: [PRO:] -Gorgeous artwork (even if traced from pictures) - Great low-poly models. - The game runs great - Has an auto-play function - The story is not too bad. - Great Voice acting - A lot of free items for new players. [CONS:] - Constant ads for the in-game store, like every time after a fight, which is annoying. -AWFUL stats for rolling, some players score high mobs easily but it seems rigged based on how much you pay. - Insanely high costs for game store-items, and even the lowest cost has now been increased without notice. - When you finish the story and daily missions, it gets boring fast. - You can barely get past rank 2 in arena, unless you pay. - If you check another app while playing, battles may be cancelled. You lose the energy for said battle anyhow. - Storage is limited and cost to much. - Fusing is very rigged and hard to do unless you pay. Summarization: Do not pay for the items, they give little help. Gaining a legendary should be easier. But if you are lucky to roll a purple with a purple crystal, BE HAPPY. I had higher chance gaining purple with the Blue crystal which is odd. THE FORCED ADs for the in-game store should have a option to turn off, or at least show up only once. Worth buying if you can ignore the endless pop-ups which keep showing every minute you exits a fight. Also the multi fight auto thingie is broken and often just show one or two guys when I selected four.

That really is my only complaint, otherwise I love the game.

Shameless cash-grab. You can drop $10-$20 at a time and still find yourself escaping out of several pop-ups in between menus. The amount of money you could spend on this game is simply mind blowing. Either that, or get ready to GRIND FOR YEARS if you have any intention of reaching some form of completion. Which is a shame because it's designed and animated exceptionally well. If it weren't trying to suck money out of you every inch of the way it would actually be worth investing time in.

It's got a 5 star idea on a 1 star platform the gameplay is non-existent but loot and gear sets are cool with infinite combinations but you have to pay for unequipping which is a bogus idea... When you get a better toon cost all your silver to recover decent items also items get consumed in rank upgrades if you don't unequip. If it was a MMORPG open world instead of (Hallway Storyline) it could hold you over till diablo4 comes out

Don't bother! It's not a game it's a casino! They are so money hungry it's disgusting! Spend all day gaining exp and money in battles then go and try to upgrade a weapon and it will take all your coins and if you're lucky it'll upgrade 1 time! I've spent over 1 million coins and couldn't even get to level 10 from level 9! Unbelievably frustrating! The game would be really good if they weren't trying to bleed you dry every step of the way!

This game has so much potential. Amazing character models, graphics, music, and some cool lore potential. But that's where it ends unfortunately. The developers have given up on this game. The only new content are "events" that encourage you to spend more money if you want to compete. It is basically a slot machine grind. That's it. PvP system is broken. New players should give up, because you'll be competing against pro players with Legendary champions at the most basic Bronze stage!

I was excited to play the game. Have made some small purchases. But have to say the packages aren't worth it and very expensive. You'll have to spend thousands and countless hours to really progress and have the legendary characters. Edit: I have now been playing for 80 days straight, and although you get shards during the course of the game, maybe I'm unlucky, but I haven't been able to summon a legendary yet. Which tells you, this is a play to win game.

Unskipable intros are really shity. I cant stand the idea of being forced to do somthing you dont like to then go enjoy yourself. I play games to forget life and its trubles not to do more life stuff in games. Skip intro button? Yes ffs please. Game kinda repeats after a while like most aps in this genre but pretty solid game play and system and dev support.

there are not enough ways in-game to get the higher level shards and thus you are forced to buy them using real money or risk not being equivalent to characters who do. the game play is similar to other gacha-hero type games like Summoner's War, but the art and story is really good. all in all the only way this game is getting 5 stars is if there are more free ways to get sacred and ancient shards since the shards themselves are random and theres no way to actually get the heroes you want.

It's fun to play but I mostly get a kick out of how many characters you can have also the rpg element is a nice finish. Being able to customize the skill-layout is a cool thing, fighting someone with the same character but built differently would be a drive for pvp. The graphics are nice and the battles turn-based with so much to do and areas to fight in. All that and more for a free game you can play whenever. I saw the ads and doubted it only to give in and give it a try..so should you :)

I get it I'm old the days of buying a game and playing it are gone, but when you charge me 10000 of one of the 30 different resources I'm supposed to farm to simply TAKE OFF an item of armor it's just ridiculous. Add the miniscule game loop and you have the human equivalent of one of those fake back packs you put in dogs so they feel like they're doing work. It's a shame because it looks great they just need to actually make a game with it and not a pavlovian slot machine

The servers are down everyday for unpredictable amount of time. Players are given a half an hours notice and no notice at all in most cases. The marketing of p2p offerings is unscrupulous and takes advantage of people's poor understanding of probability. The gameplay seemed promising at first but after a while it becomes evident that it is a slot machine with extra steps. I understand it is a gacha game, but most gachas on the playstore offer a better balance of strategy and luck.

So I've played this game for 7 days. Invited also players in the game. After LVL 21, things get hard. Quests are hard because if you want to finish a quest with 3☆ you must use only 2 champions even if you are allowed to use 4. If you use more then 2, like 3 or 4 and you win the quest, still shows 2☆ instead of 3☆. Drop rates in crystals are kinda repetitive. Many offers but expensive and is annoying sometimes to see them every time you log in several times a day.

Shame on whoever's pricing the in app purchases of this game. There is no way anyone should be paying $100 for anything other than a new phone or a downpayment on a PS5! Every purchase in the game is expensive and then you are not even guaranteed to get your moneys worth. If you are reading this, fix this game or it will be dead in a years time.

I'm pretty close to deleting this game. It's not fun to spend so much time, resources, and even real $$ to not get anything in return. The drop rates for anything good are horrible. The amount of silver to upgrade equipment is horrible, and a gamble. It would at least be tolerable if it was a flat rate. I'm spending millions and still not getting the upgrade successfully. I missed the promo code legendary UDK as well. It sucks to have new player promo codes, but new players aren't made aware.

1) boss battles damage is in "m" and rewards are by "k". It would be helpful if they were recorded both in millions or both in thousands. Consistency 2) Another consistency issue, your algorithm for leveling up weapons is usually good, but sometimes I want to delete the whole thing again when it takes 20 or 50 tries extra to level up item when the last several made the same level with in one or two tries of eachother. Grrrrr. 3) decent armor for the women. Less skin, more cool armor!!

I've been playing for well over a year and I still have not unlocked half of the characters. U can pay to be better for a little while but you can not pay to win. Also with auto battle I can play at work or while I'm sleep definitely a strategy game. NO TWO PPL HAVE THE SAME CHARACTER. Between the gears effects upgrades enchantments reworks skill upgrades soul upgrades mastery's rank asentions... Etc... The strong will survive. The wise will Excell.

Most ambitious game of 2019 indeed...massive drop in quality after the first demo fight. And RPG? Yea right when exactly do you roleplay anything ur leading an army of voiceless missionless characters with a really weird gear system where you have to pay to unequip, pay to upgrade and on the higher upgrades there is a higher and higher chance of failure leading to gold wasted and not leveling up. I forgot to mention that you are constanly slapped in the face by the pay to win. DONT WASTE UR TIME

If I could rate less I would ! poor customer service, I submitted a ticket and the response was can you resubmit a ticket because the ticket you first sent was outdated. Really ! it's your job to respond to the tickets not mine. also don't bother installing this app it doesn't have any in game content for you to enjoy urself without spending money trust me. you won't be able to keep up with events even if you strategize and save up in advance, the bar is set to high and the rewards are trash.

Drop rates are terrible making the game near unplayable or progressable. The prices for the micro transactions are unbelievable, you can buy whole games with the amount you spend. If anyone is reading this don't bother installing, I managed to see through the play on microtransaction addiction before I was too deep. Have read endless threads of people being max level and getting little to no high teir rewards even after spending hundreds of dollars. Don't get sucked in.

This game has good graphics and animation, gameplay is ok. However, it reaches a point where it's frustrating to play, even considering the long-term aspect of the game, simple quests requires so much time only pressing replay and waiting for energy to recharge.

The game is solid, a fair remake of summoners war with a few small tweaks. Graphics are great, and character balance is fair. People who say the drop rate is rigged are completely off, just random chance. But the company is open about their rates so that doesnt bug me, if anything it just helps me save money. The cost to unequip gear is my only issue with the game. I would suggest having a time limit that is required before you remove your gear rather than such extravagant costs. Fun game.

Best marketing team, really good graphic, art and design work, but is not making this game spectacular. Feels like playing open beta, not optimized. Not F2P friendly, when they say "we're trying to keep the balance" between F2P and spenders, they mean that they want you to join the spenders. Nothing wrong about it, but it's too obvious because you're going to spend more time tapping the popup offers than actually play the game by doing daily routine hearing promises for an game-changing update.

Two major downsides to this game. 1) It has a huge time sync. No fast battle system. It can take hours to complete all daily quests. The game can feel very much like a job. 2)Unrewarding. Unless you are extremely lucky be prepared to wait months for any good champions. The cost of items is also extremely high, disincentivizing moderate spending. For example to fully upgrade a legendary champions skills could cost $300+. Just to buy the books for a single champion.

3 days into playtime with this game. so far I am hooked and having a great time with it. the visuals and mechanics are smooth on my samsung galaxy. I was looking g for a good dnd style tactical game to play on the go and this game has definitely hit the spot for that itch. I am very satisfied with it so far and the reward system of acquiring and beefing up so many types of heroes kee0s me lways wanting to keep playing just one more round. I love this game.

While the game itself isn't bad, the staff is unresponsive when presented with an issue. I purchased an item almost two weeks ago using Google Play Points and I never received the item. I have emailed support, provided them with everything they requested. I still do not have a resolution to my issue.

This "game" man. Sucks you in hard in the beginning for sure. Everything goes pretty smooth the first 90 or so days then you start to realize how rigged it all is. I know its a getcha/gotcha(whatever the term is) but plarium take it to the next level. Their package options are insanely overpriced especially when you can spend money on packs and get nothing useful(id say 80% of the time). Just know going in that unless you got deep pockets this game starts to suck fast.

I'm playing bored playing auto to build my crews skills. Should be easier to develop defense and attacks! No masteries and haven't seen how yet. Think everything is on relentless play but the characters powers are boring doing same thing over and over. No chance to change have one team member just heal everyone while the rest fight. To build more than 5 at a time is way too time consuming when I should be enjoying th story instead of getting my tail kicked because skill levels aren't easily lrnt

Huge pay to win game. Not only in getting good heros but also just to finish events you either have to spend 6 hours a day or more on the game in a constant grind or pay out hundereds of dollars. Events could be fixed easily by scaling them back but that doesnt make them money, so instead they rather ruin a potentially good game and drive away its player base to comform to pay to win players. Good game if you got tons of money to waste 👎

The Game seems solid, but holy cow! I must have seen adds so many times (been asked to make a purchase) in the short time I'v been playing, roughly the span of 4 hours. I kid-you-not If I had agreed to all of them, it would have been well over $300 USD. You remove these and I'll give you the 5th star - keep it up and I'll take one away.

The game is good... lots of potential. Would it be possible to have a create character option with a list of looks and skills to choose from? You could have the existing characters looks and skills available in a dropdown list and players could create there progress tree.. It would give a player more ownership. I would like to make a Druid character something nature based. Thanks

The game can be fun but for any chance to compete you have to play on desktop or laptop. Mobile only players can't compete at top levels. Event and Tournament milestones have gotten ridiculously high because non-mobile players have the ability to use auto-clickers and other resources not available to mobile only users. You can spend $500/month on the game and you still won't be able to overcome the disadvantage as a mobile only player. Unless your not exclusively mobile, I wouldn't recommend it.

It was fun at first but then i realized that i didnt like at least 10 pop ups telling me to spend 20 dollars everytime i opened the game/returned from campaign. Graphics are nice but that doesn't make up for the amount of failures.The storie is a small cutscene in the beginning and end of each campaign area and there is no in game way to talk to the nonexistent npcs. The arena is lackluster and isn't as multiplayer as they claim.

This game is a good game, but they currently have a problem with their servers (for over a month and a half now) where the game freezes and you lose energy, boss keys, shards (to summon heroes), basically what ever you are using when the game freezes. I have lost over a thousand energy, 5+ boss keys and a few of the rarer shards (ancient shards). Submit a ticket and they give an auto response telling you to try an emulator or another device. They dont reimburse for lost items. Fix it.

Slow. I couldn't even get past the tutorial because the app kept freezing up and crashing, contacted support but they basically just told me to do the same things I had already tried. If the dev's can fix the bugs in this game I would download again because it looks interesting, just not worth all the hassles. *edit 10/19 BE WARNED CUSTOMER SUPPORT WILL NOT HELP WITH ANYTHING IN THIS GAME!!! THEY REFUSE TO DO ANYTHING AND TREAT YOU BADLY WHILE THEY'RE AT IT! DELETING THIS TRASH!

First, I'd like to say that it's a great game, with a good story, as well as game design, and that's why I give it five stars, although I a problem with it. As I don't have a Facebook account, nor a Plarium account, I wasn't able to continue playing the game. I tried to create an account at the Plarium website but it was very difficult to find the registration area, even now I'm not sure if I really found it or if just registered in the Platinum's forum.

Kind of disappointed. A lot of things I loved and the game as a game is pretty good but the pay to win aspect is brutal. The constant ads in game to buy shards and other items to advance you is relentless. They always respond with "well if you play enough you can advance without money" I calculated my play time and spending for what I put in and what I got out of it is upsetting. Save your time & money and spend it on console or PC games.

enjoy the game haven't spent any money on it yet. so that is probably the reason why I'm not that far in the game. but I wish the loading screens loaded faster and that you add speed up times 3 or like the name says and a raid pass. even if you have to or want to make it a sold content. but love the idea of the game and pretty much everything else.

Okay, so I'm biased because I'm not fond of turn-based RPG, but this game is particularly bad because of the in-app purchases. Every time I open this stupid game I have to close not one, but 10 (I counted) windows with in-app purchase offers. That's shameful. No amount of story line (which seems to be lacking anyway) can make up for that.

a lot of grinding in this game. they keep doing the same events. 3 or 4 days ago they did a summoning tournament, tomorrow they are having a summoning event. I haven't seen an artifact upgrade event for a while. seems like they dont consider players who dont pay to play. it take a good bit of time to acquire enough of what you need to get anything decent out of the events. other than that it has a lot happening. a lot of cool characters and they are always working on more.

2 stars. While the game is fun and can be free to play, I feel like there are some predatory sales tactics being used in game to get you to spend your money. There is no standardized offering of packs. What might cost you $50-100USD for something could cost the next person $30-75USD. For the EXACT same thing. This is wrong and no game who does this is worthy of 5 stars. I dont care if it's the best game. Heed what they'll tell you when you submit a ticket, "your choice to buy or not".

it's a fun turn based game. solid mechanics that make grinding feel fun. however spending money on this game isn't worth it. they doubled the chance to get epic and legendary heroes from void shards recently, I bought six and didn't get one good champion. not one. what's the point of a 30 dollar pack if it doesn't help you progress. I'm very hesitant to buy anything else because of this.

Fun game, but... there's too many ads to try and get you spending money. My record so far is having to close out TEN ads back to back. I'd close one, and the next would open. It varies from 1-10 ads any time you go to the bastion area, though usually it's 2-4. It's super annoying and makes me think it's HEAVILY pay to win later on. The game itself is fun for a clicker though, so I'll still give it 3 stars.

Decent game plagued by insane prices for a summon. Most packages are 30 dollars to.... 50 with the best items held behind bigger paywalls. Do not play this game if you plan to go F2P. You will not be able to scrape by. I regret playing this game for the short 2 weeks I have. I have spent too much for a game this small and still am not even far along! Shame.

Starting off I had a blast. After a couple of months it becomes very pay to play. On top of that the prices for things are way overpriced to even think about buying. Get ready to start the game and legit 5 ads to click through every single time. Sad, because I really do love these type of games.

This game is extremely boring and repetitive. It is 100% play to win game. If you don't spend money, it takes hours upon hours of game play to level up characters. God luck getting legendary heroes without spending any money. Every time you log in, you get a load of pop-ups designed to get you to spend a ridiculous amount of money for no real benefit. If you buy legendary shards, your chances are less than 1% to get a legendary hero. Overall, the game is not balanced between and boring.

Possibly the most fun game I've played in years. Raid: Shadow Legends has a fairly decent story line for those who care, but it's the number of different champions, artifacts and accessories that give it such a unique game experience for the individual player (of which there are literally millions). Thanks Plarium, you got me hooked over 2 years ago and I am still a happy player 😀

Don't download this game, after 3 days you will run out of coins to level up your champions, plus everytime you get on the game you will be faced with 10 ads to buy things in the game to keep playing. If you are a pay to play gamer this game is perfect for you, if you are a free to play gamer save your time and don't download for free player you get 1 lengendy champion a month like come on...

typical game of it's type. enjoying it so far, easy to navigate. only playing a couple of days, waiting to see how it developes before I go 5 star UPDATE: I've been playing for a little over 3 months and my attitude toward the game has done a 180. I like a game where you can be competitive without dropping a lot of cash... well not this game. 1 legendary card in 3 months, the latest addition is impossible to do with their current storage limits on equipment and characters. Game support is a joke!

A great game with beautiful graphics. I was hooked from the start. However, the recent refer a friend update doesn't allow you to use it if your friend is already playing the game. I referred my friend (who's now lvl 30+) to this game way before it existed and it seems now I won't get rewarded. It's a minor frustration on my part but I'm still digging the game.

it's an amazing game. I've had 4 accounts and each one different than the last and this game keeps coming up with new things. gems are easy to get and recycled for getting your accounts stronger. energy is no problem in this game even if you run out you always have energy no matter what. silver in the game is easy to get but your always spending more and more for better characters, armor, and more things. this game itself is a gem it's one of the best games I've ever played.

I installed this just to write a review. I'll never open your game. Stop spamming my life with your adverts. The game looks awful and ptw. Even if it isnt. Your pr makes me want to gag. Please just stop advertising this trash. I wish there was a block certain things from being advertised. Funny thing is, if I had stumbled across this on the store. I most likely would have given it a go. Please please please stop the adverts. EDIT To response; what about this game do you think is "Unique" lol

RAID: Shadow Legends is a complete and utter failure as a PLAYABLE game BUT more than succeeds (quite well I might add) at being a business oriented game. The game itself is an interesting and enjoyable concept with roots that could be traced to something akin to Final Fantasy Tactics but where the game fails is with its microtransaction oriented business model. There is a steep curve in price as you play the game- they even go so far as to make you pay to REMOVE gear from champions. Just awful.

Would be 4 stars but ads are CONSTANT. Every time you change screens or do anything a new micro transaction ad pops up. The game itself is alright but it's hard to get to a point where there's depth that isn't ruled by low probability gachas or random draw purchases. You have to pay $ if you want a decent hero. All in all it's on par but far from exceptional for this genre. Lose the ads and gunk all over begging for $ and I'll play.

So, after 2.5 months of this game... I have an unauthorized purchase on my account, the rng of the game has drooped a lot, and the events are geared to paying players. (If you pay up, you can win!) It starts out real nice but falls way short after the first 3 weeks as you get pay gated into buying packs to progress of hope and pray that the golden shard you just got will give you something better than the uncommon you all ready have.   A lot of the Legendary champions are worse than a bunch of the rares in the game. This is bad design. 1 Last point, the events are worse now as well. Back in April, a 5* epic piece of gear was worth 30 points in the event. Now its 22 points. All in all, I know my opinion will not change anything. And disputing a charge will get my account banned. (They do it all the time)

this feels to me like baseline mobile RPG game. like WOW it does nothing new but everything right. it also suffers from massive feature creep. the new player experience involves an absolute buttload of reading and tutorial on new types of content.. but how the content plays into the base game is unclear at first. also I'm just generally not a fan of games that have energy mechanisms to milk wales. but definitely a fun game if you are into old style final fantasy type combat.

It's alright, could be better without such an extreme "pay me!!!" mindset from the owners *edit Except the majority of your "cool rewards for quests, events, missions, and challenges" tend to be impossible to get unless you are paying money to access the event rewards. Even playing more than 14 hours a day for a week I was unable to get high enough in the events and challenges to actually get the high tier rewards. Any of your "summoning events" are impossible without paying for shards.

Great game time and ptw elements are here it's a grind feels actually a lot of fun you can also learn the premium currency so even though the game begs you for money there's never actually a point where you have to spend it after still in a couple dollars at the developers just because I've spent so much time in the game and I was able to get a fair bit out

Very fair and balanced game. Will add one more star for fun I had watching 13 minutes of arena battle where 3 heroes were not able to defeat 1 (and, finally, died). No sarcasm - I had lots of laughs. Update: Thank you for the reply. I found it even more interesting, fun and eye opening about the game than situation I described above. So it is OK, when 3 chars with max lvl and upgraded skills and arts are not able to defeat 1 enemy lower lvl. Sounds reasonable for me 😀

Real fun. I'm about 10 levels in and just got my first epic rarity summon. I'm enjoying the gameplay and abilities alike, but I'm worried there isn't much opportunity to earn higher summon Crystals, like the void and sacred, even ancient are elusive, going down the line they seem to throw a lot of the real basic 'common' Crystals at you instead. It's possible that I just don't have those opportunities being a low level, but I've been searchingand have yet to find how I'm supposedtoget these w/o $

This would be a five star game, except that it freezes all the time, losing your progress in a battle, requiring a restart of the game, and subjecting you to another barrage of ads when you return. And this is far from a new problem, so I assume the developers can't fix it or don't make it a priority. Either way, I'm not going to keep having my time wasted. To illustrate, this has probably happened 8 or ten times today alone. Would be a good game otherwise, but not worth this.

Started playing as part of a promotion for another game, was enjoying it and considering continuing to play, when I realized that to finish the promotion I'd either have to badger 4 other people into playing to lvl 50 or spend $170 on the materials. If something wants that much pay to win right out of the gate I'm not wasting any time on it.

The game as a whole is really good, especially compared to most mobile games. However, this game does have some very hefty micro transactions, and while yes, you can go without them, the grind can be a bit tedious after awhile. I think if they decreased the prices, they'd end up earning more due to more people buying in-game items. I wouldn't mind spending 20-30 for a sacred shard, but the chance for a legendary should be higher. Overall, a fun, stunning game, but the MTs need to be adjusted. <3

This game keeps getting worst. The gameplay is good, the art is great and new content just keeps comming. HOWEVER the company is making the game harder for players - rewards are being removed (or made harder to get), new content is removing old (and wanted) rewards, payed packs are getting more expensive (and the exchange rates are robbery - today same pack had a 8 euro difference from usd). Unfortunately the developers want to take more and give less... and less.. and less...

Plariums idea of "new content" is just another offer to buy shard packs that will result in crappy champs. Or a version of an existing area of the game with a new name on it. Was happy at first, but the game is a money grab and even if you do spend, you aren't likely going to get the good champs.

This is not so free unless you want to put lots of money and time to advance in the game. No wonder they pay YouTube content creators to promote this game. There are more simple pay to play games that aren't so demanding in content too. After week of I'm done! If you want to use your money and time play subscription-based MMO on your computer instead. The game is paid to advance there is no balance in the game. Paid to advance or free you fall behind. It's that simple!

Great depth of Champs and good graphics! There's far too many pop ups and there server is garbage. I play multiple accounts. That makes things terrible when you have repeated crashes! I have invested time and money on this game for about 6mnths! I have become so frustrated that I decided to leave a review before finding a new game.....

Could be a good game, but... Books are vital to most champs yet have no way to reliably obtain aside from $. Silver in the game is overly difficult to get in the amounts needed considering it costs silver to un-equip an item (yes UN-equip) and the arena is a travesty for new players. I've literally found content creator's that say it is harder to get into silver tier than to stay in platinum. And if you are reading this thinking you just will not do PvP... it's required for progression.

Can't play the game as it takes up every bit of space on my phone until it no longer works. It doesn't tell you it takes multiple gigs of space after installing. It NEVER stops downloading things. Waste of time and I deleted all my other games to try this just to not be able to play. Stop lying about how big the game is.

The game is not bad, graphics and controls easy enough. A little repetitive in the different mades, but that's ok. Biggest problem is the constant server down time. I am booted multiple times a day for either connection errors or maintenance. While I understand this is important for updates, it certainly diminishes the quality of the experience. Players should be told in advance when this will happen, and it should happen at off peak hours.

upon opening this game after download I was flooded with constant error notifications: "Unable to connect to server" or "Cannot connect to internet". I have done everything I can think of, i rebooted my device, uninstall/reinstall, cleared my cache, restarted my internet. Nothing I have done seems to be working. My guess is its a software problem on the developer side. Fix this problem, give people a chance to play.

It's a casual fun but still manages to have competitive moments. There is an element of excitement and always something to gain. I enjoy playing this game also because of the great graphics and awsome characters. It's a fair game and it let's you buy things without letting you pay to win. This is by far one of my favorite games I've played in years. I dont normally mobile game but now I do.

Played for a couple weeks. Was having a great time but I can't get over how many ads there are in this game. Seriously... it's A LOT. At first I didn't mind but a couple weeks in I shouldn't have to click through 7 different ads to start and another two every so often after exiting the tavern or coming back from campaign/dungeon.

The game is fun. The only problem I've seen is how the player is introduced to the game. The tutorial is drug out and forces the player to use items that they might not want to use. It is invasive and controlling and needs to be stepped back. The tutorial can suggest things in game, but forcing a player to do specific things isn't helpful, its infuriating

impact animation feels cheap - somewhere between the hit and sound effect, it doesnt FEEL believable. champion index is so poor. common sense to put the names under the portraits rather than their roles if you could only put a single text. transition animation between segments in a stage needs more work. champions running to hit an enemy look dumb and cheap especially if they need to run far. they should dash towards their target, and atk death animation, varied equipment builds are good

F2P player. Collect, upgrade, battle, progress; rinse & repeat. Very grindy but beautifully designed. Price of in-game transactions is absurd. Energy pool increases as you level up but is quickly expended as you attempt higher level campaigns and dungeons. This limits engagement time overall and feels like it could be better tuned. Regenerative resources for special games modes (arena, clan boss, faction wars) feel better tuned. Overall, a great game for short periods of time.

The game seems stacked against you if you don't spend money, yes I do when I can afford it. The arena is hard for new starters and impossible in tag teams. There needs to be balance in the arena. Especially the tag team. The campaign is fun along with the dungeons. I just wish it wasn't so expensive to change armor. This makes it hard to get the right artifacts for each character, I like the artifact progression, though., sometimes you can get to level 16 or 12 economically.

It's a fun game but the grind is brutal. And if you think about buying resources to make the grind a bit less brutal , prepare to spend OUTRAGEOUSLY exorbitant prices, the highest of any game i have ever played by far. These are not microtransactions, these are arm and a leg prices. And they shove forced pop ups onto you constantly with eye wateringly expensive offers.

Good with the bad. the ads are extremley annoying every single time i open the game. I dont want ridiculous priced items thrown in my face every single time. Somone told me "well its either that or ads from other companies" and i call BS on that. If you don't, that armor is sacrificed with the character. If you sell upgraded armor, do you think you get upgraded prices? I didn't actually check, but even if you make more, it's nothing close to what you put into it. Look, you can play for free, but you will never really be competitive unless you spend money. When you log in to play you often get hit with around 6 pop up ads for in game purchases (I think 1 or 2 would do) also some game characters need balancing out - when 90%of teams (1 4 character team or 3 4 character teams) are running the same 2-3 characters it would seem a bit unbalanced . Great game and a good time killer! But there is an issue with the store I believe. I don't know if it takes awhile and I didn't read or it's a straight up bug. Love the graphics, but really hard to progress without paying money. I keep getting beat in the classic arena by people who have far less upgraded characters and way less team power. Raid is a weird game cause I don't think I'd actively recommend it to most. It's extremely grindy, to the point of being unbearable. And it feels like it's that way just to get your money. Updated to 4 stars on 5-10-19 due to support feedback. Thanks for the response! Update: 5-9-19 The email I received from tech support was useless; however, the game seems to be working fine now. Lost interest mid way...many characters (as advertised but not easy to draw them either...) :/ Takes a long time before you can actually a decent unit to try around for different tactics but meh... The developers cannot get even the most basic elements of the game to work consistently. New content is virtually non-existent and when it comes out it is buggy and underwhelming. Unfortunate as the game itself is brilliantly designed but the amount of simple things that go wrong is just phenomenal.

pop ups are annoying as hell. after closing one another one pops up. it's close to being a pop up simulator. graphics are great considering this is on mobile. game itself is okay but there is almost no way for you to get better heroes if you don't purchase with money. things get stale after a while, especially if you can't get better heroes. the only epic hero i got was from the attendance reward. lol

Like a minority of people, we are offered promotions from games we play. At first, this game seems like it has plenty of systems and content - which it does. In our haste, we spend a substantial amount of money only to discover that we did not do it right. RIP 60$+ on a game I am not committed to.

Waaaaay too much pressure to pay in this game. Every time you open the game you are bombarded with prompts to buy packs of 30-50 dollars. The game is fun but there is always the reminder to pay, which makes any progress in the game feel pointless Edit: would be very encouraged to see a "do not show again today" checkbox for sales

Unless you are willing to spend hundreds or even thousands of dollars on the store, the game has hit a serious decline. The arena is so full of accounts that no longer play. My review stands, you havent fixed the problem...

Great game. Love the strategy involved with trying to make the perfect team with perfect artifacts. The only reason I'm not giving it 5 stars is because I'm tired of seeing the "deals" everytime I log in. And you can't say your deals are time sensitive. I'm level 43 and still get a popup for the starter pack.

I like the game its just that two parts of it ruin the fun of the game like removing and upgrading gear doesn't make any amount of sense to me having to pay to remove gear is weird and upgrading it is up to chance and just waist all my silver that frustraits me but if thats fixed I will love the game even more so please just change those two thing. Overall a good game would recommend to others. ( Edit) - I've been playing for a while now I know the games is frustrating but has so much to offer.

Overall, I like the game. Are there things that I would change? Sure. I love some parts of it. But you can play for free. If smart and persistent, you can compete with the whales. It works for me flawlessly for the most part. I have enjoyed myself a lot. It's a good game. You aren't raided by whales and left to rebuild until the next whale steamrolls you. You can play your game at your pace. Can't beat that.

The game is enjoyable. It would be nice if you could speed the battles up. If you are doing the 30 auto battles expect to spend 30 minutes plus just sitting there because it will pause if you do anything, or I'd the screen times out. I'm around day 35. My chief complaint is how much they push buying stuff. Every time you get on you are blasted by MANY popups with offers to buy something.

It was cool but It won't let me upgrade to level 6 star. It says I don't have the champions or chickens but I have both, all the slots are locked and can't sacrifice anything. It would be a better rating if a legendary actually got you a legendary character.

Great game to play. Some bosses are tough and all. 3 stars cause its expensive to do anything and other games are cheaper and make it where you want to buy them. 29 bucks for a shard and coin isn't very enticing. And finding part shards should be more. Or even a little easier on ascending or what not. Just hard to get stuff done and they want you to spend an arm and leg

This game is no fun after like a week when you realize just how much you're going to have to grind levels you've already played a thousand times just to build up a decently leveled group of warriors. They constantly taunt you with pay to win to make the grind seem unnecessary. I wouldn't mind putting actual money into the game if the game itself was worth a cent. The gameplay is so boring. It doesn't even try to be different from all the other gotcha games out there.

Great game so far. I've been playing for 7 days now. Highly addictive! My biggest gripe are the nonstop ads! Edit: dismissing notifications does NOT stop the ads. I have all notifications turned off and the ads still assault me. Also, all skill upgrades work additively *except* for healing skill upgrades which work multiplicatively, making them useless. This needs to be addressed or descriptions updated. Wasted 11 rare books last night on an issue brought up since March.

In June 2019 I reviewed this game commenting how tedious is to just do the same battles over and over without the option to skip, even if you have finished that level with 3 stars, this could make this game perfect, I currently waste on average 18 seconds per battle just to train one lousy character, 100 characters 40 to 50 levels each, it just makes me hate this game mechanics, if you have a job or a life you cannot get very far ahead.

Game has good graphics, good story line, and all around good game. Down side is not very free to play friendly as far as completing events and tournaments.
