Battle pass has been pushed back several times and no one knows if it's coming back. Support does not respond when you use the in game opt

Cash grab. Every time you go back to city mode. In game ads buy buy buy!!!. PvP is pure pay to win. Limited stamina system. Big turn off when a free game keeps asking you to buy stuff. Lastly. To take gear/aka artifacts off hero it cost in game currency that gets costly based on rarity of gear. Another currency sink that is a cash grab in the games favor. I spent nothing and just uninstalled.

This is more like advertisement simulator. I feel like I can't do anything without having at least 10 ads shoved in my face. Bunch of ads to start the game, more ads when I go back to the basion, more ads after a few runs of anything, ads ads ads. This game has potential but the ads make this game tacky and trash. If I want to check out what you have to offer for real money then I'll look at the store. I've stopped playing this trash until the ads are gone.

I've enjoyed the game still play daily. I have to drop my review 2 stars though. 1 for the price increase for EVERYTHING as you progress, And 1 for lack of making old champs useful as you claimed you do. I have to constantly delete the app and then re-download it because it won't let me log in. It is a decent time spender. I put some cash into getting my hands on heroes to play. I must remark that I enjoy the blending of fantasy armor and more realistic armors. every character looks rather unique enough, there are a few that use the same body models. but that's fine, they still look good.

Lost one month of my life I will never get back. The game is a lottery system, you literally could spend $200 and walk away with nothing useful. The concept of the arena is good and you have to build out the heroes skillfully to be successful. The problem however is the pricing on packages is outrageous. $40 usd for a gear set and when you purchase it, there is a very high chance none of it is usable, they hide the stats so you have to gamble. I deleted the game, nice concept though.

good game but not 5* until the skip battle feature is added, grinding takes too much. *add after reply. thanks for your response, however my phone battery does not agree with that, and the limited time i dedicate to the game shouldn't be spent grinding, which is, as you said, tedious. the game crashes sometimes, in specific timings like when you open the game it won't completely load, when you are playing multi-battles it will hang in between battles, also occuring when you are just having 1 battle.. tired of closing and restarting the app every now and then.. to be fair it's a prettty good game with awesome graphics and easy controls..

Regardless of the ad barrage: here are the complaints: massive grindfest. Dungeons that drop one damn potion when you're trying to ascend characters. -2* review for the dreadful amount of pop ups. +3* for the responses to other reviews. They actually have slightly read responses. A bit of fun on my end~ Game itself is decent. Another gacha with a bit more variety than others. Sadly, getting 5 ads Everytime you go to the base kind of makes you just want to close it out altogether. The game is fun, and there is a lot to do. I honestly feel like I don't need to spend money to have a good time. The only thing holding me back from a 5 star review is the ammount of pop ups for in game purchases. I will get 3 to 5 pop ups one after another everytime I log in, or go back to the overworld. It's incredibly annoying. Please limit the amount of pop ups. Thank you!

Been playing for about 9 months now. Pros: great graphics, champions, and content. Cons: ads are annoying but limited to when game first starts after that ur good. The worst part is the monetary system. Champions are useless without gear. Gear must be upgraded with silver. I've spent a few thousand dollars on the game and I still need silver. Game has great potential but the silver situation makes it hard for me to justify playing it.

I shouldn't have to pay more silver to remove an artifact after I've already paid to remove it. To charge me silver multiple times for something I have already paid for with silver I earned is something I've never experienced in any other games on Google Play. I also should be able to keep the rewards that are sent to my inbox without it having a time limit. They are my rewards that I earned spending countless hours to obtain and you take them from me before I can use them. That's not right!

Live arena and clan siege is the worst. As a free to play player i hate going up against other people who spend lots of money in the game with more powerful champions than I have. It's like they give you resources to play a feature of the game that you have no chance of winning. It basically comes down to how much money have you spent to beat your opponents

Although it quickly comes off as a pay to win, I'm suprised by the fact that you really don't need to. The game gets fairly repetitive, but I suppose it's enough to keep me coming back fairly regularly. The campaign is well voiced and interesting enough, although same with PvP, the gameplay is pretty dull. Lots of missed potential that I personal feel, would suit a triple A pc and console game much better. But for a mobile game, it's passable. All in all, great lore/ story, decent otherwise.

Graphics are cool but the in your face advertisements trying to get you to open your wallet kill every bit of interest in playing. I made it for about an hour and got so irritated with the so called "deals" I just quit. I get wanting to make money but that's just ridiculous and I wouldn't recommend this game to anyone.

I HATE that the upgrade dungeons are not only restricted to one day a week, but its on some foriegn time zone so most of that time is wasted during sleeping hours! never been a huge fan of phone games but hot damn!! this game is amazing and very well done! pros to this game are the graphics, amount of content and characters, and the intricacies of building up your characters. the only con i would have to say is "energy system," not a big fan of needing energy to play. however, they make it quite easy to get a good amount each day so it balances out. overall, outstanding game!!

I really want to keep playing this, as it's quite an amazing game. That said, the grinding in this is absolutely outrageous. Original was a 4 star review, but after getting a petiful answer from an official, I've decided that this game deserves no more than 2 stars, the in game transaction pop-up system is intrusive, the game runs on automode and the double speed only makes you complete the game faster, in hopes of you buying more in game stuff. Item upgrades destroys older items, leading to boring grinds and is not a fun mechanic. Most ambitious RPG ever made? Nice.

i actually really enjoy it. the rewards are good enough for returning daily, and the rate of decent summond has been good for me as well, that i haven't really hit a "pay wall" yet, there's stuff i can buy to spped up my progress but like i said, I've gotten enough decent stuff through just playing and log in and progression rewards i haven't really needed it. so it's been fun, the characters are cool, so great job so far guys

Very similar to "Monster Super League and Summoner's War". Legendary champions are very tough to get. Continuous ad pop-ups that cost money. Chatban both autobot & moderation are trigger sensitive. Fun for new players. Company refuses to design new stuff. All events are just do x thing 1 mil times and the rewards actually get worse the larger their player base gets. You'll love it at first and hate it by end game. So many problems that I can't even list. My advice is skip this or stay 100% free to play.

I have no idea who is safe to attack and thus ranking up, which the game makes mandatory to move through the main quest line, is nearly impossible. This heavily detracts from an otherwise good game.

After playing everyday for over 3 months, I realized the game is pointless. I would just log in, play the daily challenges and be done. Boring and repetitive. Like others, to really get anywhere it's either pay or a truly endless and tiresome grind. Wanted to like it and gave it plenty of time. But just not that fun.

Game is fun, the unending and unrelenting pressure to BUY BUY BUY is not. They don't care if you just bought something, they'll offer you another "limited time" $30 pack two minutes later. Go on auto battle for a little while? Expect to swat away twelve offers once you get back to the Bastion. I wish I was making that number up. Good game if you are unbothered by high pressure marketing and sales techniques. Terrible predatory bank account vacuum for anyone who has more dollars than sense.

Fun concept but incredibly buggy, and very expensive to play if you want to make progress. I can run the phone all day on other apps and games but have learned not to play RAID unless there's a power supply available. I even got a new battery but the problems with RAID persist.

It's an addictive game especially for those who likes collection of legendary heroes. Good graphic compared to most of similar games. One bad thing about this game that I hate most even if u pay no guarantee you will get legendary or nice heroes. So 90% of the times you pay for nothing. The whole point of paying to play is to make sure able to summon legendary heroes. Please review.

Short loading times, Amazing looking heroes, stamina doesnt take forever to regen, and events going on 24/7. Tiny issue with Pay to win, you can buy 5star set in bundles but they arent game breaking since you can eventually farm them yourselves with better stats. All in All, a way better game than i expected it to be.

I've played other mobile dungeon crawlers before, and the graphics and strategizing are excellent. Haven't seen bigger cash grab in a long time. From the start they just throw in your face all the options how you can waste your money. There is so much about this game that angers me. It's damn near impossible to start playing this game without a youtuber code. They barely give you enough to even try. I like it, but... They charge you silver coins for everything. Even taking your gear you put on one of your own people. And its not cheap depending on the armor. Should make it to where you can only get legendary characters with purple shards not rare that's not right! Makes it not worth it please fix!!

If you want a game that bombards you with non-stop in-game purchase adds,then your in the right place.Every freaking time when you enter the game you get like 10 of them ,and if you leave the main screen(bastion) and return they give you more.We know where the shop is and you don't have to remind us a dozen of times.Uninstaled and I'm done,your lack of respect for the players is on another level,you greedy mf...🙄

Have only played a day, but like so far. Progresses at a good place, characters look neat, and plenty of side quests. Lacking in story plot and so far it's a bit too easy. Also can tell it is going to be very grindy trying to farm more resources for character advancement.

In a word, boring. It's just the exact same fights, events and tournaments over and over again. Then there is the way they monetize the game. When you log in, you will be assaulted by stale meme references imploring you to buy the newest pack (which is usually just a reskin of a pack they pushed previously) in the shop. Plarium likes to say that they "strike a balance between paid and free content" which is untrue. There is no way to obtain enough higher tier shards through free play.

It started out fine when I installed it, and I got pretty far on the playthrough, but today and yesterday, I had to uninstall and reinstall it several times just to log in and play, before I was kicked out in the middle of a playthrough. It was fine originally, but when I tried playing again it was buggy and lags when you get to a scene.

The game is good. A legendary gotcha game to be sure. Yes, the pop ups are annoying, and the grind can be long. However, are you pretending that every other gotcha game isn't a grind? Plarium gives you everything they can, and invents more ways to squeeze in a little extra every chance (events and tourneys) they get, without you having to spend money.

This game is great fun indeed and I had originally rated 5 stars. I started using a promo code and never received the hero specified. Started at the same time afriend did and they got the hero. Not worth your time. This game sucks, it's repetitive, and pay to win. It's so boring and gameplay is laughable. (there's an auto button that plays the game for you, so what's the point?) watch YouTube channels and see how sketchy this company is with their misleading ads. Stay far away, don't play this game.

The game is nothing but a money suck, they slam you with offers constantly. When you are end game like me on umn if attack down falls off it cost you 100 gems for a new key. Overall already good, stunning game, nice graphics, and awesome gameplay. But there's 1 thing that really annoys me, it's internet connection in this game. poor tech support. after the update I couldnt launch the game. when it finally worked I lost my account and haven't heard anything from their support team 7day+ later. will rate again when the account is restored and yes I did open a ticket in game and by email. This just feels like a cash grab with a horrible game at its base where you do nothing the whole time. I've been playing for two months now. I'm told after your three month mark, the free goodies stop. How about you reward your most loyal customers that have logged in every day for 6 months? A couple of days ago I was finally able to get back on and I was so happy but this morning it went back to not making it past the load screen. I'm 3 days in of checking in to get the monkey king. Long time player here who's spent enough time and money in the game to give an experienced gamer review. I've taken a break from Raid before due to issues and came back but this time it's for good. ADS!! To many of them. They are soooooooo annoying that at times makes me want to uninstall the app. Its understandable to get 1 or 2 not 6 or 7 in a row 😡 other than that. Well if it's not one thing it's the next! At this point the game is way to expensive no new REAL updates or content they keep "fixing" arena now its broken more than ever customer service sucks its all automated the monthly pass isn't even worth the money all in all I used to be a devoted player and like many others iv stopped spending and slowed playing its going to take more than a new character (every 4 months) that you have to grind and pay for to keep people playing! Amount of MONEY that is required to spend to even progress is crazy!! its wildly addictive so far. been playing for about 2 weeks straight. has a "disciples" feel to the game play. yeah it's free to play and it better be because everything is expensive as Sugar Honey Ice Tea!!! but I'm not complaining.good game and it seems to keep giving you enough items to stay playing.
