Energy systems are awful. An auto uninstall; if I wanted to play an arcade game there's a bowling alley down the street with pinball.

Simply because extra transactions will sneak up if you ain't careful. I decided to give it a shot and purchase the silver raid pass month card and the system doesn't really make it aware to you that it's automatically setting it up for auto-renewal because the option beforehand isn't given...it's only in fine print at the bottom which is obviously sneaky on purpose to get more money. I've been charged for a few months now without being aware. Hoping to atleast get reimbursed this last payment:/

It's a fun enough game but the torrent of "sale" popups on every login is really annoying. I also feel that Mystery Shards (the green ones) should be included more in "bonus chance" events where higher rarity champions have a better chance of being awarded. I understand they want to make money but they're stingy with actually good champions.

Good game, good graphics and fun to play. However, farming based grinders can get tedious by nature, this game has low drop rates and predatory advertising. I feel like the game would be a lot less frustrating with better drop rates and less ''in your face ads''. The game has the potential for being a long lasting title if these issues are addressed. If not, I feel like you guys are gonna lose players.

It was good at start, now just want to take your money. To many Heroes, and all is to much RANDOM. Upgrading equipment, summoning heroes etc... all "LUCK", and BAD one... orange shards give you the worst heroes... to low chance to upgrade legendary heroes with books... I was playing it 2 years. Support dont help if you have problem, to many pop outs when you loge in, and they can just do with your account what they want. DON'T RECOMMEND!!!

I played for about a half hour and just couldn't get into it. Maybe it's just not for me, but in my opinion it's just the same as several other "mmo/rpg" mobile games and lacks any real eye candy or interesting mechanics. Their hope in realistic graphics are severely out done by more aesthetically unique games of a similar play style such as Summoner's War and AFK Arena. The characters are bland and the humor is dry. Overall very boring. Do not recommend.

I have changed my rating to 4 stars. RSL has improved. The graphics are great, many improvements seen which is nice. The only thing I still have an issue with is the awful Gear leveling system in the game. It costs over 1 million silver to level just one piece of 4 to 5 star gear, and that is ridiculous! This needs to seriously improve. Also your prices for in game items are way too high. On a positive note, it is fun and free to play, no one is forced to buy anything. Keep improving Plarium!

Very nice game with an entertaining grind and good gameplay, its just shame the pay to win element with all the rng and slow progression sometimes it really makes you feel like you have to spend money to move on, but you can totally progress without spending money it just takes longer. Just wish the gameplay rewards would be more impactful and the shop would be purely for cosmetics.

Initial progress is good but once you get going it's a typical pay to win game. If you don't pay, you grind and get nowhere. If you talk to in game support you get the run-around just like raids response here. I even spent a significant amount of money and still wasn't getting what my account need gear wise, and typical response, you need to play the game more! They have no clue, they are struggling with player retention for obvious reasons that they are not willing to address.

This game is AMAZING it's so fun and everything is balanced. Now why I'm writing this review is because when you join the game theres continuous pop ups saying "buy this pack and buy this starter pack"its mad annoying and can you fix the lag spikes please this game is good and I'm looking forward for future updates and when you fix these problems I will give this game 5 stars. Keep up the good work!

Nearly 200k during an event that makes gear upgrades cheaper... and still didn't get the upgrade. Unfortunately it's required to fulfill the quests. Huge drawback, it's how they get around free to play I guess. So, probably shouldn't play unless you want to spend cash or take FOREVER to progress. Loved it at first, quickly becoming frustrating.

Had fun with the game for a while, but the developer is way too greedy and the game is not fun when you're f2p or a casual spender at a certain point. It looks fun at the beginning when you can play a ton, but after that you realize it's very f2p unfriendly and you cant do much. Plarium fked all of their non-whales with their most recent event (check Foli event on google). Graphics are top notch though.

While the only thing you do in this game is level up characters, it is surprisingly complex. I've played mostly for free(I bought some legendary tomes, they are hard to get). The game is very stingy in what it grants you. You have to be patient, unless you spend money. I've been at it for about six months. He'll hades has some excellent strategy guides on yuotube.

At first I gave a solid 5 stars because the game is fun, and it's addicting. But after playing you notice how terrible this game is ran. Terrible developing and progressing of content. Issues in game take months to resolve. Even when they release "new" content it's underdeveloped and broken. Until things get fixed it will stay with 1 star, just what the development of this games deserves.

I have made a good amount of purchases in this game, deeply regretting it. I lost purchased shards as the game malfunctioned. I contacted both the app store and Plarium for a refund and they both told me to speak with the other saying they couldn't do anything. If you are going to spend money, cross your fingers you receive what you pay for.

Since they keep begging for input I figured I'd just negate a star and be honest. I usually subtract a star when reviewing if its pressured and forces me to constantly close pop-ups. Which reminds me, this is one of those games that you cant just start up and play. You have to make sure you have some free time to close out of the 19 pop-ups before you can just access the game. Once you finally get in and can play its decent. It's a bit obnoxiously advertised towards kids & teens like fortnite.

Love the game, has a very addictive setting. There are endless options to advance in the game with. The only downfall to this game is that it's a "pay to win" for most of the tournaments. You can advance on free to play just fine with some lucky shard pulls, but to compete among the top, open your checkbook.

The game starts out great and fun. You get higher level and even spending over a year and money I can't get good hero's, have to spend money to take off gear, Almost impossible to win challenges because they don't put same level people in them, very dissatisfied and keep playing because of my time invested and just doesn't get better. You must have to spend huge money to get where these top players are.... you've been warned.

Great potential ruined by a spamfest. Graphic is Nice and for once there some story telling. But I had to change my rating because of the constant spam each time you log in counted 8 "offer" you need to close down before you can actually play. Each and every one of them slowing your game. Last time it was so much I no longer felt like playing. The anwser from the développer is shy from : it just surprise mechanic

It is a great game but the developer is greedy. For example when the potion dungeons give me 1 lesser potion for beating a higher level boss which costs 10 energy it makes me want to uninstall the game. There's not much incentive to try to beat level 10 boss when the rewards are the same as level 1 boss. Everything in this game is overpriced and rigged towards spending lots of time or money or both. It is fun and addictive but very greedy. (You have no plan to change this so feedback means zip)

It's a great game. I play it daily for my quests. Only complaint is with or without spending real money it is so difficult to get any hereos you want or to get legendary hereos.. I have kind of hit a barrier where I can progress more without spending money and also getting very lucky... I have been playing daily for 3 months at this point though...

It was fun to play at first when they give you free energy. However it soon turns into a tedious grind. You are just going through the motion and doing the same tasks over and over again. Plarirum doesn't care about their player base. They make promises they can't keep. No content update, and everything is over priced in this game. They increases the prices of the packs in game based on your previous spending history. Endless money grabbing.

Honestly, does anyone get this game out of any reason besides satire. I was pleasantly surprised at the gameplay being average for a mobile game, but the amount of 'X's you need to press to actually play the game (because as much as I'd love to spend 50 bucks for the pack, id rather just use it for something useful. The microtransactions are as much as a joke as the ads that plague YouTube. I understand that the whole point is to generate a profit, but surely you got to know where the limit is.

The in your face spend money add chains are a huge distraction and annoyance. I can understand an add when I log in, but the chain of 4 ads, then go Arena fight, come back to bastion and get slapped with 3 ads. On and on it goes. I spend more time closing the ads then playing the game it seems. I would enjoy the game way better if the gaming company would scale back on the damn ads

Free to play or pay to win? I've never paid a dime. I am in the top 18% of players for overall achievement in 2020. Grinding and strategy is the name of the game. I've played (daily) since nearly the game's conception and have seen it's growth over time. The workers at Palarium have made endless efforts to accomodate any short coming. The advertisements are all click away ads for the game itself and are hardly cumbersome. If you're looking for a better game, of this kind, there isn't one.

Used to love this game, but over 2 years of playing, have seen it become a money pit. They have changed and keep changing the reward rations to the point even an artifact upgrade is 3 times more expensive than 2 years ago. Talk about inflation. Over 6k into this game and very dissatisfied with myself and game that it more about profit than anything now. They know they are at the end of their run so upping costs to maximize their end profits.

You have destroyed this game with your greed. Adding one thing that was immensely needed which is "multibattle" and putting a cap on it, is just ridiculous. Only 15 multibattles for free players per day, in a game that is literally 99% based on grind is a joke. And you want us to pay to get 25 rounds extra? Not to mention they can only be used in campaign grind and not in dungeons. I will not sit all day long staring at my phone just to repeat auto farming rounds. Stay away from this game.

Since my original review wasn't public...great graphics and character design with fun gameplay. The biggest issue with this game and the reason I uninstalled is because it is very P2P and I say that being someone that spends alot on mobile games. I completed the first 7 chapters and never even received anything that would allow me to summon anything more than a common hero. The rewards were very lackluster and it doesnt feel like the time you spend grinding is worth it.

My first problem is that it takes 4 minutes to log in because of the 10 deals it tells me to get, which are overpriced and plain annoying. My second problem is that the game is SO RANDOM, the crystal things you get are expensive and you just end up getting a champion that is worse than the ones you have. My last problem is the combat, this games combat is awful, you can only play for 30 minutes before getting bored and not wanting to play, bad game would not recommend, play somthing else

Just summoned Raf-Matab and was in the process of using a other rare shard when the app crashed (froze up). Restarted and had lost my two shards along with the champions they apparently summoned. Another "free to play" game that is incredibly tedious if you don't spend money on it. Has pvp-walls that are just shite if you hate pvp because guess what - you can't progress without doing it.

This game was deliberately designed to make players spend money it is almost gambling with odds stacked against you. Every feature of the game is probabilistic from acquiring champions to articrafts. Even upgrading the articrafts once you get them is probabilistic. There is no certain way to achieve something no matter how much you grind everything relies on luck. Even with the P2W aspect you could spend 100's of dollars and still end up with nothing of value.

I've been playing this game for years now. I love it, there are very few games that I can get on my phone that I actually enjoy and I'm very sad that this one has quit working. I don't mind the fact that I have to update it every couple days but the last few times I've tried to update it it takes forever and usually makes it worse. And now it needs an update but it says pending for days and now I can't even log in to find out my plarium i d, so I can't even delete it log in n start over help!!

Great concept I honestly like the game and it looks great. This most recent event is a slap in the face to ever low spending/FTP person. They do back to back events draining your resources to only put out another event targeting the resouces just drained so you have to spend money. Plarium only gives auto responses with never making a real change and ignoring its customer base never making simple changes that are asked for. I don't recommend this game unless you want to spend money and time.

Really loved this game at one point until it became painfully obvious that it was just another cash suck like most of the games of it's kind. I don't mind dropping a little money if I know that I'm going to be playing the game for awhile but this one advances so slowly that you have to pay to develop a decent team. Sad to say it won't be one of my daily plays anymore until something is remedied.

Been a fun little gotcha game. Thankfully it has a interesting story to keep you occupied. My one complaint at the moment is that on login, the game spams what seems like every, single, store window at you one after the other. I know free-to-play games rely on store purchases, but you don't need to litterraly spam every single $ purchas tab in my face one after the other so I'm clicking 5-8 x's befor I can actually touch the game-world. That kind of advent is just way to intrusive. ***********edit******** only way i could think to 'reply' to the devs :D Please dont take it as me being 'angry' or such, its simply the only complaint (if i had to name one) of the game sofar. i 100% understand wanting to ensure players 'know' about timed deals and such, but clicking threw 5+ individual screens is a bit much. Perhaps find a way to have 1 scrollable window that pops up with 'all' timed-events shown that comes up once on log-ins, rather than the 4,5, 6, ect that seem to pop up in rapid succession at the moment :D

Do NOT play if you are under 21 years old, this is a gambling based game, also not recommended if you have an income of less than $10,000 a month because you will be asked to spend real money everyday. Gameplay and controls are 1 star because it is an autoplay game, but the design team gets 4 stars because it looks like they put a lot of effort into the champions. The developers had a very successful advertisement campaign, but my personal opinion is this game is your average cash grab game ap.

Ugh, how do people enjoy this game? Gave it a shot to get currency in a different app, and wow is it awful. If you want a similar game that isn't boring, or chock full of pop-ups, hit up AFK Arena instead. This one is a hard pass. RE: their response, no. You get popups every time you go to the gome screen. That is not just an occasional reminder. That's ridiculius.

Hey Plarium... I gave you 5 stars for this game... The haters out there are seriously wrong about this topic! Yeah, sure, this game is developed to take in the $$$. How many aren't? What are we really complaining about? Legitimate complaints include: 1. Way too much in-money (gold) to unequip gear, and no way to save a made set for later use, gotta search for it. 2. From time to time there is a bug or glitches, but as for customer service, I give it 5 stars. Next day replays.

1 of the (or maybe the) best free app game in the play store...My only complaints are fusion and fragment events are designed to Award Raids best new champs to experts and big spenders, leaving the rest of us just wasting resources and time. I am a level in the 70's with some of the best champs in the game, and still i have never once completed one of these events. It's very frustrating...

It's a good game. It has been entertaining. Im having some minor touch issues when tapping on menus that have mobility (able to be swiped). An example is the champion list in the Tavern or the artifact slots. It could just be my screen though. I feel the micro sales could be toned down just a smidge. Like not having multiple ones where i have to close multiple ones in a row. I very much dislike the matchmaking in Arena. List has very few real battles. Constant 10-20 player levels above me.

Cannot give it 0 stars. Log in and 5 adds, adds between sections of play. Customer service really sucks as they have no power, all they want is screen shots to show them. I sent in 2 tickets and the one they responded and all I could do was scratch my head as it did not pertain to my issue, 2nd one they kept circling around for screenshots as linking to Facebook or their company for backup restarts your account. Game its self was not bad but the company has a lot to be desired.

Boring not like the advertisements at all *edit* Then after I leave a review, the developer leaves a cookie cutter response that has almost nothing to do with my initial review. Let's make it relevant: all their in game ads for the "deals" they have, are bs; and not worth anything given the amount of time and money you have to put in to get a maxed out "good" team.

Game was enjoyable on the first few hours of gameplay. Afterwards, it just got boring and it kept flashing you of its cash promos, which can actually just be ignored. But playing more and more feels like hitting a paywall and for you to move further progress, you need to pay to get strong, otherwise, it's a heavy grinding/repetitive boring game. The original concept looks like Summoner's War mobile game with a few added features and better game graphics. But that's it.

This is one of worst games for grinding out there. The volume of grinding is absolutely insane in some cases 100 + hours of actual game time to max out masteries. The amount of summons to get epics or legendarys is a joke. This game is designed to fuel the addicted personality into compulsive buying. There are better games out there. Games like this should be pulled from the market place until they fix their cash grab buying scam and their ridiculous playtime requirements.

The game stopped being fun real quick. It's just kind the same thing each fight but with sometimes more enemies. It's "turn based" different in a bad way and not even a little bit consistent. It's over all just a boring version of Fate/grand order, but that game has anime waifus and exciting visuals.

I just downloaded this game after I saw an ad about it on a fellow YouTube content creator, and I downloaded it and I can't even play this game. Basically after you load into the game, there is something you have to download and it takes FOREVER like after an hour I wasn't even 10% done. And now its been stuck For an hour. This game is not good.

Being a fan of titles like Disciples or Heroes series, i started to play this game thinking it might be similar. Far from it. There is nothing tactical in the battle ( except that little rock/paper/sc element thingie ), it all rely on having stats( and grind for them) since in the battle everybody can hit everybody. Graphics are amazing, diversity is fake, most heroes are copies of another. Too many ads and way too expensive prices. Also comercials are fake, you cant alter looks with gear.

I liked most of the game,but the arena SUCKS!!! Matches are terrible. I keep getting matched with teams I don't have a chance against and the rare few at my level are able to beat me in a couple turns. I am moving backwards because of this. I have played on and off because of this, but it seems to be getting worse. I'm now looking for a game that at least gives me a fighting chance to advance I barely hit silver level and am now going backwards in bronze

I played this game for over a year grinding out a full team of 6 star champions and even invested the time into scrolls for those champions. It doesn't matter though. You have to get the characters that have the gimmicks in the game. A single character can be the difference between my team blowing you out and your team blowing mine out. The game was good until you are trying to get to gold in arena. There's nothing higher than rank 6 Champs so you have to wait for those gimmick characters.

One of the grindiest games available. It is addictive at first. After a few days of gameplay you realize being stuck at a level and then you start grinding. The game literally has auto repeat mode knowing you'll be forced to grind. And that's when you realise that being the strategy all along. You need to pay to make good progress or keep grinding forever.

This game can be a lot of fun, but it can also be tedious and frustrating. I have 2 accounts one that I spend money in and one that is "free to play". Both styles of play have their own challenges. For example; spending money makes the campaign and dungeons easier, but it makes the arena substantially harder, due to the match making algorithm. In my experience the opposite is true for FTP. My recommendation is that if you play recommendation is: if you are new reach lvl 50 before spending.

The game is very noob friendly and obviously its a mobile game, so you gotta have "Starter Pack" pop ups every so often. Its very enthralling and addictive. The best part is you can choose to play it strategically or just basically afk it, and I think that really suites the game well. I would love to see this game on the Nintendo Switch, I think it would thrive there.

There's a lot of fun to be had, but it's so pay to win it takes all that fun away. It always feels like plarium is ignoring their playerbase, and constantly doing anything they can to squeeze every penny out of you. They released promote champions to get people to come and play raid, but they made it nearly impossible to get them. There's a lot of things they add as special events, that should actually just be a standard. No gear remove cost, super raids, guaranteed champions , and more.

In Game ads and overly complicated. I have played this game for a while now and it always has multiple in-game ads that you have to sift through before you can begin to play. You are given limited space to expand your character choices. Those characters then are limited to how far you can upgrade. It is basically a Rock-Paper-Scissors style game. Inorder to gain high level characters you have to sacrifice your others but yet it prevents or warns you against this.

The game play is pretty awesome, and the leveling aspects are addicting and fun. However, IF you create an account, MAKE SURE you link your email etc. if you want to keep your progress. I had spent upwards of $30 on the game, had a pretty high lvl and multiple champions I had worked so hard to get and ascend and I lost everything. If they didn't have this one small problem I would have easily given 5 stars. But I won't play again because of how much I lost. It does get frustrating.

I decided to give it a go, and it's pretty good. Tapping out of the 5 pop up dwals when you open the game is annoying, but better than actual adds. I did have to mark tge game down for the area. I can't for the life of me complete the mission for silver 1. Even in bronze 3 I get matched up against mostly teams of 4 level 60s. Sonetimes as much as 74k power to my 51k. They need to do matchmaking based on power, or cap how low your rank can degrade, so these teams don't clog the lower ranks.

This game is just another example of predatory gambling practices that plague the gaming industry. As soon as you log into the game you are greeted with anywhere from three to five ads or more. This game isn't a five star game, you know a good example of a five star game, Stardew Valley on the PC. Which is as close to a perfect game as it gets. This is not a perfect game. It has generic gameplay, mediocre at best. You know what this game does really good at, showing us just how bad and shady loot box mechanics really are. You can't get anywhere in this game without dropping a bunch of money trying to get five star characters and gear. I'm sure this game is making a lot of money on the endless sea of Whales out there dropping hard earned money on their game. Save your money for better games like Stardew Valley, the kind of games that don't utilize predatory gambling mechanics. As a final note, should I get a response apologizing for not enjoying their game. No, what you should be apologizing for is releasing trash like this on the play store. I'm a game and I expect better. Sadly the best they can do is contribute to the ever growing trash heap that is the free to play market here.

Game would have 5 across the board... I've had it crash numerous times. Using the pixel 3 xl. It's up to date, games up to date, but it will randomly freeze and the only way to fix it, is to force close it. The ads are normal anymore so they're honestly not bothersome, and they're really not as bad as others. Gameplay is great, smooth as can be at 60 fps. Character selection is insane. So many different characters in this game, variety is most definitely there. Enjoy it aside from the crashing.

Played for 5 days, I enjoyed it but realized ita a full pay to win game, they started selling epic champs for 50usd but the real last drop that got my nerves was the quest to build 2 champs with lvl 12 artifacts, i literally spent over 1 million silver trying to upgrade them, I never got it, they don't even show the % of the success upgrade. I guess I'm just disappointed, it could have been a great game but you can tell they just want to make it hard on you so you buy their bundles and packs

A: this game takes up too much phone memory. I've played other similar games and they never took up this much of my memory. B: Even though I've deleted many apps to make sure there is enough room, the game resets often right after I start a fight. This makes me lose energy, keys, etc. C: I've clicked report most of the time after this has happened and it continues making me believe this company has no real concern about their players. More complaints but not enough room. Only good is graphics

so far it's been fun, minus all the pop ups to buy packs, but I guess that's just part of the games nowadays. there's so much to do in this game it keeps you busy with all the quests and challenges to motivate you to keep on playing, and then there's clans to meet new players that share your playing style. I love it! oh, and the graphics are the best for any mobile game I've seen yet! have fun playing...

Sadly, another greedy company who is trying to milk it's player base. Literally everytime you go into the main screen you get an ad pop-up. The rewards from in-game are terrible, so are is the value for the items you can purchase. "Faking"/Pushing their download/new player numbers with events targeted towards "new" users, however, mainly existing users are creating new accounts to participating. Recently, events/promo codes are targeted towards new users only, while active paying users are left

Character progression is slow if you don't pay for boosters or other content. Your "core" characters should be able to progress through the main campaign without having to replay previous levels several times just to gain high enough levels to progress. Still, the game is a fun way to just pass time.

Addictive, fun, but ultimately will only last a long time for payers. End game content requires either a ton of time or a lot of money to make anything happen. Gets to a certain point where it's just a daily grind to get your keys spent and use some energy. Events are good, great champions and graphics. I like that they offer some champions to fuse and have events that can get you some new ones. A lot of research involved if you're going to really get into speed-tuning teams.

To qualify myself: Over ~1 year (449 hours played time) Ive spent over $2k on in-game content. Critics would profile me a "tuna" rather than a "whale", or a "medium-heavy impulse spender". I've completed all manner of in-game content; achieved the top-most accolades, challenges conquered ect. With that said: this game has so much potential, yet will never reach full efficacy. Game/Art/Mechanics are superb. It's the devs and shareholders who push a culture of financial manipulation on players.

Fun, until you realize everything about this game is to get in your wallet. It's ran by greedy people. It's a waste of money. Don't play if you have a gambling problem... Out of my first 3 champions 2 were duplicate Lord Shazars and now I have a bunch of duplicates and can't do a thing with them. Don't fall for their greedy bonus summon "deals" either. This game is definitely rigged against the players and is way to time consuming. I've been playing for over a year and it makes me sick

This game has game play similar to Contest of Champions but set in a Tolkien world. I like that you can rank up a champion if you have invested time in it. A 3 star can become a 4 star and so on. I don't like that everything costs silver. Open a crystal, hand over silver. Take off armor, hand over silver. Fail upgrading something, it keeps eating silver until it upgrades or you run out. All in all, I thoroughly enjoy the game. I really love the training pit. Over all great game.

Looks great, only took a few days to reach the "no progression unless you pay" cap. Edit: also they seem to not understand the concept of "microtransactions" as most of the ads that popped up were $40-60 CDN. I don't mind spending a few dollars on quality mobile games, but not that much thanks.

If you want to feel inadequate as a man...step into the Raid arena. You can have a team with twice the power of your opponent and you will be destroyed in a few rounds because they have 1-2 bought and payed for characters. I thought about spending the money to be competitive, because I do enjoy the feel of the game. However, after adding it up I would need to spend about $1000 to upgrade skills, armor and accessories in ever hoping to get to the gold level in the arena.

Let me start by saying I really enjoy this game and think it has great potential. But there is something seriously wrong with how Plarium treats their long-time player base. No matter what kind of excuse you try to find, the decision to replace the 5* chicken and sacred shard with a (not login exclusive) mediocre legendary was a slap in the face for each and every long-time player. You need 4 months to collect the fragments to summon her, which equals 4(!) sacreds & chickens.

Awesome design poor execution. Increase drop chances for legendaries and reduce gold costs. Freaking annoying to spend resources for equiping/unequiping champions. I dont mind paying for a good game, but this is the first game I played that offers so little value for your $. Ребят, слушайте игроков побольше. Удачи.

I do really like this game, many different heroes, skills, options for battles and bosses. But this is the only one game where for 129 gaming days I did not get a single legendary hero from SHARDS, even having Amazon Prime, having bought an event pass, even with the portal BOOST. This game has the lowest chance of a drop of legendary heroes and most of all shopping reminders... No fun - no game. Uninstalled...

Great game, however Plarium is destroying it with their greed. Events are becoming harder and harder to complete to the point where you have to constantly skip events. However there is no long term calendar so the player has no idea what's coming. The paywall is massive for any decent champions. Their latest stunt with the Monster Hunter collab and Xena just highlights that they don't care about the game or players, just their bottom line. I honestly like this game, but Plariums greed is huge.

Can be addictive, the 'pay to win faster' metric is just getting old to me. On top of that, being barraged with deal after deal after deal soon as I login to the game is irritating. Probably wont be playing much longer but as long as its interesting and Im actually moving forward consistantly through the game I might stick around. We'll see...

It's a good game. But it's way better on PC simply because it's less tedious to have it on a larger screen with better controls. Normally, games like these lose my attention because they're tedious and boring, especially on mobile. But this one can hold my attention for hours on end. There's plenty to do, the graphics are great, and the music and audio is awesome!

The game is horrifically pay to win, once you get deep enough into the game you begin to realize that there is genuinely no strategy or smart play. PvP is a joke, for example if someone else got lucky enough or spent enough money to pull a Krisk the Ageless congrats, you lose, there's no counter except having an insanely high speed stat on multiple legendary champs, which you'll only have if you spent insane amountso money. Predatory and morally bankrupt, it isn't even a game, it's a casino.

Aside from the expected constant nag adds that appear everytime you return to your base, I really don't have any complaints about the game. It's standard gacha fare, but you can tell a lot of love went into the art and it runs pretty smoothly on a Pixel 3 XL. Having played for a few days now I can honestly say I wish PC games came as bug free as this game seems to.

The game play isn't even mediocre. It's just plain and boring and unimaginative. They put all effort and money into advertising the game. The constant pop-ups to spend money are so frequent it gets incredibly frustrating and the pop-ups aren't even like spend $5 for something the pop-ups want you to spend $30, $40, even $60. They have some nerve to try to get people to spend $30+ for a phone game and it's boarder line predatory how often they want you to spend money and the gameplay is trash

Hackers, 3 months for adding half of a rehashed feature, rewards for which will be given in 3 months+, balance somehow getting even worse, events that required 10k points now require 28k for the same rewards, and the list goes on. Plarium has the unique talent of surprising you. When you think the game has hit rock bottom, it becomes even worse. Just do yourself a favor and not install.

At First: It an mobile game that cared about the product they were making. Money is spent in the game but they don't make you feel like you have to. But after awhile it is drys out. It begs for money. I was wacth the model more than play because playing is not a thing in this game. To Plarium resposnse: The major promblem with the game is not the money and balance it is gameplay. I don't feel like I'm playing a game; I look at it. It is not a rpg it pretends to be one.

This vapid, soulless, nothing of a "game" is brought to you by every YouTuber on the planet. Downloaded this game only so I could get free stuff in a different game. I didn't get my free stuff. They didn't swindle me, I just couldn't bare to pay this garbage long enough to unlock the reward for beating the tutorial. Edit: The dev response just shows they didn't really read my review, lol.

Casino in your phone that won't satisfy your RPG element thirst of a gameplay. Game development has been lacking since day one and has almost no content provided for a very long time. Game in general looks very appealing mostly because of art work but it gets boring very quickly because it's all repetitive grinding. In game events and tournaments look like are providing you with opportunities of getting some good rewards but in reality there is a huge pay wall to get any of the good stuff.

Cons: Raids rates are trash, the progression is terrible, the events last a week when they should last a month (IE they'll need upwards of 1000's of energy to complete and the rewards are often needing several iterations of this [fusion events]). This game is a very carefully tuned FOMO engine. If the drip rate for summon rewards were more consistent (ie 1-3 a week for purples or better and 10-20 a week for blues) and books were about the same rate it'd be fine. Needs 3x the rate of silver.

Too many attempts at getting you to buy items. Every time u log in there is 4 to 8 different popups that need to be closed prior to being able to play. Then when playing 90% of the time that you go back to main screen same thing. Yes these are generally pay to win games but it's too much

It's great with one problem way to many adds in the game you can't do nothing and go back to your keep without adds popping up over and over like there broke and needing players to throw money at the like a poor person when I know hell of people spend money on the game give us an option to stop them from poping up all the time we get it there are specials in the store we don't need to see them every time we need to do something in town and if you do that the game is great. Please fix it

So I love the gameplay, story, but might wanna ease up on the micro transaction pop ups, it's ALOT, finish a mission, boom ad, level your gear, ad. Also your guys rates on summons, I did 10 void summons during your rate up 2x summons, chance for epic and legendary, and they where all rare. Not 1 epic or legendary. Just my 2 cents, otherwise a fun time consumer.

There hasn't been new content since faction wars was added back in 2019. I don't count the "new" tag team arena as new content because it's just a reskin of classic arena. There's nothing to do in this game anymore and it's become boring. The events are all the same garbage that just requires you grind out a section of the game. It would be 100x better to have events like "X2 exp weekend" or "half price artifact upgrade" weekend, or dare I say it, limited time dungeons? I think it's time to quit

Was a good game after the last update ive had trouble logging in. First it wanted me to have 3gigs of open memory on my phone every time i log in regardless of being after the update was fully installed. After deleting some apps and playing for a while it now doesn't let me log in at all. Constantly showing a random error. Im in a top 450 guild and hoping i can get back in before im removed.

I have been playing for probably a year now. I'm rating a 1 until you get rid of the tirade of obnoxious popups at game start. There's a red dot to tell me about new articles and I can browse the shop for offers if I'm interested. I don't need ads in my face. Dev responded to turn off notifications. They are already off. Again, if I was interested in offers, time sensitive or otherwise, I would check the shop. Dev response does not resolve my issue. Please allow disabling of ALL pop-ups.

Terrible implementation of clan quests and clan shop. This new feature does not promote team work. On the contrary, it provokes in-game fighting with the people you are supposed to cooperate. Since there is a limited amount of quest and coins are earned INDIVIDUALLY, it is a first come, first serve model. While a few do the easy quests and earn gold, the rest of us get nothing and are left with absurdly hard quests. Also, they removed the sacred shard and 5 * chicken from rewards (best items).

I have an $8k whale account, but Im never coming back to this game. This game seems like it has a lot of content early on, and it hooks you in to wasting your money trying to gamble for the broken characters, but then at the end game, there is absolutely NO CONTENT TO PLAY. The developers don't release any new content that is worth a damn. Every patch is several months between and contains nothing NEW to actually do. EVERYONE has been complaining for months but this company does not care AT ALL

An easy game to pick up, play, and level quickly. No need to buy anything, you can however, but it's not necessary to have fun. Daily tasks can be finished in 30 minutes, or less, and this alone can move you up in ranks and get summoning shards to gain more, and diverse, heroes. Special summoning events increase the chances of getting higher skill heroes. There are plenty of things to do other than just the dailies.

Fun but unrealistic costs. Core game is fun and looks great. However the in game store is so over priced it's almost hard believe it's real. I have never seen such aggressively overpriced in game content. They may over value the game and it honestly makes me want to play it less. I purchased a few things and do not feel good about my purchses as what you get is so underwhelming in addition to over priced. Like all games in this style you can't move forward at some point without paying.

I love this game! I would definitely recommend! Its easy to play theres tips everywhere if you need help progressing through. I love getting daily login rewards I haven't missed a day. If the game ever has issues they always compensate you with whatever guests. The events and tournaments can be tricky but they help you progress even further. You dont have to spend really money to play. And there are no video ads just pop ups in beginning. I hope the doom tower comes soon!

It's a very fun game, but the summons are outrageously screwed. It's nearly impossible to get any good characters. I've used tons of shards, blue and purple, and got nothing but rare characters. If I can never get a legendary, what's the point of playing? I guess you gotta pay to play.

Stole my money. Played it off and on for a few days, was fun. Decided okay I can spend some money on it, bought the starter pack. Waited about 10 minutes after google and my bank had processed the transaction, hadn't received anything. Talked to support, their answer; wait longer. Waited 2 hrs, sent another message still haven't heard back. Took a day but they eventually got the pack I bought to me. Moved up to a 4.

Please for the love of God. Can you tone it down on ads? I hate seeing an add for this mediocre game every 5 minutes I'm scrolling through the net. It's exhausting. Like I'm going to play it more. If it was good I get it but it's so boring after 5 minutes. Isn't 2 years of marketing enough? And it's the same repetitive commercials.

The game is ok as far as gachas go but it is MASSIVELY P2W. The freebies aren't nearly good enough to advance very far forcing purchases, the summons aren't nearly as forgiving as they should be forcing purchases and the packages are outrageously expensive and when you do purchase a package it doesn't loosen anything up in the summons. Summon info says the percentages for better drops goes up the more you fail to summon anything good but there is literally no evidence of that.

My original review had a few good things. This one will NOT. After playing this game for a month, and spending far more than I now wish I had, I experienced game breaking issues with my account. So debilitating it made the game barely playable. I looked the issues up on forums, found nothing similar. Contacted support, to see if there was any way my account could get reset, without the loss of all my purchases. Response "No, but it'll get better with the next update, please keep p(l)aying"

I love this game but it is a money magnet. It's like the game pays attention to what you are doing and then throws all these over-priced offers at you. Not to mention that progression in this game is nearly impossible unless you dump large amounts of money into it. There was a shard event where you could pull some of the most wanted legendary champions for ancient shards at 10x extra chance. I pulled over 215 shards and got 1 legendary champion and it wasn't even one of the ones Mentioned.

very surprised by how much I like this game! I'm sure some people spend ridiculous amounts of money on Raid but you don't need to. I have a free 2 play account and only spent $10 one time for a certain armor set. overall it is a good game but they do everything in their power to get your money!

Fun game, passes the time, only thing I don't like is the popups for in store items popping up all the time(Should have option to turn that off in my opinion). And some of the items in the store little pricey. But if ya just wanting to play without buying extra I recommend this game to pass the time.

Awful, a money pit with no rewards. The only way to progress is to spend money. No endgame. Constant duplicates, and redundancy. Full of bugs, errors and problems. Would not recommend unless you have a gambling addiction and like to spend money with no reward. Support is the worst I have ever experienced, its not really Support at all, and there is no benefit to using Support. You are a payment method nothing more.

Fun game, just a bit on the nose with "buy things!". They do spam their deals way too much. Also, they have lately had a LOT of connection problems. Getting quite tiresome to play the game when it keeps loading all the time. According to the forums, it's a very common problem. Happening on and off to a lot of people. Still, it is a fun game. When it's working properly.

I thinks it's ridiculous I have to close 10-15 pop up bundle packs for sale, can't you bundle your bundle packs into one pop up that can scroll through all of them. Either that or change your YouTube advertisement to say free to play but we're gonna pressure the hell out you to buy something within the first 10mins of playing every log in.

The graphics are nice. The amount of ads to buy gems, to get new characters, to restore energy, level gear and characters... if get two pop-ups in between each click I made. It's disgusting. I don't mind some ads but this was obscene. They are wrong about the daily login making worthwhile. No matter what they say in reply, they offer nothing worthwhile to offset the constant begging for your money.

I must say this game is completely lop sided when it comes to playing against the cpu. A Level 5 3 star blue character can and will destroy your 4 star purple character who is level 25 in 3-4 hits, now flip that and try it on the cpu and you won't barely move their HP. It's so obvious it needs to be fixed like crazy but people buy into this so why fix it right devs? Also if your looking for a game that's a complete slot machine and cost 30-50$ for A CHANCE at a legend character this one's for u!

Unless you are willing to spend a good amount of time daily you wont get anywhere much in the game, the weapons upgrade system is just a waste of resources, the forge is kind of useless unless you reach certain levels and the drops dont get better in the dungeons even if you reach higher levels of such dungeons.

It's a fun Game but the ad bombardment keeps it at 3 stars since they don't go away even when you spend money on the app. Will probably quit after the raid card I bought expires due to my iritation the ad's bombs. Update don't buy the raid card, you get the extra auto battles but not enough energy to make use of it unless you want to keep spending money on energy, and the extra turns don't roll over.

Downloaded this game a while ago but really got into it about a week ago. Very well made game. NOT A TOTAL MONEY GRAB GAME. You can easily progress without spending money. A lot of grinding but that's expected. I don't mind spending money for a well made game. Will definitely look into spending a some money on this game.

After being constantly bombarded with ads I decided to give it a try expecting that I would download and uninstall it within an hour. I was pleasantly surprised! There are actually MANY different types of events, and the story of the campaign actually has some thought into it. Kudos to the developers for having so much content in a free to play game. Side note: there are many prompts to buy boosters and starter packs, but with the amount of content in the game, I can easily forgive this.

I've spend time and money on this game than I'd like to admit and have been playing almost since the original release. I'm still struggling with basic missions in the game. Not because I don't have good gear or champions, but because of pure chance to pull characters to progress on in game missions. Edit: I'm stuck on missions for the Rahz fusion there is no amount of other players experience to get past this. It's all about pulling shards to get the rares champs needed

to summarize, start with the positives, this game has a great graphic by today standard, and the good things ends there. To be honest, i am quite heavy spender (have spent 600 bucks in 2 months) and i still struggling to get a meaningful progress in game, the hero drop rates are trash particulary the legendary one, i spent that amount of money and never got a single legendary hero, what a shame really. The energy refill is painfully long to wait, unless you spent real money to refill.

I've been enjoying the grind for the most part & milestones to get to the other modifications & added ways to get better gear etc. .BUT the lack of positive results after spending a decent amount of time is fine since it's apart of grinding. but after the purchase of various ingame offers to speed up the process in hopes of acquiring a good team sooner & using COUNTLESS blue, purple, & even a few orange summon stones & end up with an army of useless 3stars was frustrating.

the game is good and the graphics are aswell, my biggest problem is with the random number generator. It either seems to be really in or against your favor depending on how its feeling. For instance I've had a character that has 75+ % crit chance not land a crit 4 hits in a row. Other times it seems to function more normally.

Just too much grinding to get decent characters in top form. You have to level up six classes of artifacts and three accessories per character. They are 16 levels and it costs a lot to max them out. The there are skills that can only be upgraded by books. The books are rare and expensive. A single character can often require ten or more books to max out skills. All of this and more is required per character. Very repetitive and kind of boring. They also have a team rating system that's a joke.

Good game keeps you interested. The auto attack option makes it a lot easier to play when you have things to do. Has a lot of in-game pop ups pushing bundles within the game. Usually averaging 3-5 pop ups at start of game. Once you get passed that it's nuisance free.

for what little this game has without paying anything is good. however you can only get so far before you hit a wall. progression is really slow. i know that you can get everything in the game without paying for it but damn if they didnt design this game to try to make you pay. unfortunately when you decide that this is the time you would like to buy something they change your mind by the over priced items. this game is good but not friendly to wallets. maybe a little to proud of their game.

Genuinely fun game, it's been a while since I've had this much fun with a mobile game. Yet there are HUGE pay walls and the progression seems to hault or slow you on purpose to get you to buy their packs and spend more money. I just wish there were games out there that didn't do this, the player base would be HUGE for a genuinely f2p grind that had a working progression system.

I just cant get into the game. There is too much of a pay wall if you want to do anything. You cant do some things usless you have units of a specific faction. A ton of the units feel very unimpactful and unimpressive. I have spent more money on this game then I would like and only gotten one decent unit. The game looks good on the outside but it feels very hollow.

I'd say, they only thing keeping me from giving this game five stars, is the fact that when you get the Purple and Orange level Shards for champion pulls, it hardly ever feels like you are getting something worth dropping everything to power level. The overall layout and amount of freely given items is vast and at times well thought out.

First and for most, there are hundreds or thousand of players on this game who have spent more than 10000 USD on this game. So if you are not willing to spend the price of a car, you will not be competitive. Some games you. An spend 100 bucks and gain an edge. This one you can spend 1000 and gain nothing. Do yourself a favor and pass on this time/money holes

Game looks good for a mobile game, but I have never once gotten a champion at the rarity of the shard I open and its frustrating, every single legendary shard ive opened turns into an epic... Every epic ive opened turns into a rare, it feels like all the work to get the shards is completely wasted and makes me feel like the time spent on the game was for nothing, and it ruins the game.

Good game by itself, but its a slow grind. In game actions take too long to complete, I wish there was a more efficient way to speed up gameplay. The amount of ads for in-game products is a bit much. I would like a feature where you can add individuals as friends, that way someone isn't lost forever if they happen to leave a clan or get kicked while they're on vacation. Global/clan chat is fine, but a little more on the side of individual interaction would be greatly appreciated.

Technically one of THE BEST turn based combat games... SADLY tooooo overpriced! NOT FREE TO PLAY! I am a paying player, spend hundreds, and laughed at this one! Summons insanely expensive, drop rates atrocious, packages WAY overpriced, no afk rewards, worthless quest rewards, LOTS of grinding required, being turn based also means requires LOTS of time to do anything... OH and they use an old school energy system that first permit accomplishing even basic daily grind... SKIP THIS ONE!

1. Its super pay to win, in the 20 days ive played i havent found one way to get the better heros offered without paying tons of money for *maybe* a chance of getting a good hero. 2. There are 15 adds you have to close one at a time, every single time you open the app. Adds like (buy this $30 pack and maybe you might get this super awesome hero lol) and $30 is cheap for the packs offered, its rediculous. 3. Its really kinda grindy. Like you have to do one level 10 times to get a good armour.

The game was fun for a while, until it became like every other repetitive game. The developer seems to go out of their way to make sure their customers know they hate them and do not consider their thoughts or opinions. If you don't spend money, you will not be anywhere close to decent any time soon. Delays on updates and new content. Massive lack of compensation to players for downtime/updates. Overall, not something I would recommend to anyone, unless I wanted to get them annoyed/angry.

Deleted the game. Been playing for 5 years and when I got screwed out of a free character because you only can have 400 roster spots and can't get rid of 1 star garbage characters. I tried to reach out to customer support multiple times and was completely ignored because you can only email them. It was time to uninstall the game. Email sent but never got a response

The last couple of days, I have not been able to access the game. I have uninstalled and reinstalled it twice. When the game boots up, it just stays at the loading screen. The game has gotten very boring and repetitive. The lack of new content is pathetic. For the amount of revenue this game takes in, you would think the creators would pay more attention to its community. I suppose this is a sign to just step away and find something new.

1999 Internet Pop-Up Simulator. Open the app, get cash shop ad after cash shop ad that takes up the whole screen and makes you close each one individually before you can get to the gameplay. Gameplay consists of grinding for lootbox drops and can be put on literal auto play. So after you get through 4-10 ads for cash shop bundles the game just plays itself.

Went from a decent game, to an awesome one, back down to a waste of battery. From how Plarium treats its content creators to the disappointment of meh to bad update after update, this game has been on a steady decline every since I started it almost a year ago. The sad part is I dont regret spending almost a 1000 dollars on this game, I'm just disappointed in the lack of direction and new player friendly content. Plarium itself is aware of this, and only cares about one thing.

Here we are, in my 6th year of playing this game and there have been changes. Some good, others bad, and since downright predatory. Let's start with the bad. Events and fusions have been getting harder and harder to compete for Free2Play players with higher and higher point requirements and the majority of the rewards top heavy. Fusions have become numerous, often coming in every other month which leaves the low spenders and again Free2Play players struggling. The good. There's new dungeons!

This is literally a reskin of about 15 other games. There's nothing new here, except the sheer number of times it begs you for money. The graphics are nice, but the gameplay is so shallow it hurts. There are paywalls everywhere in this game, and rewards earned while F2P are laughable. I do not understand how this game has such high ratings, and I would never recommend this.

I started this game when it was in beta and really enjoyed it. Was a bit grindy but so are all games of this genre. Over the past two years the amount of new PVE content has been almost non existant, faction wars meh. The only new content has been been focused around adding new heroes and PVP, these typically are the primary way companies earn money. While I completely understand the need to earn money there needs to be a bit of extra content, Void Tower would invigorate the player base IMHO.

To be honest your progress with this game will be slow if you do not purchase anything, but it is still possible to complete this game as free to play. The positives is that your brain will be exercised to plan strategies on using unique teams to complete in game dungeons and task with little resources. If you plan on playing a game might as well invest time, because if you are playing and you are complaining you do not have time to play it, then why play at all... Play if you love it...

I love this game a lot definitely could be better though, I love the game there is way to many pop-ups and it takes a couple minutes of what could be my playtime instead of not buying them because I am a free to play player. My only issue is why there are so many pop-ups if you could reduce the time they pop up that would be a great help playing and advancing through the game!

The game has a lot of potential with great graphics and effects but that's where it ends. A total lack of new content and the constant delays of things like Battlepass, Void tower, ability to farm skill books etc, which players have been asking and asking for, all to make way for this tag (whale) arena which nobody wanted. Meanwhile the classic arena is of full of old idle accounts way too powerful for newer players to progress even out of bronze is a joke. I could go on but....

Good game overall but the chances of upgrading artifacts are way too low. 200k to get to upgrade an artifact to level 16 is too expensive, and having to pay to unequip any artifact is a little bit too much..Also it would be better if we could accomplish the progress missions in no particular order instead of being stuck on a task for ages and not getting any rewards for the ones we already achieved.

Absolutely great game, Has a little bit of everything for every type of game, strategic planning with an RPG feel and an in depth story on top of that what more could you ask for? I mean it's free as well, but for those nay sayers out there thinking "yea I bet it's a great game after spending like $50 to get some good stuff." WRONG!!! I haven't spent a dime and I'm almost level 20 and just started a few hours again and have a decently boss team. Well done.😀

I'll try to give my most honest constructive criticism as I can. Pros: 1) Graphics, one of the best looking phone games there 2) Gameplay, very addictive and very fun so far 3) Progression, It feels like a journey, not forced nor stalled Cons 1) Forced popups for payed features, tho there is option to turn the notifications off, but even if you turn those off, you still get some I know there's considerably less cons but the weight of the con balance the weight if pros, thus I'm giving 3*

Experiencing problems. Internet is good. I don't know. From start was going ok. Logged in using Facebook. It frozed. Couldn't play vs or nothing. Did let play as guest, but also frozed when trying look at characters. I guess it's just me. Game looks fun to play. Tried uninstalling and reinstalling. Nothing! No other role play games frozed on me. So... Was going give 2, but since it did actually let play. I'll give it a 3. Till I can or you can fix? I'll go up 4. Stays 3 for right now. 👌

I enjoy this game quite a bit as a time killer. I like the mechanics of how the game runs and the challenges of working with what you got to consider champion skills and synergy to maximize your team's effectiveness in various campaign, dungeon, and arena environments. Like most p2w games, you can spend tons of money getting farther faster, but if you spend wisely you can make progress just fine. For f2p you can still make slower progress. The game is very RNG based, so luck comes into play.

Really good game if you dont mind grinding, you can set to auto during battles and farm items and coins, graphics are top notch . Dont like paying a lot of money to play a mobile phone game but at least there is a variety of packs to buy instead of paying 100 for 1 pack like some other games out there, can be ftp or play cheaper...changed rating ..able to log in again thanks for fixing 👍

I will not lie, this is a pay to win experience. However this game is quite Enjoyable and challenging As a free to play player. You have to go after whatever quest will give you energy and gem rewards. There really is a good amount you can do to grow stronger even as free to play; And to be honest it is quite a fun way to play. There will be annoying moments in which you run out of energy, whales in the arena that are hard to defeat, and champions you can't get. Overall though I recommend.

Extremely Fun! However, energy doesn't refresh at a fast enough rate and silver is used for basically everything in the game. To progress at a steady pace; you have to spend actual money. Lower some in-game silver costs and increase the energy refresh rate, and this game would get a 5⭐️ review from me. More promo codes would sure help too!

Terrible customer service.. you can't actually speak with anyone to get help if you have a problem you will just get a automated email. I changed phones and it won't let me log in on my new phone I've tried everything. I'm just glad I figured this company out before I spent a lot of money on the game. Luckily I'm only out 15-20$.

Extremely P2W. You almost never get blue summon crystals or higher (takes a lot of patience and dedication to get one) they want you to buy the summon packs, which are heavily priced. Ads constantly pop up in your face when you go back to the main screen. The drop rates for epic heros is extremely low, thus diminishing the worth of buying summon packs. It takes hours to burn through 200 energy. Go play Summoners War instead. At least that feels rewarding.

This game is UNDOUBTEDLY one of the better games of any platform I have played yet. I enjoyed playing it and I have been playing it for over an year! The building up a Champion for something, strategizing in certain places to get higher, wait for a certain time and pull your shards to get champs and have a laugh or cry. It was and still is (somewhat) a lot of fun for me. However, this game has flaws. Overall, enjoyable to play if you are F2P. Just ignore all the ads in the beginning.

Decent enough game... only reason i am not giving 5 stars is the rng on shards being in favor of the developers (pay to win), there's no percentage rate on artifact upgrades (just certain high medium and low), and no way to boost the percentage on the artifacts like other games of this catagory (though it has b3en made up for with a ton of freebies).. besides that, very decent rock,paper,scissor turn based rpg.. if you can get past the small issues I've stated i think you will enjoy..

In terms of a case by case basis, customer support is lacking. Imagine spending good money on a game, and one of the things you spend money on is a daily login reward, and you're unable to log in one day due to technical difficulties and they say they won't compensate you, i'm not speaking in terms of money, they won't give you some sort of in game compensation for your troubles. I've never seen that in a mobile game before.

Been playing this game on and off since launch and I gotta say no matter how many times I quit, it keeps pulling me back in. Partly I'll admit since I feel invested, as I've spent a good amount in this game. But coming back now after 2 years, with all the new champs, my account def doesn't feel like a spenders account. There will always be new shiny toys u have to keep up with. But the core game I like. Would recommend playing but not spending:D

I seriously don't know what to say, this game is okay until you play for a couple weeks. I've maxed out my starting champion and still can't do anything in the events. It's impossible this far.is strictly pay to win "oh we try to balance F2P and purchases." Bs this game has it's biggest events on the 1st and 15th (a lot of people's pay day) it's designed to give you a boosted start but then it's just P2W and there's no point of playing this game save your time if youre not interested in spending

There are a few things keeping me from continuing playing this game. First of which is data the data usage of this game, like alot of people in the states I have a very small data allowance from my isp and between this game and other apps I use daily I would never have enough to make it through to the subsequent month. Next is a minor reason but one that could improve the "quality of life" which is the time it takes to do the daily missions, if that went a bit faster I'd be more satisfied.

At first I was enjoying the game but it became very evident that if I wanted to progress after the initial start I would need to P2W. I am ok putting a few dollars in but the amounts it asks for is absolutely ridiculous and unreasonable for a mobile game, I can buy full console games for less then some of the packs

A decent game that is unfortunately strangled by some of the most incredibly overpriced microtransactions I've ever seen. 30 Euros for some gems and an equipment set that isn't even that great is very insulting. Hundreds of much higher quality games on PC and console are worth less than that. This monetization is predatory and focused on the big-spender whales.

The kind of manipulation when they ask to save a Tutorial progress under a new account just so that you can get into your old progress. Just imagine that every time you reinstall the game for any reason , you have to save that tutorial progress under a new account. Micro transactions are there and highly encouraged to purchase, but there's just no need in my opinion. 5 stars. Make a CYBERPUNK version!!!

I have had a love hate relationship with this game. From the grind to how my champions fight on auto to the excitement of getting my first legendary. Now I'm not going to say pay 2 win is great (it's not) but this game balances it pretty well. Silver is not hard to get, gems are easy enough to save (I look at them more as a bonus and luxury anyways) and if you save shards for the boost events you can definitely get some end game Champs.

Fun game but, my God, it's super grindy and the ads for pay to win are absolutely awful. I get 42 pop ups when I first open the game, then another 23 after looking at my champions or opening some other in game window. We get it, I can drop hundreds of dollars for the slightest boost. Oh, why does it cost money to change gear, what sense does that make? Dumb AF

My first review was 2* back a year ago when the game wasn't making changes that reflected what the community wanted with the game. Things have improved from a year ago, though some features I'm still yearning for, especially since I play this game very regularly. I hope that a way to effectively grind skill tomes as well as a legendary duplicate system is still in the works, but a lot of other aspects of the game have improved, and I'm glad to update my rating.

Its pretty nice and straightforward, but like most there are a TON of popups that show the incredible pay to win nature. +1 star for artwork and animations Really though, this game wants about 2GB of storage! I cant import it to my SD (bc its an app) and so the space requirement is VERY misleading. Deleted for that reason.

Gameplay is smooth and the Graphics are decent. The popups for buying packs and items in the store happens everytime the game loads. You're also put into a playing stand still until you grind enough for upgrades. That tactic to almost force you into buying items. I uninstalling for that reason.

This game is more like a casino game rather than an actual game. The graphics are not so special and the story to. And for the end the mechanic it s not help the players when they play. It s an ultra pay to win and if you pay a logic amount of money it will be nothing show dont spend your money and even worse your time in this game I m taking from experience.

This game could not be worse if it tried to be. Firstly you have to get through fifteen adds just to be able to start the game i counted. Oh and everything on it costs too god damn much money and nothing has been changed for the better. I keep coming back cause i see the online adds and thw the tv adds and nothing has been done to even make this game playable yet enjoyable to play. If i could give every single part of this game a rating i would give it a zero rating across the board.

Definitely geared to pay to win. I would not spend any cash on it (shards) because the actual chance of getting a decent champion is VERY LOW. The game is very playable and entertaining. Just don't expect to rise to the top anytime soon. All things considered I will play it until something else catches my eye.

To much content to do and not enough ways to speed it up, so you need to spend too much time playing the game, and I'm the last update they made it so that if you minimize the game for more than a minute it restarts, which is really stupid, cause I can't have the game open all the time, sometimes I need to use my phone for phone things. Idk why they insist on making this game worse with updates

The grinds are outrageous once you start hitting mid levels. Potion drop rates are ridiculously low in higher level dungeons, gear upgrades & drops suck, character rolling of rare crystal's often gives you lease valuable characters. not enough energy to grind needs. concept and play is fun, and I p2p many games, but this game is too $ greedy for your return & enjoyment. I'm done with this game. not worth my time and energy for what you actually get by paying.

Absolute waste from a spam company Everywhere I look this game is advertised. Every video I watch is sponsored by this game. Not only is it spammed in your face everywhere, it's a bad game. Most of the game is behind a payment wall, the missions are mostly repetitive and it basically becomes an idle mmo simulator that you pay to do anything real in.

Would rate it more if the drops would have been better, no legendary hero and i've been playing for months, other than that you can finish the campaign and reach gold arena without paying anything, so it's free to play up to a certain point, depends on the hero drops. Edit : it seems that something changed in the arena, all of them are better than they should, 80% have gorgorab to increase speed and damage and you are done if you do not work on your speed

It's ok when you first start. But than it goes down hill. You have to spend way too much money to get champions an than you have to spend even more money to max them out. It's horrible how much books are to upgrade your skills. The campaign mode isn't that good. After you beat it on normal the story ends. So that is boring. Getting shards without buying them sucks. I only got 3 of the top shard since I've been playing.

Game is fun and challenging however, having to close 5-6 "pay to win" packs anytime I do anything is super annoying. I always try to spend a few bucks on a game I enjoy to help the developers but the packs are so overpriced I dont imagine I'll play this game long. Hardly anything under $10 that feels remotely worth it.

The good, bad and the ugly. Good: challenging progression game that is different for each user. Developers update game and make changes frequently. The bad: most of the time, store has overpriced items for what they are actually worth. The events are for cash whales, not normal players. The ugly: NIGHTMARE MODE. 16 energy and 3-6 item stars. Should be 10 and 4-6 as it would MATCH the pattern. Clearing dungeons and getting a champion or shards instead of gear. ADD it with gear. Duh Plarium!!!

The game is even greedier than Summoners Wars and that says a lot. It constantly bombards you with paid offers, really annoying to deal with pop-ups and blicking alerts on the paid content. The mechanics of the game work but the commercial element is so strong and forcefull this feels more like a slot machine.

rewriting the review and upping a star. my original review wasnt happy with the constant ads for micro transactions, however, you can definitely play without spending any money on it. it has become a game I always have running because I love the heros and the loot. just a great game. got all my friends playing too which makes having a clan even cooler.

The game is fun. I originally built up 5 players. Now i spend all my time boosting stats to players i'm not even gonna use just to use them as upgrades for my favorite players. It too time consuming and it forces you to constantly start over from scratch with a new batch and repeat the same thing over and over again.

It's enjoyable, but I would recommend playing for a while until you learn how to play efficiently, then delete your account and start over to use the near infinite energy you get during your first few days for a better start. Most of the events are not designed to be completed by low-level accounts without spending a lot of money. Finally, Plarium doesn't understand the "micro" in micro transaction, expect $20 to get what $1 to $5 would get in other games.

Out of all turn-based RPGs, this one is top tier. The character designs and story is really compeling. The only issue Iv'e had is the luck percentage. The probabilities are too low. Whether in the summon or the rewards after beating a campaign stage. I also purchased primal shards once but I only got nameless heroes. I still think about that and it hurts. Also, why do summoning requires coin? What's the use of the shard if you can't use without coins. Thankfully, the game is generous about it.

The tag team arena is as big a mess as the regular arena used to be. The game totally depends on getting the right champions which is next to impossible. Getting the great ones is far too hard. You receive way too many useless duplicate champions. Their customer service sucks! Upgrading artifacts becomes next to impossible and it's boring and takes too long to get enough money. The milestones in the tournaments are ridiculously high and the rewards are pathetic. Everything is so expensive.
